notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance - September 25th
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5kjj54nt/250415_maintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 25th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 3 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
-Time-
Thursday, September 25th
Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 10:00 AMEastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CEST, UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEST, UTC +10): 12:00 AM (September 26th) - 3:00 AM (September 26th)
To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.The Metropolitan High School Box is ending. Grab your uniform before it's gone!The 3rd Season of the Erinn Adventure Pass is starting and is sure to be electrifying with rewards!Go live and have your Milletian streaming with the Livestream Star Box! 
The following bugs will be fixed:
Minor typo fixes. Thank you for the continued reports!The in-game reporting function has been fixed and will no longer give an "e-2" error.We've renamed the following hotkey setting to be clearer:Messenger Window --> Friends List
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Erinn Adventure Pass - Season 3
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/axzckya3/v2_250924-wgc-2466-erinnpassevent-940x290.jpg
We've leveled up the Erinn Pass this time around with some electrifying rewards! Complete different tasks to update the Pass and gain rewards each time the Pass levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can purchase a Special Erinn Pass Expansion ticket to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.
[hr][/hr]
Season Dates: Thursday, September 25th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 11th, Before Maintenance
Erinn Adventure Pass[table noborder=true][tr][td]Upon logging in during Erinn Adventure Pass Season 3, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Chronicling an Adventure.Talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register a main character.You can only participate with one character, and this CANNOT be changed.To open the Erinn Adventure Pass, on the main task bar click on Character → Erinn Adventure Pass.You can also set a hotkey shortcut for it in Options → Game → Control → Hotkey Settings.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1694/ui-bubble.png[/td][/tr][/table]
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tqyh0bfc/eap-ui-v2.png
With the Pass, you will receive a wide list of Daily missions for you to choose from, including but certainly not limited to:Completing Part Time JobsPlaying Musical InstrumentsCompleting a Uladh DungeonClearing Glenn Bearna**New** Defeat 1 Boss of Brí LeithAnd many, many more!Daily missions reset every day at 7:00 AM Server Time.
Adventure Level
[table noborder=true][tr][td]Each time you complete a task, the mission will automatically complete and you will receive Adventure EXP.Collect Adventure EXP to raise the Pass Grade.There are 50 grades in total. A maximum of 280 Adventure EXP can be earned per day.The limit is reset every day at 7:00 AM Server Time.You can earn 1.5x more total Adventure EXP during the weekends (starting and ending at 7:00 AM Server Time).You can also use additional Erinn Pass EXP Tickets to increase your Adventure EXP.The Adventure EXP gained from using an Erinn Pass EXP Ticket is not subject to the daily Adventure EXP limit.The Erinn Pass EXP Tickets can be purchased from the Item Shop.The Erinn Pass EXP Ticket has a weekly limit of 5 and resets on Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time.[/td][td][table noborder=false][tr][th]Erinn Pass EXP Ticket[/th][/tr][tr][td width=25%]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1653/grade-up.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Price: 2,100 NX
BUY NOW
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[table noborder=true][tr][td]Special Erinn Pass ExpansionIn addition to the normal rewards, there are also Special Rewards.Special Rewards can only be obtained after being unlocked via the Special Erinn Pass.The Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket can be purchased from the Item Shop.Purchasing a Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket will not reset your progress and will allow you to collect the special rewards of the levels you've unlocked instantly.[/td][td width=25%][table noborder=false][tr][th]Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket[/th][/tr][tr][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1652/special-pass.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Price: 21,700 NX
BUY NOW
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

Rewards
Season 3 of the Erinn Adventure Pass contains various items such as AP Potions, Erg Unlock Assist Potions, Lightning-themed Chairs and Titles, and more!Normal Rewards can be claimed any time you reach a new level.Special Rewards can be unlocked using a Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket.For each normal grade unlocked, you will unlock up to the same special grade reward.Note: You can only Claim Rewards while the Erinn Adventure Pass season is active. Unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character’s Point Inventory after the season ends.
Normal Rewards
Normal Rewards can be claimed any time you reach a new level.If you complete all Pass Levels, you’ll receive the Erinn Adventure Pass Season 3 Conqueror 2nd Title!All items from the Normal Rewards track are not tradeable.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 18th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:17 AM and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 18th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
-Time-
Thursday, September 18th
Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AMEastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEST, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 3:00 AM (September 19th)
To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.Windows Update.Cash Shop Update.Adding 3 more new channels: Channel 14, 15, and 16. Channels 14 and 16 will not be raid channels.Channel population of the other channels will not be adjusted.The winners of the first Community Pet Poll have been selected with over 1,700 Milletians having voted! These pets will be brought back to the cash shop for the next 3 months. Be sure to give us your thoughts on what other pets you'd like to see go on sale or brought back!1st Place - Thunderbird (30% off)2nd Place - Golden Pig (20% off)3rd Place - Shark Robe Seal (10% off)Test your Summer Festival training results in the challenging Malign Hellgate Event!Wind down after the Summer Festival and relax with other Milletians in A Campfire for All Event!
The following bugs will be fixed:
[strike]The in-game reporting function has been fixed and will no longer give an "e-2" error.[/strike] After further testing, this issue will require additional time to fix.We've cleaned up the few Pet Medals on the Auction House that were still untranslated.Spiders had filled in the entire back of the Cobweb Wings giving them a solid color. We've dusted those off so they'll display correctly just in time for Samhain season.We've renamed the following settings to be more clearer:Open/Close Interface --> Show/Hide User Interface (UI)Open/Close Character Name --> Show/Hide Character NameThe Tiger Cub Whistle was refusing to accept its true colors earlier, but is now called the Yellow Tiger Cub Whistle.Lightning and Thunder Dragons pets? Too confusing. We've condensed the naming to all be just "Thunder" Dragons.We've cleaned up the naming convention of Stat Stones that were obtainable through past Samhain events to be more clearer.Additional Stat Stone (Regular) --> Additional Stat Stone (Primary)Additional Stat Stone (Secondary) --> Additional Stat Stone (Unique)Mandrakes are important for potion making! HP, MP, and Stamina 300 Potion RE now correctly lists Mandrakes as one of it's vital ingredients.
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Malign Hellgate Event
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/0elpt3lo/250915-wgc-2449-mb-malignhellgateevent-1400x300-v2.png
Tech Duinn beckons for Milletians to band together and uncover a new portal allowing for even greater dungeon challenges. Prizes and glory await... Can you handle what this new mode has to offer or will you succumb to the depths of Hellgate?
[hr][/hr]
Table of Contents
Event DetailsEntering HellgateHellgate Missions and QuestsHellgate RewardsHellforged Adventure RingsSecond TitlesHellgate Remnants 
 [hr][/hr]
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, September 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 13th, Before Maintenance
Log in to receive the quest [Guide] Hellgate Investigation Participation.No rewards are given for completing the Guide Quest.Find the Hellgate Researcher in the Tech Duinn Lobby to learn more about the increased dangers that occurred due to the newly spawned portal.Unlike other events in the Summer Festival, you will not be able to teleport directly to the NPC.You’ll be asked to register a Main Character to partake in the event.It’s recommended to register with your most powerful character on your account for this event.Your registered character will need to have completed Generation 22 and access to the Tech Duinn Lobby.Hellgate Mode will take after the 4 regular Tech Duinn Missions with a significant difficulty increase.
Entering this mode will not count towards your Tech Duinn weekly limit.You will not receive regular Tech Duinn rewards in this mode.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dtphq2gm/hellgate-entrance.png

Entering Hellgate
Entering Hellgate requires Milletians to be in a party of 4 to proceed.
The created party cannot be a squad, concert, or mini-game party.All members of the party will need to be the registered character on their account.The party leader will need to talk to the Hellgate Researcher to open the Hellgate UI Menu, allowing you to customize the difficulty modifier.The Hellgate UI Menu has 5 slots available to adjust the difficulty, ranging from Level 1 to Level 25. 
Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones are required to increase the difficulty level.Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones range from Level 1 to Level 5, empowering the modifier it is slotted into.
You can acquire these stones as an end reward in each Hellgate mission.
Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones received at the end reward will be determined by the Hellgate Level mission in the table below.Alternatively, Sealed Hellgate Proving Stones can be acquired through Sealed Hellgate Level # Proving Stone Boxes from the Hellgate Researcher’s shop for 1,000,000 gold each.
Note: While you are allowed to purchase any level box from the shop, the highest level of your investigations from the week prior will determine the level of Proving Stone Boxes that can be opened.
Example: Completing only Level 13 as the highest level will only allow you to open up to Sealed Hellgate Level 3 Proving Stone Boxes.[table][tr][th]Hellgate Level[/th][th]Stone Level Earned (Reward) / Purchased from Store (Box)[/th][/tr][tr][td]0 - 4[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 1) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 1 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]5 - 9[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 2) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 2 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]10 - 14[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 3) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 3 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]15 - 19[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 4) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 4 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]20 - 25[/td][td]Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone (Level 5) / 
Sealed Hellgate Level 5 Proving Stone Box[/td][/tr][/table]Depending on the indentation the Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone is slotted into, the mission will provide different effects:
HP Increase:
Increases the health of the boss. The higher the level of the stone, the more HP the boss has.Defense Decrease:
Decreases the defense and protection of players. The higher the level of the stone, the lower the characters’ defense and protection are.Blighting Orb:
An orb will appear around the battlefield, rapidly losing health. Overhealing it will provide a buff to those within range. Failure to heal will cause a debuff to those within range.Burning Earth: 
The player furthest from the boss will be targeted. After a set amount of time, the ground beneath will begin to burn, dealing damage to any players still inside.Withering Doom:
Continuous mark that will appear over the player closest to the boss, dealing damage that continuously stacks.Any party member can slot a Sealed Hellgate Proving Stone into the indentation on the UI.Players will start immediately at the boss of that level when entering.
Note: The Researcher is unable to learn everything about what's inside, thus turning to you. Milletians will need to work together to learn what's different about these bosses…//g.nexonstatic.com/media/2j0pf4si/hellgate-ui.png

Hellgate Missions and Quests
The Investigation is focusing on specific missions each week. As such, entry into other missions are closed until the appropriate week:The dates of when Hellgate Missions open are as follows:[table][tr][th]Mission[/th][th]Investigation Begin Date[/th][/tr][tr][td]Revived Illusion[/td][td]September 18th, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td]Feth Fiada[/td][td]October 2nd, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td]Awakened Abyssal Lord[/td][td]October 16th, 2025[/td][/tr][tr][td]Seven Nightmares[/td][td]October 30th, 2025[/td][/tr][/table]Investigations into each mission will reset weekly (Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time), in which you’ll be rewarded up to 20x Hellgate Remnants depending on how many challenge levels you and your party completed the week prior.In addition, the Hellgate Researcher will provide the player with 3 investigation quests with unique rewards.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zulddkbo/hellgate-quests-v3.png
Hellgate Rewards
Hellforged Adventure Rings
After completing the quest Hellgate Investigation (Intermediate), you’ll be given an exclusive Hellforged Adventurer Ring Selection Box. Be sure to open it to choose between boxes, each containing a powerful ring allowing you to empower yourself with physical or magical enchantments of Hellgate. Be sure to open this box before the end of the event however… Hellgate will reclaim it otherwise.

Fantasy Life Changes
Unvisited Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates will be semi-transparent until visited for the first time.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrajw0az/mana-tunnel-map-merged.png
Right-clicking an item will now list options to search and list the item on the Auction House.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zqoas4m3/right-click-menu.png
When searching the Auction House: Pet Adoption Medals, Blacksmith Manuals, and Sewing Patterns will contain the full name.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/g0pf5luw/auction-house-improvement.png
Preset Character Models have been refreshed for new accounts and premium character cards during character creation.The pop-up box will no longer appear when attempting to enter a dungeon room where a battle is active.When changing channels, you can now double-click the channel name in the list to move.Two new functions have been added to items when the Inventory Magnifying Glass window is open:
You can preview weapons, clothing/armor, and chairs.
You can search items directly that are listable on the Auction House.The Auction House has added security measures to assist with your daily trading and shopping:
The warning message has been enhanced to give more notice when attempting to purchase or sell an item 90+% higher or lower than the average price.Warning messages have been added when attempting to purchase non-repairable items that have 20% or less durability/use.Options for Hair Styles, Eye Shapes, Faces, and Mouths have been revised in the Dressing Room so the most recent additions will appear at the top.Sick of having to go outdoors to warp? We are too… so we’ve addressed that! You can now warp indoors when using the following warp functions:
The Arcana Room via your Character UI Menu.Festia via your Character UI Menu.Doki Doki Island via the Soulmate UI Menu.The Star Citadel via skill use.Guild Hall via the Guild Hall UI Menu.Event NPCs through the Event UI Menu.Feedback heard! We’ve updated the Astral Reave Dan Tests to be slightly less difficult. You will now receive 35 points instead of 30 when attacking an enemy with Astral Reave.Additional search fields have had their case sensitivity removed:Guild UI MenuPoint InventoryParty BoardProduction Crafting ListsBard BulletinWhen picking up equipment from the ground, the logic has been modified so it will no longer be equipped to the character’s style tab automatically.
The equipment can still be automatically slotted into the character’s equipment tab as normal if the equipment tab slot is empty.The following appearance scrolls have been renamed to indicate that they are applied onto two-handed axes, not scythes, despite visually being scythes:
Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Moonshadow Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Duskveil Emissary's Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll -> Frost Great Scythe Appearance Scroll (2H Axe)Following the Magic Attack Changes in July, adjustments to ease the difficulty have been made to most RP missions where the Magic Talent is a focus.[Element] Alchemy skills have been properly unified in name, matching the format of the current Earth Alchemy Mastery skill: 
Fire Alchemy -> Fire Alchemy MasteryWind Alchemy -> Wind Alchemy MasteryWater Alchemy -> Water Alchemy MasteryBug Fixes
We’ve been continuing to address G27 via several fixes throughout the month. Thanks for all the reports - we very much appreciate these, and we hope that you’re enjoying the story!
Zap-happy Dark Diviners with Thunderblight and specific timing could accidentally destroy the enemies during one of the G27 cutscenes, creating a time paradox where nothing further would happen! ...Until you left and tried again, that is. The enemies have been adjusted to no longer be defeated during the cutscene. Fixed an issue causing the game to close when previewing one of the following chairs: 
Kanna Tanning ChairEirlys Tanning ChairElsie Tanning ChairDai Tanning ChairKaour Tanning ChairLogan Tanning ChairShuan Tanning ChairChristmas Dessert TableElegant Afternoon Tea TableThrough your reports, we found and fixed a few more Sewing Patterns where the pattern had gone mysteriously blank.

Bugs fixed during the August 28th Maintenance
Addressed the channel lag by adding new channels and redistributing channel population capacities. See the August 28th Maintenance Patch Notes for the full details! More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel!As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. Robes that were crafted in this incorrect way have been corrected automatically. The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:
[Dual Guns]
Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers
[Control Bars]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer Tricksters
Perseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars
[Knuckles]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer Vagabonds
Perseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented KnucklesAdditionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type (ie. Nightbringer Warlord Greatsword).
Bugs fixed during the August 21st Maintenance
Fixed some Generation 27 typos as reported by our Milletians.Known Bugshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngAn e-2 error is occasionally causing in-game Player Reports to fail to send. In the meanwhile, if you need to submit a report we ask that you use our Player Support website.There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.

Hello Milletians!

We'll be having a mid-cycle patch with a few upcoming changes.

Table of Contents:
Return of the Over the Rainbow EventChannel Increase and ReductionBug Fixes
Return of the Over the Rainbow Event
In our previous announcement, we shared about the various issues that were discovered and needed to be addressed to ensure the gameplay was fair for all Milletians. The biggest issue was the efficiency in which Milletians could acquire rewards through Leprechauns, particularly Dapper. To prevent high-valued rewards from being flooded into the game's economy and ensure that the rewards still have value after the event, the following adjustments have been made:
A weekly Leprechaun Encounter Limit will be added to Uladh Hard Mode Advanced, Tech Duinn, and Crom Bás Dungeons.Crom Bás: 10 EncountersTech Duinn: 15 EncountersUladh Hard Mode Advanced: 15 EncountersThis limit functions separately from the dungeon reward limit.The weekly encounter limit will reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT.With the addition of this limit, the encounter rate for higher-grade Leprechauns has been slightly increased for both Tech Duinn and Crom Bás.Leprechauns will no longer spawn in the Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares mission. Initially, a Leprechaun would spawn when Cethlenn would reach 20% health, but would cause the Leprechaun to despawn if Cethlenn was defeated.Due to the nature of this bug and to ensure a timely return of the event, this particular Tech Duinn mission has been excluded.[table noborder=1][tr][td]The Over the Rainbow Event will resume this Thursday after maintenance and will be extended for 2 weeks after its original end date, with the new end date being October 30th (Before Maintenance).[/td][td width=40%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/doto52nn/otr-ticket.png[/td][/tr][/table]
We greatly apologize for the inconvenience that the temporary suspension and adjustment of the event has caused. As compensation, the following rewards will be provided via a Hotday Event for all accounts from August 28th to September 11th:
Service Error Compensation Box (Expires in 30 Days)5x Unlimited Dungeon Pass Boxes (Expires in 7 Days)Each Box contains 3x Unlimited Dungeon Passes (Expires in 7 Days)3x Holy Water of Murias (No Expiration)Applying this item to equipment can grant a powerful random effect.Once applied, the equipment will be untradeable and cannot be stored in the Dressing Room unless removed.Please refer to our Generation 27: The Garden of Solace Update Notes for more details and information.1x Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 Days) (No Expiration)All items received are untradeable and can only be claimed once per account.
Channel Increase and Reduction
With the Summer Festival in full swing, we have noticed a significant increase in Milletians both joining for the first time and returning to Erinn! As mentioned previously, we are aware that these growing pains are not without issues, particularly lag amongst all channels. 

In this upcoming maintenance, our first update aimed at addressing the recent performance will be taking place:
3 new channels will be added to the server, for a total of 13 channels.Channel 11Channel 12Channel 13Adjusting the channel population to be uniform for all channels.
While these adjustments are just an initial step, we will continue to share about the changes made to the game. In the weeks following we will be monitoring these changes and these new channels for stability and overall improvements. Following changes to be made include improvements to the server hardware, the inclusion of more channels as needed, and more as our changes uncover other issues or point us towards areas of greater focus. 

Thank you for your patience as we continue to make further adjustments as necessary to bring you the best Mabinogi.

Bug Fixes
More text fixes added for Generation 27. We're still working on our polish for this Generation based on our own playthroughs and your reports, and we're still eternally grateful! More is yet to come as this giant-sized generation is brought to heel!As accidentally (we swear!) showcased by GM Quuku and GM Hongenjo during the Brí Leith stream, the hard cap on Protection was not set, allowing damage reduction to increase up to 100% instead of capping at 90%. This hard cap will be put in properly with this update, though this requires very high values that can be difficult or impossible for players to reach.In rare circumstances crafting recipes using the Destructive Crest that are expected to be 99.9% completion in one tap would incorrectly finish at less than this. This issue has been corrected, and any players who encountered this issue are encouraged to contact Player Support to have their robe corrected.The following armor pieces have been renamed to match their materials:Saint Guardian's Leather Armor [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Breastplate [M/F]Saint Guardian's Leather Helmet [M/F] -> Saint Guardian's Battle Helmet [M/F]In order to properly reflect the multiple weapons that come with it, the following weapons have been renamed:[Dual Guns]Nightbringer Vanquisher -> Nightbringer Vanquishers[Control Bars]Nightbringer Trickster -> Nightbringer TrickstersPerseus Conflict Control Bar -> Perseus Conflict Control Bars[Knuckles]Nightbringer Vagabond -> Nightbringer VagabondsPerseus Tormented Knuckle -> Perseus Tormented KnucklesAdditionally in a future patch, based on feedback from the Soul Liberator weapons, we will be looking to rename the Nightbringer weapons to include the Weapon Type.

- The Mabinogi Team

Obtain a free one through the Test Your Metal Event!The new Blanc Patisserie Box is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth cravings Milletians may have!The Black Combo Card Event has been extended by 1 week, giving you a little more time to complete those cards just the way you want them.Lorna and Pan are packing up all their Memory of a Story books. Last chance to purchase or earn a few free ones in the Box full of Memories Event!Additionally, we're adding/removing several items to/from the Web Shop. Take a look!
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Over the Rainbow Event
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ta2np5ww/250805-wgc-2283-mb-overtherainbowevent-1400x300.png
A glimmer of gold dances on the horizon… Leprechauns are spreading across Erinn! During this colorful event, brave solo Milletians can earn a chance to encounter elusive and rare Leprechauns with unique treasures. Ready to chase the rainbow? Check out the details below.
[hr][/hr]
Update: This event has been updated. Please review the changes in the Leprechaun section.
Event Dates: Thursday, August 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 30th, Before Maintenance
Event Details
Upon logging in during the event dates, the event will automatically be active! There’s no need to register a main character like typical events.*Certain dungeons and missions will have a chance to drop special items as additional rewards!
This can be done either in solo or party-play![table][tr][th]Uladh Hardmode Advanced Dungeons (Alby, Ciar, Rundal)[/th][td]Up to 2x Broken Magic Essences[/td][td rowspan=6]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/15ln1yqi/august-milletian-cameos.png[/td][/tr][tr][th]Elite Shadow Missions[/th][td]Up to 4x Erinn's Spirit[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]Tech Duinn Missions[/th][td]Normal Mode: Up to 2x Geass Materials & Ruination Weapon Materials[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hard Mode: Up to 3x Geass Materials & Ruination Weapon Materials[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]Crom Bás[/th][td]Crom Bás (0~30%): 
• Up to 1x additional Grumpy Cat’s Marble 
• Up to 1x Glas Ghaibhleann Material (Glas Ghaibhleann Heart, Damaged Glas Ghaibhleann Feather) have a chance to drop[/td][/tr][tr][td]Crom Bás (40~70%): 
• Up to 2x additional Glas Ghaibhleann Materials (Glas Ghaibhleann Heart, Damaged Glas Ghaibhleann Feather)[/td][/tr][/table]
Note: When participating in Crom Bás while solo during the event period, you'll be automatically revived upon incapacitation.
Leprechauns
[table noborder=1][tr][td]If you’re on the hunt for lucky loot goblin Leprechauns, you’ll need to dive into the above dungeons and missions while playing solo![/td][td width=35%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/oc1psvkj/rewards-inventory-horizontal-diagram.png[/td][/tr][/table]There are four different Leprechauns you might encounter. Each has unique rewards based on hits as well as when you manage to defeat them! The types of Leprechauns found are:Treasure Hunting Giant LeprechaunSilvershine Giant LeprechaunGoldengleam Giant LeprechaunDapper Dandy Giant LeprechaunHigher-tier Leprechauns will grant chances at significantly more valuable! The higher the difficulty of the dungeon, the higher the chance of encountering a higher-tier leprechaun.Crom Bas Leprechaun RestrictionsLeprechauns will only appear in Crom Bás ≤30% Dark Erg. (Sorry Glas Ghaibhleann)You will only be able to encounter a Leprechaun a total of 10 times per week in Crom Bás, regardless of the reward limit.This limit is account-wide.Weekly encounter limit is reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM (Server Time).The spawn rate for higher-level Leprechauns has been slightly increased.Tech Duinn Leprechaun Restrictions
You will only be able to encounter a Leprechaun a total of 15 times per week in Tech Duinn.This limit is account-wide.Leprechauns will no longer spawn in the Seven Nightmares Mission.Weekly encounter limit is reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM (Server Time).The spawn rate for higher-level Leprechauns has been slightly increased.Uladh Advanced Hard Mode Dungeons
You will only be able to encounter a Leprechaun a total of 15 times per week in Uladh Advanced Hard Mode Dungeons.This limit is account-wide.Weekly encounter limit is reset on Thursdays at 7:00 AM (Server Time).
Erg[table noborder=1][tr][td]Erg Unlock Slot Materials are alternative unlock materials that can be used for Erg level cap increase.Basic Erg Unlock 1st~3rd Materials can be used for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Erg level cap increase respectively.Intermediate Erg Unlock 1st~3rd Materials can be used for 4th, 5th, and 6th Erg level cap increase respectively.Advanced Erg Unlock 1st~3rd Materials can be used for 7th, 8th, and 9th Erg level cap increase respectively.[/td][td width=13%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/y43dlttl/erg-slot-materials-icons.png[/td][/tr][/table]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/obnkl1bx/erg-slot-materials.png

Note: All items indicated with '(Event)', as well as Erg Unlock Slot Materials that are dropped by Leprechauns are bound to your character and untradable.

Note: When attempting to use any of the '(Event)' weapons below provided during the event duration for Erg Infusion, 0 experience points will be acquired.

notes.title: Test Your Metal Event
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lg0ic3wa/250805_wgc-2282_testyourmetalevent_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png
Ferghus is looking to give you a free weapon! We promise it's not a scam. Earn yourself a weapon on par with the Perseus weapons through his own craft and all he asks is to spread his good name throughout Erinn in return! Check out all the details below!
[hr][/hr]
Event Dates: Thursday, August 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 16th, Before Maintenance
Event Details
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Log in to receive the quest [Guide] You’re Un-Fergh-ettable!Meet with Ferghus in Tir Chonaill to learn more about the new set of weapons he’s created.
You can also warp to him directly by clicking the “To NPC” button in the Summer Festival UI.You may add/remove this event to/from your Event Icon List by clicking the “On/Off” buttons in the Summer Festival UI.[/td][td width=10%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wltc3pqv/tym-ui-icon.png[/td][/tr][/table]
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ckubiwfw/summer-festival-ui-help.png
You’ll be asked to register a Main Character to partake in the event.Select the weapon you wish to acquire. This weapon will be on par with its Perseus Weapon counterpart.After confirming the weapon choice, Ferghus will provide the option to choose what kind of quests you’d like to complete to acquire enhancements for your new weapon. Your decision will determine what type of objectives you’ll need to complete to upgrade your new weapon.
Thrilling battles! - all objectives given will be combat-related, clearing dungeons, and dungeon-related storylines.Calming crafting and gathering - all objectives given will be life-related, ranging from commerce, gathering, and quests related to stardust.A little bit of everything - you will be given a mix of both combat and life-focused objectives.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sjun1zdr/test-your-metal-ui.png
Regardless of which objective path you choose, you’ll have 12 different tasks assigned to unlock all the rewards specifically designed for your new Fergseus weapon.Six of those tasks will be available the first week, with 2 additional tasks opening each week after on Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time.Check out all the exclusive enhancements you can earn to upgrade your weapon:
[table]
   [tr]
      [th width=8%]Week[/th]
      [th]Item[/th]
      [th]Additional Information[/th]
   [/tr]
   [tr]
      [th rowspan=6]1[/th][td]Special Fergseus Upgrade Hammer[/td][td]This unique hammer will automatically apply all of a weapon’s normal and gem upgrades in one go.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Fergseus Reforging Hammer[/td][td]This special reforging hammer will apply an optimized reforge, ensuring a helpful bonus.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Fergseus Prefix Enchant Box[/td][td]Will provide you with a custom-made Prefix Enchant Scroll to complement your weapon[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Fergseus Suffix Enchant Box[/td][td]Will provide you with a custom-made Suffix Enchant Scroll to complement your weapon[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/td][td rowspan=5]Allows you to choose between a Lucky Blue Upgrade Stone or Lucky Red Upgrade Stone.

Lucky Upgrade Stones allow you to perform a special upgrade on your weapon at 100% rate up to Level 5.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]2[/th][td]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]3[/th][td]Special Lucky Upgrade Stone Selection Box[/td][/tr][tr][td]Exceptional Special Upgrade Increase Scroll[/td][td rowspan=2]Boosts the Special Upgrade of your Fergseus weapon by +1, up to Level 7.[/td][/tr][tr][th rowspan=2]4[/th][td]Exceptional Special Upgrade Increase Scroll[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Blossoming Hope Gem[/td][td]
Upgrades the number of attribute slots on your reforged weapon to 3.

Note: Using this item first and then the Reforging Hammer will remove the extra attribute slots.
[/td][/tr][/table]All upgrade items can only be used on the Fergseus Weapon you currently own.All upgrade items are untradeable and expire within 60 days if not used.
Weapon Swapping
Did your hand slip and you selected the wrong weapon?
Ferghus will allow you to trade the weapon in for a different one once per day (resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT) with the following restrictions:You must still own the current Fergseus weapon you obtained.Any enhancements applied to the weapon acquired from the event can be reapplied.Objectives will need to be completed again to acquire the prizes.Any enhancements applied to the weapon not earned from the event will be lost.If the weapon has been turned into a Spirit Weapon or been imbued with Erg, it cannot be traded in.Please transfer the Erg or Spirit prior to trading in your weapon.

Generation 27: The Garden of Solace
Word travels across the land as Divine Beasts begin to appear once again. This time, however, rumors spread of a mysterious warrior who claims they can solve any problem that the famous Milletian can…
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Generation 27: The Garden of Solace has been added.Players who have completed Generation 26 will automatically receive the quest The Sign of the Comet.Players who have not completed Generation 26, but have reached at least Cumulative Level 5,000, will receive a window notification that the storyline is available for them to start if they so choose. You may start the storyline by clicking the “Start G27 The Garden of Solace” button in the Storyline Menu.Korean voiceover has been added to all characters in the story. You can adjust the volume of the voices through the Options menu by going to the following: Options → System →Sound → Voice Volume[/td][td width=30%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yhxcpaox/g27-story-message-ui.png[/td][/tr][/table]Completing Generation 27 Part 1 will reward the player with the following:Sister's Flower CrownCompleting Generation 27 Part 2 will grant the player with the following:: Brí Leith Dungeon unlockedwho Recalls the Unfading Garden titleSolace Prefix EnchantAcquire the Garden of Solace Collection Book to further enhance your MabiNovels by talking to Declan at the East Wind Camp in Port Ceann.Invite a G27 NPC to the Campfire Spirit.Revisit Generation 27 cutscenes by watching them anytime through the Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library.9 BGMs related to the G27: The Garden of Solace campaign have been added to the Jukeboxes for your Homestead and Moonlight Island.These songs can be unlocked through the C1-C7 Replay Reward Boxes.
Brí Leith Dungeon
Entry Details //g.nexonstatic.com/media/554fnkwr/bri-leith-dungeon-pass.png
Entry will be available through the Gate of Murias located at the Longa Desert Oasis in Connous.Dungeon Entry Conditions:Generation 27 completed.Cumulative Level 20,000 or higher.Arcana Total Level 200 or higher.A minimum of 1 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeon.Each party member must have a Bri Leith Dungeon Pass to enter.You may purchase passes from the NPC outside the dungeon Entrance Portal.
The price of purchasing a pass will increase depending on the number of passes you purchase during the week.These prices are applied account-wide.Purchased Dungeon Passes are good for 7 days.Dungeon Pass prices will reset every Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time.[table center=1][tr][th]Number of Passes Purchased[/th][th]Price (in Gold)[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]100,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]200,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]400,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]700,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]1,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]2,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]3,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]5,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]7,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]10[/td][td]10,000,000[/td][/tr][tr][td]11+[/td][td]50,000,000[/td][/tr][/table]
Retry & Checkpoints
RetryDuring battle, the party has the option to restart the current battle from the beginning by pressing the [RETRY] button at the top right of the screen.All players in the party must press the button to restart.CheckpointAllows the party to continue where they left off in the dungeon.After defeating a boss, a checkpoint save menu will appear, allowing you to save your status in the dungeon and re-enter at a later time.The checkpoint save will last until you’ve completed the next boss/cleared the dungeon, or canceled it outside at the gate.A new Dungeon Pass is required when exiting and re-entering the dungeon where you left off.When entering the dungeon through a checkpoint, ALL party members must be at the same checkpoint.
Revival Restrictions
Party members can be revived once per battle stage.Harmonic Saint’s Steadfast Soul ability can bypass this limit, allowing for a second revival for themselves.The limit is reset upon retrying or winning the battle.If all party members are incapacitated, the battle will automatically restart, regardless of the number of revivals the party has remaining.
Time Limit
Each stage of the dungeon has a set time limit.Should the fight exceed the time limit, the current battle will end and automatically be retried.
Reward Distribution
After defeating each stage of the dungeon, the party will be rewarded with one treasure chest.See Brí Leith Dungeon Reward Details section for more details on the rewards themselves.At first, the treasure chest can only be opened by the party leader.If the party leader does not open it after 30 seconds, anyone in the party can open the treasure chest.Upon opening the treasure chest, a special reward distribution UI will appear listing all the rewards that can be distributed to all party members currently in the dungeon.If a party member happens to re-enter the dungeon after the chest has been opened, they will be ineligible for reward distribution.Each eligible party member will roll the dice (1 to 100) for each item. The party member with the highest roll will win that item.If two or more winning party members rolled the same number on an item, a second tie-breaker roll will be initiated to break the tie.If you move to another location or exit the dungeon during the reward distribution, all items except for the ones you’ve already won will be automatically “passed over”.If a solo party opens the treasure chest, a reward choice UI will appear, allowing the player to select which items they’d like to discard/keep rather than the party reward distribution UI.
Other
A cooldown period of 30 seconds is applied when consuming a potion in the dungeon.Party members can only re-enter the dungeon when the party is not currently fighting a boss.
Brí Leith Rewards
Many new rewards have been added, allowing you to further empower your gear, Arcanas, and craft the most powerful weapons ever seen in Erinn - Soul Liberator weapons.
Rewards can be obtained after defeating each boss in the dungeon.With each boss defeated, each party member is guaranteed the following rewards:Trace of MemoryHoly Water of Murias (Not Tradeable)Further rewards are distributed through the reward distribution UI.Neither EXP nor Gold are awarded in the dungeon.[table noborder=1][tr][td]Defeating each of the 3 dungeon bosses will reward you with a Journal AchievementBri Leith - Defeat Vertrag of the Deep Roots (10 points)Bri Leith - Defeat Bronntanas (20 points)Bri Leith - Defeat [Final Boss] (30 points)[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/cpvmeowq/bri-leith-journal-achievements.png[/td][/tr][/table]Multiple titles are available to earn throughout the dungeon:who Broke the Comet’s OrbitMovement Speed +3%who Trampled the TramplerMovement Speed +3%the Ender of EuphoriaMovement Speed +3%the Agony and the EcstasyMax Damage +33Magic Attack +55Defense +30Magic Defense +30Protection +15Magic Protection +15Movement Speed +2%whose Memories Shall Never FadeMax Damage +33Magic Attack +55
Holy Water of Murias
[table noborder=1][tr][td]The following items have been added:Bri Leith Cascading WaterElixir of RealityHoly Water of MuriasHoly Water of Murias Cleansing Scroll[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ccphbqqn/holy-water-murias.png[/td][/tr][/table]Similar to Holy Flame, applying Holy Water of Murias will grant new effects towards equipment.Items that have had Holy Water of Murias applied will become untradeable.The Holy Water of Murias’ effect and untradeable status can be removed through the use of a Holy Water of Murias Cleansing Scroll.Holy Water of Murias can be either obtained by defeating a Bri Leith dungeon boss or through Handicrafting.The items required for crafting can be obtained through the Bri Leith Dungeon NPC Shop and through Bri Leith’s reward distribution.The potential list of effects on equipment blessed by Holy Water of Murias can be seen below:[table][tr][th width=40%]Effect Type[/th][th width=10%]Effect Value[/th][th width=40%]Effect Type[/th][th width=10%]Effect Value[/th][/tr][tr][td]Max Damage[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Max HP[/td][td]1~500[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Attack[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Max MP[/td][td]1~500[/td][/tr][tr][td]Strength[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Max Stamina[/td][td]1~500[/td][/tr][tr][td]Intelligence[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Natural HP Recovery[/td][td]1~500%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dexterity[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Natural MP Recovery[/td][td]1~500%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Will[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Natural Stamina Recovery[/td][td]1~500%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Luck[/td][td]1~30[/td][td]Healing Effect[/td][td]1~10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defense[/td][td]1~100[/td][td]Damage Balance[/td][td]1~5%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Defense[/td][td]1~100[/td][td]Critical Rate[/td][td]1~5%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Protection[/td][td]1~3[/td][td]Critical Damage[/td][td]1~5%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Protection[/td][td]1~3[/td][td]Piercing Resistance[/td][td]+1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Total Alchemic Element Damage[/td][td]1~50[/td][td]Music Buff Effect[/td][td]+1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marionette - Destructive Robe ChangesFour new robes have been added as a “stepping stone” for crafting a Destructive Robe:Void Robe (M)Void Robe (F)The Void Robes have Piercing Level 1.Abyssal Robe (M)Abyssal Robe (F)
The Abyssal Robes have Piercing Level 2.Six new Sewing Patterns for Tailoring have been added and can be found in the Dead-End Hallway Chests of Rundal Advanced Hardmode, Rundal Advanced, and Peaca Intermediate dungeons:Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (M)Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (F)Sewing Pattern - Abyssal Robe (M)Sewing Pattern - Abyssal Robe (F)Sewing Pattern - Destructive Robe (M) (Upgrade Only)Sewing Pattern - Void Robe (F) (Upgrade Only)A new item, Destructive Crest, has been added:This new item will be required for the Abyssal and Destructive Robes (Upgrade Path).The Destructive Crest can be crafted through Handicrafting.The number of dyeing channels for the Destructive Robe (M) and (F) have been improved from 4 to 6.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/np1incrp/mabinogi_2025_08_05_125615.png

Fantasy Life Changes
Bag Tag Improvements
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]We’ve added MORE tags to better help you filter your inventory space!Star ReflectionsShyllienHillwenHomesteadGlyphsChecksMusic ScrollsAlban KnightsExpiring ItemsWhen minimizing a bag, the icons you’ve selected will now remain listed.The Fynni Gems tag now includes Fynni Whistles.[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5fyip0sa/updated-bag-tag-list.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Improved NPC Searching
A new UI window has been added to search for any available NPC throughout Erinn.This menu is accessible by clicking the “NPC Search” button on the mini-map.Click the NPC on the list to automatically move to the relevant Mana Tunnel/Moon Gate or go on foot.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kuvgnrr1/npc-search-window.png
Other Misc. Changes:
The delay when using the Thunder Skill has been reduced significantly further.Before/After ComparisonWith the release of Generation 27, Veteran Mercenary Fedelm has added two new items to her Master Plan Event Main Shop. These rare relics are only available upon completing Generation 27 during this Master Plan Event, so don’t delay!Homestead Murias Apple TreeHomestead Murias Ground Floor Small ArchEnhanced Mana Bullet has been added for Dual Guns.This new powerful bullet can be crafted through Magic Crafting.Attack +50Maximum Stack Size: 5000The tooltip has been updated to show the RBG values of item pouches.In order to encompass the new Murias Relics, texts that previously indicated Falias Relics as the category name, such as the Auction House category, have been renamed to Divine Relics.In order to better indicate that they are magically replenishing, the infinite-use Arrow items have been renamed to include a pluralization. With the inclusion of the infinite use Soul Liberator Eternal Bolts, one Bolt has also been renamed:Demolition Breaker Arrow → Demolition Breaker ArrowsArrow of Ruination → Arrows of RuinationPerseus Voiceless Arrow→ Perseus Voiceless ArrowsHandmade Bolts → Handmade BoltThe item descriptions for the various Mana Bullets have had their format unified.The following items have been renamed:Melodic Metal Board → Melodic Metal PlateFalias Rain Drop → Falias Raindrops
Web Shop Improvements
Over the next few months, we’ll be overhauling the Web Shop to better suit Milletian needs and desires per all your wonderful feedback in our survey earlier this year. Starting this month, the following changes have been made:
[table noborder=1][tr][td]The following items have been added to the Web Shop:Rainbow Name/Chat Color Change Box2x Skill Training Potion Selection BoxOpen to select a [Talent] Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Age Potion Selection BoxOpen to select an Age Potion (Ages 9 to 19)The following items have been removed from the Web Shop:Crusader Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Chain Slash 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Ninja Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Puppeteer Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Music Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Fighter Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Dual Gun Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Alchemy Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Magic Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Combat Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Life Skill 2x EXP Potion (1 Day)Age Potion - Age 10Age Potion - Age 11Age Potion - Age 12Age Potion - Age 13Age Potion - Age 14Age Potion - Age 15Age Potion - Age 16Age Potion - Age 17Age Potion - Age 18[/td][td width=35%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5xonndnz/aug-shop-items.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes
This is a fix-heavy patch, with some unmentioned smaller text fixes, as we continue to polish Mabinogi to a shine. There is a lot of text in this update (like last month!), and while we hope as ever that there aren't any issues, we aim to fix any that do get reported by you with expedience! ♥
Adjusted the song answers for Musical Math Dungeon to match the proper song titles.Under certain specifications, an issue was causing Gold-Leaf Pine Cones to stack in values less than 1000 when registering them in the Handicraft menu.When creating an Elite Shadow Mission party via the Shadow Mission Board with an invalid name, the Shadow Mission pass would be lost to the shadow realm. A ward has been put in place to prevent your passes from being lost.On relevant weapons, the item attribute for "Piercing Can Be Added" was missing a proper line break and was running cozy with the line before it. It should now respect the boundaries of others.Fixed several display issues with the following outfits:(Special) Moonlit Howls Outfit (M) & Moonlit Howls Gloves (M)(Special) Astraea Stella Wear (F) & Astraea Stella Heels (F)(Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (M)(Special) Royal Brawler Outfit (F) & Royal Brawler Heels (F)Neon Blossom Shinobi Gloves (F) (for giants)(Special) Winter Fairy Long Outfit (F) (with Demigod)Cowenna's Outfit (M) & Cowenna's Gloves (M)Moonlight Hunter's Hat (M) (for giants)Ravenscall HaloEochaid's Outfit (F) & Eochaid's Shoes (F)(Special) Blue Dragon's Chosen Robe (F) & Blue Dragon's Chosen Wristguards (F)Simple Autumn Wear (M) & Chic Autumn Wear (M)Helionic Chariot Halo & Selenian Chariot Halo(Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (F) & (Special) Sunbather's Bliss Wear (F)(Special) Sunbather's Paradise Wear (M)Soldier's Combat RaincoatQueen of Hearts StaffSpecial Neon Blossom Shinobi Wear (F) (during the motion)Celtic Control Bar (for giants)(Special) Eternal Resistance Outfit (M) & Eternal Resistance Shoes (M)Folamh's Set (all pieces)Midnight Investigator (F) (all pieces, when Resting)(Special) Crocus High School Warm-Weather Uniform (M) (for giants)Improved the texture on Homestead Timepiece Mechanism A.Fixed a rigging error when equipped with Lightning Two-handed Sword Appearance Scroll and Eternal Resistance Replica Sniper Rifle Two-Handed Blunt Weapon Appearance Scroll.Corrected some overlapping textures on the Cwn Annwn pets.Fixed an issue causing the Naraka Inferno wings to be unable to be picked up from the ground unless Alt was held.The Dark Erg spilling forth from Crom Bas was causing Brielle's body to warp during the Crom Bas storyline missions. Nothing our brave sundrop couldn't handle--she has dispelled the effect and once again looks just like the picture on her archaeologist's license.Behold! The magical "Pig Cooking Pot" and "Antique Cooking Pot"! See how they cook food, despite not having any flame beneath them whatsoever! Yours for the low pri- no! The flame has come back?!The following Homestead Props were difficult to select, and have been adjusted to make them easier to move:
Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Partial)Homestead Halloween Flagstone (Whole)Homestead Halloween Pumpkin Flagstone (Whole)Adjusted the menu present when right-clicking items to better fit some rarer text options. Lookin' at you, Classic Spirit Weapons.A vile and insidious curse befell elves holding the Royal Mage Cane- their footsteps would fall silent, as if their existence was denied! Thankfully, in the whisper of the night, they have returned, as if nothing had happened.The visual effect for the Eclipse 2nd title was appearing incorrectly under certain animations and has been corrected.The visual effect for the Ruler of the Stage of Trials 2nd title will no longer render incorrectly when equipped by giants.During G2's Paladin Training Courses cutscene, the ground texture was previously not visible. A rendering error, or a possible preview of a later storyline- you decide!Some Sewing Patterns for Bonita Plumed Ankle Boots were showing as blank. They have been restored to the correct functionality.The weapon upgrades that were named "Break [weapon name] Seal", or similar names, have been unified to "[weapon name] Unsealing". 
Before example: Break Infinite Bow SealAfter example: Infinite Bow UnsealingAn unused setting was present in the hotkey menu and has been removed.
Bugs fixed during the July 24th Maintenance
In addition to the below list, we've also included fixes for several smaller typos (such as a missing space after your character name in the Arcana questlines) and text display errors from the July patch. There was a high word count in this update (same for next month! exciting times for Mabinogi~), so we are thankful for the quick reports to allow us to make quicker fixes.The Talent icons for the Arcanas were slightly misaligned. Laoire was informed and he has since brought them back in line.The notification text when using a Memory of a Story book has been adjusted to show in full.The ranking list shown when viewing the Previous Guild Point Rank Info has had the test guilds removed, and will now display the proper rankings.
Congrats to Goodmorning for having the most Guild Points earned prior to the Guild Renewal!The Duration text for Divine Retribution was incorrect and has been adjusted. This is a text only error; no gameplay has been adjusted.
At Rank 1:
Before: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest duration + 6 sec.After: Equal to the Shield skill with the longest durationThe additional duration time was a holdover from a previous version of the skill that had a much longer cooldown, and no behavior that could reduce the cooldown.The Little Morning Star Homestead Figures (from the Flying High Event) were incorrectly able to be placed in the Relic equipment slots. As these are not proper Relics, we have fixed these items to no longer be equippable. We have unequipped these Figures from characters that had them equipped, and placed them back into your inventory.
Known Bugs
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngThere are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.
The Mabinogi Team has been working hard to investigate fixes for the lag issues that have been occurring of late. With the many new Milletians entering Erinn, we love to see Mabinogi growing and flourishing, though we recognize this hasn’t been without issues. In the future, we will send a letter about our plans to address and improve the network latency. We apologize again for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determine the causes.

[h2 style=center]Community Challenge Event Details
Challenge Begins: Thursday, August 14th, After Maintenance

How to Participate:
[olist]Gather your party and defeat all 3 bosses of Brí Leith Dungeon before any other party!
Using the checkpoint/save feature to exit the dungeon, recover, and resupply is allowed.Successful attempts where a group uses a glitch or bug to bypass dungeon mechanics may be subject to disqualification.

Post your group in the Official Mabinogi Discord Server #contest-submissions channel for Milletians and the Mabinogi team to cheer your group on!Be sure to include the IGNs of ALL players in the party in the post.

[Optional] Want to earn more prizes? Stream your attempts to win additional Brí Leith Dungeon Passes! Post the stream link in the same #contest-submissions channel for other Milletians and the Mabinogi team to watch the accomplishment live (or the VOD if it's after hours).Only one member of the group needs to livestream the attempt. [/olist]

5x Brí Leith Dungeon Passes (Non-Streaming) // 10x Brí Leith Dungeon Passes (Streaming)"the Conqueror of Brí Leith" titleThis title has no stats.

Event Details

Unlocks July 10th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Complete 5 Part-Time Jobs.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 2nd Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 17th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Clear a Shadow Mission or Uladh Dungeon 3 times.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 3rd Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 24th, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Engage in Commerce 3 times.[/td][/tr][tr][td][Quest] 4th Weekly Mission:
Unlocks July 31st, 2025.[/td][td]Task: Harvest Homestead Crops 5 times.[/td][/tr][/table]Completing all 4 weekly quests will also reward you with the best reward of all… Pan’s admiration and respect. notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:56 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on June 12th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 3 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-
Thursday, June 12th
Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 10:00 PMEastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CEST, UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEST, UTC +10): 12:00 AM (June 13th) - 3:00 AM (June 13th)
To address the following:Weekly server upkeep.Pan's Check-in Attendance Season 7 is ending. Get those last stamps in if you haven't already!For our more forgetful Milletians, Lorna will keep any unclaimed rewards safe with her for a week. Be sure to talk to her to obtain them!The following bugs will be fixed:The Traveler's Guide will now correctly open the Summer Festival Event web page.You can now resize the in-game browser Summer Festival web posts, allowing you to increase the text size.When Rebirthing, the Purchase Pon button will now correctly lead to the appearance page on the Cash Shop.An issue was causing the Ravenscall Knuckles to display incorrectly when equipped with certain outfits. notes.title: Summer Festival Event
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aixdqfur/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png
This summer is certain to be an unforgettable one! Join in several events throughout the next few months with fun for all Milletians. Whether you're participating in activities with friends and guildmates, trying a new look, or simply becoming stronger, there's an event for everyone!
[hr][/hr]
Summer Festival Events
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Log in anytime during the Summer Festival to participate in the various events planned over the next several months!A dedicated Event Icon will appear in your Event Tab, allowing visibility of all active and upcoming events during the Summer Festival![/td][td width=15%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sljhv0np/event-book-ui.png[/td][/tr][/table]Click to open the Summer Festival UI, showcasing all the events taking place this summer!Each event will display its dates, summary, relevant quests, and the main rewards related to that event!Certain events will have extra features such as:
Event Icon - allows you to show or hide the shortcut icon, located on your Event Tab.Details - will provide some extra information for the event, such as attendance UI.To NPC - allows you to teleport directly to the corresponding NPC of the event.Link - opens the in-game browser window to the web post of the event, providing additional information about the event.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wejhkxjm/summer-festival-ui-v2.png

Not currently in Erinn, but want to know more about each event? While we're providing a small synopsis of each event here -- clicking any of the banners below will take you to that event's dedicated web post! This web post will be updated each month with which events are available, which ones have ended, and which are yet to come as the festival progresses, so be sure to keep this page bookmarked!
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]New Events

Summer Master Plan Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vjhjxwwa/250626-wgc-2143-mb-masterplanevent-1400x300.png(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
Ready to pick up the pace this summer season? It's getting hot in here with these fiery rewards... including FREE Combination VIP Service. Check out all the details in the dedicated webpost above!

Flying High Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2fbyh11/250626_flyinghighevent-newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
Dash, Leap, and Fly your way to new heights as you acquire goods that will help every Milletian with their Master Plan training! From acquiring your first (or second) Arcana to dashing to Level 40,000, the benefits of this event are sure to have you dashing, leaping, and eventually, flying high!

Box Full of Memories Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/p3hhwght/250703-wgc-2139-mb-mainstreamstoryskipsale-1400x300.png(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Thursday, July 10th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, August 14th, Before Maintenance
Lorna and Pan found a new item that’s sure to help any Milletian in saving Erinn! They found so many that they’re willing to let you sample this new item out! If you want more though, it’s gonna cost ya… check out all the details in the dedicated webpost above!
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]Ongoing Events

Luis's Pinata Prep Event

//g.nexonstatic.com/media/1euh5vde/luispinataprep-1400x300-1.jpg(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
Luis is looking to bring a little extra cheer, but his colored paper blew away. They've formed into giant piñatas just outside of Dunbarton. Grab several of your friends, a good stick, and an appetite for sweets as you bash away for some delicious candy and colored paper! Turn that paper in to Luis for some delicious rewards!

Letters to a Milletian Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/lwlnlsh3/letter-to-milletian-1400x300.jpg(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
In celebration of Milletians, several NPCs have each penned a letter, expressing thanks and gratitude... and a daily buff! It's all packaged in a neat 'Nao-box' alongside LOTS of goodies! Be sure to open it on a character you treasure most.

Guild-ed Gala Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/bl3jtdav/guild-ed-gala-event-1400x300.jpg(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
Celebrate the Guild Renewal with some rewards, buffs, and your very own Guild Title! Create or join a guild, make some new friends (and guildmates!), and get a head start this summer!

Mystical Rental Event
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wl3abudy/mystical-rental-event-1400x300.jpg
(Click to visit event page)

Event Dates: Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
Can't wait for the rental services from the Master Plan? Neither can Sasha! She started her own Rental Service and improved it! Whether you're looking for a new cool ride to travel in, a powerful weapon to tackle Glenn Bearna, or showing up other Fashionogists with your new look, this event has you covered.
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr]Upcoming Events

We have even more events planned for Milletians later this summer! Here's what's still in store for the remaining months!

notes.content:
In celebration of Milletians, several NPCs have each penned a letter, expressing thanks and gratitude... and a daily buff! It's all packaged in a neat 'Nao-box' alongside LOTS of goodies! Be sure to open it on a character you treasure most.
[hr][/hr]
Event Details
Event Dates: Wednesday, June 4th, After Maintenance ~ Thursday, September 11th, Before Maintenance
