notes.title: Guild Renewal Update
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/aonb2vws/250526-wgc-2054-mb-guildrenewal-1400x300.jpg
[hr][/hr]
Active Events/Sales/Promotions
[table][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yc5jvkgv/250527_summerfestivalevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/grwk4o3n/250530_southseasailorbox_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg[/td][/tr][tr][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1694/250303-wgc-1841-mb-panscheckinevent-940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/kdwjfugb/250523-wgc-2063-mb-outfitpakagesale-940x290.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg[/td][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/tamjcquk/250519_mb_ravenscallbox_wgc-2006_940x290-1.jpg[/td][/tr][tr][td]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ylxh1ugg/260529_mb_glennbearnaevent_wgc-2057.jpg[/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table]
(Click the banners to go to that event/sales/promotion webpage)
Guild Renewal
Guilds have been a cornerstone of Erinn since Mabinogi first released! While the strengths and bonds between Guild Members is unique for each guild, the system to help foster those bonds had been severely neglected. We hope that this massive renewal of the Guild System will continue fostering new bonds between Guildmates that cannot be found anywhere else.
A new Guild Home UI has been created and added to the game to house most guild-related things.A new Guild Menu button has been added to the bottom of the screen to open the Guild Home.The Guild Home and Guild List buttons at the bottom of the friends messenger window have been removed.All Guild Stones will be removed with the update. The following features have been added to the Guild Home UI:Guild Search
You will be able to search by Guild Name and/or Guild Master.Tag Filtering is now possible to find the guild that suits your playstyle best.Guild Recommendation
When not in a guild, opening the Guild Menu will open the “Recommended Guilds” tab.Guilds that have a healthy activity record will have priority in the displayed list.Guild Member Play Rankings
Guild Members will be able to compete against other members of their guild to be displayed on a Leaderboard for certain activities.Guild Portrait
Guild Portraits allow Guild Members to be displayed on the Guild Home screen.Spend Guild Points or Gold to unlock new locations, the number of members that can be displayed, and more.Guild Guide
Will guide you to the official web Guild Guide.A new NPC, Siobhan, has been added to take over the duties of Eavan and Sinead.Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the first quest.Siobhan is normally located inside the Guild Hall.Three (3) new Guide Quests titled [Guild] A Guild-ed Opportunity have been added to introduce the changes to the Guild System.Talk to Siobhan outside the Guild Hall to start the 1st quest.After completing A Guild-ed Opportunity (1), Siobhan will open the Guild Shop for Guild Members, and be in charge of handling changes made to the Guild Banner, Guild Robe, and when available, Guild Title.Guild Leveling and perks have been added.Guilds can now level up, earning perks with each level.The types of Perks a guild has unlocked or yet to unlock can be viewed through the “Perks” tab in the Guild Menu.Leveling will require a set amount of Guild Points (GP) and Guild Gold (GG), contributed by members of the guild.Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.All Guild Points prior to the update will be reset. The maximum amount of GP a Guild Member can now hold is 2,000.The maximum amount of GP a guild can now have is equal to the amount required for leveling up.Members can still donate GP if the guild is at the cap to earn Guild Coins, but the GP will not be credited to the guild.Donations of GP will reward the donor with Guild Coins.Guild Coins are a new currency, allowing Guild Members to purchase items from the new Guild Shop through the Guild Assistant Siobhan.Guild Missions have been added.Two different types of Guild Missions have been added:Guild Field Missions - band with your Guildmates to defeat a Field Boss and earn GP.Guild Life Mission - deliver materials per the NPC's request to earn GP based on your score.Each Guild Member can earn GP from both Field and Life Missions up to 3 times per week.A Guild Shop has been added.The new Guild Shop is available for all Guild Members starting at Guild Level 1 through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.The Guild Shop only accepts Guild Coin (GC) and all items are subject to a weekly purchase limit per character.A guild can level up the shop by reaching Guild Level to access the “Guild Shop Level 2” tab containing more powerful items.[table noborder=1][tr][td]Guilds can now create Guild Banners.The ability to create Guild Banners is unlocked when a guild reaches Level 6.Creation of a Guild Banner will cost the guild 25,000 Guild Points and 10,000,000 Gold.Guild Banners can be crafted through Siobhan in the Guild Hall.A Guild Banner will apply the same emblem, embroidery, and border used in the Guild Robe.Guild Banners can only be wielded by the Guild Master.Guild Banners can be planted when a guild Reaches Level 9.Planting a banner will create an interactable banner, and will remain for 10 minutes or until the Guild Master leaves the map.[/td][td width=30%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ex4hsiej/guild-banners.png[/td][/tr][/table]Additional Guild Changes:All web functionality of guilds has been removed.The "Guilds" tab will be removed from the Mabinogi Website.Member requirement for creating a guild has been reduced from 5 players to 2.The Guild Hall is now available immediately upon creation of a guild.Guild Leaders can now assign up to 3 Guild Officers.Functionality of duties between Guild Leader, Guild Officers, and Members/Senior Members has been updated.Guild Leaders can now withdraw up to 100 million gold per day from the Guild Treasury.The requirements of disbanding a guild have been updated to require only the Guild Leader to remain in the guild.The cooldown time for leaving and joining another guild has been reduced from 1 week to 24 hours after joining the previous guild.An “Immediate Join” option has been added, allowing players to instantly join a guild without waiting for approval, if the guild allows it.Guild Quests sold by Eavan have been removed.The method for obtaining Guild Points have changed:
Before: 1 GP per 10 minutes; 5 GP per level up.After: 1 GP per minute; available through Guild Missions.The Guild Points requirement for the Guardian Guild Tournaments has been reduced from 15,000 GP to 1,000 GP.
Read more in-depth about guilds and all the new changes in the dedicated Guild Guide!
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5uifjiey/guildguide-1400x300.jpg
Tutorial Improvements
Arcana Achievement Missions
Arcana Achievement Missions have been added for Milletians that have yet to acquire an Arcana on any character of their account.Accounts that have an Arcana unlocked on any of their characters are not eligible for this questline.Only one character can progress through the questline.Upon completing the Third Memoir of Blannid’s Brave Boost questline, you’ll receive a Guide Quest to talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register for the questline.You can confirm the progress of the questline by going to Guides → Arcana Achievement Mission in your bottom menu bar.Alternatively, you can select “View Arcana Achievement Mission” by opening your Quest Log.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/n2cnfvgd/arcana-achievement-missions.pngThe Arcana Achievement Mission UI will provide you with information on what your next Cumulative Point Rewards are, what the next step in your current quest is, and additional details for better understanding.Only one quest is given each real life day (17 quests in total)The next quest after completing one will be delivered at 7:00 AM Server Time the next day.When completing objectives, you will receive Arcana Achievement Mission Points as a reward.Upon accumulating enough Arcana Achievement Mission Points, you’ll receive the current Cumulative Point Rewards listed.Tutorial Improvements ft. Blaanid
The introductory tutorial quests have been improved.
The quests [Tutorial] Battle in Erinn, [Tutorial] Basics of Battle, and [Tutorial] To The Outside World have been removed.Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.The removed quest rewards can be obtained from previous quests.When creating a new character, some guidance messages have been added to the upper right corner of the screen.When entering the Soul Stream in certain situations, the following UI will now be hidden:Skill slotsChatNotificationsEvent windowsSome of the specifications of the tutorial zone have been changed.Some chats and notifications in the UI will be hidden in the tutorial zone.Some of Nao’s dialogue has been adjusted to account for the various tutorial changes.[Tutorial] Item Equipping and Usage will no longer provide Lorna's Stadium Horn.After completing the revamped Tutorial, Milletians will receive the books “Traveler’s Guide Life Edition” and “Traveler’s Guide Combat Edition”.These books can also be purchased from Aeira in Dunbarton.Some of the contents of the "Traveler's Guide" book when creating a new character has been changed to improve readability."Practical Course - Talent Experience" has been added to the courses that can be ordered on the Beginner's Combat Course bulletin board.By taking this course, you can experience various talent skills.When a beginner rebirths, they can obtain the beginner title of the Talent they selected, and the beginner title will not be removed.In addition, some of the title descriptions have been changed due to the specification change.Blannid’s Memory Book
The introductory quests have been improved.
The tutorial quest [Tutorial] Rebirth and Talent has been removed.As a result, a Milletian's first guided Rebirth will be led by Blaanid.Milletians that were actively on the quests can proceed naturally.The Chain Slash questline has been removed from Blaanid’s Memoir quests.Throughout Blaanid’s quests, various visual glowing indicators have been placed at objectives to help Milletians find their way.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/4uwafqib/blaanid-ooooh-shinyyyyy.pngWhen Blaanid’s Memory Book is in progress, a button will appear at the bottom of the quest window.If you have not purchased any items upon Rebirthing, the purchase confirmation pop-up window will not appear.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qkhgsmve/blaanid-brave-boost-quest-mark.png
Other Fantasy Life ChangesThe Auto-Pathing function has been improved.Teleport fees are waived if your cumulative level is below 10,000 or if you have an active Basic VIP Membership.If you are on the same continent and not in a restricted area, you also have the option to Go on Foot without spending any Gold.When viewing Quest Info, you can now teleport to the nearest Moon Gate.//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ovgoivyj/auto-pathing-june-update.gifStack Sizes for certain items have been increased.We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to 100!Rebirth PotionForgetful PotionTendering PotionSpecial Tendering Potion (S, SS, and SSS)Likability PotionChat Color Change PotionName/Chat Color Change PotionEnchant Protection PotionEnchant Extraction Protection PotionTrade Unlock PotionHeight PotionAge Potion - Age 9 ~ 19Partner Age Potion - 9 ~ 19Partner Age Potion - Max AgePet Age Potion - Age 1 ~ 5Combat 2x EXP PotionLadeca Combat 4x EXP PotionPet EXP PotionLife Skill 2x EXP PotionCombat Skill 2x EXP PotionMagic Skill 2x EXP PotionAlchemy Skill 2x EXP PotionMartial Arts Skill 2x EXP PotionMusic Skill 2x EXP PotionPuppetry 2x EXP PotionDual Gun 2x EXP PotionNinja 2x EXP PotionSpeed Walk Potion (30%)Speed Walk Potion (40%)Complete Skill EXP PotionRoyal Complete EXP PotionMonster Drop Booster PotionFishing Booster PotionDragon Knight’s PotionMagic Power PotionMagic Speed PotionPhysical Power PotionAll [Skill Name] Training PotionsE.g. Fury of Connous Training PotionAll [Skill Name] Production Boost PotionsAll [Skill Name] Quality Increase PotionsAll Restorative Potions (HP, MP, Stamina, Wound), including:
SERELiquidsCrystalsBeginnerBuffComprehensiveFull RecoveryBase PotionChildlike Green PerfumeChildlike Yellow PerfumeChildlike Pink PerfumeYouthful Black PerfumeMature Red PerfumeHoly Water of LymilarkMassive Holy Water of LymilarkDiet Potion UDiet Potion LDiet Potion FFlintWe’ve also increased the following item stack limits to 200!
Light Magic Power PotionLight Magic Speed PotionLight Physical Power Potion
*Note: The stack improvements will also apply for various items with suffix tags, such as (Event), (Untradable), (Can be Traded Once), (30 min), (1 Day), etc.
The following Phoenix pets have been renamed:
White Phoenix -> Mistborn PhoenixBlue Phoenix -> Cerulean PhoenixThe following items have been renamed:
Special Eluned Classic Maid Dress (M) -> Eluned Special Classic Maid Dress (M)Special Eluned Classic Butler Outfit (F) -> Eluned Special Classic Butler Outfit (F)Baseball Bat -> Baseball Bat (M)Pom Poms -> Pom Poms (F)Water Spirit Ankle Straps -> Water Spirit Ankle Straps (F)Water Spirit Sandals -> Water Spirit Sandals (M)The training method for Rain Casting requiring one to "Produce something under a cloud" has been expanded to make the action more clear- "Successfully perform the finishing steps of production under a cloud".The required method itself has not changed, only the description.We have truncated the text tags on Commerce Mounts within the Commerce Trading menu, to allow more of the name to be visible.
[Partner] -> [P][Guild] -> [G]Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Seasonal Commerce Alban Heruin Season 1 will begin at 7:00 AM PDT on July 3rd 2025 and run until November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST.[Claim Previous Seasonal Ranking Rewards] and [View Previous Seasonal Ranking] buttons will be deactivated during the reset time, and re-activated when you open commerce UI after the previous season's ranking is compiled.Alban Heruin Season 1 will conclude on November 6th, 2025 7:00 AM PST.Viewing the season rankings and claiming previous season’s rewards will be disabled for 30 minutes after the season is changed to ensure that the ranking compilation can be completed before rankings and rewards are distributed.Purchase limits within Trade Merchant’s shops and Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The following items have been added to the Erinn Merchants' Guild Souvenir Box.Cone Hat Balloon Pony WhistleFestival Troublemaker Alo WhistleThe Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:**NEW** Alban Heruin Season 1 Challenger 2nd TitleMovement Speed +3%Mistborn Phoenix Whistle
20x Precise Reforging Tools (Expire after 30 Days)[/td][td width=40%]//g.nexonstatic.com/media/twwi1xt1/alban-heruin-season-1-challenger-2nd-title.gif[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes
A few fixes in this auspicious update, with some typical typo fixes alongside them. We like telling you that we're still fixing these typos, and hearing your wonderful reports, we just don't always feel these smaller items are worth highlighting individually as they're typically uninteresting!
The icon for the status effect Support Shot was missing and has been added.A few otherwise fine folk in Erinn were sporting an overly bald look, appearing as if they had no hair or skull! Spooky! We asked them to don their hair proper, and they will be showing correctly moving forward.A fix for the recent issue causing audio to behave unexpectedly, such as overlapping BGM, has been added and the issues should be quelled.Small modeling fixes have been made to improve the display of the Shadow Reaper (F) set.The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls were displaying the incorrect name when applied, and will now show their correct name:
Ravenscall Hunter's Shotgun CrossbowRavenscall Shotgun CrossbowMorpho Dreamwood Long BowMorpho Dreamwood Two-Handed SwordThe description for Clairvoyant Wings Orb was updated to properly indicate that it grants Placid Shining Forest Wings instead of Placid Folded Shining Forest Wings.Slight corrections to the following Enchants, to better reflect the actual skill names:
Alchemist'sDazedGalacticTiltedWitch

Grab several of your friends, a good stick, and an appetite for sweets as you bash away for some delicious candy and colored paper! Turn that paper in to Luis for some delicious rewards!

//g.nexonstatic.com/media/wl3abudy/mystical-rental-event-1400x300.jpg
Can't wait for the rental services from the Master Plan? Neither can Sasha! She started her own Rental Service and improved it! Whether you're looking for a new cool ride to travel in, a powerful weapon to tackle Glenn Bearna, or showing up other Fashionogists with your new look, this event has you covered.

Upon logging in, you'll receive the quest [Guide] Rentals for Success.Talk to Rental Agent Sasha next to the Part-Time Job Bulletin Board in Dunbarton to Register a Main Character.
You'll receive the following upon completing the quest:50,000 EXPTalk to Sasha once more to learn more about all the types of rental programs she has available during the Summer Festival.

notes.title: Milletian-Ran Event Support
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/u3qns0kf/250425_mb_community_wgc-1975_1400x300-1.jpg

Hey Milletians!

Looking for some additional support to help host your next Community Event? Now's your chance! Submit information regarding your upcoming event via the application form below for a chance to have your event receive support from the Mabinogi team!
🎉What events are eligible?🎉
Events that are public and available for all players of the Mabinogi Community to participate in are eligible to receive additional support. Some example events are (but not limited to):
Trivia/QuizzesRacing/SpeedrunsScavenger HuntsPlayer vs. Player (PvP)Creative Competitions (Art, Music, etc.)And more!
🎁What support is available?🎁
Depending on the type of event, expected attendance, prizes (if any), etc., different avenues of support are available by the Mabinogi team. Listed below are support options that may be available, depending on your event, availability by the team, and more.
Official Discord Promotion - This level of support is self-promotion within the Mabinogi Discord's #milletian-events channel. A special role is required to post in this channel, and is highly curated for all Milletians with visibility to the channel. You can even ping the @Community Alarms Role for those following the channel, as well as publish to other servers following along!
After your first successful promotion through the Discord Channel, additional opportunities will be available.
GM Attendance - Looking to have a GM assist by being a judge, hand out prizes, or more? Depending on the day and time, CM Arciellia or Elebon will schedule time to be in attendance!Prize Support - Need a little bit of extra oomph to your prizes? The Mabinogi team can support additional prizes, relevant to the type of event being held! While we can't provide gold or high-valued items, we can provide prizes such as: Transformation MedalsGachaponHomestead ItemsChairsFoodFansStickers
Note: This type of support requires at least 4+ weeks of advanced notice and if approved, will require a post-mortem of how the event went, what went well, what could be improved, etc.Other - Have an idea for us to help support that doesn't fit above? Reach out to Arciellia or Elebon and we'll discuss further on whether it's something the team can support!
📝What do I need to submit?📝
You'll need to fill out this provided Google Form with complete information about your upcoming event. The more information provided, the better we can gauge whether the Mabinogi team can accommodate any extra support!

//g.nexonstatic.com/media/x4clnaqq/glyph_design.png Coordinator Submission Application //g.nexonstatic.com/media/x4clnaqq/glyph_design.png

We'll also have this link, and all of these details pinned in our Official Mabinogi Discord Server where you'll also be able to promote your event. Please make sure to join our Discord if you're not already a part of it!

We look forward to seeing all the wonderful Milletian-ran events that come up!

- The Mabinogi Team Community Managers

notes.title: [UPDATED] Dragon Master Season 3
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/z2ddimbr/250502_dragonmastereventseason-3_newsarticleheader_1400x300.png
Meiling is back once more and needs your help to craft the dragon! Brave Uladh's Dungeons and Shadow Missions to collect the items needed for the dragon. Or, log in in every day to make this majestic pet your own! Check out the details below.
[hr][[/hr]
Update: Thank you to all the Milletians who have provided your feedback regarding the Dragon Master Event. During the 5/15 Maintenance, we have updated the rewards for the Dragon Master Event below. 

The Dragon Master Season 3 event rewards were far too spread out into the entirety of the duration of the event, making it more difficult than intended to receive all 9 Blue Dragon Bag Royal Pouch items to completely expand the Blue Dragon Bag. To alleviate some burden, we’ve reorganized the Attendance Scroll event rewards allowing you to obtain all of the Blue Dragon Bag Pouches with several days of leniency built in. We hope that this change will allow you to continue working towards becoming a Dragon Master!

Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, May 8th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, June 4th, 7:00 AM PDT
Log in during the event period to receive the quest [Guide] Return of the Dragon Clan.Talk to Meiling in Dunbarton Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account.The character must be above Level 1,000.Once completed, you will receive the following:20,000 EXPAttendance ScrollCrafting a Marshal Blue Dragon's HornDuring the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a Marshal Blue Dragon Whistle.You can only craft one Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn during the event period.You can also obtain a Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn as a reward from the Attendance Scroll event.Note: The event items (Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Old Dragon, Blue Dragon's Hard Blue Leather, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, Incomplete Horn, and Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.You must gather one Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon, one Blue Dragon's Hard Blue Leather, one Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, and one Strength Essence for Meiling to attempt to craft the Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn.
Known Bug: The description text on the Horn of the Ten Thousand-Year Dragon, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, and Incomplete Horn incorrectly refers to a Red/Fire Dragon instead of a Blue Dragon. This is a text error and will not impede making the Marshal Blue Dragon's Horn.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/yrpjusti/blue-dragon-pet.png
You have a chance to collect the Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon by clearing an Uladh Dungeon:

Active Events/Sales/Promotions

[hr][/hr]
Renovation: Season 7
Gunslinger
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dcyewezl/shooting-rush.png Shooting Rush
Damage has been increased for all Ranks.For Dan 3:Before: 600%After: 960%

The cooldown time has been reduced from 300 seconds to 60 seconds at Rank 1.
[hr][/hr]Improvements
Partners
Several changes to Partners have been made.
Partner Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.Using the card from the inventory will create a Partner Card on the character creation menu.Partner Cards are tradeable with other players.The following Partners and their Mounts are now permanent items on the Cash Shop:MaidButlerCommercePartner’s Magical BroomPartner’s Noble CarriagePartner’s Long BoatPartner Mount PackageEquipment items equipped by Partners are no longer bound and can be retrieved by the player without the use of a Partner Trade Unlock Potion.
All remaining Partner Trade Unlock Potions have been removed as a result.Partner Trade Unlock Potions that have been purchased from the Cash Shop since April 1st, 2024 and unused will be refunded the amount purchased in NX.Partner Trade Unlock Potions sold on the Auction House, but the funds are still unclaimed, will be claimed with the gold being delivered via mailbox.A Style Tab has been added for Partners.
Tail and Facewear Slots have been added.Newly created Laighlinne Partners will now have 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in their inventory.
Players who previously had a Laighlinne Partner created before the update will receive 5x Partner Stat Training Kits in the mailbox on their highest-leveled character.The Gift function has been improved.
The maximum number of daily gifts you can give to your Partner has been increased.
Before: 5After: 10A Partner’s favorability now increases further when gifting an item.
Before: 2After: 5Partners will now only accept a certain type of gift.
Maid: HerbsButler: FishLaighlinne: InstrumentsCommerce/William/Rem/Ram: GemsPartners have been given a “Partner Exclusive” tab in their shop containing Partner Age Potions and Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Boxes.
Partner Age Potions do not reset on Saturdays.You can now change most Partners' body type and height.
A Partner’s weight, upper body, and lower body can be modified similar to a player’s body through the use of Hot Springs and feeding them food.A Partner’s height can be modified through the use of Partner Age Potions.William and Commerce Partners cannot have their body type or height modified.Multi-person chairs can now be used with Partners.
A Partner can only be seated on a multi-person chair placed by the Milletian who summoned them.After sitting on the multi-person chair, you can change the seat that your summoned Partner occupies through right-clicking your Partner and selecting “Sit Together”.Some Partners' dialogue and lines have been updated.A “Disable Basic Interaction” button has been added in the menu options when right-clicking a Partner.
Toggling this option will hide all speech bubbles and dialogue, as well as motions by the Partner.
Party System
The Party Creation Menu UI has been updated.
Regular Parties and Dungeon Parties have been merged.
The ability to restrict parties by Skill Level has been removed as of a result.The maximum length of a party name has been increased to 50 characters.Leaving a party name blank will auto-populate with "[Character Name]’s Party."
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/muzdwpk2/before-after-party-creation-ui.png
The Party Menu UI has been updated.
The “Wanted” button has been renamed to “Recruit Locally”.
The Recruitment Notice above your character will no longer expire.The [Wanted] party recruitment messages will no longer appear in the party chat.The width of the UI has been expanded for better visibility of text.Added new functionality buttons:
Recruit on Party Board - adds/removes your party from the Party Bulletin Board.Move to Destination - teleports you to the pre-determined location.Recruit via Bugle - allows you to send a bugle with the party information.The Party Bulletin Board UI has been updated.
All parties, regardless of objective, will be displayed as a default view.You can now search via party name directly (case-sensitive).The ability to move parties to a preset destination has been added.
When creating a Normal Party, the following locations have been added as destinations to teleport to:
Glenn BearnaCrom BásTech DuinnMag MellAvalon PurificationSidhe FinnachaidAlban KnightsTaillteann Shadow MissionTara Shadow MissionHard Mode Alby Advanced DungeonRabbie PhantasmAbyss Peaca Advanced DungeonHard Mode Rundal Advanced DungeonA 30-second cooldown has also been added to prevent teleport spamming.You can now right click → Invite to Join Party.If not in a party, this will create the party and send an invite to the player.This option is available through the Player, Friends List, and Guild List.This can be done across channels / maps.Added a Bugle Recruitment Feature.
When a destination is determined in a party, the “Recruit via Bugle” option will be available in the Party Menu UI.A ‘Horn Bugle - World’ item is required and consumed when used.
The Horn Bugle - World with the shortest expiration timer will be consumed first.Using the feature will display a clickable message with the party information in the message log, allowing other players to join with ease.
The bugle message will begin with a # symbol and have an outline around the message.Players joining the party via clicking the bugle message will be prompted to change channels (if necessary) and move to the destination.The bugle link is valid for up to 3 minutes.
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/d0bps5lr/bugle-party-message.png
Emblems
A new UI has been added for synthesizing Alban Knight and Commander emblems.Right-click an Alban Knight or Commander emblem and select "Synthesize" to open the synthesis UI.It is no longer possible to combine emblems through the "drag and drop" method.A "Training Camp" tab has been added to Shaun's shop in the Alban Knights Training Camp with the following items:Unadorned Alban Knights EmblemRune of BodyRune of MindRune of SharpnessRune of IngenuityRune of Mana*New* Alban Knights Rune BoxThis box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.A "Commander" tab has been added to the Royal Quartermaster's shop in the Tech Duinn Lobby with the following items:Unadorned Commander's EmblemRune of Command: Phantasmal SightRune of Command: FateweaverRune of Command: Tenacious TauntRune of Command: Zone of RenewalRune of Command: Unified Might*New* Rune of Command BoxThis box will contain a random chance at an Unadorned Emblem or any of the 5 Runes.
Auction House
You can now preview Hair Dyes and Chairs through the Auction House.An “All” category has been added to the top of the Category list.
Categories can now be expanded/collapsed with a single click rather than double click.The following items can now be sold/purchased via the Auction House: 
Clothing/Outfits:Aladdin ShoesBadoura CostumeCat ArmorCat Armor (Giant)Cheerleader BootsChina 7th Anniversary Headdress (F)China 7th Anniversary Headdress (M)China 7th Anniversary Outfit (F)China 7th Anniversary Outfit (M)China 7th Anniversary Ring    China 7th Anniversary Shoes (F)China 7th Anniversary Shoes (M)Clover Pig Costume (F)Clover Pig Costume (M)Dorren's RobeGoggle ShadesGreat Goggle ShadesHeart EyepatchLollipop Heart EyepatchMabinogi School ShoesOrnamented CrownPop Star BraceletPop Star DressPop Star EarringsPop Star ShoesStyle SunglassesTaoist BraceletTaoist CostumeTaoist HeaddressTaoist ShoesWeapons:Carpinus Healing WandChef's Passion  Metal Ice WandMetal Lightning WandPanacea Healing WandPop Star Conductor BatonRuyuefeixue's Butterfly FanScythe that Reaps DarknessChairs:Double SunbedSingle SunbedMisc. Items:Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group)Ruined Bonita Twin Tail RibbonsBonita Twin Tail Ribbons Repair KitBroken Ruyuefeixue's Butterfly FanRuyuefeixue's Butterfly Fan Repair Kit  Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Mirror World PassReceiver of Nao's Blessing Title CouponTotem Reset Coupon
[hr][/hr]Patch Notes
Fantasy Life Changes
Keyword Highlights have been added to the Chat Menu Options.When an added word/phrase is said in chat, it will be highlighted to draw your attention.You may add up top 10 words/phrases, with a maximum of 20 characters per entry.Management of this system is located in Options → Social → Chat → Manage Highlighted Keywords 
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/k2ufgwht/image-22.png
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dhanq0x4/image-23.png
Your chat log history will not reset upon changing channels.It will still reset upon logging in/out of the game however. Clicking a player's name on the Message Log will now bring up the Report User window. The in-game Cash Shop has received an update:The window will now load directly in your Mabinogi client, rather than as an external window.The specifications and security have been updated.The calculations performed when production crafting have been modified to capture the state when starting the craft. This will prevent situations where the display showed 100%, but it was still possible to fail, even when successfully clearing the crafting mini-game.The setting to hide the visibility of your Support Puppet will now be saved when swapping to different Extra Equipment Slots.Shadow Missions that previously required you to be in a party to progress, such as The Secret of Scathach Caverns, will now allow those not in a party to progress when speaking with the NPCs.It's dangerous to go alone, but you got this!You no longer need to meet the requirements to teleport to the entrance of Sidhe Finnachaid when using the Dungeon Guide.Expanding/Collapsing a Group in your friends list now only requires a single-click instead of double-click.In line with our rename change to Fragarach, we have also renamed the G25 sword from Luminous Cross-hilt Sword to The Answerer.Combo Card Slot Change Coupons have been modified to allow them to be destroyed via the Trash Can.Character Card purchases will now appear in your inventory as an in-game item.Using the card from the inventory will create a Character Card on the character creation menu.Character Cards are tradeable with other players.With this change, Hero and Elite Character cards have been removed from the Cash Shop.
Bug Fixes
Smaller text fixes this month for some of the Shop related dialogue with NPCs, some C7 NPC text polish, more changes to the Party and Partner related texts, and unification of some of the Lance item descriptions to better convey the gameplay. Thank you for your eyes with each update. We're glad we can continue to make this game clean.Improvements have been made to the newly added Pet Parade action that allow it to perform better under higher latencies.The (old) Doki Doki Island quest Natural Dye Event has been cleared from all accounts. Apologies for the confusion!Doll Bag Storage Chests will once again show the contents that are stored within the chest.Shopkeeping Milletians of Dunbarton and elsewhere (though mostly Dunbarton…) - you will once again be able to check the set price of your wares when reviewing your merchandise.
Belvast Merchants where ya be? 😭The range of Smokescreen was increased to 15m with the Battle Astrologer update. The associated skill text has been updated to reflect this change.With the update to the in-game Cash Shop browser, the zoom level has been corrected and the page will now display as expected when opening.The button redirects for opening specific Cash Shop pages have been updated to better direct you towards the relevant item(s).Fixed an issue where the status effect from a Carpentry Quality Increase Potion was not properly removing itself when failing a crafting attempt.
Changes during the March 20th Maintenance
As mentioned in our April Update, the following mythological sword and accompanying technique have been renamed, and all accompanying text (such as from the storyline) has been replaced:Pragarah -> FragarachSeal: Pragarah -> Seal: Fragarach[table][tr][td]【 Localization Note 】
The Localization Team has wanted to correct "Pragarah" for several years now, re-localizing it to its proper mythological name "Fragarach" (which, in Gaelic, translates to "The Answerer"). After all, just as one would never expect to see "Excalibur" rendered otherwise in a game based on Arthurian legend, Fragarach ought to hold a similar status when one discusses the tales of Ireland. With the recent updates to the Seal: Fragarach skill, we finally had the opportunity to make the change to this odd artifact of legacy localization. The Mabinogi Team hopes that this small yet meaningful change will help foster a deeper connection with the Celtic lore that serves as the inspiration for so many characters, places, and events within the world of Erinn.[/td][/tr][/table]
Bug Fixes during the March 20th Maintenance
An issue was causing the Def/MDef/Prot/MProt reduced via Brionac and Seal: Fragarach to be lower than expected. This has been fixed, and both should be reducing the values in the same way to the appropriate amounts.The description of this year's Lovely Doki Doki Commemorative Box has been updated to reflect the proper outfit.The Life Exploration Tools now correctly line break in the Item Attribute field.DJ Romantic will be coming back from his "judging competition" on April 17th instead of April 24th. He wrote the wrong date in his calendar, it seems.Reserve Attack settings will now save upon logging out/changing channels.Fixed an issue where an untranslated message was showing when a Trade Unlock Letter of Guarantee when applied on an item.The family name of Zeder was retranslated from Shiarpe to Scharp.
Known Bugshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngThere are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.content:

🎉 20,000 Members and Counting – Let’s Celebrate with a Giveaway! 🎉

The Official Mabinogi Discord Server has reached an incredible milestone—over 20,000 Milletians have joined our growing community as of this past month! 🥳

To celebrate this momentous occasion, the Mabinogi Team is hosting a special Discord-exclusive giveaway with a variety of fun prizes! Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning or just found your way to Erinn, this is our way of saying thank you for making this community so vibrant and welcoming.

Giveaway Dates: Tuesday, May 6th, After Stream (~3:00 PM PDT) - Wednesday, May 7th, 3:00 PM PDT
🎁 Giveaway Details
The Mabinogi Team is celebrating 20,000 Discord members by giving away several exciting items to randomly selected participants! Community Managers @Arciellia and @Elebon will host the event, using Wheel of Names to determine each winner's prize—live on the Mabinogi Discord Server!
✅ How to Enter:[olist]Join the Giveaway
During the designated entry period, click the 🎉 button on the giveaway post (posted via Caravan Joe, our Discord bot)![olist]The giveaway will last 24 hours until Wednesday, May 7th ~3:00 PM PDT, so make sure to enter within that time![/olist]Random Winner Selection
After 24 hours, 20 randomly selected winners will be entered into a live prize drawing using Wheel of Names, hosted by CMs Arciellia and Elebon in a livestream in the Discord server (#starlet-stage).Watch the Spins!
Winners are not required to be present during the livestream, but we’d love for you to join the fun!Results Announcement
Final prize results will be shared in the #announcements channel in Discord after the event.[/olist]📜 Giveaway Rules:You must be a member of the Mabinogi Discord Server prior to the start of the giveaway (May 6th, After Stream).New Discord accounts created after the announcement will not be eligible.Winners can only be selected once.Winners must not have any active bans or sanctions on the Mabinogi Discord Server.🎁 Giveaway Prize List 🎁
Here’s what lucky Milletians could win on the Wheel of Names:
Flashy Dead Bee x1Choice of Pet from Below x1(Golden Retriever, Straw Magic Broom, Afghan Hound, Rainbow Sprite, Guardian Spider, Baby Pig, Mini Thunderbird)Elysees Manor Box x11Arcana 2x EXP Potion x1 (Listed twice)Bank Limit Expansion Coupon (10 million) x1Ethereal Ballet Box x11DIY Dye Mold Selection Box x5Pon (100)Irusan's Letter of Guarantee x5Nao Coin x1Special Gold Box Coupon x2Title Voucher: Who Can't Find a Needle in a Stack of Needles
(Or vanity title of your choice – e.g., "Bling Bling", "Ferghus's Senpai")Rebirth Potion x3Lucky Blue or Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x3GM's Dungeon or Shadow Mission Key Card x3Spirit Appearance Slot Expansion Coupon x1Mabinogi Combination VIP Service (14 days) (Listed twice)🎉 FREE PICK – Choose any prize on the wheel!
Legal Rules
We’re incredibly grateful for the 20,000+ Milletians who make our Discord server such a fun, helpful, and friendly place. This celebration is all about you—our amazing community!

👉 Haven’t joined the Discord yet? We'd love to have you! https://discord.gg/mabinogi

We hope to run more giveaways like this in the future! Let’s keep the memories going, together in Erinn. 💖 

– The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch
notes.content:
https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/mu5dciyt/1100x225-maplestory-worlds-official-launch.jpg

MapleStory Worlds has now officially launched! Enjoy MapleStory in entirely new ways, with countless worlds and games with unique gameplay, all created by other MapleStory fans! Join the fun at the MapleStory Worlds website, and try out the creation tools to craft your own MapleStory experience!

What is MapleStory Worlds?
MapleStory Worlds is a UGC platform where players can build, explore, and monetize their unique games. With intuitive tools and access to 30M+ assets, creators of all levels can bring ideas to life. Players can explore a delightful range of Worlds catering to all play styles. There is a perfect World waiting just for you! Explore. Discover. Play!

What Can You Play in MapleStory Worlds?
There's tons of games to play on MapleStory Worlds, with more coming out all the time. Check out the three games below for a taste of what you can enjoy and create!
Maple Duel
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/eq4j3qvv/mapleduel_1920x1080.png

Experience MapleStory in a whole new way with this card battle adventure! Collect cards for the Warrior, Magician, Bowman, and Thief jobs and build a deck to battle in friendly games or competitive ranked matches against other Maple Duel players! Play Maple Duel on the MapleStory Worlds website!
Maple Slash
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/vrjbcpcu/mapleslash_1920x1080.png

Hack and slash through MapleStory's classic combat with a roguelite twist! Upgrade randomly selected skill cards as you level up, creating a unique build every round, and use them to battle through an endless battalion of monster! Play Maple Slash on the MapleStory Worlds website!
Durango: The Lost Island

//g.nexonstatic.com/media/odljzxud/durango_1920x1080.png

Explore, gather, hunt, research, build, and craft to survive in the wildlands of Durango! Tangle with some adorable monsters and endure the lost island in this survival game with a MapleStory flavor! Play Durango: The Lost Island on the MapleStory Worlds website!

Unleash Your Creativity

Discover how our creators are turning their ideas into reality. From puzzle games to battle arenas, this thriving community is shaping the future of MapleStory Worlds. Learn more in the Creator Center!

Join the Creator Circle

We developed this ongoing monthly program to amplify the work of promising creators like yourself. Whether you’re just starting out or an experienced creator, the Creator Circle provides mentorship, promotion, and financial support ($3,500 USD monthly stipend) to help you build the next great world. Learn more in the Creator Circle post!

Available Regions and Platforms

MapleStory Worlds has officially launched globally, allowing players from all corners of the globe to play. Players can play and create on Windows PC, Mac (Beta), Apple, and Android mobile devices. Get ready to explore new realms and unleash your creativity in MapleStory Worlds!

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - April 24th
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/5kjj54nt/250415_maintenancebanners_newsarticleheader_1400x300-2.jpg
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:13 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience and apologize for the delay.

[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on April 24th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
-Time-
Thursday, April 24th
Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AMEastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEDT, UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 3:00 AM (April 25th)
To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.Windows Update.Last chance pick up some glorious wings as the Resplendent Wings Box is fluttering away.Can you see yourself wearing some Eluned wear? Try out the all new Elysees Manor Box!
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 5:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - April 17th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 11:06 AM PDT and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience and apologize for the delay.
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on April 17th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 3 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.
-Time-
Thursday, April 17th
Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 10:00 AMEastern (EDT, UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CEST, UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEDT, UTC +10): 12:00 AM (April 18th) - 3:00 AM (April 18th)
To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.Looking for a change in pace? Try the second season and earn new rewards with the Erinn Adventure Pass!Both the Erinn Pass EXP Ticket and Special Erinn Pass Expansion Ticket will be available for purchase after maintenance.As mentioned in our April Update, the following mythological sword and accompanying technique have been renamed, and all accompanying text (such as from the storyline) has been replaced:Pragarah -> FragarachSeal: Pragarah -> Seal: Fragarach
The following bugs will be fixed:
An issue was causing the Def/MDef/Prot/MProt reduced via Brionac and Seal: Fragarach to be lower than expected. This has been fixed, and both should be reducing the values in the same way to the appropriate amounts.The description of this year's Lovely Doki Doki Commemorative Box has been updated to reflect the proper outfit.The Life Exploration Tools now correctly line break in the Item Attribute field.DJ Romantic will coming back from his "judging competition" on April 17th instead of April 24th. He wrote the wrong date in his calendar, it seems.Reserve Attack settings will now save upon logging out/changing channels.Fixed an issue where an untranslated message was showing when a Trade Unlock Letter of Guarantee when applied on an item.The family name of Zeder was retranslated from Shiarpe to Scharp.
The following bugs have appeared:
The Natural Dye Event has revived a quest from an old iteration of Doki Doki Island Event. This quest cannot be completed, but can be safely ignored. The quest will be removed at a later date.
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Erinn Adventure Pass - Season II
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/rurdjmvc/250403-erinnpassevent_940x290.jpg
The Erinn Adventure Pass is back! Complete different tasks to update the Pass and gain rewards each time the Pass levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can purchase a Special Erinn Pass Expansion ticket to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.
[hr][/hr]Season Dates: Thursday, April 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 31st, Before Maintenance
Erinn Adventure Pass[table noborder=1][tr][td]Upon logging in during Erinn Adventure Pass Season 2, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Chronicling an Adventure.Talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register a main character.You can only participate with one character, and this CANNOT be changed.To open the Erinn Adventure Pass, on the main task bar click on Character → Erinn Adventure Pass.You can also set a hotkey shortcut for it in Options → Game → Control → Hotkey Settings.[/td][td width=20%]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1694/ui-bubble.png[/td][/tr][/table]
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/2y0pt3n0/eap-s2-ui-board.png
With the Pass, you will receive a wide list of Daily missions for you to choose from, including but certainly not limited to:Completing Part Time JobsPlaying Musical InstrumentsCompleting a Uladh DungeonClearing Glenn BearnaAnd many, many more!Daily missions reset every day at 7:00 AM PT.
Adventure Level
[table][tr][td]Each time you complete a task, the mission will automatically complete and you will receive Adventure EXP.Collect Adventure EXP to raise the Pass Level.There are 50 levels in total. A maximum of 280 Adventure EXP can be earned per day.The limit is reset every day at 7:00 AM PDT.You can earn 1.5x more total Adventure EXP during the weekends (starting and ending at 7:00 AM PDT).You can also use additional Erinn Pass EXP Tickets to increase your Adventure EXP.The Adventure EXP gained from using an Erinn Pass EXP Ticket is not subject to the daily Adventure EXP limit.The Erinn Pass EXP Tickets can be purchased from the Item Shop.The Erinn Pass EXP Ticket has a weekly limit of 5 and resets on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT.[/td][td width=30%][table][tr][th]Erinn Pass EXP Ticket[/th][/tr][tr][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1653/grade-up.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]

notes.title: End-of-Sale Notice: Partner Trade Unlock Potion
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg
[hr][/hr]
Hello Milletians,

In the May Update, several Fantasy Life Changes related to the Partner system are abound! We are announcing the end of sale of the Partner Trade Unlock Potion in the Cash Shop, effective immediately during the April 10th, 2025 maintenance.

With the update, the tradeability and equipment tab of Partners will be made accessible without locking the item exclusively to your Partner character. The Partner Trade Unlock Potion item no longer has an effective use.

Existing Partner Trade Unlock Potions will be retrieved from all characters with the May update patch. 

For players who purchased the Partner Trade Unlock Potion item directly and still had the item in their account, they will be refunded the original value spent on the item in NX. If a player purchased the item and used it, they will not be refunded. This will be distributed with the May 8th, 2025 maintenance. 

Those eligible for the reimbursement must meet the following criteria defined below:
An account who had purchased the Partner Trade Unlock Potion item within the last 1 year (April 1st, 2024 ~ April 10th, 2025)The account still had the item:Item was not claimed from the Cash Shop Inventory
ORItem is in the inventory of the character on the account
Thank you,
- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding the Soul Streamers Program - March 7, 2025
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Dear Milletians, and our sincerest gratitude for our Soul Streamers,

We have evaluated the current operational needs and requirements of the Soul Streamer Influencer program and must announce that we need to sunset the program. To explain this decision on behalf of the dedicated team members of Mabinogi NA Marketing, due to a shift in strategic priorities, the program unfortunately can no longer be maintained. 

This by no means minimizes the achievements and dedication that our Soul Streamers and affiliated community members have shown. While there is no fault of the influencers’ work, the program and ongoing operations related to this program will conclude. Therefore, information detailing the program on our official website and social platforms has been archived.

[table][tr][td]To our Soul Streamers – 

We hope that you retain your love and appreciation for Mabinogi, and we will continue to support you and other community members in new and different ways in the future. We cannot express our thanks enough for the events you created, and we have fond memories of the many streams, videos, and messages from the community revealed through your works. Through many successful community-based efforts and events, collaborations and promotions with VTubers, celebrations of new content through videos and livestreams, and more, your dedication for Mabinogi shines.[/td][/tr][/table]

The Soul Streamers program was an effort amongst many different team members at Nexon, including the Mabinogi Development Team! We are thankful to each and every Soul Streamer, all 25 dedicated members over the course of the program, and we extend our gratitude for the trust in the project which grew and evolved over time. We are honored to have hosted many talented content creators through this program, and encourage all Milletians to create to their heart’s content, and to continue sharing your adventures. 

We hope to implement new and different methods for our Milletians to share and engage with each other’s content. We ask for your patience and understanding as these new projects may become available slowly. After all, there are many new contents to be revealed in the coming year that will require your support!

Please look forward to news about Mabinogi and our community on our official website and social platforms. Thank you once again.  

- The Mabinogi Team
Special Thanks
Special thanks to our Soul Streamer roster, as it stood on March 7, 2025. We encourage you to visit the creative pages of our community members below.

For a full list of our Soul Streamer roster at the time of this post, please visit our official webpost.

notes.title: 17th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1570/17thanni-news-940x290.jpg
[hr][/hr]Simplenogi
Options Menu
 The Options Menu has been overhauled and updated to better assist Milletians with their settings.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1686/options-menu-before-after.png
Tabs/Categories in the Options have been re-labeled and reorganized.All customizable options have been rearranged to fit the updated tab/category.Many options now have hover text to further explain their functionality.The following customization options have been removed and are permanently activated:
DitheringSky RenderingRendering SpecularShadow BlurringEnable HotkeysQuick EquipHighlight New ItemsGiant / Nascent Divinity Camera Height Adj.The following customization options have been removed and will be permanently disabled:Reserve AttackAuto-Attack is not being removed and has been relocated to the Gameplay tab.The following customization options were removed due to the option not working as intended:Use NPC Theme MusicUsing 3D SoundNew customizable settings have been added to the Options Menu:Horn Bugle - World Prem.Located under Gameplay → System → View Announcements.Unchecking this box will prevent all text from World Premium Bugles from appearing. Regular Bugles will still appear as normal in the Horn Channel.Video VolumeLocated under Sound → Video.You can now adjust the volume of video cutscenes.
Allow Astral ImagingLocated under Gameplay → Social → Community.Toggle this option for All players, Party members, or Guildmates only.The following customization options have been added to the Gameplay → Display → Show/Hide section to help increase visibility of the world of Erinn.Talent Title and Icon2nd Title IconMonster Fynni Gem IconGuild Name (Self)Guild Name (Others)Doll BagsPet/Partner NamesMonster Names (Non-Boss)Damage Skin (Others)Erg Effects (Self)Erg Effects (Others)Special Upgrade (Self)Special Upgrade (Others)Pet Fynn Sync Effect
For all above customization options, unchecking the box will remove the display of said effects.All options are checked by default.
When entering Dunbarton square, the Simplified Display Options pop-up window will appear.Clicking “Apply” will apply the recommended “Simplenogi” settings.You can still fine-tune your preferences through the Options menu.Clicking “Do not show again” will prevent the pop-up from appearing again.

NPC Shop Menu
The UI of NPC Shops has been changed to a “list” format, allowing for better visibility on items, such as cost, inventory size, and more.You can alternate between the two styles by clicking on “Switch to Bag” / “View as List” in the top right corner of the Shop Menu.A search function has been added.The shop search function is case sensitive.You can now sell up to 14 items at once when selling to an NPC.The repurchase limit from an NPC shop has been increased from 10 to 30.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1687/shop-menu-before-after.png
Title Menu
Title Menu UI has been revamped.Improved search functionality to now include effects from titles.i.e. searching “Speed” will bring up “the Busy” title.The title search function is not case sensitive.Expanded the window for easier viewing of all titles.Added a “Favorites” button to have your favorite titles be automatically listed at the top.You can still right-click a title to add/remove from the favorites’ list.A “Preview Effects” window has been added, allowing for visibility of 2nd Title Visual Effects.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1688/title-menu-before-after.png
Other Simplenogi Changes:
Talent Title icons and 2nd Title icons will now be vertically centered based on all tags displayed in the name area (Guild, Talent, Name, etc.)Spirit Transformation Liqueur (Invisible) is now available in Berched’s shop in Taillteann.When applied, all visual effects from the Spirit Weapon will be invisible.When defeating (most) non-boss monsters, the name will now be hidden and its body will turn transparent before disappearing.The Combat Log will no longer list when you’ve made a critical hit on an enemy.Auto-pathingAuto-pathing has now been added to the game as an improvement to the auto-navigation system for Milletians and their Pets.When clicking a location on the mini-map, a set route will automatically appear, allowing your character to run or ride all the way to its destination without making a 2nd marker.Auto-pathing is only available in the overworld and is not available in some areas or conditions such as:CommercingDungeonsShadow MissionsStellar CitadelAny Doki Doki FlightAuto-pathing will remember your pathing when on a mount and alternating between ground and sky.The auto-pathing must be set before taking flight.Patch Notes
Fantasy Life Changes
The Library of Secrets has been added as a Deluxe Background for Astral Imprinting.The name for the visual-only halo for Blaanid's Blessing has been renamed from Blessing Effect to Halo Effect. As this drop-down selection was always visual-only, not the strength of Blaanid's Blessing received, we hope that this better communicates as such.The death-defying technique and Cwn Annwn skill, Defiance and Veil of Mystique, have had their priorities altered. When the conditions are met, Defiance will now activate before Veil of Mystique.All non-gold currency will no longer be able to be stored in your bank.Note: Any non-gold currency currently stored in your bank account will be automatically moved to the character based on the tab the currency is stored in.These include currency such as:Dungeon Vouchers (1st Voucher, 2nd Voucher, etc.)Adventure SealsGold-Leaf Pine Cones
Bug Fixes
Thank you all for your continued reports! A lot of smaller text fixes here and there with this patch, notably updating the descriptions for Upgrade Stones to better indicate their use, polishing up text for Fate Astrologer, shortening some of the lengthier buff-related ticker messages, and correcting the necessary book for rank 3 Rest's upgrade. Also, a new description for Cilantro's favorite food!While we were updating the UIs, several text boxes have been updated to better fit the text inside the field.An issue has been fixed that was causing the Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 Scrolls and Set Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 Scrolls to not work on the following items:Set Effect Bash Enhancement +1 ScrollPerseus Brutal War HammerNightbringer EnforcerSet Effect Windmill Enhancement +1 ScrollPerseus Steeled SwordPerseus Brutal War HammerPerseus Vigilant ShieldNightbringer AssaultNightbringer EnforcerNightbringer VanguardBow-wielding Humans of Erinn, your time has come. The issue causing Arrow Revolver to lock characters in place when the burst fire was cast in extreme rapid succession with other attacks has been fixed. Nock your arrows, fire them well!Under rare circumstances, players could find themselves with two Homestead Houses. The issue has been fixed, allowing players to remove the faulty house.Despite this sounding affluent, this would lock them out from doing most things relating to the House.Effie found a few boxes of clothes in the back of her shop- these items have returned back for purchase in her Shop.Although he's a star, the Treasure Hunter Ace Talent was unintentionally giving 2x Skill Training to Fate Astrologer skills. This has been corrected.Corrected the listed Collection Categories on the Black Moon Commanders Compact Doll Bag Box. The Bag is unchanged.
2/13 Maintenance
The issue causing Astral Frames to display incorrectly (missing subjects/stickers/etc) has been fixed. The issue has occurred one last time with this week's maintenance as we corrected the root of the issue; Astral Frames will stop resetting starting next week. Frames that are currently displaying incorrectly cannot be automatically fixed, and we apologize for the inconvenience.
2/27 Maintenance 
The Black Rose Wig (F) from Tolly's Fashion event was not properly removed- we snatched your wig in this maintenance.
Known Bugs:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1592/bug_catching.pngFor those truly dedicated to Commerce and keeping Erinn stocked up- when reaching over 4.3 billion ducats, the inventory window will incorrectly return the value to 0.This is a display only issue- if you obtained another 1 billion ducats after this, the display would show 1b but you would correctly have 5.3b.The props used for Special Idle Motions are currently showing incorrectly at the start of animation cycles. There are currently issues causing the Blacklist to not work as expected for some players.Under periodic conditions, Milletians will be temporarily unable to duel other Milletians.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - March 6th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:01 AM PST and the servers are available once more. We thank you for your patience.
[hr][/hr]Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on March 6th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 6:00 AM PST and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-
Thursday, March 6th
Pacific (PST, UTC -8): 6:00 AM - 10:00 AMEastern (EST, UTC -5): 9:00 AM - 1:00 PMParis (CET, UTC +1): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PMSydney (AEDT, UTC +11): 1:00 AM (Feb 7th) - 5:00 AM (Feb 7th)
To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.UI changes, updated auto-pathing, and more in Mabinogi's 17th Anniversary Update!It's time to celebrate Mabinogi's 17th Anniversary this month! Join the celebration with the Library of Secrets Event!Acquire unique goods such as Cowenna's outfit in Pan's Attendance Check Season 7!Tell other Milletians "You've Got Mail!" in style with the all new Erinn Courier Box!Frieren and her party are ready to depart. Thank you for joining them and compleing their story! Life in Erinn with Frieren is ending. It's the last chance to grab Frieren and her party's looks! It's also the last chance to have your very own Frieren-themed Doll Bags!The Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Adventure Box Sale is ending.The Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Demon King's Army Box Sale is ending.The Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Doll Bag Box Sale is ending.
Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PST time, and will be available after the maintenance.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Library of Secrets Event
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1597/250227_libraryofsecretsevent_newsarticleheader_940x290-2.jpg
Milletian… we cordially invite you as a guest to one of Erinn’s most secretive corridors that only a select few are welcome. We ask that you enjoy your time, enjoy the celebration… and maybe read a book or two while you’re here.[hr][/hr]
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, March 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 3rd, Before Maintenance
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Upon logging in, you’ll receive the quest [Guide] 17th Anniversary: An Invitation to Mystery as well as Leath’s Letter.Read the letter to both select difficulty and register a main character.You will also receive an Orange Wings of a Goddess to whisk you to a location most Milletians are allergic to.You will receive the following rewards for completing the quest:5,000 EXPWhile only the main character will be able to participate in the story, mini-games, and earn rewards, all characters on your account will be allowed to visit the new location once you’ve discovered it.While you’re there, Leath loves to hear about your adventures, receive presents, and more! Try equipping various generational and dungeon-related titles to get a fun reaction from him! (Preferably not dog food...)[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1625/leath-2.png[/td][/tr][/table]That’s not all! Check out what else is happening around Erinn during this time of celebration:When issuing a check from any bank in Erinn, all characters will receive a 17th Anniversary Check design.
17th Anniversary Hot TimeLog in during the event period to receive special items prepared by Nao herself to celebrate 17 years of Milletians’ in Erinn!Claim the items from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose Claim Later if you wish to receive the reward on another character.You can only claim the item from the Hotday menu once during the event period.These items will not expire once acquired.
Item Details
Letter from NaoA letter personally written by Nao to you. Using the item will allow you to read the message and receive a special buff leaving you Refreshed for the next 10 minutes:HP / MP / Stamina +100Defense / Magic Defense +5Protection / Magic Protection +5Strength / Intelligence / Dexterity / Will / Luck +20Max Attack +30Critical +5%Combat EXP Bonus +150%17th Anniversary CakeA delicious cake baked by Nao. Consuming this cake will provide you with a temporary boost of the following stats:+20 Strength+20 Intelligence+20 Dexterity+20 Will+20 LuckAs this cake is one of a kind, it cannot be used as a Catering Ingredient.17th Anniversary Fantasy Star 2nd Title Coupon https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1613/17th-anniversary-title-icon.pngStats:Max Damage +17Magic Attack +17Alchemy Elemental Damage +11Strength / Intelligence / Dexterity / Will / Luck +17Movement Speed +1%
Library of Secrets Quests
Upon completion of the guide quest, you’ll receive the following quest, allowing you to learn more about the secret area and the purpose it serves:
[Event] 17th Anniversary: Be Our GuestFollow Leath’s instructions to locate the secret area.Completing all tasks will award you with the following rewards:5,000 EXP10x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.pngDeveloper’s 17th Anniversary Thank-You Notebook2x 17th Anniversary Week # Instant Prize Tickets[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]A UI Icon will appear for your main character to provide information regarding the event overall, allowing you to teleport to the event area, and allowing you to enter the Instant Prize Drawing remotely.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1652/event-ui-icon.png[/td][/tr][/table]
While you’re exploring the area, you’ll notice another Milletian that reminds you of the early years in Erinn. Join her to go down memory lane together, learn about what mini-games are available, and more! Each week, you’ll receive a new quest that reveals more about this strange Milletian and the Library of Secrets…what secrets await?
[table][tr][th]Week[/th][th]Quest[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][th]1[/th][td]17th Anniversary: A Song of Serenity[/td][td]30,000 EXP20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png
**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]17th Anniversary: The Flame of Memory[/td][td]30,000 EXP20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png
**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]17th Anniversary: May Happiness Be With You Always[/td][td]30,000 EXP20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png
**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]17th Anniversary: Going on Seventeen[/td][td]30,000 EXP20x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png
**NEW** 1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings[/td][/tr][/table]
Each quest will unlock on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PST/PDT (or after Maintenance)Week 1: March 6th, Week 2: March 13th, etc.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1618/caibres-bugle.pngCairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings - similar to other Cairbre’s bugles, this special bugle can only be used after having acquired Melody Step from Music Jam. Upon using, your Melody Step will be upgraded in both power and time, becoming Exalted Melody Step. This new buff lasts for 3 hours and gives you a +5 Musical Buff! Now run and spread the celebration all across Erinn!
Daily & Achievement Quests
It’s a month of celebration, with rewards to earn every day with the Daily Quest - [Event] 17th Anniversary: Treat Thyself!
[table][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Experience one of the enchanted tales in the Library of Secrets (Play a mini-game once)[/td][td]20x 17 Anniversary Story Snippets https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1615/17th-story-snippet-icon-1.png1x 17th Anniversary Week # Instant Prize Ticket[/td][/tr][/table]
Looking to experience it all? You’ll earn a hefty amount of Story Snippets in return by completing objectives in the Achievement Quest - [Event] 17th Anniversary: The Mabinogi, Our Never-Ending Story.
[table][tr][td][table][tr][th]Objective[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Complete the 17th Anniversary: Going On Seventeen quest. (Available March 27th)Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story SnippetsComplete the 17th Anniversary: Treat Thyself quest 20 times.Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story SnippetsSpeak with Duncan in Tir Chonaill with the Undelivered Letter in your possession.Reward: 200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets[/td][td]171717 EXP10,000 Gold200x 17th Anniversary Story Snippets1x Cairbre’s Bugle of Abundant Blessings**NEW** Branches of the Mabinogi Set Selection Box 
(Click Right Image for Outfit Animation)[/td][/tr][/table][/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1651/mabinogi-celtic-branch-outfit-mplusf.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Celebration of Mini-games
What’s an anniversary celebration without mini-games? The Booksprites around the library have set up many different types of mini-games to test your skills, knowledge, and reflexes. You’ll earn unique prizes from each mini-game, so be sure to check them all out!
Attempting any of the mini-games will net you a 17th Anniversary Story Snippet.You can only earn 5 Story Snippets per day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT) across all mini-games. Don’t try to fool the Booksprites, they know and see all!
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]Who's that Whirling Sprite?
Speak to Yoyo towards the back of the library to start this mini-game!You’ll watch several Booksprites whirling around with one being different from the rest. You’ll need to guess what that unique Booksprite looked like, but be quick! They won’t be on screen for too long!There are 5 rounds in total, each round will be tougher than the last, so sharpen those observation skills Milletians!Depending on how many you get correct, you can earn up to 30,000 Exploration EXP.Getting at least 3 correct will net you a Library of Secrets Transformation Medal Fragment.Combine 3 fragments to acquire a Shamala’s Transformation Medal.You are limited to obtaining 3 fragments per real life day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT).[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1661/whirling-sprite-minigame.png[/td][/tr][/table]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]Sprite of Order
Talk to Nono in the top-right corner (near the giant book and scrolls) to get started!You're given 60 seconds to sort as many dyes as possible.Each successful sort will net you 3 points.Each incorrect sort will cost you 2 points.After the mini-game, you can turn your points into Combat EXP or Exploration EXP.If selecting Combat EXP, the amount earned is based upon your Final Score x 1,000.If selecting Exploration EXP, the amount earned is based upon your Final Score x 100.Score over 350 points to earn a random Fixed Color Dye Ampoule!You can only earn 1 dye per day (resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT).Dye expires in 7 days.Potential Colors available are:[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1659/dye-sorting-minigame.png[/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]#F1EBC6[/td][td]#73824B[/td][td]#684329[/td][td]#E1DDCD[/td][/tr][tr][td]#F8E610[/td][td]#2F4A2F[/td][td]#B3B3C4[/td][td]#EFE8E5[/td][/tr][tr][td]#927A5C[/td][td]#51423C[/td][td]#8D3131[/td][td]#191616[/td][/tr][tr][td]#767272[/td][td]#100F0F[/td][td]#373F57[/td][td]#6F5F4C[/td][/tr][/table]
Stage of Trials
Looking to showcase your achievements and scale the toughest boss rush Erinn has to offer? The Stage of Trials is for you then! The trials have two modes: Basic and Veteran. Talk to Fofo who is next to Nono in the Library or read below on what to expect:
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td]Every Day, you’re given 3 attempts to make it to the end of the trials.The Stage of Trials is a 1-room dungeon with 15 bosses.The following restrictions apply in the dungeon:Cannot summon petsCannot reviveCannot enter with a partyCannot use a Rag DollCannot use a Marshal WeaponCannot use a Remote Bank CouponCannot have accepted a Shadow Mission
Note: The above items cannot be in your inventory - be sure to check your point inventory as well!The following additional restrictions apply when attempting Veteran mode:Cannot use potions.Cannot use the following skills:Anchor RushTumbleWings of Eclipse[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1660/stage-of-trials.png[/td][/tr][/table]In Basic, you’ll be given a rest point after every 3 rounds.Additionally, the stage manager will apply one of the following buffs of your choosing:PowerDefenseSpeedIn Veteran, you’ll attempt to clear it without any rest period or extra buffs.
Of course, we wouldn’t leave our most courageous Milletians without goodies!
Completing at least the first stage of the trials each day will count towards the Daily and Achievement Quests of the Event.Limit once per real life day; resets at 7:00 AM PST/PDT.For each attempt, you can choose your type of reward EXP:Combat EXPExploration EXPMusic Renown EXPLife Renown EXPFinally, the Booksprites are providing titles for those who reach the following accomplishments:

[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Title[/th][th]Stats[/th][th]Requirements[/th][/tr][tr][td]who Took the First Step to the Stage (1st Title)**[/td][td]Luck +19[/td][td]Clear at least 1 round in the Stage of Trials (Basic or Veteran)[/td][/tr][tr][td]who Upstaged the Stage of Trials (2nd Title)[/td][td]Max Attack +17
Magic Attack +17[/td][td]Clear the Stage of Trials
(Basic or Veteran)[/td][/tr][tr][td]who Bested the Stage of Trials (1st Title)[/td][td]Max Damage +30*
Magic Attack +45*[/td][td]Clear the Stage of Trials (Veteran)[/td][/tr][/table]* Stats Expire after 30 days once awarded.** If you already acquired the “who Took the First Step to the Stage” title from the 16th Anniversary Event, you will not receive another.
Dungeons that Drag-on
Do you enjoy dungeons? Do you enjoy roleplaying?, then this mini-game’s for you! Talk to the Elder Booksprite to get started!
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td]This mini-game will have you roleplay one of three famous characters as you clear a Uladh Dungeon.Legendary Warrior - RenoLegendary Mage - VayLegendary Archer - TionYou’ll work with the other two legendary characters to complete the dungeon.Completing each room will allow your character to grow stronger, tackling stronger enemies with each room until you reach the boss.Despite the dungeon consisting of the legendary trio, this mini-game is solo-only.Completing the dungeon will earn you the following rewards:+10 Levels for your character.If you are Level 190 or higher, you will only gain levels up to the Level cap of 200.1x Aggressor’s Will1x Defender’s WillYou can earn up to 3 Aggressor’s and Defender’s Will per day.Both the Aggressor’s and Defender’s Will will expire after 14 days.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1658/dungeons-drag-on.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Developer Thank You Notes
Throughout the celebration, enemies throughout Erinn will drop Thank-You Note Fragments. As you received the Developer’s Notebook in [Event] 17th Anniversary: Be Our Guest, be sure to collect all 27 fragments to complete the book, composed of thank you notes, heartfelt messages, and even custom artwork from the Mabinogi Team!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1602/thank-you-notes.png
Instant Prize Capsule Machine
Tucked away in a small corner of the Library of Secrets, you notice a little prize machine filled with goodies. It reminds you of the one in Festia in prior years. What potential prizes are up for grabs this year?
[table noborder=1][tr][td]Click on the Capsule Machine in the Southwest corner of the library to open the Instant Prize Window. If you’re too busy to stop by the Library, you can also enter remotely through the Event UI Button!You can use 20,000 Gold or 1x Instant Prize Ticket to draw from the Capsule Machine.The capsule can only hold so much gold, so to be fair to all participating Milletians, only 20 gold entries per real-life day will be accepted.Instant Prize Tickets do not have a limit, but you will only be able to use the current week’s tickets.Gold entries reset every real life day at 8:00 PM PST/PDT.Higher-end prizes are in limited stock and are for the entire server.The Prize Window will display how many prizes are left for the server.All prizes will be re-stocked every Thursday at 7:00 AM PST/PDT.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1664/instant-prize-machine.png[/td][/tr][/table]
