notes.title: September Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1698/240829-wgc-1400-mb-septemberupdate-940x290.png
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.png Elemental Knight Skill Changes https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1580/ek-icon.pngThe Link Bonus effect has been improved.At Link Level 10, you can now use all 3 Elemental Instillments simultaneously.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png All Instillments
Instillments will deactivate if either your Mana or Stamina are exhausted and will reactivate again when both are above 100.When multiple Elemental Instillments are activated, the consumption rate will increase based on how many Instillments are active.The Minimum and Maximum Damage effects now stack when multiple Elemental Instillments are activated.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1584/instill-flame.png Instill Flame 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have increased for most skill ranks.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +1.1% (0.5% → 1.6%)Rank 2: +0.4% (2.5% → 2.9%)Rank 1: No Change (3% → 3%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1585/instill-frost.png Instill Frost 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have decreased for each skill rank.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: -0.4% (1.0% → 0.6%)Rank 1: -3.0% (5% → 2%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1586/instill-thunder.png Instill Thunder 
The Minimum and Maximum Damage Increases have changed for each skill rank.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +2.6% (1% → 3.6%)Rank 1: -1.0% (6% → 5%)
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1574/blazing-assault-slash.png Blazing Assault Slash 
Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 400% Additional DamageInstill Frost: Reduce’s target’s Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 20% for 5 seconds.Instill Thunder: Pulls all stricken enemies to the target’s location
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1590/shattering-windmill.png Shattering Windmill 
Damage Calculations have been changed.
Before: Windmill Rank Damage + Base Damage +  Additional Damage after Frozen Effect ends.Example: Based on Rank 1:Windmill Rank Damage + 300% of Base Damage + 1200% After Frozen DamageAfter: Windmill Rank Damage + Increased Base Damage.Example: Based on Rank 1:Windmill Rank Damage + 1500% of Base Damage.Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 450% Additional DamageInstill Frost: Attack Radius +2 metersInstill Thunder: 500% Damage to Enemies every 2 seconds for 5 seconds.Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 10 seconds.Increased the duration of frozen enemies at higher ranks.Example: Based on Rank 5 to 1:Ranks 5-2: 4 secondsRank 1: 5 secondsThe duration of the Frozen Status effect now resets when Shattering Windmill is used again while the target is still frozen.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1578/dynavolt-smash.png Dynavolt Smash 
Additional Effects have been added while using Instills.Example: Based on Rank 1:Instill Flame: 600% Additional DamageInstill Frost: 1200% Additional Damage to Enemies frozen by Shattering WindmillInstill Thunder: Attack Width +2 meters; Attack Length +5 meters【 Developer Comments 】

To create a better play pattern and play experience, the development team decided to allow simultaneous use of Instill Element, granting Elemental Knights the benefits of all three Instillments (Flame, Frost, Thunder) at once. Additionally, the additional effects that each Instillment grants to the primary skills (Blazing Assault Slash, Shattering Windmill, Dynavolt Smash) have been modified to increase the link between skills as well as to provide utility and benefits to individual skills, such as increased attack range and pulling enemies inward.

As we are increasing the power of Instill Element, the upkeep cost (Mana, Stamina) will increase when multiple Instillments are activated. Our intention is that players will consider their situation and increased upkeep cost, selecting which and how many Instillments to use accordingly, rather than having all three elements up at all times. Each additionally applied Instillment will grant further increased damage, so we have adjusted the damage increase granted by each element.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.png Harmonic Saint Skill Changes https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1582/hs-icon.pngThe Link Bonus effects have been improved at the following levels:Link Level 6Warmth of Life is now granted to the caster when allies are standing in Pulse of Purification’s area of effect.Link Level 8A new Veil of Life effect is applied when healing an ally or self with Hand of Restoration or Echoes of Salvation.Veil of Life converts healing into a shield at the default healing amount when a player is at full health with no wounds.The Veil of Life condition lasts for 60 seconds or when the shield has been exhausted, whichever comes first.The Veil of Life will reduce incoming damage by 50%.Those under the effect of Veil of Life will be immune to most knockback and stun.Link Level 9Pulse of Purification no longer recovers HP and Wounds for allies within range by 160 upon inflicting damage to enemies.Now grants Warmth of Life at Link Level 6.Grants Music Buff +3Pulse of Purification Radius +3 meters
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1579/echos-of-salvation.png Echoes of Salvation 
Now heals wounds for each skill rank:Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: +100 Wound RecoveryRank 1: +250 Wound RecoveryMP and Stamina recovery are now instantaneous rather than increased recovery speed.Additional MP and Stamina recovery based on the Rank of Enduring Melody’s recovery speed.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1591/voice-of-vitality.png Voice of Vitality 
Voice of Vitality’s Effect will now remain even when incapacitated.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1575/blessing-of-protection.png Blessing of Protection 
If the health of an ally or self is below 10% or in Deadly status, casting Blessing of Protection will now restore health up to 10%.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1589/pulse-of-purification.png Pulse of Purification 
The usage method for the skill has been changed so that you can click the area that you wish to cast the skill.Numerous changes have been made for each rank.Example: Based on Rank 1.Deals 3,000 Magic Damage/second to enemies within the skill’s radius.Restores 200 HP, MP, and Stamina per second.Grants Stun and Knockdown Immunity to allies within the skill’s radius.Deals an additional 10,800 Magic Damage after the skill ends to any enemies remaining in the skill’s radius.Casting Time has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second.Cooldown has been drastically reduced from 360 seconds to 60 seconds.Now only consumes Mana upon use.The skill can now be canceled by using the skill again while activated.The skill’s Piercing Effect has been removed.Visibility of the Skill’s Effect has been enhanced.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1588/polyphonic-melody.png Polyphonic Melody 
A new skill acquired upon reaching Level 3 of Harmonic Saint.Provides a chance for the next use of Enduring Melody, March Song, or Harvest Song to stack with other Musical Buffs.Example: Based on various ranks of the Skill:Rank F: 30% Strength of BuffRank 9: 60% Strength of BuffRank 5: 80% Strength of BuffRank 1: 100% Strength of BuffOnly 2 Musical Buffs can be active at the same time.You are unable to stack the same Musical Buff.【 Developer Comments 】

Harmonic Saint has been modified to maintain its role as party support. Some of the less meaningful Arcana Link effects have been adjusted, and a brand new effect Veil of Life has been added into Link Level 8. Hand of Restoration and Echoes of Salvation are powerful heals, but are limited to only healing missing health, so it can be difficult to respond immediately to every situation. With Link Level 8, Veil of Life will activate when healing those with full health, and provide an additional shield proportional to the strength of the heal cast. This effect will allow Harmonic Saints to apply preemptive support.

When considering that higher difficulty dungeons require more active play, the development team decided to allow continuous party support even while using Pulse of Purification. We felt this would allow for a more positive and synergistic experience. Additionally, by reducing the immediate damage output of the skill and supplementing it with a highly reduced cooldown and a party member support effect, Harmonic Saints will be able to leverage Pulse of Purification more often in combat. We hope you enjoy it!

Lastly, a new skill, Polyphonic Melody, has been added to increase the Harmonic Saint's contribution to the party. However, we have found that with Share Music Buffs settings, the best possible buff combination would be different for various talents, and some talents may not be able to fully benefit from such situations or require different combinations from others, causing those talents to be less favored in parties. Thus, we decided to limit the songs that can be activated with the Polyphonic Melody to Enduring Melody, March Song, and Harvest Song to allow each member of the party to benefit from the buff effects while keeping the Harmonic Saint's party contribution ability intact.
Non-Arcana Skill Changes
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1595/smash.png Normal Attack/Smash
Enemies who have Counterattack loaded and are not the intended target will not trigger its use nor be affected by the attack splash.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1593/bash.png Bash
Stacks now decrease by 1 instead of all stacks when the retention timer ends.Fixed an issue where the skill could not be used on enemies in Finish State.
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1594/rage-impact.png Rage Impact
Now accounts for sizes of enemies when measuring distance.Enemies hit by Rage Impact now have the debuff applied to them for the entire duration.Debuff duration decreased from 10 seconds to 7 seconds.Melee Attack Bonus Damage has been decreased at all ranks.Example: Based on Rank 1:Reduced from 50% to 15%.Glyphs with the Rage Impact Skill augment have had the Melee Attack Bonus Damage reduced from 1% to 0.3% per level.Imperial Knight Gloves have【 Developer Comments 】

Rage Impact previously would increase the strength of the next melee attack’s damage after it was applied onto a target. However, when factoring in party play, it was very likely that this effect would be consumed unintentionally, making it difficult to fully utilize this damage increase. 

To resolve this, we modified the effect from the skill. Targets affected by Rage Impact will now take increased damage from all melee attacks during its duration. In order to keep this balanced, we have adjusted the duration and damage increase. 

We have also adjusted the Rage Impact enhancement effects to match this change. Like Rage Impact, the damage multiplier for the enhancements have decreased, but will now apply for all melee damage applied during the duration. We expect this to increase synergistic use in combat.

notes.title: Developer's Note: Moonlight Island Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, Milletians!

Greetings from the Mabinogi Development Team,

Last week saw the debut of the Moonlight Island update, bringing a whole new dimension of fun to Milletians.

Moonlight Island is Mabinogi's newest life content, allowing players to create and customize their very own Island, invite visitors to become residents, and continue to grow and expand the Island by using their islanders' skills to good use.

The development team has analyzed ways in which we might make Moonlight Island more enjoyable and accessible for everyone. After much discussion, we have included the following updates:

Improving the Starter Guide
Moonlight Island is an expansive and multifaceted offering, especially considering that it adds a variety of resources and vectors for growth. We decided it would be beneficial to improve how the game better explains those systems to players and expand access to the materials needed to help one's Island grow in its early stages. By doing this, we hoped it would help players to not only understand everything Moonlight Island has to offer, but get them off to a good start in developing their Islands.

The best way to accomplish this was to enhance Moonlight Island's tutorial questline.

Reviewing our existing material, we've made revisions to help walk you through the different systems available on Moonlight Island. It is our hope that the addition of step-by-step Guide Quests, which award Moonlight Island materials, will provide a supportive foundation to help you become more familiar with Island growth.

Lastly, we've added Amelia, a brand-new NPC ready to greet you on Moonlight Island. Amelia has plenty of help to offer, running you through Moonlight Island's systems and offering a variety of items for use on the Island in her shop.

Reducing the Difficulty of Island Growth and Management
Our aim with Moonlight Island was to give players a fun experience as they settle on their Island, complete with residents, using the skill points earned from growth to customize the attributes of Island and Islanders alike.

To help Milletians enjoy the excitement of populating their Island sooner, we decided that we needed to ease up on the requirements for the initial stages of growth. We've reduced the EXP needed to level up the Island and the Islanders to accomplish that.

We understood that the time and the cost of managing Moonlight Island were somewhat high. As a result, we've made it easier for your Islander’s production activities by making adjustments to several elements that could be exhausting or costly.

Increasing the Accessibility of Island-styling Elements
One of the most engaging and captivating features of Moonlight Island is that you can expand the Island and reshape its terrain to your liking. Landscape Essences are required to make alterations to the terrain, and we've made them available not only through the guide quests I mentioned earlier, but in Amelia's Shop as well.

Also, since we expected players might initially find it challenging to obtain the Moonlight Island Special Production Materials necessary to expand their Islands, we lowered the requirements for the first stage of Island expansion, making it easier for more Milletians to reach that momentous milestone.

Celebrated the Update With a Boost Event
We held a two-week celebration boost event to celebrate the launch of the Moonlight Island update and helped every Milletian get their Island off to a great start.

During the event, Amelia's Shop sold some of the Moonlight Island Special Production items that bolstered your combat abilities, which allowed you to try them out until enough Milletians improved their Islands enough to start crafting them. In addition, to help ensure you had plenty of items to customize your Moonlight Island, Amelia's Shop sold Amelia's Homestead Boxes, which contained one of the many Homestead furnishings.

During the event period, EXP acquired from Moonlight Island Production increased for both the Island and Islanders alike, and you saw increased chances for visitors to drop by your Moonlight Island.

It's our hope that your beautifully decorated Moonlight Island will become a beloved place you can go to relax, and we'll continue listening to your feedback and making improvements as we go.

The detailed guide page below contains additional information about Moonlight Island and its features.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1266/240802-wgc-1291-mb-moonlight-island-guide-940x290-v2.png

As always, we'll continue striving to create a more enjoyable environment for every player, working hard to make you proud to be a Milletian.

Thank you.

- The Mabinogi Development Team –

notes.title: [Notice] Aug. 8 Account Sanctions
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

In our recent August patch, we noted that an exploit involving Treasure Chest Keys had been fixed and was under further investigation. During this investigation, we have found numerous accounts that have rampantly abused this method to gain an abnormal amount of rewards from Glenn Bearna, exploiting the issue multiple times. These accounts will be facing immediate bans, ranging from permanent to temporary, based on the severity that they abused this issue.
63 players will be facing immediate bans of varying lengths based on the severity at which they've abused the exploit. Accounts that have had leniency placed upon them for prior offenses are subject to stronger punitive action
While we cannot disclose specific details of the bans directly, if you have any questions regarding your account, please submit a ticket to Player Support. As a reminder, use of and discussion of exploits are against Mabinogi's Terms of Service.

Thank you for your understanding.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: G26 Winds of Fate Part 2 + Moonlight Island Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1276/240729_augustupdate_socials_newsarticlefooter_940x290.png
[hr][/hr]Winds of Fate
Search for traces of Delga and the Divine Beasts on the continent of Iria. To plot your course, Aine and her companions turn to old, faded writings they've collected to guide them!
Generation 26 - Winds of Fate - Part 2 has been added.Players who have completed Generation 26 Part 1 will automatically receive the quest The Open Door.After completing Generation 26, you can talk to the Researcher next to the Poulnabrone in Dunbarton to receive a copy of the Winds of Fate Collection Book for your Mabinovel.Completing Generation 26 will award the player with one of the following titles based on their choices during the story:who Seeks to Bring Orderwho Strives for a Better Lifewho Dreams of a New WorldThe G26 Winds of Fate Clear Reward Box has been added and is awarded after completion of Generation 26 - Part 2.
Use the item to receive an invitation for Roisin to appear in your Moonlight Island.


https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1266/240802-wgc-1291-mb-moonlight-island-guide-940x290-v2.png
[hr][/hr]Moonlight Island
Moonlight Island has been added.Players who have a Homestead created will receive the quest [Guide] Moonlighting in Island Development upon log-in.The existing Homestead Hotkey (Default: “U”) has been updated to a new menu/UI.Information and Activity regarding both the Milletian’s Moonlight Island and Homestead will be visible through the new menu.Players will be able to enter both their Homestead and Moonlight Island through the new menu.The Weekly Island Spotlight will feature a highly active Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the week.Today’s Islander will randomly select a resident of a random Milletian’s Moonlight Island and display it for the day.Islanders will visit your Moonlight Island!Each day, a new Visitor will visit your island.Islanders can be invited to stay on your island through the use of a Resident Invitation, obtained after completing a Visitor's quest and tasks.Islanders can produce unique materials through various activities and facilities through Moonlight Island.Doing such activities will spend a Islander’s endurance.An Islander’s endurance can be restored by gifting food, certain items, leveling up your Island, or naturally over time.Milletians can help their Residents grow by ranking their skills and abilities.Certain abilities require Resident Journals, which can be obtained from spare Resident Invitations you acquire.Residents can also be removed from the island.Any time, effort, and journals used to rank the resident’s abilities will not be refunded.Milletians may dress their Residents with outfits and weapons.Effects from certain outfits will not trigger (e.g. Patron Wear).Certain Tuatha de Dannan will also visit your Moonlight Island.These noticeable characters will assist you with your Island when visiting through special shops, gifts, or buffs.You will need to complete Generation 26 - Part 2 in order to have them visit.The ability to alter the landscape on Moonlight Island with Terrain Change Mode has been added.A new "Moonlight Island" Tab in Quests (Default: "Q") has been dedicated to all Moonlight Island quests.Read more about Moonlight Island in the dedicated Moonlight Island Guide!
(Available after the update goes live!)

Fantasy Life Changes
Bugles
A cooldown of 30 seconds has been applied to all Bugles.
When attempting to use a bugle within this cooldown, you will receive an error message.
 
Curious to know what else was added? Be sure to check out the full Patch Notes!
(Available after the update goes live!)

notes.content:
Catch some rays at the Connous Beach! Log in each day and get a mixed drink from Hafgan on the house. Now's your time to play some of the mini-games for Magical Pieces and other useful dye ampoules! Check out the details below.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1619/drinkies.png
[Update 2:15 PM Aug 8]: We're aware that purchasable items from Hafgan's Vacation Shop are not populating properly if you've previously purchased the product in past event periods. 
The team is looking into this and will share further information when the issue is resolved! Thank you for your patience.
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, August 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 5th, Before Maintenance
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] A Time To Chill.Log in during the event period to receive the Orange Wings of the Goddess to travel to the Connous Beach Metallurgy Site.Event NPCs and props have been moved to the plaza in Port Connous.Register a main character with Hafgan located inside the Tropical Orange Drink Stand.Once you register your main character, you will receive a cocktail and a Vacation Box.Once [Guide] A Time To Chill has been completed, you will receive the following rewards:10,000 EXP
Talk to Hafgan each day to receive a cocktail and a Vacation Box.You will receive a different cocktail each day:Monday: June Bug (Instantly grants 500% of EXP needed)Tuesday: Cosmopolitan x3 (Recover full HP, MP, Stamina, and Wounds)Wednesday: Mojito (Gain 50 AP)Thursday: Martini (Increase EXP by 35% after Resting for 36 min. Lasts for 3 days)Friday: Blue Hawaii (Rewards from clearing a Shadow Mission will be increased by 360%)Saturday: Pina Colada x3 (Increase Movement Speed by 40%)Sunday: Long Island Iced Tea (All Skill Training EXP x2)These are event versions of existing consumables and will not stack with their non-event versions. For example, the Long Island Iced Tea item will not stack with a Complete Skill EXP Potion.
Vacation Coin DetailsCollect Vacation Coins by logging in or doing the assigned daily quests.You can redeem the Vacation Coins with Hafgan for hot rewards!The daily reset is at 12:00 AM PDT.

notes.title: Milletian Events: Black Combo Card Event
notes.content:
Psst, you. Yes, you. Move 3 steps to the right and act natural. Secret Agent Joe as a special training mission for you. Can you handle it? He's willing to provide you with a Black Combo Card if you do. This message will self-destruct on August 15th. More info is below.
[hr][/hr]
Black Combo Card Event
Event Dates: Thursday, July 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 15th, Before Maintenance

Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] Black Combo Card.Talk to a particularly inconspicuous Special Agent Joe in the Dunbarton Town Square. Register a main character with Special Agent Joe.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Black Combo Card:5,000 EXPIncomplete Black Combo CardBlack Combo Card Special Mission PassThe event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.When the event ends, all event quests and event items will be deleted (Incomplete Black Combo Card, Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission Pass, Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons).Note: All Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons registered in the Auction House will be deleted. Please collect all proceeds from sales before the maintenance. Unreceived sales proceeds will not be recovered and instead donated to pay for Ferghus' blacksmithing classes.

Special Agent Joe's Special TrainingYou will receive the daily quest, [Event] Black Combo Card Special Mission.You will receive the following rewards after completing the quest:20,000 EXPBlack Combo Card Special Mission Pass x2Use the Black Combo Card Special Mission Pass and complete the mission. To enter the mission, right-click "Use" on the pass.You are able to choose the difficulty level for the mission.
Beginner is about the same as the Hard Shadow Missions.
Normal is about the same as the Elite Shadow Missions.
Advanced is as hard as Tech Duinn Missions.You can earn a maximum of 90 Black Combo Card Points per day.You will earn 30 Black Combo Card Points for clearing 1 mission, regardless of difficulty level.You can enter this mission 5 times a day.
Entering the mission will count towards the limit, regardless if you succeed or fail the mission.You can complete this mission with a party of up to 4 people.Our intel recommends entering with a full party of 4 to maximize your chance at success.When completing this mission, you will receive EXP, Gold, and a Treasure Chest Key depending on the difficulty level.
The treasure chest will grant a random potion, leather/silk/fabric, and Skill Combo Card Fragment of a Talent.
The higher the difficulty of the mission, the more Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Combo Card Exchange Coupons you will receive.
Combine 10 Skill Combo Card Fragments of the same Talent to receive a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon for that talent.
The mission consists of 5 waves of Caravan Joe and his cousins... we think. This intel we've been told is unconfirmed.

Special Agent Joe's Dispatch CommissionAfter participating in Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission once for the day, the Dispatch Commission option will become available.Exchange one Special Agent Joe's Special Training Mission Pass and 300,000 Gold to receive the rewards from Advanced difficulty immediately, and 30 Combo Points (up to the limit of 90 points per day).The daily Event Mission entry count will be reduced by 1, and cannot exceed the daily mission limit of 5 missions per day.You will not receive EXP or Gold for completing with a Dispatch Commission.

Incomplete Black Combo CardBy completing Special Agent Joe's Special Training Missions, you can receive 30 Combo points, up to 90 Combo points per day.Combo points can be used to modify the Incomplete Black Combo Card.Right-click "Use" on the Incomplete Black Combo Card in your inventory, then click Customize Combo Card.
Select a Slot Number of the Incomplete Black Combo Card and choose to change the skill, or unlock the slot.**NEW** You can use 90 Combo points and a [Talent] Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon to change one skill of the Incomplete Black Combo Card to a skill of your choice.You can use 60 Combo points to unlock a new skill on the selected Slot Number.
Note: Slots must be unlocked in order from Slot Number 4 to Slot Number 6.You can click on Bonus Reset for Slots 2 through 6, and reset the bonus value of the Slot using 30 Combo points.The Bonus Reset Value is determined by different probabilities within the parameters of each slot:Slot 2: 0~10%Slot 3: 0~12%Slot 4: 0~15%Slot 5: 0~20%Slot 6: 0~30%**NEW** Alternatively, clicking on Fixed Bonus Change will apply a fixed value to your combo card slot with the payment of 90 Combo Points and a small sum of 1,000,000 Gold.The Fixed Bonus Value is based on the chosen slot:Slot 2: +8%Slot 3: +10%Slot 4: +12%Slot 5: +16%Slot 6: +24%When you are satisfied with the Black Combo Card, click on Complete Combo Card to receive the Black Combo Card in your Combo Card menu.
Do not complete the card until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.Completing the Combo Card is NOT reversible. Even if you complete the card by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.Only one Black Combo Card can be completed during the event period.The Black Combo Card will expire in 30 days, but can be extended or made permanent using the Permanent Combo Card Coupon item.Once you have completed the card, you can no longer edit it.Similar to normal Combo Cards, you can customize it using Advancement Badges.Here is a list of skills you can receive for the Black Combo Card:

notes.title: Master Plan: Sizzling Summer Boot Camp
notes.content:
There's a heat frenzy hitting Erinn and there's only one cure - the Summer Master Plan Event! Join in this year's summer Boot Camp that's sure to be sizzling! Enroll with the Mercenaries and train like never before. Curious to see what benefits this camp has to offer? Mercenary Liaison Cineraria has the details or check out more below!
[hr][/hr]
Event Dates: Thursday, July 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 12th, Before Maintenance

Event DetailsDuring the event period, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Calling All Mercenaries!Find Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton near the Upgrade Anvil.Talk to Cineraria to learn more about the program and to complete the quest.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Calling All Mercenaries!:5,000 EXPAccess to the Mercenary Training Guide.View your play records during the event period, available benefits, and even move to the NPC Specialists.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2312/even-icon-white.pngYou’ll receive the quest [Guide] Ready for Action.Talk to Cineraria again to register a main character for the event.You can only register one character per account.The main character will have access to the following benefits:Master Plan InventoryPet RentalWeekly QuestsYou will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Ready for Action:5,000 EXPCineraria’s Brawn-ic Tonic
Drink this to increase your stats for the duration of the event:Defense +10Protection +5Magic Defense +10Magic Protection +5HP +500MP +500Stamina +500
[hr][/hr]Pet, Inventory, and Weapon RentalAfter getting registered, you’ll receive the quest [Guide] Boot Camp Benefits.You will receive the following rewards after completion:5,000 EXPTalk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton to learn more about the Pet Rental Program.You can rent a Level 200 Ceraunus.You can only rent one Ceraunus per account.The rental pet does not have an inventory and expires once the event has ended after September 12th.The pet whistle will be removed at the end of the event if it has not been used.Talk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton to learn more about the Master Plan Inventory Rental Service.You will be able to use the Master Plan Inventory, which has a 15x10 inventory size for the duration of the event.The Master Plan Inventory is accessible by clicking on the Master Plan Inventory bag icon in the top-right of your main inventory window.Once the event ends, the inventory space will be locked. No items can be put into the bag, but all items can be retrieved at your leisure.Talk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria in Dunbarton to learn more about the Weapon Rental Program.You can rent a pre-enchanted, pre-upgraded, and pre-reforged (Rank 1) weapon of your preferred talent.The rental service is free; however, you can only rent one weapon at a time.To rent a different weapon, destroy your current rental weapon, then talk to Mercenary Liaison Cineraria to request a different weapon to rent.Rental weapons can only be used during the event period and will be removed once the event ends.[table][tr][th]Talent[/th][th]Weapon[/th][/tr][tr][td]Alchemy[/td][td]Celtic Tetra Cylinder (Rental)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Archery[/td][td]Celtic Ancient Bow (Rental)

finale week, you will receive the benefits and support from all the scouts.Only the main character can receive the Combat Support BoxYou will receive the weekly quest, [Guide] Strength for the During the finale week, all event benefits from the mercenaries will be available.The following items will only be given to the main character:Combat Buff Support BoxDuring the finale week, you will receive the quests [Event] Cineraria’s Final Training and [Event] The Capstone Course.Complete the requirements listed on the quest scroll to receive Summergold x40 as well as the following rewards:[table][tr][th][Event] Cineraria's Final Training[/th][th][Event] The Capstone Course[/th][/tr][tr][td]Baltane Mission Crystal (x3)Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day)Potent Finest Shadow Mission CrystalPet EXP Potion (1 Day)[/td][td]Day 1: Dungeon/SM/Baltane Elite Pass Selection BoxDay 2: Amplified Skill Training Seal (50)Day 3: Renown Seal (250) Selection Box (x5)Day 4: Pet Rebirth PotionDay 5: Mysterious Spirit Stone (50%)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Note: All items expire within 15 days.[/td][/tr][/table]

Reunited Milletian Hotday
Log in during the Masterplan event period to receive the Reunited Milletian 1st Title Coupon reward.Claim the item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose Claim Later if you wish to receive the reward on another character.The item cannot be moved between characters through the bank.You can only claim the item from the Hotday menu once during the event period.Reunited Milletian 1st Title Max Dmg +10STR +5INT +5DEX +5WILL +5LUCK +5Movement Speed +1%2x All Skill Training EXP2x EXP for missions and dungeon (1.5x EXP for party members) Note: The title and title coupons will be removed when the event ends.

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2348/240627_julyupdate_socials_newsarticlefooter_940x290.png

Winds of Fate
With multiple divine beasts appearing throughout Uladh, Etain and Eirawen make a secret pact to overcome the crisis by working together and recruiting the Milletian and four mercenaries to handle the new threat.
Generation 26 - Winds of Fate - Part 1 has been added.Players who have completed Generation 25 will automatically receive the quest When Fate Comes Knocking.Players who have not completed Generation 25, but have reached at least Level 5,000 will receive a window notification that the storyline is available to start if they so choose.You may start the storyline by clicking the “Start G26 Winds of Fate” button in the Storyline Menu.Voice acting (Korean) has been added to all characters in the story.You can adjust the volume of the voices through the options menu by going to the following:Options -> System -> Sound -> Voice Volume
Fantasy Life Changes
Enchant Naming
Enchant Scrolls will now display the name of the enchant in its name.The Auction House search function has been updated to allow you to search by the enchant name.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2425/enchant-search.png
Case-Sensitive Closed
Searches within the Auction House and Traveler's Guide are no longer case-sensitive!https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2424/dead-bee-case-sensitive.png
NPC Chat Log
The Chat Log now has a dedicated tab for NPC Chat.All conversations that appear in the NPC Conversation window will appear in the chat log.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2422/npc-chat-log.png
Durability Indicator
A new window will appear when the durability of your equipped item is close to breaking.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2423/durability-indicator.pngAbove 20%, the indicator will display normally.At under 20%, the indicator will display Yellow.At 0% durability, the indicator will display Red.The indicator will appear when you have any items equipped in your gear tab.You can disable the indicator in the settings by going to:Options → Game → Etc. → Hide Durability Alert
Forgetful Potions
All Special Forgetful Potions will be renamed to “Forgetful Potion”.All Forgetful and Special Forgetful Potions now reset every day at 7:00 AM PDT.The timer of any Forgetful and Special Forgetful potions currently on cooldown will reset with the upcoming maintenance to accommodate the change.
Inventory Identifier
Improvements to the UI have been made so it can be easier to see which inventory space belongs to a bag.Hovering over a bag will darken the inventory that the bag belongs to.Hovering over an item name in the "Inventory Magnifying Glass" will darken the inventory space that item is in.
Erinn Essence
When using a title coupon obtained from Erinn Spirit that has already been collected, you will now receive Erinn Essence, which can be traded in with Eavan at Dunbarton for a title coupon you may not yet have. The following list of 2nd Title Coupons are available for purchase:[table][tr][th]

notes.title: Renovation Season 5: Close Combat and Lance Changes
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1994/renos5-news-940x290.jpg
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1967/grandmaster_close_combat_icon.png Close Combat
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1968/smash.png Smash
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:Before: Humans and Elves: 620%, Giants: 720%After: Humans and Elves: 800%, Giants: 900%The cooldown of Smash is reduced at higher ranks.Before:3 seconds at all ranks.After:Rank F ~ Rank A: No ChangeRank 9 ~ Rank 1: 2.5 secondsRank Dan 1: 2.4 secondsRank Dan 2: 2.2 secondsRank Dan 3: 2 seconds
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1966/bash.png Bash
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 380% / 400% / 420% / 440% / 460%After: 520% / 540% / 560% / 580% / 600% The cooldown of Bash has been increased to 2 seconds.Bash's attack priority has been adjusted to be higher than normal attacks.When using Bash while dual-wielding, Bash stacks are gained twice as fast. Close Combat Talent Damage increases based on the number of Bash stacks.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: 2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%Close Combat Talent Damage increase is only applied while wielding a Close Combat Talent weapon.When Bash is at 5 stacks, Close Combat Talent and Elemental Knight Skills will ignore Auto-defense of Heavy Standers below a certain rank.The Bash stack retention time has been reduced to 20 seconds for all ranks.The Bash stacks will remain even when changing weapons.Bash will now automatically strike the enemy from a distance, depending on how close the character is to the enemy.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Distance up to 7m This function does not occur if the skill is used by a monster.The issue of intermittent normal attacks when using Bash continuously has been fixed.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2005/counterattack.pngCounterattack
Counterattack has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack at higher ranks.Before:3 seconds at all ranks.After:Rank F ~ Rank D: No ChangeRank C ~ Rank A: 2.5 secondsRank 9 ~ Rank 6: 2 secondsRank 5 ~ Rank 1: 1.5 secondsRank Dan 1: 1.4 secondsRank Dan 2: 1.2 secondsRank Dan 3: 1 second
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2006/assault_slash.pngAssault Slash
The damage multiplier for all skill ranks have been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 260%After: 350%Assault Slash has been improved so that the character can move more quickly after a successful counterattack.Example:  Based on Rank Dan 3 of the skill:Before: 1.5 secondsAfter:  0.3 secondsThe cooldown of Assault Slash has been reduced.Before: 7 secondsAfter:  5.5 secondsAn issue where the skill could not be used in certain situations on enemies who have been knocked down has been fixed.[table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】In order to reduce the inconvenience of Automatic Defense and ensure that Close Combat talent skills can be used meaningfully in battle, we have updated the above skills and adjusted their values. Due to how Close Combat skills work there are often situations where you need to approach your target. Our expectation is that you’ll be able to zip around more in-battle with Bash’s new gap closer and Smash's lower cooldown. As Smash contains higher potential risk, the damage values have been increased so that the skill has a higher payoff when successful.[/td][/tr][/table]
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2012/grandmaster_lance_combat_icon.png Lance Combat
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1993/lance-impact.png NEW! Lance Impact
New Lance-only skill!Knock your target back with a heavy blow, and grants an effect that gives your next Lance Charge increased damage when unmounted!Knocks your opponent back in a straight line, up to 5m. If your opponent cannot be knocked back, you will leap back 5m instead. Grants Lance Charge Mount Bonus (On Foot) upon use, empowering your next Lance Charge. Your next Lance Charge will deal mounted Lance Charge damage.The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.  
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2037/lance-impact-eng.gif

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1991/lance-leap.png NEW! Lance Leap
New Lance-only skill!Reposition backwards with deft grace, and empower your next Lance Charge’s unmounted movement speed!Leaps backwards upon use, distance increases with rank, up to 6m at Rank 1. Grants Lance Charge Speed Boost (On Foot) upon use, enhancing your next unmounted Lance Charge. Your next Lance Charge will have increased movement speed while unmounted.The effect disappears upon use of Lance Charge or after a short duration.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2038/lance-leap-eng.gif

Other Lance Weapon Changes
Basic Attacks and Smash can now be used from a closer range. The damage dealt will depend on the distance between you and the target, with the damage being reduced if targets are too close. If the Spirit enhancement skill Ultimate Lance is present, this damage reduction does not apply. The Defense skill can now be used when equipped with a Lance.Lance Counter can now be canceled out of and ignores stun.Corrected the behavior of Lance Charge that was causing it to occasionally fail when used at minimum range.When undertaking the Lance Charge Advancement Test, you can now use Lance Impact and Lance Leap.[table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】As is, the Lance talent can be used most optimally when riding a pet, but as a talent it can be difficult when in positions where you cannot use a pet. When entering progressively higher leveled dungeons, it becomes more difficult to make use of your pet. To this we decided that a new skill would be needed to allow for greater use of the Lance Combat talent even in harder content. The development team wanted to add more fun to the player input of the talent while reducing the dependency that the talent has on pets- Lance Impact and Lance Leap were designed with this in mind.[/td][/tr][/table]
Additional Changes
Human Movement Speed
Human movement speed has been increased, and is now equal to Giants.The movement speed bonus gained from Breath of Ladeca has been reduced due to this change. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2007/breath_of_ladeca.png Breath of Ladeca
The amount of movement speed granted in the description is now a percentage, rather than a flat value. Altered from ~13% down to its new value of 10%. Removed the 10% bonus damage to Close Combat talent skills when Dual-Wielding.Now adds 5% bonus damage to normal talent skills.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2011/spirit_of_order.png https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2010/soul_of_chaos.pngTransformation Skill https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2009/fury_of_connous.png https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2008/daemon_of_physis.png
Your 1st and 2nd Titles are now maintained when using Paladin, Dark Knight, Beast, and Falcon transformations.Transformation-specific Titles can still be used when transformed.Passive Defense Skills for the transformations, such as Paladin Heavy Stander, will now always be active. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/2013/shield_mastery.png Shields
The Shield Mastery skill had had the following changes made:The damage reduction rates depending on the size of your shield have been changed.The damage reduction when using Defense increases depending on the size of your shield.The Elemental Knight skill Dauntless Defense accounts for the size of your shield as well as the new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect.The following Shields have had a new “Damage Reduction Rate” effect added:  Frosted Borealis Shield: 14% Divine Shield: 15% Massive Despair Shield: 18% Perseus Vigilant Shield: 20% Nightbringer Vanguard: 30%Using the Defense skill will no longer reduce damage against a skill that cannot be blocked, and your skill will be canceled instead. [table][tr][td]【 Developer Comments 】Previously when wearing a small, medium, or large shield, the damage reduction of the Defense skill could be applied regardless of if the attack was successfully blocked or not, allowing players to maintain the damage reduction at all times. The development team decided to adjust this behavior in order to create more interesting combat scenarios in future content where Defense must be used to block some skills, while other attacks must be avoided entirely as they cannot be blocked. Instead of having an effect based solely on the size of the shield itself, we’ve strengthened the options and tweaked the damage formula so that higher-tiered shields are stronger in the long run.[/td][/tr][/table]
Fantasy Life Changes
Ducat Exchange Daily Limit
Seasonal Ducat exchange for Ducat currency will no longer have a daily limit.Commerce merchant NPC dialogues have been updated to reflect this change.
EXP-Granting Items
Gaining experience by percentage is changed from current level to absolute level for the following values:Item use (eg. Golden Fruit, Magical Piece (Grade n), Pet Golden Experience Fruit, etc.)Shop Sales Bonus (Equipment that has Shop Sales Bonus attribute which you then sell it)Fountain of Blessing in Uladh DungeonsThe experience formula values for the following are subject to change:Battle experience (including pets)Exploration experience (eg. Special Artifact)Spirit experience (eg. Mysterious Spirit Stone)

Be sure to check out the full patch notes!

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - May 30th
notes.content:
Maintenance has concluded as of 9:01 AM PDT and the servers are open once more. We thank you for your patience.
[hr][/hr]
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on May 30th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-

Thursday, May 30th

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 10:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM

notes.title: Milletian Maestro Concert
notes.content:
You've dueled it out in the arena, now it's time to take the stage... with music! The GMs are calling upon all musically-inclined Milletians to audition for a chance at the spotlight! Curious to know more? See below for full details!
[hr][/hr]Event Details
Audition Dates: Wednesday, May 22nd at 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT) - Wednesday, June 19th at 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT)
[olist]All performers aiming for the stage will submit an audition video of their song being performed through the link below:Audition FormThe song must be an original composition! Copyrighted music will not be counted this time around.While we love the music that's already out there, we want to hear YOUR musical talent and creativity!The audition piece should be no longer than 8 minutes long.The audition can be either a Solo performance or an Ensemble (up to a Quartet).If you are auditioning as part of an ensemble, only 1 entry is needed for the group.Milletians can only be apart of 1 performance.All players In-Game Names must be visible in the audition video.Do not use Laighlinne partners.Judging will be done in 2 parts:Judging will be done internally by Nexon staff to select the Concert Finalists.
The theme is A New Chapter.Criteria will be based on:50% Originality50% Video PresentationJudging for the Grand Performances will be done by the Community after the concert.Those chosen to perform will be notified the day before the concert through their preferred method of contact.Performers will need to be available the evening of the Winner's Concert to receive a Grand Performance or Finalist Prize.All audition videos will be available for viewing after the concert in the Mabinogi Official Discord's Contest Submission Channel.[/olist]
Concert DetailsConcert Date: Wednesday, June 26th at 5:00 PM PDT (8:00 PM EDT)Location: Emain Macha Stage OR Arpeggio Concert Hall, Channel 2Thirteen Performers (Solo or Ensemble) will be selected as Finalists to perform their audition piece live to all Milletians watching both in-game and/or through a Mabinogi Livestream, hosted by the Community Managers.After the concert, Milletians will get to vote on their favorite performance to determine the Grand Prize Winners.Voting will take place in the Mabinogi Official Discord Contest Submission Channel and will last 1 week.Top 3 highest voted will receive the Grand Performance Prize.
Prizes
While the ultimate prize is hearing the beautiful melodies our Milletians create, we also have some wonderful prizes for everyone! Regardless of solo or ensemble, all players of the performance will receive the same prize based on their performance overall.

See the full post for more information: May Quality of Life Update.Many changes to High Level Dungeons have been made to better support Milletians on their quest to be the very best.Another round of items are now stackable and/or had their stack size limits increased.And More!The following changes have been made to the game:The Elves in Filia will be closing Fahmes Ruin to make some renovations to the dungeon. NPCs won't appear in Fahmes Ruin region. The end of game survey will now open in your default browser. Buon giorno! The Saga mission "Retreat to Vales" will no longer drop items on monster defeat.Cliona found hidden boxes full of Blacksmith Manual - Hand Chimes, and has subsequently added them to the Tara Auction item pool. To make it more clear which does what, we have improved the descriptions of the Extra Equipment Slot Coupon (# days) and the Extra Equipment Slot Expansion Coupon. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1565/updated-title-ui.pngThe following bug fixes have been made to the game:Ever continuing Generational Typo polish, this month starring G24 and G25. notes.title: May Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Dungeon Changes
General Tech Duinn Changes
Instructions for some missions have been improved to provide clear indicators such as monster deaths (Example: Golems in Awakened Abyssal Lord) or item use requirements (Example: Lava Lump in Seven Nightmares).The Lava Decal spawned when defeating enemies in the Salamander family will now have a casting indicator to warn of the incoming danger. Fixed an issue causing Lava Decals (such as those from Salamanders) to stun Milletians through Iron Will.A timer gauge has been added to show the time remaining until Salamanders "self-destruct" after a certain period of time.Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorBosses will no longer resist the following skills: Final HitMagnum ShotFireboltChain ImpaleThe following enemies will have a cooldown added to their Ice Spear spell: CethlennTathlum Red Lizard WitchBlack Moon FollowerThe following rewards will now have a longer despawn timer when on the floor:Evil Eye SealstoneFunction Geata FragmentRemnants of Illusion
Revived Illusion Changes
A timer to show when the next Salamander will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Red Lizard Witch enemy.The gimmick of Red Lizard Witch reflecting damage from being hit has been removed.

Feth Fiada Changes
The draw distance for Feth Fiada has been slightly increased. The frequency of how often the following enemies teleport in combat has been reduced: Fire SlimeIce SlimeLightning SlimeLightning Slimes and Black Moon Followers will no longer become temporarily immune to all damage upon knockdown, and will instead gain a temporary boost to their Protection and Magic Protection.This change also applies to all Lightning Slimes outside of Feth Fiada.Previously Illusion Zombies and Black Moon Followers would ignore damage below a certain threshold. This has been removed, and their HP values have been increased to compensate.During the Hallway Puzzle, Illusion Zombies will now spawn in the same fixed locations on both Easy and Hard modes.Tathlum's "Spin Dash" skill, which attacks while rolling, has been changed:Cast time of the skill before rolling has been increased.An attack range indicator is displayed during the casting time.The monster can be damaged while using the skill.The attack range has been reduced to a narrower range.The attack duration, which was slightly different between difficulties, has been adjusted to be the same in all difficulties.These changes also apply to the Frostwork Soul monsters in Glenn Bearna.A timer gauge has been added to show the remaining time towards when Black Moon Followers will disappear.When the first Tech Duinn Geata is defeated, the particle indicator will be shown to point towards the location of the next orb.Tech Duinn Geatas will now always spawn in a fixed location on both Easy and Hard modes. The following attacks from Tech Duinn Geata will now display cast indicators, and have had their casting time increased to allow better reaction: Light of AnnihilationLight of DestructionWindmill
Seven Nightmare Changes
During the Salamander puzzle,The "Black Explosion" caused by the Evil Eye Monolith has been removed.Lava Lumps held inside the inventory will now automatically be used against the Evil Eye Monolith every 5 seconds. The Lava Lump can still be manually activated.During the Black Moon Follower Battle puzzle,The radius of the Lava Decals has been decreased, and the amount that appears has been increased.A preview casting indicator has been added for decals that are about to appear. During Cethlenn’s boss fight,Cethlenn's "Summon Reaper" skill indicator now has a higher resolution.The skill indicator has also been changed to better match its range.Cethlenn’s Staff enemies have had the following changes made:Staves will pass through targets, applying a bleed effect on hit.  Their attack speed has been increased.They will no longer cause knockback on hit.The enemy name and health bars will be hidden to reduce noise. 
Awakened Abyssal Lord Changes
During the Golem Puzzle, the moving sacrifice circle has been removed and replaced with a large stationary one in the center.During the Barrier/Bastion Puzzle,A timer to show when the next Barrier Spirits will be summoned has been added as a visual gauge above the Bastion enemy.The maximum number of summoned Barrier Spirits has been changed so that it does not exceed a certain number of summoned monsters.During the Boss fight, the location of the name and health bars of the Soaring Leg enemy have been improved to be visible from the floor

Crom Bás Changes
Defense and Protection of regular Crom Bás monsters has been reduced.When Dark Erg levels are between 71~100, the Protection of regular monsters has been reduced, but their HP has been increased. Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorThe defense-increasing Divine Blessing effect from Frozen Cari and Dark Cari will no longer apply to Frozen Cari and Dark Cari. Stun Immunity has been removed from the following monsters:Dark RonaunDark CariDark LlygadogDark GwallgofDark WynebDark DiscipleThe following monsters have cooldowns added to the listed skills, causing them to be used less:Disciple and Dark Disciple: Shooting RushSlime Wyneb and Dark Wyneb: Ice Spear and ThunderUn Llygadog and Dark Llygadog: Icebolt and ThunderRonaun and Dark Ronaun: Puppet's SnareFrozen Cari and Dark Cari: Icebolt, Ice Spear, and ThunderIrusan: Ice Spear and ThunderExcluding specific phase mechanics, the damage caps for Irusan, Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann have been removed. The additional damage taken by Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann when dazed has been reduced from 230% to 200%.Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's "Erg Black Hole" will now be visible when the ‘Minimize VFX’ option is enabled. The Disciples that spawn during Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's gimmicks had their passive defenses removed, except for when they resist that damage type.The following changes have been made to the fight with Irusan:The summoning rules for regular monsters have been changed, and new gimmicks have been added.Irusan now has an increased delay after using Sharpened Claw.The progression rules for Irusan's Sweet Tea Time (where the cauldron is activated) have been changed.Irusan's Deathly Brand has been changed so that it can be canceled using Hand of Restoration.This status effect icon is also now visible to all party members.Some dialogue about this effect provided by Brielle has been changed.The interval of Dark Lure (Red exploding circles) has been changed:
Dark Erg 0-30: 6~10 secondsDark Erg 31~70: 5~8 secondsDark Erg 71~100: 4~6 secondsThe visibility of Warp Circles in Crom Bas has been improved.[table][tr][td]Green Magic Circle has not been changed.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1563/green-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Yellow Magic Circle now has an outline without a shade added.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1591/yellow-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]Red Magic Circle now has an outline with a shade added.[/td][td]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1564/red-crom-bas-circle.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Glenn Bearna Changes
Removed the following skills from most non-Boss enemies: Heavy StanderNatural ShieldMana DeflectorDamage caps have been removed except for certain sections during boss fights.An issue where some monsters behave abnormally when hit by the Flame Burst skill has been fixed.
Miscellaneous Dungeon Changes
G1 Fiodh - Lowered the HP value of the following creatures:Small GolemFlying SwordAdditional Fantasy Life Changes
General
Spring is in the air and there are flowers to be picked! To help with that, we’ve added 2 new items: https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1589/empty-flower-baskets.pngFlower BasketThis item can hold up to 200 Bundles of Flowers.Can be purchased from Del for 350,000 gold.Sturdy Flower Basket*slaps top of basket* This bad boy can fit even more Bundles of Flowers - up to 500!Can be purchased from any Commerce Trading Merchant Imp for 500,000 Ducats.We know that carrying several of the same item can be cumbersome, so we’ve now made the following items stackable and/or had their stack limits increased to 20, including:Bunches of FlowersDye AmpoulesMetal Dye AmpoulesAll Baltane Mission Elite PassesAll Shadow Mission Elite PassesTo better assist our merchants, the Auction House functionality has been enhanced.The UI will no longer close after registering an item for sale.Erinn will now inform you that the item has been successfully listed in the chat log.Items that can be sold on the Auction House will now be highlighted in your inventory and gear slots.The “Claim Rewards” button in the Growth Guide has been renamed to “Completion Rewards” for better clarity.An outline will be added to the VFX which indicates the impact range of Moon Stones in the G24 [Fallen from the Sky] mission.
Quest Polishing
Blaanid is now more concise with her dialogue when helping new Milletians on their path of learning about the world of Erinn. In the Pet Training Skill quest [A Blossoming Embrace], the number of required Bear Fynni Gems has been reduced.Additional text has been added to the Quest Scroll to clarify how to speak to Fynni Fynn.You can no longer remove the Dark Knight Armor in your inventory prior to completing [Eliminating the Dark Knight Armor] Quest.In the G1 Mission [Paradise], you can now talk to Tarlach to receive another Brown Fomor Pass if you happen to lose it.In the final G1 Missions [Tir Na Nog], [Find the Black Orb], and [Final Dance], additional text has been included into the Quest Scroll on how to return to Tir Na Nog.

notes.title: Froggy Foster Friend Event
notes.content:
Have you ever wanted to raise your very own tadpole and watch it grow up big and strong, or maybe become rich and famous? Rafaela has many foster frogs that need tending to and she feels that you have the expertise to help these little ones grow... help prove her right (or wrong?) and you could even earn some ribbiting prizes out of it!

notes.title: [UPDATED] The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 5
notes.content:
Ethel the Billionaire is here to invest in your growth! The scrappy young entrepreneur will be providing support to all Milletians by selling Recommendation Letters for additional rewards. Additionally, rare artifacts have been discovered in Musical Math Dungeon allowing you to have 10x the loot... for a cost. Rumor is Ethel is planning even more as the event rolls on. Check out the details below!
[hr][/hr]
Overall Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - July 11th, Before Maintenance
Event Details
During the event, you'll receive the quest [Guide] Investing in the Future.Talk to Ethel in Dunbarton to learn more of what he has to offer this time around.When listening to his story, you'll need to select a Main Character.You can only register one character per account.After talking to him, you'll automatically complete [Guide] Investing in the Future.You will also earn the following rewards:10,000 EXP
Musical Math Dungeon
Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - July 11th, Before Maintenance
During the event, when completing Musical Math Dungeon, you will receive Excavated Artifact (Music) x10 from the dungeon end chest.Each artifact can be sold as-is for 5,000 Exploration EXP or can be taken to Voight for restoration.The Artifact Investigation Skill cannot be used on Excavated Artifact (Music).Voight will offer to restore the artifact for the low, low price of just 50,000 Gold per artifact!Once an artifact is restored, it can be sold for 50,000 Exploration EXP or exchanged to Ethel for a Music Dungeon Box.
Music Dungeon Box List:
When opening a Music Dungeon Box, you are guaranteed any of the following items below:
Music Score Scroll (2000)Music Score Scroll (1000)HP 500 Potion REHP 100 Potion REMP 500 Potion REMP 100 Potion REStamina 500 Potion REStamina 100 Potion RE
Additionally, boxes may contain additional item(s) from the list below:
Song StardustInstrument StringsHarmonic Wood BoardMelodic Metal BoardJabchiel's Music Score (10)Jabchiel's Music Score (5)Jabchiel's Music Score (3)Tuning Kit
Purification Missions
Event Dates: Thursday, April 18th, After Maintenance - May 16th, Before Maintenance
Ethel will provide players with Sponsored Missions.These missions are for up to 2 players.Missions will require Recommendation Letters.You can purchase up to 7 Recommendation Letters for 777 Gold each per week from Ethel.Ethel will restock his recommendation letters every Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time.Additional Recommendation Letters can be obtained by clearing existing Purification Missions each day, 3 times per day. (Resets at 7:00 AM Server Time)One Recommendation Letter has a chance to drop during each Purification Mission, regardless of the number of party members.Innes will inform you how many reward attempts you have left based on the number of Recommendation Letters you have in your inventory.Sponsored Missions are the same as before, with adjusted monster health and stats. The rewards are 2 to 4 times higher.Cleared solo: 4x increase for rewardsThe monster has increased health, but lower defensive stats.Cleared by 2 players: 2x increase for rewardsThe monster has increased health, and the same defensive stats as the existing mission.
Avalon Field Raids
Event Dates: Thursday, May 16th, After Maintenance - June 13th, Before Maintenance
Ethel will provide players with Sponsored Missions: Avalon Raid.These missions can be completed solo or in a party with 2~8 players.MokkurkalfiSylvan DragonMissions will require Recommendation Letters.You can purchase up to 7 Recommendation Letters for 777 Gold per week from Ethel.Ethel will restock his recommendation letters every Thursday at 7:00 AM Server Time.Visit Innes in the Outskirts of Avalon to proceed with a Sponsored Avalon Raid.Innes will inform you how many reward attempts you have left based on the number of Recommendation Letters you have in your inventory.Sponsored Missions are the same as before, with adjusted monster health and stats based on the number of party members.MokkurkalfiSylvan DragonWhen successfully clearing the mission, you will receive 1x Billionaire’s Proof. These coins are stored in the Currency tab, and can be used to purchase items in Ethel’s Shop.Mission Difficulty will depend on the number of current Billionaire’s Proof you have, ranging from Difficult Lvl 1 to Difficulty Lvl 10. Innes will inform you of the current difficulty level at anytime by talking to her.If partaking as a group, the difficulty is set based on the number of Billionaire’s Proof the party leader has.Spending Billionaire’s Proofs at Ethel's Event Shop will reduce the difficulty level, but higher valued items are worth more Billionaire’s Proofs.Keep in mind that both solo and party challenges count towards the total number of rewards you can earn, up to 10 per week. Only the main character can enter the missions.If the mission fails before you are able to complete it, the Recommendation Letter will be granted back to youEthel's Event ShopUse the Billionaire’s Proof items received from Avalon Field Raid Sponsored Missions to exchange for the Relic Boxes.Each Dragon Relic Box can be purchased once a day (resets Daily at 7:00 AM Server Time).Each High-Quality Dragon Relic Box can be purchased once a week (resets Weekly at Thursday 7:00 AM Server Time).[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Cost[/th][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x1[/td][td]1x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x2[/td][td]2x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x3[/td][td]3x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x4[/td][td]4x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dragon Relic Box x5[/td][td]5x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x1[/td][td]6x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x2[/td][td]7x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x3[/td][td]8x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x4[/td][td]9x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][tr][td]High-Quality Dragon Relic Box x5[/td][td]10x Billionaire’s Proof[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Mini-games + Quality of Life Update - Patch Notes - April 11th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring April's Mini-game + Quality of Life Update!
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:Mini-games + Quality of Life Update: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - PermanentMilletian Got Game Event: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Service Error Compensation: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceGalaxy-Brained Study Buddy Event: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, 2024, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-in Event Attendance Season 5: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 18th, 2024, Before MaintenanceDigital Destiny Box: Thursday, April 11th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, 2024, Before MaintenanceFlorist Box: Thursday, March 28th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 25th, 2024, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, 2023, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeMini-games + Quality of Life update:It's time to relax with some mini-games! Check out all the newest mini-games added to the game as well as some text and title quality of life changes to help improve your fantasy life!Seven new mini-games added to the game to be played anytime, anywhere*You can now choose the text size of Speech Bubbles and Chat Logs.Extra Equipment Slots now allow you to register titles.Vanity Titles have arrived - show off your favorite title in style while still holding the stats of another.The following changes have been made to the game:Monster names of the following families have been made consistent:SahaginBlack Moon FollowerBone Lancer IllusionHeavily Armored Skeleton OgreBone ArcherHellhoundRenamed the following items:Stationary Table > Stationery TableFairytale Gardener's Straw Hat > Fairytale Gardener's Felt BeretThe Stage of Trials Manager has informed us that Milletians will no longer be permitted to use the VIP Remote Shop / Repair / Bank services during the trial.The harps in Musical Math Dungeon are now more sonorous.Added the channel and time to the Fashion Contest Finals Entrance Pass. Come strut your stuff and showcase your favorite styles!The cursor will now be visible after using Chain Sweep and Bachram Explosion.The following bug fixes have been made to the game:Fixed an issue causing Extra Equipment Slots and Jukeboxes to expire even when VIP Services are present. Many typo fixes this update- G13/G14/G24/G25, Glenn Bearna, Tech Duinn, Farming, and Fashion Contest were the major areas covered!The Fashion Contest registration UI has been resized to fit the text.Fixed issues causing Pet Notes to display incorrectly and occasionally disappear.It is no longer possible to request to fly with a character using Soar.Under certain conditions the Shop Repurchase menu would not properly display all the re-purchasable items.Slightly alleviated the game slowdown when a lot of bags are open.When using music buff skills through higher ranks of Song, the durability and proficiency of the equipment in your right hand will no longer be affected unless the equipment is an instrument. Very small Milletians with very large hair/wigs were found to be possessed by a ghost, causing them to float above the ground. With Corentin's help we have banished the spectre. An issue where some outfit meshes may appear broken when changing equipment to the same outfit has been fixed.Both cymbals are now properly sized on Giants when equipped with cymbals and sheet music.The 'Complete Mission' and the 'Close' buttons no longer overlap when opening a G19~G25 Quest window.Fixed an issue where Giants would occasionally fail to hit dungeon marbles after drinking a mini potion. Mini Giants can go back to their regularly scheduled oxymoron.Pets will no longer relentlessly chase after opponents following a PVP match like a cat chasing after catnip.The Pet House UI would occasionally close itself, but this has been fixed.Shrimp Taming Bait and Taillteann Carp Bait will now stack properly.Elemental Removers dropped from monsters and purchased from NPCs will now stack properly.Fixed an issue where Auto Weapon Slot Conversion would not swap to proper equipment when using Party Healing.Gathering Clams in Scuabtuinne was not properly counting towards Hoeing training.Moving a bow to the bank via alt-click will now properly unequip the equipped arrow.Warping via the Moongate / Mana Tunnel will no longer cause outfit motion props to disappear.When equipped with a Control Bar with increased Control Marionette Range, an issue has been fixed where Act 1: Inciting Incident would occasionally fail to work.Fixed an issue where Cello-playing Milletians would fail to properly leave the homestead.A few Talent skills were able to be incorrectly used while riding a pet. This has been corrected.Fixed an issue with the portrait on the Printed Casual Wear displaying incorrectly.Marionettes will be able to move sooner if the target dies during the middle of Act 2: Threshold Cutter.The Preview option in the Dressing Room was not properly displaying when a collaboration appearance was selected.Fixed an issue where Milletians were unable to move upon using Divine Blast or Nova Obliteration.In rare circumstances the client would close upon changing channels. This has been fixed.Silk-Weaving Gloves were incorrectly granting their bonus while at 0 durability. They will now give no bonus in this state.Dorcha Snatch was training improperly when used when Hot-Air Ballooning. Little known fact, Sluagh loves floating through the sky.The Falias Artifact Restoration window will now display above your inventory.Fixed an issue where monster AI would not properly cancel an unused Life Drain.An issue where a previewed appearance in the dressing room was not updating under certain circumstances has been fixed.Specifically timed gestures/blinks/etc will no longer cause Eye VFX to stop displaying.Novice cards were not properly issued to new accounts with a hero card or elite hero card. This has been fixed.Fixed an issue causing remaining duration messages to display incorrectly when changing channels. An issue where the Spread Wings and Crisis Escape skills cannot be used after using a Moongate or Mana Tunnel while riding a pet after using Spread Wings has been fixed.A bug where pet skills are not used when summoning a Kart Rider pet has been fixed.The issue where pets could be summoned in Festia's Clobbermeister mini-game has been fixed.Fixed an issue where Act 1: Inciting Incident would improperly move when cast on a monster outside its range.The cat from the Academy School Uniform's outfit motion would cause characters to move awkwardly when running. This has been fixed.An issue where the body shape is not applied during motion when wearing the Eluned Cherry Blossom Dress (M) as a Giant character has been fixed.Corrected display issues with the following equipment:Blue Dragon's Chosen RobesCircus Performer's OutfitsFestial Jumpsuit (M)Birman Marching Boots on GiantsGuardian BootsBugs fixed during the March 28th Maintenance: Corrected a floor exploit in Fahmes Ruins.Fixed an issue where the Extra Equipment Slot duration was not reflected properly for some characters.Fixed a few Festival of Stars event related typos, and improved the dialogue of a certain raccoon.As grandiose as COMBAT VIP MEMBERSHIP BATTLER'S BOON / LIFE VIP MEMBERSHIP BOUNTIFUL boon are, the full names probably don't need to show on the status effect text. These have been trimmed to VIP Battler's Boon / VIP Bountiful Boon.Made minor adjustments to the Flight Action names to make them consistent.Improved the text on several Cooking Quest scrolls and objectives.Despite it not being visible in-game anymore, we've fixed a decade-old EU Mabinogi typo. Finally the Brioncac has been defeated!Found a few more strings referring to "Premium Service" and replaced them with the proper name.Found a few Homestead items missing the "Homestead" designation on their item names.Homestead Tropical Party PineappleHomestead Tropical Friends PineappleHomestead Christmas WreathHomestead Christmas TreeHomestead RudolphHomestead Old JunkHomestead Giant Stone StatueHomestead Haunted HouseHomestead Red Rose Patch (Full)Homestead Red Rose Patch (Partial)Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Full)Homestead Pink Rose Patch (Partial)Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Urban)Homestead Rose Vine Arch (Rustic)Homestead Hanging Rose ValanceHomestead Hanging Rose BlossomsHomestead Hanging Rose VineHomestead Vine Rose FenceHomestead Wild Rose BushBugs fixed during the March 21st Maintenance: Giants equipped with the new Two-handed Sword Motion Card (Type 2) and Shields were behaving strangely. The sheer magnitude of their power will no longer cause them to sink into the floor.The 16th Anniversary Drawstring Pouch (Doll Bags) was incorrectly targeting Birman Bags. This has been corrected so that the Doll Bag Drawstring Pouch can now be used on Doll Bags, as expected.The following are known bugs:https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1150/bug_catching.pngIn rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - April 11th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on April 11th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 6:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Maintenance has concluded as of 9:26 AM PDT and the servers are open once more. We thank you for your patience.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

- Time -

Thursday, April 11th

Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 8:00 PM
Sydney (AEST, UTC +10) 11:00 PM - 4:00 AM (April 12th)

To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.We hope you enjoyed the extra week of the Milletian Events: 16th Anniversary Buffs! However, all good things must come to an end.Wing Season is over as the Stellar Wing Box winds down. Last chance to get wings, wings wings!Last call to grab some Reforging Tools, Arcana 2x EXP Potions, and more through the 16th Anniversary Package!We've trained Irusan to stop eating keys! Irusan's Check-in Attendance Event will be restarting.Do you "got game"? Test out your mini-game skills in the new Milletian Got Game Event.The Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy Event is starting. Be sure to hit the books so you don't flunk!Stylize your digital prowess with the new Digital Destiny Box!Didn't get the prizes from the 16th Anniversary GM Event? We're doing another distribution! Be sure to check your mailbox after maintenance.As a thank you for your patience regarding the Extra Equipment Slot and Homestead Jukebox being affected with VIP Service, we're starting the Milletian Events: Service Error Compensation Hotday. Please see the post for more information.We know you're eager to receive the Pon reimbursement for the Style Tab changes. We prioritized the recent live issues surrounding the Extra Equipment Slot and Attendance Event so that it could be resolved quickly. Rest assured, we are still working to ensure your Pon amounts are correct and can be distributed as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience!Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 6:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.
- The Mabinogi Team
