notes.title: Galaxy Brained Study Buddy Event
notes.content:
Siyu is in danger of flunking and needs your help preparing for the exams again! Use a Study Desk to copy notes from the Thick Books into a Notebook every day. The better the quality of your Notebook, the more rewards you'll earn! Remember, don't copy off of your Study Buddy! Check out the details below.
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, April 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 9th, Before Maintenance
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Seeking a Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy.Find Siyu in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Siyu.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following event items after completing [Guide] Seeking a Galaxy-Brained Study Buddy:10,000 EXPUnlock [Event] A Thorough Review, [Event] Surefire Study Tactics and [Event] Hard Work Pays Off quests.Standard Study Desk (Event)50 Thick BooksLog in to receive 50 Thick Books once per day.The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.All event quests, items, and Blacksmith Manuals will be removed when the event ends.Daily QuestEach day, you will receive the daily quest: [Event] A Thorough Review.Stay online for 36 minutes or longer to complete the quest.When you complete the daily quest, you will receive:20,000 EXP70 Thick BooksEach day, you will also receive the daily quest: [Event] Surefire Study Tactics.Complete the quest every day by using the Standard Study Desk and Thick Books to copy the notes.To copy the notes, you will need to craft a Notebook using the Thick Books.You can craft a Notebook anywhere. One Thick Book will create one Notebook.The craft success rate by grade will differ depending on the type of desk used. Dress like the deity themself as you reject the Church of Lymilark or go for some unique Spirit Transformation Liquers. There's also brand-new Support Selection Boxes every single week. Check out the details below!
[hr][/hr]
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, April [strike]4th[/strike] 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July [strike]11th[/strike] 18th, Before Maintenance

Update 2: Hi Milletians, after further testing, we're postponing the start and end dates of the Irusan's Check-in Attendance Event by one week (Now 4/11 ~ 7/18) to allow further time to fine-tune the event and ensure it meets Edern-level standards of quality. We apologize to those who experienced issues in Erinn today because of Irusan stealing keys. (A certain guild stone may have taken the phrase "collect key items" too literally...). We'll provide further details if anything else changes prior to then.

Update: Hi Milletians, thank you for reporting the issue about not receiving treasure chest keys in your mission clears. After investigation, we believe that this issue occurs when there is one person in the party that has not yet received their stamp from the Irusan's Attendance Check-in event. The mission clear will count for the stamp check, however the key is not granted for the end chest reward for the party. As such, we recommend receiving your stamp through your preferred method first before doing higher dungeon clears such as Glenn Bearna. We will be forwarding the information regarding this issue to our development team and will notify you when there is an update on this. Thank you for your patience!

Log in during the event period to receive the quest [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract.Find A Kitty in Need in front of the Unicorn Statue in Dunbarton to learn more about the contract.You’ll receive a Stamp Employee Contract. Use it to register your account for the event, allowing you to participate on all characters.Completing [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract will award you with the following items:1,000 EXP500 GoldOnce registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2664/irusan-icon.pngYou can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.There are a total of 3 calendars with 28 days each, for a total of 84 days.You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive your daily stamp, or how far along you are!An Event Clock Timer is also available so you can check your Daily Stamp progress at a glance without opening the Event Menu.
Attendance Stamps
You now have even more ways to earn a stamp each day!Complete any of the following to earn a stamp:Daily Taillteann Shadow Mission.Daily Tara Shadow MissionBaltane Mission.Excluding Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table missions.Lord Mission.Mag Mell Mission.Tech Duinn Mission.Clear Crom Bas.Clear Glenn Bearna.3 Part-Time Jobs perfectly.Stay logged in for 1 hour to earn a stamp.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect the stamp.If you still have time remaining on your Event Clock timer and it is already 7:00 AM PDT, the remaining time will not reset.If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PDT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.You will only receive 1 stamp per day.Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from July 11th, After Maintenance ~ July 18th, Before Maintenance.When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2663/irusan-check-in-board.png
Attendance Pass Purchase
If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for 29 Pon.The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. Additionally, speak to A Kitty in Need and select “Gold Event Shop”.A Kitty in Need sells 5x Magical Attendance Passes that can be used to recover stamps you’ve missed.This item will be removed when the event ends.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2665/pass-ui.png

notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the 16th Anniversary Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Introducing the Erinn Adventurer’s Package!:Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Permanent VIP Service Renewal Update: Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Permanent 16th Anniversary Event: Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 11th, 2024, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events - Combo VIP Hotday: Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 28th, 2024, Before Maintenance16th Anniversary Sale: Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 11th, 2024, Before MaintenanceStellar Wings Box: Thursday, March 14th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 11th, 2024, Before MaintenanceBlue Dragon's Chosen Box: Thursday, February 29th, 2024, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 28th, 2024, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
16th Anniversary and VIP Renewal Update:
It's Mabinogi's 16th Anniversary, and joining it is our VIP Renewal Update! See the full post for more information: VIP Service Renewal UpdateNew VIP Packages to pick from, including Combination VIP, Basic VIP, Combat VIP, and Life VIPThe use of Style Tab regardless of VIP status, and Unlimited Talent Title Changes/Unlimited Title ChangesImprovements to VIP Service MenuAnd more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
The conditions for receiving the ‘Country Living’ Journal achievement related to the Tailteann Farming system has been changed. The points achieved are still the same (30 points) and already acquired journal entries will be reflected automatically.Before: Earn 400,000 Gold from FarmingAfter: Earn 200,000 Gold from Farming When right-clicking on an item within the inventory, if the item has a longer item description (200+ characters), the menu is shortened and it is now possible to scroll through the item description using the scroll wheel.In order to avoid confusion that a VIP Membership would be required, the Festia VIP Pass has been renamed to Festia Mini-game Ticket.A few Wings have been renamed to better reflect what they are, notably trimming or replacing the word "Wings". We'll be wanting to similarly update a few more items in the future.Muffler Wings > Muffler (ex. notes.title: Producer's Letter: 2024 Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

It’s been awhile since I’ve updated you about the many content updates we love to see in Erinn. Things have been quite busy for the past few months as the team and I have been working tirelessly to implement all of the new contents you’ve seen in Q4 last year, as well as the January and February updates this year. With many aspects to review and features to test, it has been a whirlwind of conversation and discovery throughout each patch cycle. This is an ever trending cadence for us as we continue to work on each upcoming release, so we are always very appreciative of your excitement and understanding!

[hr][/hr]
Without further ado, we are so excited to share with you about some of the events and contents that you can expect to see this year. Starting off with our beloved…

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1963/doki-doki-banner.jpg

💕 Doki Doki Island! 💕

Sior and Reni are featured in adorable illustrations that remind us of the longing, reminiscent times we have spent with our Soulmates… digging potatoes, flying the skies, and forever fishing. I hope you have been enjoying these activities, along with all the exciting changes and activities added to the lovely Doki Doki Island this February! Don’t forget to check out the full travel brochure to get the full experience.

P.S. you can download the wallpapers on our media page!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1962/16th-anniversary-banner.png

🌟 16th Anniversary 🌟

Mabinogi NA is celebrating our 16th Anniversary this year! The Festival of Stars will bring the return of many Festia activities like the Festia Instant Prize, and a new basketball minigame! Starry themed items like new damage skins, outfits, chairs, and a Starry Sheeptuplet will have you seeing stars all over Erinn. Alongside these in-game events, we will have our annual Anniversary GM Event to celebrate, and more Community contests held during the month! We can’t wait to send out some exclusive Arcana: Dark Arts physical prizes to the winners of these events, so keep an eye out for further news! We can’t wait to see you! 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1961/vip-renewal-banner.png

VIP Service Renewal is just around the corner, as we finish up the final tests and tie up all the pretty bows on the addition of four new package types, including all your favorite features and more. We’ll share all of the details about the new packages soon (your current service will carry over, don’t worry!), as well as all the fun stuff like, what’s in the packages? (You’ll see!) Are they tradable? (Yes!) Can the Extra Equipment Slot be free with VIP? (Yes!) What about Style Tab? (What about it? It will be free for everyone!)

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1965/minigames-banner.png

Mini-games Forever! An update later this year will also bring many of the event mini-games to you to play anytime, anywhere~ What other kinds of mini-games would you like to see one day?

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1966/renovation-s5-banner.png

Renovation Season 5

With the newly introduced Arcana talents, the combat of Mabinogi has begun to change. Additional skill revisions will make their debut with our fifth season of Renovation which aims to reduce the gap between some talent and Arcana skills, and increase usability. This update will focus on improving the overall viability of using certain skills in combat, such as increased damage, reduced cooldowns, and other changes to improve skills in the following areas:
Combat (Smash, Bash, Counterattack, Assault Slash)Increased damage, reduced cooldowns, and some changes to skill functionality will supplement the skills usabilityLance Revising lance skill functionality and implementation of new lance-only skills that support the talent further, without the use of a mounted petLance ‘Blow’ will knockback enemies in a straight line with effective damage similar to Lance Charge, while Lance ‘Step’ will let you gain distance for Lance Charge and charge to enemies fast.Breath of LadecaImproving the movement speed and bonus damage effectsShield EffectsChanged damage reduction from being reduced by shield size to being reduced by the new [damage reduction] effect added for shield items.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1964/g26-banner.png

Chapter 8: Generation 26

Maybe the most captivating news is that the beginning of a new Chapter will present itself this Summer! Chapter 8: Generation 26 will bring a new storyline, NPCs and monsters, and all the great stuff we love packed into Generation updates. Do you have any discoveries you wish to uncover?

Moonlight Island

Moonlight Island is a new take on creating a unique lifestyle space for you and your favorite NPCs. With many new features to decorate and expand the island to your liking, such as changing the island’s topography, you can also invite residents to the island to engage in various production activities and acquire various items that are helpful to your Erinn life. We can’t wait to see what you’ll create, and I am sure we will have more to share regarding this special creative update once we grow closer to the update! What kinds of things would you want to add to your island? 

There will also be improvements to the Homestead so that you can decorate freely in your original sanctuary place! The purpose of these updates is to expand the options you have to create, rest, and make happy memories in places that you enjoy most! 
 
[hr][/hr]
Thank you, Milletians, for always supporting the world so many of us feel safe in. 2024 will bring many new memories for us in Erinn. With the Mabinogi Eternity in development, we are even seeing further glimpses of our future Fantasy Life, made possible from your everlasting love of Mabinogi. Please look forward to more update news later, and I hope to see you all in-game soon!

Until next time, 
~ GM Mewlynne, a Milletian of 16 Years
Mabinogi Producer

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: Discussing the January 2024 Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Hi Milletians,

With our January 18th update, we have released changes to Mabinogi that we recognize many Milletians have strong feelings about. In particular, we would like to address the changes to Tech Duinn missions and the weekly clear reward limits that have been integrated into these missions. As with Crom Bás or Glenn Bearna dungeons which had weekly clears from the start, Tech Duinn has now been updated to introduce similar weekly clear limits. Along with this change, the mission format has been reorganized, consolidating difficulty levels from four to two (Normal/Hard), improving the ease and intuitiveness of mission puzzles, adjusting dungeon rewards, and improving dungeon drop rates.

Many of these changes represent improvements on the existing system, but the community has expressed considerable uncertainty regarding the weekly clear limits. The team has been reading and digesting the many thoughts and feedback you have. While adding a limit to content that was previously unlimited understandably may not sit well initially, the reasons behind the change have been reviewed and considered deeply by the development team, whose thoughts we will share with you below.

As Mabinogi’s publisher, we will review and scrutinize the many facets of the game’s content, while also placing our trust in the best intentions of our developers. Our goal as a connected team aligns in our desire to do what is best not only for the longevity of the game, but for the enjoyment of our community.

From myself, and on behalf of my team at Nexon America and Nexon Korea, we will continue to put our whole hearts into Mabinogi to provide a service that we can all enjoy.

Sincerely,
GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer
Developer’s Comments: Behind the Change 
The core purpose of dungeon-related updates is to increase the value of dungeons and rewards. Most dungeons in Mabinogi have a lower chance of rewarding the most desirable items. This is by design, to encourage repeated playthroughs. The items given as dungeon rewards are typically also tradable, so the reward probability has to be determined by taking into account repeated play. Our development team believed that this was causing repeated negative experiences in dungeons.

After reviewing the data and play patterns of our Milletians, we decided that it was necessary to make improvements so that you could grow and acquire equipment. However, there were concerns that simply increasing the probability of receiving rewards would increase the supply of materials excessively, decreasing the value of items and ultimately leading to a loss of motivation to play dungeons at all. This is also the reason why the average number of runs required to obtain a desired reward set in general Mabinogi dungeons was not able to be adjusted immediately, even though it might have felt somewhat difficult for Milletians trying their hardest to grow. Our development team has thought deeply about the best choice we could make for Mabinogi’s future, and has significantly increased the probability of rewards while limiting the number of clears so that Milletians, in their quest to grow ever stronger, can enjoy a meaningful challenge in the dungeons they are focusing on.

In preparing for this update, we considered the appropriate direction based on these contents as basic premises. 
[olist] Tech Duinn weekly clear limits 
Tech Duinn is a dungeon with the most direct rewards that Milletians can achieve as intermediate goals in their growth process. If you look at the status of Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, they are generally receiving “Elite” passes on Feth Fiada Hard difficulty. In the case of Crom Bás, it is possible to enter without obtaining an entry pass to farm the Nightbringer weapon set, so the fact that you needed to separately obtain an Elite pass to acquire the materials for the Perseus weapon set felt like an unnatural part of the growth process. We eventually determined that to be one of the hassles, and thought of the way where you could play them without acquiring passes.

However, as acquiring passes is no longer required and the drop rates for the rewards have been increased, we have concluded that the amount of acquired items could increase too excessively, without the limitation to the entry. As maintaining items’ value is also an important part of the game, we concluded that the entry limit is necessary.

When looking at the play patterns of North American Milletians playing Tech Duinn missions, the dev team found that most Milletians who were playing the Elite missions were clearing them fewer than 10 times per week, and around 80% of Milletians were clearing them fewer than 5 times a week. When considering the now-increased probabilities of receiving many of the rewards, we felt that clearing the mission about 15 times was a reasonable level, providing a better experience in clearing without significantly affecting the value of the rewards obtained.

We have also prepared the methods for Milletians who want to clear missions more by making it possible to clear more than 15 times a week (25 times or more in total) using additional entry passes received through events and Adventurer’s Seal Shop. We are also open to the possibility of gradually easing restrictions when the demand/supply of rewards has stabilized in the future.

We are also listening carefully to your concerns about situations that impede free play. We will continue to think about which values ​​are most important from a long-term perspective and find solutions that offer enjoyable experiences. 

Intention of introducing the Dungeon Re:fine system 

A lot of Milletians have been asking about the details of the Re:fine System and the intention behind it.

Re:fine system is the system where the probability of a certain reward’s appearance remains the same regardless of the party member’s number. In practice, it works as below.

For certain items, the number and the probability of these items appearing in one dungeon run will remain the same regardless of whether it was cleared by one person or multiple people. Once the item’s appearance is decided, who will get the item among the party will be decided by an even probability.

In other words, if the probability of an item is 1%, and an individual clears the dungeon, the item will appear by 1% for them. If the dungeon is cleared by a party of 4, whether the item will appear or not will be decided by 1%, and the item will be given to the 1 of the 4 members by even probability.

The initial purpose of the Re:fine system was to bridge the compensation gap, accounting for multi-client usage. Although this will now be addressed to some extent by blocking the use of multiple clients, we still have to take into account abnormal styles of play. In particular, the higher the expected reward of a dungeon, the more advantageous it is to clear it using multiple computers. We intended to prevent this type of play pattern from being encouraged. With the update, we applied the Re:fine system to certain dungeons while increasing the drop rates of major rewards, to prevent the situation of using multiple clients or computers being advantageous while increasing the level of rewards for playing dungeons.
[/olist]
The purpose of the development explained above is focused on changes for the long-term growth of Mabinogi. However, we believe that the freedom and variety of play styles that can be experienced in Mabinogi are also important values. We will strive to develop Mabinogi through a process of gathering opinions while doing our best to provide a sufficient explanation of our intentions to all Milletians.

Thank you,
Mabinogi Development Team

Several quality of life changes have been added to help with your fantasy life! See the full post for more information: The First Chronicle UpdateNew weapons have been added, and existing weapons have been adjusted!Changes have been made to Tech Duinn Missions.Dungeon drop rate improvements have arrived!And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
The following books have been updated with a revised version to be more canonically accurate.The Goddess Who Turned to StoneThe Knight of Light Lugh, The Hero of Mag TuireadhIn the Bag Order Settings menu, 'PLUS Inventory' has been renamed to 'VIP Inventory', to match the tab name. Renamed "Glass Trim Monocle and Earrings" to "Glass Trim Veiling Band and Earrings" to have the name better match the face accessory's visuals.Renamed "New Start (Ship BGM)" to "New Start (Tutorial BGM)". Visions of a blue-haired girl and a black-wooled sheep cross your mind.Chain Slash Grandmaster has been renamed to Grandmaster Chain Slasher, to fit with the other GM Talents. We'll always remember you, Chain Slash Grandma.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1165/this-goes-out-to-all-the-grandmas.pngThe text when attempting to wear an invalid face accessory and headgear together has been improved to be much more clear and a bit less judgmental. 
It was "Probably not a good idea to dress like this.", if you were curious.
When sending a message to an offline friend, it no longer will tell you that your friend is too busy to chat. They might still be busy, but that's not the reason why your message wasn’t received.
You can now earn Field Raid Contribution when using the following Harmonic Saint actions:
Recover an ally with Hand of Restoration or Echoes of Salvation 
Resurrect an ally with Hymn of ResurrectionWhen using Shadow Flare and Polar Vortex, 2x casting speed of wands will be applied to the Celtic Tribolt Wand and single-attribute wands.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Continued Text Polish on generations and items! 
Why the catch-all item instead of listing them all out individually, you hypothetically inquire? These are usually small things, such as adding missing periods/spaces and other similar typos. We try to include the more impactful fixes and changes individually. Thank you as always for your reports!The Abominable Rabbit from Glenn Bearna was being too abominable. Previously after using Roar, the unpleasant bunny would stackingly increase its allies Defense and Protection. As this was not intended to stack, we've asked the loathsome lagomorph to take it down a notch.In specific situations, Dauntless Defense’s cooldown would be applied incorrectly. This has been corrected.The damage is now applied correctly when using Thunderblight at rank 5 or higher against a target whose Magical Defense and Magical Protection have been reduced below zero.The bag sizes for the following Doll Bags were incorrectly listed. The text has been updated to match the actual values. 
Bhatair Doll BagMorfydrianas Doll BagTani Doll BagThe item descriptions for the following Doll Bags displayed the incorrect Collection Categories. Only the text was incorrect, the functionality for these items have not changed. 
Talek Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy -> Gold, Ore, GemsMarleid and Piran Doll Bag: Gold, Rare Mineralogy, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring Materials -> Gold, Ore, Gems, Weaving/Sheep Shearing, Tailoring MaterialsFixed an issue where Doll Bags did not collect Equipment if set to the Cooking and Equipment Collection Categories.The Shadow Reaper Mask was so stealthy that Milletians couldn't even see its textures. A series of off-screen montages has given all Milletians the power to properly see the mask.Improved the text when cooking the best food Erinn has seen. Continue your hunt for the essence of true flavor, Master Chefs!When undertaking the Shuriken Charge Advancement test, the supervisor no longer refers to it as the Kunai Storm test.Corrected a minor visual error with the Vanguard Uniform Bandage (M).Corrected a minor visual error with the Cheerful Bride's Gloves.After waiting many long years to return, the Girl on the Moon was super excited to see all you ‘Mabinogians’ again for ‘second anniversary’! She's going to catch some well deserved rest.
The following bugs were fixed during the course of December:
The Check Weekly Rewards Received for Glenn Bearna no longer inaccurately lists the weekly limit as 4x per week. The text now displays the correct 3x per week.Undye your hair and mourn no longer- Atrata now properly grants selected PTJ rewards, rather than just giving it out all as experience points.Chefs rejoice! You can now search for Cooking Potions on the Auction House!The Echostones from the Erinn-go-Round Echostone Boxes were interacting unintentionally when an Echostone Supplement was applied. We have fixed the issue causing Echostone Grades to reset- you can no longer use the Echostone Supplement item on an Echostone that has not been advanced at least one Grade.The notification of your Auction House listings being sold are now correctly showing once more. Yayifications!The Detective Squirrel Doll Bag description stated that it had a set effect when summoned with another doll bag. As this isn't the case, this line has been removed.
The following are known bugs:
🐛When using the new item Defender's Will, the stats displayed in the message incorrectly displays the stats from Aggressor's Will. This is a text issue only, the correct defensive stats are given. The new crafting recipes for Protective Red Upgrade Stone and Protective Blue Upgrade Stone incorrectly refer to 'Gem of Protection' as 'Gem of Protective Power'. The former is the correct name for the item, and is the item used in the craft.In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: Mabinogi Eternity Project: Finding the Erinn we dream of
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Hi Milletians,

We are excited to share the first developer blog post, “Finding the Erinn we dream of" that has been written about the Mabinogi Eternity Project! We are planning to share more with you in the future in a space created especially for Eternity. More information on the development of Eternity, behind-the-scenes blog posts, videos, screenshots and other related information are some of the things you can expect to see in those future posts. For now, we will continue to share some blog posts with you separately, until the space is ready. Please look forward to it! 

Please enjoy these four videos that we would love to share with you, showcasing what the world of Erinn could look like. 

A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Tir Chonaill
[previewyoutube=-lylKimTxKw;full][/previewyoutube]

A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Nighttime Milletian
[previewyoutube=ZC0aWm0SlvM;full][/previewyoutube]

A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Fishing
[previewyoutube=iyS1rYC3dFA;full][/previewyoutube]

A Glimpse of Mabinogi Eternity: Milletian in Tir
[previewyoutube=S2ZuPC-2Op0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you, 
- The Mabinogi Team

“Finding the Erinn We Want”
From the time we first made the decision to replace Mabinogi's Pleione engine with something newer and more modern, our list of factors that needed to be accounted for has only grown.

After all, if we replace the engine, we need to upgrade the game's visuals in turn. The problem is, we quickly discovered that everyone had a different idea of what "Mabinogi with updated graphics" would look like.

Some were picturing radical improvements, on the level of what someone might expect from a full-blown sequel. Others had far more modest changes in mind, more on the level of a simple HD remaster.

It got to the point where it was difficult to reach a consensus, so in order to make progress on this issue, we took a look at the game together to see which visual elements we thought needed to be improved.
"Which visual elements were most in need of improvement?"
This was pretty clear right from the outset. 

In addition to the countless opinions and feedback we'd received from Milletians, the dev team had a long list of things they wished they could do but weren't able to due to the limitations of the old engine.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2756/visual-elements-improved.png

There were so many things we were frustrated about! Things that are considered part of the basic feature set of other engines were beyond the capabilities of ours, so it was only natural we'd have strong opinions on the matter.

"Well then, let's fix all those things in the new engine!"

The dislocated shoulders, wonky physics on outfits and hairstyles, greater freedom in customizing textures, advanced ability to handle light and reflections... There was no shortage of things we wanted to take a crack at, so we on the Engine Replacement Task Force began excitedly uploading some of our existing resources to the new engine.

That said...
"Is this still Mabinogi …?"
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2737/nao_standing_tir.png

Due to the fundamental differences in the new engine, even our fully-realized designs appeared very different from the look we'd all grown accustomed to.

It was only to be expected, though. Our current engine uses light in a very simple way, acting as a sort of gradient between 'brightness' and 'darkness', while the new engine specializes in the realistic expression of light, lending itself to very nuanced depictions of light and shadow.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2757/gap-between-engines-example.png

Of course, this was just a proof-of-concept--we hadn't configured the shaders or applied any other settings, so once we'd gotten those set up properly, it was possible to recreate a feel much closer to that of the Pleione engine.

Still, it was clear that even that initial configuration left a lot of room for improvement--we had our work cut out for us.

Our take-away from that experiment was clear:

"If we set about 'improving' things without establishing a clear direction for ourselves, 
we might lose the heart and soul of Mabinogi."

As a Milletian who's played Mabinogi since its launch, I didn't want Mabinogi to lose its unique flavor in the pursuit of improvement, so I returned once more to Mabinogi's deep archives of art and design work.
"What IS the 'Mabinogi style'?"
It was surprisingly simple to uncover what the 'Mabinogi style' entails by revisiting the efforts our artists have made to overcome the limitations of the engine and create a richer, more abundant sense of expression within the game.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2739/ribbon-girlplusroyal-guard.png

Detailed texturing and modeling help to surmount the engine's limitations

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2740/erinn-world.png

Meticulously thought-out environmental design helps to avoid a sense of monotony caused by the engine's simplistic ability to handle lighting expression.

Within the Pleione engine, nuanced lighting isn't really possible, as light calculations have to be done based not only on the source of the light, but also taking into account the data and positioning of the models.

To avoid a sense of visual monotony, Mabinogi's art team has focused on thoughtful environmental design, adding detail via textures, and placing each and every one of the background props with care.

It's those efforts to circumvent or overcome the limits of our existing engine that have contributed greatly to Mabinogi's unique style.

We felt that these values that have shaped the game are worth preserving.
"So, what direction should Eternity take?"
It may sound obvious when I put it this way, but our goal here is to keep Mabinogi's unique identity and values while improving upon those things that are currently lackluster or disappointing.

A simple update to a more modern graphical standard, while good, wouldn't be enough.

But we, the Milletians, already knew what was needed.

In all the retouched screenshots you've posted online and through social channels, we can see the hopes and dreams for how Mabinogi's world might change for the better.

Upgrading to a new engine will give us the ability to depict the world of Erinn in greater detail than ever before,

but rather than creating a new art style, we should focus our efforts on finally breaking through the previous engine's technical limitations that had limited our ability to express the things we'd imagined.
"Erinn should always feel like Erinn"
This is the goal we've set for ourselves with Mabinogi Eternity.

We promise to give the very best we have to give so that Mabinogi can become a tale that lasts forever.

Thank you for your continued support, Milletians.


~  Mani, a Milletian of 19 Years

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2758/marnie.png

and, The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Upcoming Changes: Blocking Multi-Client and Improved Dungeon Drop Rates
notes.content:
Hi Milletians,

We are announcing in advance that the security for Mabinogi will soon be improved to strengthen the detection and prevention of third-party programs and multi-client use. We recognize there may be some beneficial aspects that client modifications can offer to improve a player’s game experience, although most functionalities are against the intentions of the game and impose unfair capabilities and barriers to players who don’t modify their files. There are also risks that come with modifying the game client and data for the player and the game.

Mabinogi has been steadily improving the playability of the game, adding commonly requested features that were previously mod-only, as well as other features that have improved the stability and performance of the game. While it is important for us to continue to improve the in-game experience, we believe that at this present juncture, we need to further improve the security measures within the game to prevent security vulnerabilities and create a safer Mabinogi.

Blocking Multi-Client and Third-Party Programs
Multi-client use has not been allowed in Mabinogi and it is not possible to run multiple clients through normal means. However, there are many players who have been logging in on multiple clients through unauthorized methods, bypassing the game system to play on multiple accounts at one time. In order to provide a better game experience, we are enhancing the game’s security so that it is no longer possible to bypass the restriction. In the future, if you run two or more game clients on the same device, any instances of the client beyond the first will be automatically shut down. 

Other security improvements made to the game client and account system will terminate the use of third-party programs and launchers along with it. This notice is being posted early so that you can take care to play on a clean game client before the blocking measures begin to take effect. While special mods and third-party launchers may offer small gameplay tweaks or improve the game’s performance for some, there are more risky parts of client modifications that aren’t good for the game’s overall security. This must be addressed to prevent forms of illicit or fraudulent activity, egregious activities, game exploits, hacking, and other types of abuse. There are also cases in which third-party programs can alter the game’s intention too greatly in ways that are considered exploitative and unfair, such as changes to skill cooldowns, skill usage ranges, or skill uptime. Players found abusing the game while using these types of game modifications will be subject to sanctions. 

Further information about which actions are considered violations is outlined in the Terms of Service agreement that has been agreed to when creating a Nexon account.

Addressing the Caravan Joe Problem
Multi-client use is impacting many aspects of the game. In particular, it creates an environment that feels like a gatekeeper to many players of all types. It is not a fair experience to those wanting to play and grow their character when there is such an imbalance between players who are playing multiple accounts and those who are not. The area that has experienced the most significant impact of multi-client use is the supply of gold and rewards. If we take a look at the current dungeon play experience, for example, we have individuals that play and receive one reward chest, while those using multiple clients will receive the reward chest from each of the controlled characters. Milletians who focus on playing with one client are bound to feel like they are at a disadvantage, which we are deeply sorry for.

[table][tr][td]"The Many Cousins of Caravan Joe"

Let's take a look at two different players, Cowenna and Caravan Joe. Both players are looking to receive a Broken Magic Essence (BME) from the Alby Advanced Hard Mode (AAHM) dungeon, and have been farming a while in hopes of getting it.

Each time Cowenna plays, she does a few runs through AAHM. Sometimes by herself, sometimes she invites her friends- Rowan, Eochaid, and Loiscneach. For a successful clear she opens a single chest and takes the loot, as do her friends. One player gets one key to open one chest, or four players get four keys to open four chests.

Each time Caravan Joe plays, he does a few runs as well. He also plays by himself, but with a twist - he invites his cousins, all three of them also named Caravan Joe. For a successful clear each Joe opens a single chest and takes the loot, but after this, each Joe then trades their drops to a single Joe. One player gets four keys to open four chests.

In this scenario, Caravan Joe is four times more likely than Cowenna to receive a Broken Magic Essence. Due to this imbalance, it has been difficult to move forward with Drop Rate increases without accounting for how Caravan Joe and his cousins, aka multi-clienting, would create further imbalances. Cowenna is still doing her AAHM runs hoping to get her BME, but feels that it's unfair that Caravan Joe is getting more drops per run. [/td][/tr][/table]
In other words, this imbalance is not a sustainable way for players to gain resources and this must be addressed to ensure that reward opportunities are available to all players in the game.

Increasing Dungeon Drop Rates and Improving the Reward Experience
A significant change that will be made to Mabinogi will be the addition of improved drop rates to dungeons and missions. This will allow players to play dungeons with more opportunities towards their reward goals. A major impact of this change will be the leveling-out of imbalances that inevitably became the norm due to multi-client use, and the creation of a better experience for those hoping to receive materials and other rewards from their dungeon runs. The drop rates of rewards from major dungeons and missions will be increased significantly to the same level that Mabinogi Korea has right now. We will increase the drop rates of many rewards, with our primary focus being–but not limited to–core high-level rewards such as crafting materials and Enchant Scrolls. For some dungeons, the Dungeon Re:Fine system will be applied with the increase of drop rates. 

We will share a detailed list of the dungeons and rewards affected by this change in a later announcement. Please look forward to the improved dungeon drop rates coming soon, with detailed information regarding the changes provided in the patch notes as usual! 

Another part of the game affected by multi-client use is the in-game events. Several players have been participating in events using multiple clients to get multiple rewards. Therefore, the reality of multi-client use was factored in when the Development team determined the coin shop prices for items in event shops. Oftentimes, there is also the need to pick and choose which rewards to spend coins on versus obtaining all rewards from the shop. This aspect is where players would feel that playing on an alternate account was required in order to earn the rewards, which we want to improve. There are certain events that allow all rewards to be obtained, and the aspect of choice is an integral element of game freedom, so this will still be a factor seen in events. However, to improve the experience after the multi-client block, we will adjust the event shop’s reward prices so that you can get enough rewards by solo playing, without using multi-clients.

Further Improving your Fantasy Life
Even with the many improvements that have been made to Mabinogi in recent years, we recognize that there are still options that many players have requested that may be missing from the game. In addition to these changes mentioned above, we will continue to actively improve the elements that burdened the experience and made multi-client use feel like a significant improvement to the game experience.
We sincerely apologize for allowing the multi-client behavior to impact the game as much as it has and hope these changes will begin to change the experience for the better. We appreciate your understanding as we enter this next chapter of Mabinogi. As this is a very important step for the future, we will do our best to ensure the long-term growth and stable service of the game, rather than focusing on the short-term visible result, such as the number of concurrent players in the game.
Thank you for your continued support, and please look forward to more details about upcoming updates to the game. We will continue to work hard so that Mabinogi can continue to grow steadily for a long time.

Milletians, we also recommend following the tips below to ensure that you are playing on a clean client:
Please ensure that you are launching Mabinogi through the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.Please delete any unofficial files that may be saved in the game installation folder.After removing any precarious files, perform a Repair Installation if using the Nexon Launcher, or Verify the Integrity of the Game Files if using the Steam Launcher. Alternatively, we recommend deleting the entire game installation folder and preparing a full reinstallation of the game to ensure that all files have been directly downloaded from the Nexon Launcher or Steam Launcher.As the Nexon Game Security client will be improved and updated, ensure that your antivirus or firewall trusts and allows the Mabinogi client and related files to run. If you encounter any issues, please contact Player Support.
Thank you, 

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: End-of-Sale Notice: Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

We are announcing the end of sale of the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll in the Cash Shop, effective immediately during the December 14th, 2023 maintenance.

With the Enchantment System Changes in the Arcana: Dark Arts Update, the expiration attribute of Enchant Scrolls has been removed entirely, and the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item no longer has an effective use. You can read more about these changes to the Enchantment system through the update patch note post.

Existing Enchant Expiration Removal Scrolls have been retrieved from all characters. These items can be claimed once again through the mailbox of the highest cumulative level character on the account.

For players who still had an Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item on their account, and they obtained the item through methods such as crafting, bought the item from another player, got the item through an event, etc., the item can be exchanged to NPC Stewart for 50,000 Gold.

For players who purchased the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item directly and still had the item in their account, they will be refunded the original value spent on the item in Pon. If a player purchased the item and used it, they will not be refunded. The exchanges for Pon have been completed with the December 14th, 2023 maintenance.

Those eligible for the Pon are defined as below:
An account who had purchased the Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll item within the last 1 year (December 1st, 2022 ~ December 14th, 2023)The account still had the item:Item was not claimed from the Cash Shop Inventory
ORItem is in the inventory of the character on the accountThe Enchant Expiration Removal Scroll will be removed and 12 Pon will be added to the account. 
Thank you,

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Arcana: Dark Arts Update - Patch Notes - December 14th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Arcana: Dark Arts Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Erinn-go-Round Event: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 11th, Before MaintenanceIceborn Noble Box: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 11th, Before MaintenanceMaster Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before MaintenanceWinter Specialist Doll Bag Box: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before MaintenanceWinter Holiday Decorations in Erinn: Thursday, December 14th, After Maintenance - January 18th, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeArcana: Dark Arts Update : Permanent
Arcana Dark Arts Update:
Several quality of life changes have been added to help with your fantasy life! See the full post for more information: Arcana: Dark Arts Update and check out the dedicated microsite!Two new Arcanas have been added - Alchemic Sharpshooter and Dark Diviner. Visit the Arcana Talent Association in Tara Rath Castle to learn more!Special Upgrades have been improved to make your upgrades feel more special!Enchantment has been given a remake! Timers on Enchant Scrolls are now a thing of the past!And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
Within the Point Inventory (the shopping cart icon), we have renamed "Rearrange" to "Claim". This button has always claimed all of the selected items, which is technically a form of rearranging, but we felt it could be a lot more clear.Renamed "Mana Tunnel in Filia" to "Filia Mana Tunnel" to be consistent with other Mana Tunnels and Moon Gates.Small text improvements have been applied to Jousting and the Tara Banquet.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Due to equal parts of your helpful reports and our love for polishing, we continued to improve the text in November's Beyond content. This took several forms- Mainstory text, Spirit text, Stardust quest information, and several PTJs (especially those involving the Dunbarton Library).(Also, we convinced Stewart to rename the Magazine section to Periodicals.)Corrected the text for the materials needed in the Norman Warrior Armor. Previously this indicated that you needed Common Leather Straps, when the materials used were actually Common Leather.Endelyon will no longer ask you to "일반 아르바이트 완전 수행 성공" for your daily Renown. Hopefully "Earn full credit for the perfect completion of any Part-Time Job" is a little more understandable!The Growth Guide now recognizes your hard work and will award you your Growth Guide Point when you complete "Work a Part-Time Job".The Upgrade Stone Selection Box from the Growth Guide no longer has a unfortunate adjective suggesting that this should be a Protective Stone. The intended rewards are and always have been Red Upgrade Stone (Event) x1 or Blue Upgrade Stone (Event) x1.The Inquisitive Black Friday Package previously stated that it granted only one Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) and 10x Forgetful Potions. This has been corrected to the proper values: Golden Experience Fruit (1000%) x5 and 10x Special Forgetful Potions. This is only an issue with the box text, the items within have always been correct. Although the sale has ended, we feel that it was best to right this in-game as well.The Skill Learn method for Metal Conversion has been referencing older requirements. This has been updated to reflect the actual requirements!If you're still unable to learn the skill through the above methods, we heard nearby rumors that talking to Pierrick might help...
The following bugs were fixed during the course of November:
Corrected an issue causing the Commerce Rankings to not update.Fixed issues with a few Part Time Jobs:Glenis was ignoring Nerys' ring.Fraser was not giving out selected rewards for his PTJs.Effie and Nicca's PTJs were not showing on the Rano PTJ board.Surging Hope Gems can once again be used as expected.The default Dollbag collection categories for Shyllien Ecology and Rare Mineralogy were not collecting all the same materials as the add-on collection categories. Both lists are now the same.The Premium Collection Category Add-on Slot was not properly working for the following Dollbags:Cethlenn and Vayne Compact Doll BagCommerce Companions Compact Doll BagCrom Bas Brielle and Gillach Compact Doll BagCrom Bas Cast Compact Doll BagDeirbhile and Piran Compact BagEnya and Etain Compact Doll BagEnya, Merlin, and Altam Compact Doll BagExpeditionary Force Compact Doll BagFolamh and Irusan Compact Doll BagG22 Compact Doll BagIgerna and Caoimhin Compact Doll BagLinden and Sayiv Compact Doll BagMarleid and Piran Compact Doll BagMelwyn and Llywelyn Compact Doll BagOrder of the Black Moon Compact Doll BagPinkie and Katell Compact Doll BagSplish-Splash Cat and Bug Catcher Pup Compact Doll BagThe Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon now correctly states that it can be used three times, up to a maximum of six.
The following are known bugs:
Sometimes one of the baby reindeer gets a little too excited for Part-Time Jobs and will collide with the Part-Time Job bulletin board in Dunbarton. Don't worry, he's fine and will make a full recovery (after the holidays)!A few bags are have incorrect sizes listed in their box description. This is only a text error and does not affect the actual bag.Bhatair Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10Morfydrianas Doll Bag Box - states 8x8, actual 7x10Tani Doll Bag Box - states 7x7, actual 7x10🐛In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: BEYOND Update - Patch Notes - November 16th
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the BEYOND Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Master Plan: Winter Infinite Growth Event: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before MaintenanceWinter Specialist Doll Bag Box: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 18th, Before MaintenancePart-Time for the Holidays Event: Thursday, November 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 7th, Before MaintenanceResistance Box: Thursday, November 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeBEYOND Update : Permanent
BEYOND Update:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: BEYOND Update
Part-time jobs have been improved. Read all about them with the Part-Time Job Guide!The Growth Guide has been added. Check out the Growth Guide Handbook!Our beloved spirit, Eiry, has returned!And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
Certain ranks of the Fishing skill’s description have been updated.Tamers rejoice, it has arrived. Fixed the issue where you could not collect the 5 star taming journal of the following monsters:
Cloaker: Peaca Intermediate DungeonGrumbill: Shadow Mission ‘Defeat Fomor Commander II’Wight: Peaca Basic DungeonKobold: Math Advanced DungeonGhoul: Peaca Normal DungeonTo address feedback that the dungeon vouchers were out of order on the Currency menu, we have renamed them from First/Second/Third/Fourth Vouchers to 1st/2nd/3rd/4th Vouchers. Behold the list in all its organized splendor.Polished the standard text on the Title menu for clarity.
This change is being made to the UI text. The titles and title display are unchanged.In order to make the Welcome Milletian Package's contents as clear as possible, we have renamed the 'Spirit Weapon Contract and Growth Box' to 'Spirit Weapon Starter Kit and Growth Box'. The contents of this are unchanged.In order to make the action more clear, we have retranslated the menu when using a Loot-o'-Lantern. 
Additionally, we have added a note to all Loot-o'-Lanterns that you must be in Iria to use it.As Rua deserves the best and only the best, we have improved her dialogue during the "[Dorcha Conversion] Artifacts of Bean Rua" quest.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
How strange- two enchant scrolls shared similar names of Strange and Strange_. We have renamed them as follows: 
Strange (Rank 9) Enchant has been renamed to Weird.Strange_ (Rank 3) Enchant has had the stray space at the end of its enchant name removed. (Strange_ > Strange)Additionally, the Water Drop (Rank A) Enchant should now be displayed as Water Drop in all areas, as opposed to Droplet.Corrected an issue where Elves could not move while the Eternal Resistance Two-Handed Sword Appearance Scroll was applied on an equipped weapon. Castanea asks that you forget this.Blue Coupons were displaying as blank items on the updated Logout screen, and shall no longer do so.Polished the text on a few Iria Exploration Quests. Most notably: 
Two not-quite-as-famous deities of Erinn, Paea and Kheridwen, have been retranslated as "Phaea" and "Ceridwen".No longer shall two quests ask you to Defeat 10 Black Forest Mushroom Spiders, as one has been correctly renamed to Defeat 10 Blue Forest Mushroom Spiders.We accidentally'd a word on the Ace Hero Ampoule Sets. They now indicate that they are Ampoule Sets, rather than singular ampoules. Treasure Hunter is complaining, but Starlet will calm him down.Minor text polish on the Generations, while we were in there for Beyond.Removed a few more references to Inventory Plus Kit from certain Bag Coupons.Players reported a handful of items where the (M) and (F) descriptions were swapped. Whoops! These have been fixed.Fixed a rare crash issue on certain chairs.
Bug fixes from the October 19th and 26th Maintenances:
Six NPC transformations from Samhain's Mysterious Transformation Medal Box were not properly registered, causing the relevant medals to display blank. The following transformations have been added, and previously blank medals are now able to be used.
Altam the Energetic, Avelin the Wrap Artist, Caswyn the Listless, Llywelyn the Perpetually Unimpressed, Pihne the Seller of Souvenirs, and Talvish the Middle ManagerFixed an issue that prevented the use of Birman Bag Coupons while possessing specific Totem Bags.Giants have recently started to uniquely travel upon their Purrlings. In fear for the kitty backs, the act of Purrling Surfing has been made illegal by royal decree.Some players noted that the new logout/exit game feature was too big for their resolution.
The number of items that can display has been reduced to improve this issue.
The following are known bugs:
The Spirit Weapon Additional Contract Coupon displays the old increase totals of '+2 for a total of 5'. This item can correctly be used three times for a total of six Spirit weapons, only the text is incorrect.🐛In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.The family is packin' it up and ready to go home after their long vacation. The Family Weekend Fishing Event Returns! is ending.Fashion Week is ending in Erinn, and we're cleaning up the apparel. The BLEUGENNE by Bleugenne Cosmetics Box Sale is ending.Heed our warning, Milletian: only the bravest in all of Erinn dare to open this jar... the Midnight Investigator Loot-o'-Lantern Sale is starting!As a reminder, it's the 7th and final week of the The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 4!Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm), Mag Mell, and Tech Duinn Missions will have dungeon key drops and increased drop rates.Processing of requested name changes. notes.title: October Quality of Life Updates - Patch Notes - October 12
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the October Quality of Life Updates!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Family Weekend Fishing Event Returns!: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before MaintenanceBLEUGENNE by Bleugenne Cosmetics Box: Thursday, September 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 19th, Before MaintenanceBillionaire's Bankroll: Season 4: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before MaintenanceSamhain: Times Forgotten, Times Remembered Event: Thursday, October 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before MaintenanceShopkeeper's Sale: Spooky Halloween Horror!: October 12th, 2023, After Maintenance - November 2nd, 2023, Before MaintenanceMoonshadow Emissary Box: Thursday, October 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeOctober Quality of Life Updates: Permanent
October Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added with the October update. See the full post for more information: October Quality of Life Updates
The Equipment Appearance Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.The Currency tab has been added.
The Quest Helper System has been improved.And more!
Commerce Alban Eiler Season 2:
Seasonal Commerce Alban Eiler Season 1 will begin at 12:00 AM PDT on November 1st, 2023 and run until March 1st, 2024 12:00 AM PST.Alban Eiler Season 1 will conclude on Friday, October 31st, 11:59 PM PDT.The following new outfits and sewing patterns have been added. The sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop in Season 2 for 3,000,000 Seasonal Ducats:Refashioned Coco Sailor Mini
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1128/refashioned-coco-sailor-mini.pngRefashioned Mini Leather Dress
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1129/refashioned-mini-leather-dress-image.pngPurchase limits within Sayiv’s shop will be reset.The Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger Box will be available, containing the following items:*NEW* Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger 2nd Title
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1134/alban-eiler-season-2-challenger-2nd-title-lorge.gif
Movement Speed +3%20 Precise Reforging ToolsThe Seasonal Commerce Guide will be updated with Season 2, and Alban Eiler Season 1 information will be archived.The stock for Bartering and Merchant Group Commerce won't reset.Commerce that has been completed while the season is changing will be refunded, however, please note that the purchase count won't be restored.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The width of the Character Status Effects UI menu has been increased so that active effect names are no longer cut… off.Added a line on Starblaze Fishing Rod's description to indicate that it increases the amount of Items fished up.As it wasn't entirely true, we've altered the Theta cooldown message from "resets during maintenance" to "resets Thursdays at 7:00 AM Server Time". We'll want to make this change in more places in the future for clarity.While "Server Time" isn't perfect, we find it a bit more preferable to "Earth Time"- which as it turns out, has multiple time zones.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Text fixes to the Generations, renaming Mini Effects to Minimize VFX, Jousting corrections, and more fixes have been included during the September patch cycle, yet after the initial September patch. See the September Patch Notes for more details!Some people heard the whispers of a Weird Cat when failing to complete their Dan Tests. No longer shall they hear its mews.Elsie and Shuan have been feeling ill since eating Altam's leftovers, leaving them in a state of constant screams. They have since received Party Healing, and their mouths are back to their regular size and shape.Corrected a visual issue when wearing Languhiris Chaser Gloves alongside Royal Knight Armor.A few Sewing Patterns had counterfit copies issued. Walter has since issued a recall, and the following patterns now work as expected: 
Sewing Pattern - Elegant Gothic SuitSewing Pattern - Lacard's Layered Muffler RobeSewing Pattern - Classic ShoesThe Advanced Search for Pet Type now appropriately uses the pet type names instead of numbers.Where "11" would previously bring up all the Bears, now "Bear" will.Lileas was a bit distracted during the 7:00 PM PT nightly Jousting Prelims, and started the initial match's registration time five minutes later than expected. Alpin was seen giving her a lecture on responsible Honey Drink consumption practices.Registrations for 7:00 PM PT Jousting Preliminary matches now can be accessed at 6:45 PM PT as expected.
The following are known bugs:
Giants have developed a unique way of riding Purrlings, causing their models to be misaligned.You cannot use Birman Flat Pouch coupon while possessing one of the new Horizontal Totem Bags.
You cannot use Birman Knapsack coupon while possessing one of the new Vertical Totem Bags.🐛In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.content:

You've been invited to participate in this year's Samhain. Watch the story unfold and retrieve precious memories as you complete the Singer of Secret's quests! Check out all the details here!

Event Dates: Thursday, October 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 2nd, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] A New Tale for Samhain Eve.
You will receive an Unsigned Invitation upon logging in during the event.Use the invitation to be spirited to the Dunbarton Library instantly.Meet with the Singer of Secrets in Dunbarton Library to register a main character.
You can only register one character per account.
You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] A New Tale for Samhain Eve:10,000 EXP2,023 GoldStory Snippet x10Story Snippets are event currency that can be used in the event shop for rewards.Every day when the main character logs in, Story Snippet x10 will be obtained.As a main character, you will be eligible to take part in a new story for Samhain, meet new characters, and immerse yourself with new BGM and NPC voice over (Korean) and obtain rewards along the way!
The volume of the voices can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Voice Volume.The reset time for event quests and mini-games will reset each day at 7:00 AM PT.All event quests and event items will be removed when the event ends.Memories of Samhain Event Quests
Quests' Challenge Level 
During the event, you will select the challenge level. The difficulty of the story quests will change depending on the choice you make.You can change your choice at any time by speaking with the Singer of Secrets again about Change Quest Challenge Level.Quest rewards do not vary depending on difficulty, and all quest rewards are the same.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1136/quest-difficulty-ui.png

There are several story quests that you can complete during the event period.After clearing a story quest, the next story quest will unlock after 7:00 AM PT the next day.

notes.title: October Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1147/231003-wgc-319-mb-oct-update-940x290.jpgOctober Quality of Life Updates
Equipment Inventory Slot

A new function has been added to the Dressing Room!
The Equipment Appearance Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1151/equipment-appearance-slot.pngSave the changed appearance of an equipment to a slot or change it to a different appearance using the change option.Characters will have three Equipment Appearance Slots by default.You can store different dyed versions of the same appearance scroll in separate slots.Equipment Appearance Slots are not shared among other characters within the account.Equipment Appearance Slots can be expanded by using 30 Pon.Maximum expanded slots is up to 300.Weapon Appearance Scrolls of some weapons have been added to NPC Shop.Sold from Nerys in Dunbarton when selecting the "Misc" tab.The following Weapon Appearance Scrolls have been added:Bastard Sword Appearance ScrollMace Appearance ScrollBipennis Appearance ScrollClaymore Appearance ScrollLeather Long Bow Appearance ScrollCrossbow Appearance ScrollPhysis Wooden Lance Appearance ScrollCardinal Chain Blade Appearance ScrollBasic Control Bar Appearance ScrollWood Atlatl Appearance ScrollSpiked Knuckle Appearance ScrollSpiral Shuriken Appearance Scroll
Currency Storage

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/1153/currencies-ui-plus-button.png
The Currency tab has been added.
Currency items that are used to purchase items at NPC shops will now be stored in the Currency tab located when clicking the Inventory icon on the UI rather than in your inventory or bag. Gold and Ducats will remain in your inventory. Open the menu through Inventory > Currency tab, or set a hotkey for it under Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings > Currencies. The items that have been converted to currency and moved into three categories of the Currency tab are as follows:General
Adventurer Seal
Basic/Intermediate/Advanced Baltane Seal
Gold-Leaf Pine Cone
Royal Society Sponsorship Badge
Returned Milletian’s SealBattle
First Voucher
Second Voucher
Third Voucher
Fourth Voucher
Adamantine Coin
Frostwork Crystal Shard
Field Raid MementoEvent
Note: Limited timed event coins and currencies will be stored here while the corresponding event is active.
With this new feature, the Currency Storage notification will always display each time you log in until you open the Currency Storage for the first time. To remove this notification, open the Currency tab once.Certain currencies can be withdrawn from the bank menu.The Quest Helper SystemThe Quest Helper System has been improved.The quest help button can be checked in the quest window.The Altruist rankings reset periodically.This new season ranking is separate from the existing cumulative help score ranking with each season lasting for 3 months before resetting. The first season will run until January 1, 2024 at 12:00 AM PT. The Season Ranking schedule for each season is:January~March / April~June / July~September / October~DecemberThe quest helper related rewards have been changed and new rewards have been added.
After the season ends, the top 100 players in the season will be able to support story shadow missions, similar to a Royal Alchemist, until the end of the next season.Titles are awarded based on the Total Quest Help Provided. If you have already progressed the Quest Help more than the required number for the title acquisitions then you will obtain the title when you complete 1 "Helping Out" request after the update.
A Help button has been changed to Quest Help.
The Quest Help button can be checked in the Quest window.Improvements have been made so that notifications can be set on the Altruism Quest Board.You can now enable Altruist Notifications from the Altruism Quest Board.This will send you a notification when a user requests assistance for a quest.You can still register to be an Altruist through the NPC Weird Cat in the Chief’s House in Tir Chonaill. The notification change limit will be reset every day at 7:00 AM Erinn time.You can now check the number of Quest Help Provided on the Altruism Quest Board.Quests that can be requested for help will display a Request Help button in the Quest Info window, and when pressed, the quest will automatically be set as a Help Request Quest.Quest Help criteria and scores have been improved.
Completing a "Help Out" request has been changed from "when pressing the Complete button" to "when completing the last objective" of the quest.Removed the deduction of Altruism points if no help is provided for a certain period of time.Altruism points can now be obtained from an account only once per day.Altruism points can be earned again after 12:00 AM PT.Additional Changes
