notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the September Quality of Life Updates & the September Jousting Renewal Updates!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Sea Angel Box: Thursday, August 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 21st, Before MaintenanceSestia Academy Box: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 5th, Before MaintenanceBillionaire's Bankroll: Season 4: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 26th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeJousting Tournament Renewal Update: PermanentSeptember Quality of Life Updates: Permanent
September Jousting Renewal & Quality of Life Updates:
The Jousting Tournament Renewal is here! Check in with Lileas and review the updated details here: Jousting Tournament Renewal Update
The preliminary and tournament match times have been updated.Up to 64 combatants can participate in the Jousting Finals.Skills exclusive to Jousting have been added.New rewards have been added to Lileas’ shop which Jousting Points can be exchanged for.The ability to cheer on combatants has been added, rewarding Jousting Points when spectating.And more!Several quality of life changes have been added with the September update. See the full post for more information: September Quality of Life Updates
Several inventory improvements have been implemented, such as a fishing box, trash can function, and changes to the Inventory Search functions.Elves and Giants can now get married in Emain Macha!Dan Advancement tests have been balanced so that you can achieve your Dan ranks more comfortably.And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
Updated the Word Filter to allow “Swap”, “C8”, and “Lesbian”.You can now use Rage Impact with the following Two-Handed Clubs: Sheep Mace Lovey Dovey Cotton Candy Merchants' Guild Abacus Seashell Plushie Beluga Whale Plushie Dumbo Octopus Plushie Black Rose Bouquet Black Rose Clutch Glass Trim Bouquet Sacred Glow Censer Sacred Glow Holy Water Fairy Bubble Blower Seraphic Cantabile Holy CenserIn order to better tell them apart, we have renamed the 24-Hour cooldown “Forgetful Potion” to “Special Forgetful Potion”. The 7-Day cooldown version will remain the same. The descriptions for both have been updated to make the effects more clear. Renamed “Sephirot Arrow” to “Sephirot Bolt”, as these can only be fired via Crossbow. The buff effect for Baltane Mission Crystals has been changed from "Shadow Crystal" to "Baltane Crystal", in order to make them more distinct from Shadow Crystals.(As of the August 10th Maintenance) It has been changed so that when you use a Weapon Appearance Scroll, the color of the item will now follow the color codes of the item the Weapon Appearance Scroll was based on. Before, the color was assigned randomly.This change applies only to the appearance scrolls obtained after the August 10th update patch.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
The Gather Stackable Items buttons will no longer restack and highlight stacks that are already at maximum. This improves the performance of this button.Improved the Pet Dye UI to fit RGB values properly.Continued our constant pursuit of polish by fixing up typos in G3, G24, and G25.Joust in time, we've performed a polish pass on the Jousting-related text!Do you hear bells? We've also improved the Marriage-related text!Fixed the text on Zone of Renewal to correct the ability cost from Phantasmal Amalgam to Phantasmal Remnant. The actual cost is unchanged.Fixed an issue where Intact Shyllien (Part-Time Job only) and Energy Converter (Part-Time Job only) placed in pet inventories could not be retrieved.The ability Mirage Missile was not properly granting stats from ranking the skill up. For those whose Mirage Missile was already ranked up, you will receive the missing stats automatically following a Rebirth.Floating heads no more- Fixed an issue where NPC-style Transformations would lack a body when transforming with a full body Robe equipped in your Gear slot.Corrected a few graphical issues on the Rookie Barista Uniform (M).(Fixed during the August 17th Maintenance) Commerce rejoice and wyverns beware - Fixed an issue with Poison Potions that would prevent players from crafting Poison Tip Wyvern Ballista Bolts.
Bug fixes from the September 14th Maintenance:
Heavy Strike! Fixed an issue where the number of players able to join the Jousting Tournaments was incorrect. Up to 16 players may join the Preliminary matches, and up to 64 players may join the Finals.
Counter! The ticker times for the Preliminary matches now correctly displays the proper times.
Focus! The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary now displays the proper Prelims Jousting times.
Unbreakable Defense! The Cheer Squad has set their alarms and will now properly show up at the updated match times.In an effort to improve the flavor of Mabinogi's early-game experience, we have revised the descriptions for a number of early-game weapons commonly available in NPC shops.Removed an out-of-date mechanic reference on some older Staves. More Stave descriptions will be updated in a later patch.
Polished the descriptions of the myriad Shadow Crystals to make the effect more clear.
Provided a little more polish for the Wedding text. Hope your love springs eternal!
The recipes for Arbalest and Highlander Long Bow have been updated to remove "Radiant Tough String" for the correct "Radiant String". This is a text only change, the functionality for these recipes is unchanged.Improved the objectives for the Carpentry Grandmaster Missions to better indicate that the [Average/Fine/Finest] Firewood must be Made, not Obtained.
The following are known bugs:
When viewing the additional information in the character information UI, there is some text cut off at the bottom of the Jousting information.The "Today's Contents" section of the Traveler's Diary still has the incorrect time for the Sunday Jousting Finals.In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.
There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.
There is an issue with the in-game Guild list not populating with guilds.

notes.title: Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 4
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1245/220124_irusanattendanceevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Eochaid outfit set (appreciation for eel not included). Become the baby Harmonic Saint you've always wanted to be, or if you're a giant, an Eochad when you finish the calendar! There's also brand-new Support Selection Boxes every single week. Check out the details below.
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, September 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 30th, Before Maintenance
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.pngDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract.Log in during the event period to receive the Stamp Employee Contract.Register for the event with the Stamp Employee Contract.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Stamp Employee Contract:1,000 EXP500 Gold*NEW* 7x Irusan’s Support Selection Box https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2207/irusans-support-selection-box.pngUse this box to select and receive one of the following items:Light Physical Power Potion (30 min)Speed Walk Potion 40% (30 min)Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion (Not tradable) x10Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min) (Not tradable)Light Magic Power Potion (30 min)Party Phoenix Feather (Event)Refined Shadow Crystal (Event)Perfect Free Repair KitBaltane Mission Crystal x3Golden Experience Fruit (100%)Production Boost Potion Selection Box (Not tradable)Special Gem Selection BoxRoyal Academy Crystal (Not tradable)Direct Metal Dye AmpouleDirect Pet Dye Ampoule (Not tradable)Divine Mineral Fragment (Event) x3 (Does not expire)Only one box can be used per real day. Resets every day at 7:00 AM PT.Items from this box expire after 1 day, with the exception of the Divine Mineral Fragment (Event)Find A Kitty in Need in front of the Unicorn Statue.Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen.  
You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 28 days, while the last calendar will only have 21 days of log in.You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.A new Event Clock timer is available so you can check your Check-in progress at a glance without opening up the Event Menu.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2079/irusans-clock-ui.pngAttendance StampsThere is a new way to earn a stamp each day!Clear one of the following missions to get a stamp:Daily Taillteann MissionDaily Tara MissionBaltane Mission (other than Nowhere to Run, Gatekeeper, and Knights of the Round Table)Lord MissionMag Mell MissionTech Duinn MissionStay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.You will only receive 1 stamp per day.Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from November 30th, After Maintenance - December 7th, Before Maintenance.When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2141/irusan-s4-calendar.png
Attendance Pass PurchaseIf you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for 29 Pon.The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. Additionally, speak to A Kitty in Need and select “Gold Event Shop”.A Kitty in Need sells 5x Magical Attendance Passes that can be used to recover stamps you’ve missed.This item will be removed when the event ends.

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2177/230904_septemberupdate_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpgJousting Tournament Renewal Update
The Jousting Tournament has been newly improved!
The preliminary matches for the Jousting Tournament will now be held on channels 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.The Jousting Tournament preliminary matches will be expanded to 6 matches, 3 times each, at the following times:Preliminary Round (10am PST / 1pm EST / 7pm CEST and 7pm PST / 10pm EST / 4am CEST)Monday ~ Saturday: 10:00 | 10:15 | 10:30 | 19:00 | 19:15 | 19:30Channel 5, 6, 7, 8, 9The Jousting Tournament Final Match will take place at the following time:Final Round  (1pm PST / 4pm EST / 10pm CEST)Sunday 13:00Channel 8Registration for Preliminary Rounds starts 10 minutes before the match starts, and registration for the Final Round starts 30 minutes before the match starts.If you win in the Jousting preliminary round two times within the same week, you will receive the Weekly Jousting Tournament Entry Ticket to enter the Final round.A maximum of 64 participants will be selected in order of arrival for the final match.The final round can now start without the maximum number of players.There will still need to be 8 players participating for the final match to begin.If you have a Weekly Jousting Tournament Entry Ticket at the time of reception for the final Jousting, but are not selected for the final Jousting, 200 points will be refunded. Rewards are not available outside of these times.Jousting Points can be earned when participating in a Jousting match.Preliminary Rounds:Win: 50 pointsLoss: 25 pointsFinal Round:Win First Place: 3000 pointsWin Second Place: 1500 pointsWin Third Place: 300 pointsLoss: 150 pointsJousting attack combos specific to a character’s race have been removed.Command (W,A,S,D) damage has been changed slightly.Skills exclusive to Jousting have been added.Skills can be used by consuming skill points, and recovers +1 skill points when hit and +2 skill points when attacked.Skill point costs are below the skill icon, and accumulated skill points are indicated below the health bars during a match.You can have up to 10 skill points.You can enter a combination of commands and skills during the command input time.If there is no key input during the command input time, the command is automatically selected randomly, but the skill will not be automatically selected.Skills can be used by selecting the skill icon or using the number keys 1, 2, 3, 4.[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Attack Details[/th][/tr][tr][td]1. (Opponent skill point +1)[/td][/tr][/table]The Jousting Tournament cheering function is added, so cheer on and favor the competitor you’d like to see win!Even if you are not selected as a Jousting tournament player, you can cheer for the competitor who participates in the game through the Jousting Tournament Board placed throughout the Jousting tournament site. In the preliminaries, even if the cheering person wins or loses, Jousting points are rewarded.Win: 30 pointsLoss: 15 pointsIn the final round, even if the person cheering wins or loses, Jousting points are rewarded.Win: 300 pointsLoss: 100 pointsEven if you are selected as a participant in the Jousting competition, you can cheer for yourself or others.When cheering, gold is consumed based on the cheering costs according to the preliminaries/finals, and the gold used for cheering purposes are non-refundable.If the match is canceled because there are less than 8 participants in the final round, the gold used for cheering will be refunded.You can choose to cheer on a player participating in the match for 10 minutes before the start of the match.To determine the priority and selection of competitors in the Jousting Tournament, additional points are applied based on cheering.As the amount of participants and channel where the Jousting tournament is held is limited, the amount of points determine the selection.If there are more than 16 people registered for the match before the preliminaries, selection will be determined according to the additional points each person has.Bonus points are accumulated the more you cheer, and the higher the accumulated points, the higher the probability of being selected for the match.Lileas’ dialogue has been updated so that the guidelines will reflect the changed tournament rules.Through Lileas, you will be able to reset your Jousting Tournament records.1,000,000 gold is consumed to reset the statistics, and the results of the Jousting Tournament will return to 0 wins and 0 losses. Jousting Points are not reset.The cost of practicing alone in the Jousting Tournament has been changed from 50 gold to 5,000 gold.Several new items have been added to NPC Lileas’ shop! notes.title: September Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2020/220916_septemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngSeptember Quality of Life Updates
Inventory Improvements

Many functions of the Inventory have been improved and some new functions are implemented.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2221/anglers-creel-item-and-inventory.png
The Angler’s Creel item has been added.The Angler’s Creel is a fishing bucket where you can store fish and items acquired when using the Fishing skill, and up to 100 items can be stored.The Angler’s Creel occupies a size of 2x2 and can be placed in your inventory window or bag.You can obtain it by purchasing and using the Angler’s Creel Coupon for 1,000,000 Ducats in the Limited Items tab of a Commerce Trading Post merchant.The coupon is tradable. When used, the Angler’s Creel is a non-tradable item, and you can only have one per character.You can manage the items in the fishing bucket by selecting the acquired fish or item and move them to your inventory or destroy them.Items moved to the inventory cannot be put back into the fishing bucket.If you catch a fish while summoning a seal, it will be acquired in the seal’s inventory first.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2171/trash-can-feature.png
A Trash Can function has been added. The trash can is a function that allows you to select items that can be destroyed or dropped and remove them all at once. Select the trash can icon in your main inventory tab to open the trash can pop-up.Select items to move to the trash by pressing Alt + Left click mouse button. Items in the trash can be removed at once with the Destroy All button. Items destroyed in this way will be deleted permanently and cannot be recovered. A function to move all items to the Trash Bin has been added to individual item bags.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2169/bag-move-all-items-to-trash.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2174/hidden-menu.pngA hidden button has been added to the main inventory tab, and some functions have been moved to the hidden window in a dropdown menu.The Extra Equipment Slot icon is moved to the hidden window.The Bag Order Settings function is moved to the hidden window.Functions that have the same effect as a bag are moved to the hidden window. (Example: Soul Stream Inventory, Master Plan Inventory, etc.)An option is available to open it at the same time as your main inventory.The function to bundle items with an expiration date is moved to the hidden window. An option is available to activate it at the same time as the Gather Stackable items function.The function to remove items that have expired is moved to the hidden window. An option is available to activate it and open the Trash Bin function at the same time.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2170/bag-rename-function.pngWhen minimizing a bag, you can now set the bag name to further organize your belongings!A maximum of 16 characters can be used for the bag name. The bag name is saved only on individual PCs and is not available across devices.Several changes have been added to the Inventory Magnifying Glass menu.8 new icons have been added to the favorites menu.The number of items that can be added to favorites has been increased from 6 to 10.An Equipment Enhancement tag has been added and the following items are classified under that tag. Celtic SignetsReforging Tools and Hope GemsEnchant Protection Potion, Enchant Extraction Protection Potion, Repair Protection Potions Red / Blue Upgrade StonesEquipment Durability and Proficiency increase hammersAn option is available to open it at the same time as your main inventory.The Recovery Potion tag has been revised to Potions.When an item's maximum bundle stack has been reached, the color of the bundle count’s text color will change to yellow.The position of the 'NEW' display for newly acquired items has been corrected by 1 pixel.A Reset function for the Jabchiel's Music Folio items have been added.The Jabchiel's Music Score has been renamed to Jabchiel's Music Folio, and information related to resetting has been added to the item description. The Reset function can be used in the item menu that appears when you right-click Jabchiel's Music Folio in the Inventory window.Upon resetting the notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2023 Year End Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Dear Milletians,

How has your summer been treating you? It’s been scorching hot in LA, but we’ve been keeping cool and staying hydrated (with our stackable water bottles)! How about your adventure in the Snowy Summer in Erinn? Glenn Bearna’s chill certainly stirred a bit of commotion in Tir Chonaill, so we hope your foray into Sliab Mis has been a manageable one. The team and I had a ton of fun working on the Glenn Bearna update this year. We were glad to see the intrigue and anticipation from you all with the update microsite and the July 13th release!

As you can tell, this year’s Summer Master Plan was also intended to coincide with this chilly summer update. We heard your desire for the event to return and it was tough for us to keep quiet until the event post went out. We are hoping to improve that experience and we’re brainstorming on ways to bring you more teasers and previews, even in small ways. My favorite part about working on Mabinogi is the rare opportunity to see all the sneak-peaks and the behind-the-scenes content being worked on by our talented team members and developers. Since we are constantly working on upcoming and future projects, it can be exciting to think of how you’ll react to it once it has been released. Recently, we’ve received many positive praises and feedback from you all, especially after the Fantasy Party and Mabinogi Eternity announcement. We can’t thank you enough for sharing your thoughts with us, and it has been incredibly heartwarming to know that our work is bringing joy for many people. 

Do you think the weather will be nicer in Connous? I heard Arciellia is planning a beach party…
Stay tuned for more details!


https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1805/look-at-how-cute-we-are-gms-940x390.png

We love to check what all of our Milletians are up to, and what you are all enjoying. Many of you post and talk about events and activities in our community spaces, and it is always fun to see the range of interests that are discussed in there daily. It’s such a fun outlook because we all reside in Erinn and experience it differently, but at the end of the day, we’re all loving the same game. It is a pleasure to be a part of a community much larger and more vibrant than we think. Recently, we have had several community-run events in-game and offline with fun mini-games and rewards! Shout out to all of the event coordinators who make these community faires come to life! If you are interested in joining in on these events, or running your own, you can find all the details in our #community-events Discord channel. There are many more spaces where you can strengthen the bond of being a Milletian, and you may meet new friends where you didn’t think you could. 

You know what else excites us every month - new content releases! The team has been working on several updates, scaling from minor and major updates. I wanted to bring attention to this because we’ve heard your feedback and know that there are many updates you are hoping to see come to Mabinogi. While we can’t share all of the specifics just yet, there are many topics currently in discussion.

We hope to continue bringing changes and improvements to our service to enhance your gameplay and experience. On that note, what else can we expect to come in 2023!? Let me share some of the contents we are preparing for you, and while not mentioned below, there will of course be other events and items to enjoy as well.

In Q3...
Auction House overall improvements and changes have landed in Erinn! Many functional and visual changes have been prepared to improve areas where Milletians may have had a negative experience. Menu changes such as favoriting, displaying bank balance, addition of visual indicators for enchanted items, and more have been included to make it easier and quicker to search for items. You can now purchase individual items from a stacked bundle, and re-list or retrieve multiple items all at once! We know how much you wanted these features, and it was great to see how happy you were when the patch notes were released.While we encountered a few (now resolved!) slight hiccups after the patch, we are incredibly thankful for your quick reports and understanding of our investigations and downtime required to fix those issues.Additional quality of life improvements include increased item bundles and stack count for more items, improved inventory management (trash bin, fishing tackle box), and other minor bug fixes to come. More content changes? We can expect to see a renewal to the ol’ medieval sport: Jousting! Let’s give Lileas a visit, hmm? With new Jousting-exclusive skills and new rewards, Jousting will become more thrilling!Milletians looking to improve their academy scores will also be in luck, as changes to the Dan Advancement Tests will be introduced, removing many elements that depend on luck and adjustments to the difficulty level of certain tests will be made. Another highly requested and incredibly anticipated change is the power of love between Elves and Giants…in Marriage! I can’t wait to see everyone’s intertwined love come true. ❤
In Q4...
We have an exciting new story event to share during the Halloween season. As we shared during the Fantasy Party stream and recap, new improvements to the early game experience will be coming soon with several changes: the Part-time job renewal, spirit weapon tutorial (Eiry’s return!), a content growth guide, and many generation quests will be simplified. What we may all be the most hyped for is new Arcana talents! Also shared during the Fantasy Party, these extraordinarily cool talents “Alchemic Stinger"* (Battle Alchemy + Archery) and "Dark Mage"* (Chain Slash + Magic) will be available in Erinn soon! *Names subject to change.
Is there anything you are looking forward to from this list? We can’t wait to dive in to all the things in the works in Erinn this year!

Thank you for reading and catching up with me! I hope you all have pawsitive summer adventures, with apurrtizing summer foods, ameowzing sights, and take some time to relax and enjoy the world! Don’t procatstinate your skill training or leveling though, the purrfectly cuddly Purrlings will need levels too!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1650/webimage_purrling_tabby02_crop.png

Sincerely,
GM Mewlynne, Mabinogi Producer Cat Lover
& The Mabinogi Team ❤

notes.title: August Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1502/220819_augustupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
August Quality of Life Updates
Auction House Changes

Many functions of the Auction House have been improved and some new functions are implemented.
The bidding auction method will be removed.
There were two types of transactions in the Auction House: normal/regular listings, and auction/bidding listings. Through this patch, all auction listings have been integrated into a regular auction listing instead of the bidding auction listing, which has a remarkably low utilization rate.The Bid selection has been removed from the Auction House search options.If a bid has failed due to another character's higher bid/re-bid/purchase failure before the patch, the Gold for that failed bid will automatically be sent back to the bank of the account during the August 10 maintenance.The default sorting method of the Auction House search results has been changed so that items are sorted in order from lowest to highest price.In addition, in order to minimize the damage caused by “Auction House fraud” or the act of “scamming”, which results in an unfair advantage by deceiving the selling price of an item, the default sorting method of the Auction House has been changed to sort by the lowest price per item sold.An option to Purchase Individual Items has been added. When purchasing bundled items on the Auction House, you can now purchase them as a whole stack or individually. Buy now in the quantity you need!When purchasing bundled items, Purchase All and Purchase Individual buttons are displayed.   When purchasing an item, a window where you can check the purchase method, purchase quantity, and purchase amount will be displayed.   When registered bundled items, the amount entered in the listing will be the price per unit. Example: 10 Dead Bees for a unit price of 1,000,000 gold each will be registered for a total price of 10,000,000 gold.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1692/dead-bees.png
For bundled items that have been sold individually, you can collect the payment and unsold items during the sale through the item’s listing.After collecting the partial balance, any remaining items on sale will be canceled and the partial sale amount will be paid. Remaining items will be returned to the inventory.A Favorites feature has been added, so you can add and manage favorite item searches in the Auction House.Use the Register Favorites option to save a preferred search term, auction category, search options, and detailed advanced options. Up to 10 favorites can be saved.The favorites information is saved only on individual PCs and is not available across devices.The Search Popular Items search function is added.You can check the top 20 items with the highest daily trade volume in each Auction category.Transaction volume is updated in real time.The popular item search list is reset at 12:00 AM PDT every day in real time, and during maintenance.The Search bar function has been modified.If you search for an item and click a related search term populated in the dropdown, it will be searched with the [Exact Match] check box activated.A Search History function that saves up to 10 search terms is added and resets when you change channels or log off.Highlights are displayed when dragging a search term in the search bar.You can open and close the autocomplete window and search history by clicking the search bar.The width of the search bar is expanded.It is improved to enable search regardless of spacing in search terms.Suggested search options will appear when an item matches the search term inputted, as before.Improved the detailed search Advanced options for auction listings.[Exact Match] can be used in all categories.Function-related information is added to the tooltip when hovering over auction functions.Improvements have been made so that you can set the rank, number of effects, name, and range when searching for Reforging.When searching for Reforging, the character limit for names is extended to 40 characters.You can set the type and range of enhancement when searching for Special Upgrade.When searching Glyphwright, you can set the effect name and level range.When searching Echostone, you can set the effect name and level range.The following have been added to the Advanced option search.Set Effects - Added to the Equipment and Accessories category.Motion - Added to the Armor Equipment category.Crafter Info - Added to the Equipment and Accessories category.When searching for Advanced options in the Sewing Patterns and Manual categories, you can search separately by production rank and production item name.Training Stone Type - Added to the Alban Stone category.Signet - Added to Weapon categories.Max ATT, Magic ATT, Food Quality - Added to Ingredient category.Glyph Quality - Added to the Glyph Imprint category.Location Used - Added to the Homestead category.Equip Restrictions - Added to Weapon, Equipment and Face Decoration categories.The Auction House menu has been improved.Even if you click refresh, the sorting function and page are maintained.10 page turn buttons are added.Among items with the same price in the sorting state, the item registered first is positioned at the top.The bank balance is displayed at the top of the Auction House UI.The following subcategory tabs have been added:Melee WeaponsSword Other EquipmentLife Skill ToolsThe Cooking Tools category has been removed, and items will now be included in the Life Skill Tools category.The Fynn Bead category has been moved from the Other Equip subcategory to the Consumable subcategory.
4 new subcategories have been added under the Misc category:
Tailoring/Weaving
Fynni Pets
Smoldering Thread
Perfume
When registering an item, it is improved so that you can register a sale item using Alt + Left Click.The display of item information in the Auction House is improved.If items are listed that were purchased from the NPC shop, it is now displayed after the item name in the auction list.In the case of an item whose validity period has expired or durability is 0, a red shadow appears on the background of the item image.Items with initial durability of 0, such as balloons and empty bottles, will not be displayed.For items with enchantments, a color is assigned to the enchantment name.The restrictions that prevent you from using the Auction House in certain conditions are partially improved.Some conditions and functions are limited to the use of the Auction House as before.Flight state, umbrella open state - All Auction House functions are available.Transformation, demigod/Divinity state - All Auction House functions except preview are available.Pet/partner summon status, mounting, trade status, dungeon entry status, shadow mission entry status - You can use the Auction House and Preview functions.You cannot use most of the core functions, such as purchasing or retrieving items and gold when a Pet or Partner is summoned.The Discount Coupon Settings feature is available, which allows you to set the minimum amount price cutoff for when the prompt to use an Auction House Fee Discount Coupon on a sold listing.It is improved so that you can set in-game notifications related to the Auction House under Auction House Settings > Sold Item Notifications.Added a checkbox to select multiple items in the My Auctions tab. A Relist Selections function is added, and items that have failed to be sold are registered for sale again with the settings that were initially registered.A Reclaim Selections function will be added and items that have failed to be sold will be returned to the inventory.When using the Reclaim Selections function, you can choose to receive payment or receive items.The batch processing function of Auction House items is improved and added.It is modified so that batch processing functions can be used without separate sorting.
The Preview function is improved.It is improved so that you can move the location of the character and homestead props by right-clicking.A function to reset the viewpoint is added. Some bugs are fixed.An issue where an infinite message pops up when entering the Enter key in the search box is fixed.The sales amount in the payout notification window will be modified to display [total amount] instead of [amount per item].Typos in the guarantee check notification window will be corrected.The certified check notification window is modified to display the current bank balance.An issue where the enchantment list is not displayed when searching for an enchantment with 'Exact Match' enabled is fixed.An issue where items with both prefix/suffix enchantments were not searched when searching for an enchantment with 'Exact Match' enabled has been fixed.An issue where, when purchasing an item with a recent average price difference of 90%, an information window with overlapping information displayed twice will be fixed.

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Hyperspace Aurora Box: Thursday, June 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 20th, Before MaintenanceBudding Friendship Doll Bag Box: Thursday, June 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 27th, Before MaintenanceSeraphic Cantabile Chest: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 10th, 2023, Before MaintenanceRelay Attendance Check-In Event: Thursday, June 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 27th, Before MaintenanceThe Scouts' Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event: Thursday, July 6th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 7th, Before MaintenanceA Snowy Preparation - Glenn Bearna Events: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 10th, 2023, Before MaintenanceGlenn Bearna Dungeon Support: Thursday, July 13th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeGlenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update: Permanent
Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update:
A new dungeon, Glenn Bearna, and a new area, Sliab Mis, have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.You can meet the new NPC Loiscneach, the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.See the full post for more information: Glenn Bearna: The Midwinter Fissure Update. Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
Update Regarding Recent Lag

We have been working hard to fix the various lag issues that have been occurring of late. Though we reduced the heaviness of the lag a few weeks back, we wanted to improve things further. There are still a few reports we've seen that we will continue to look into, but we feel that the game is in a much better state than when this all began. 

In the future we will need to further update the affected areas which could cause some return of the lag. We will communicate this with you when the time comes, and do our best to avoid and mitigate any issues. 

We apologize for the impacted gameplay, and thank you for your patience as we determined the root causes.

- The Mabinogi Team

The following changes have been made to the game:
Upgrade Reversion Kit can now be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.Print Casual Wear can no longer be upgraded.
The upgrade options of already upgraded items will be kept but cannot be further upgraded.
Color has been added to the sword appearance in the animation of the Special Imperial Knight Uniform.
As a material item with the name "Shining Crystal Shard" already exists, the "Shining Crystal Shard" that can be obtained from Glenn Bearna will be renamed to "Frostwork Crystal Shard" in a future patch.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed a rare issue that loading the skill UI could cause a client crash.Fixed an issue where the charge count appeared abnormally when parallel-casting Elemental Knight skills.Fixed an issue where the remaining time for Final Strike appeared abnormally when parallel-casting while using Final Strike. Fixed a rare issue where you could not finish casting Meteor Strike when you are attacked while parallel-casting. Fixed the issue where you could defend the skills which should not be defendable by Dauntless Defense. Combo: PummelAct 6: CrisisSuccubus Queen's Butterfly KissMerrow’s WaterspoutRoaring skills of dragons and NeidFixed the issue where Elemental Attunement was applied when using Thunder skill.Fixed missing plus marks on the announcement text when summoning (or unsummoning) a doll bag.Removed an incorrect mention of Royal Complete Skill EXP Potion (1 Day) being listed as part of the Snowy Scout's Warm Up Gold Shop.Fixed an issue causing the Fantastic Chorus Enhancement effect to not further boost the reduction to enemy stats. All other portions of the effect are working as intended.An issue where the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title were granted when retrieving the previous season's rewards has been identified. Characters who obtained the Alban Eiler Season 2 Challenger box and title have had these items replaced with the correct Imbolic Season 2 Challenger Box and Imbolic Season Challenger title automatically during the July 13th maintenance.Found and fixed many typos through the game, this time mostly around G22, G23, Techniques/Briogh, and Arcana quests. Thank you players for continuing to report these!
The following are known bugs:
Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.There is an issue where one-time/limited items cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their countdown start when the item is purchased.Several items containing ampersands in their name and description aren't showing the & symbol.
In rare circumstances when rapidly casting Arrow Revolver, players will become unable to move or attack until receiving an attack or relogging.
The Journal images for Glenn Bearna display the dungeon name as "Glenn Berna".

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1148/230627_julyupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update DetailsA new dungeon, Glenn Bearna, and a new area, Sliab Mis, have been added. You can reach the area through Sidhe Sneachta.Sidhe Sneachta’s terrain has been partially changed.Scenario quests related to the new areas will be added.You can meet the new NPC Loiscneach, the mountainkeeper, during the Glenn Bearna scenario quest.Several enhancement changes have been introduced for Erg, Echostones, Arcana, and more.Additional details for Glenn Bearna can also be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
Scenario QuestsCold winds from the northern lands have blown into Tir Chonaill. The Glenn Bearna prologue story will be available. During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the quest [Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind is automatically given to characters who have met one of the following condition: Completed Memory Book Volume 3, Completed Generation 1's "Advent of the Goddess", Completed Arcana Guide Quest "Lighting the Arcana's Flame"During The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event, the difficulty of battles during quests will be lowered. After The Scouts’ Snowy Summer Warm-Up Event ends, the quest [Content] Dark Dreams of a Winter Wind will be automatically given to characters who have at least one Arcana Talent that has at least 1 Link unlocked.   The Glenn Bearna scenario quest line begins with the guide quest, [Content] A Flame of Burning Cold.This quest is given when the cumulative level is 20,000 or higher, an Arcana Link is unlocked at level 1 or higher, and the prologue story quest, [Content] A God of the Northern Winds is completed.You may have to change channels to receive the quest after completing the prologue story.You can proceed with the quest by talking to NPC Laoire in the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.Progress through the story to discover the reason behind the abnormal weather.During the quest, [Content] A Tranquil Mirror of Dawn and Dusk, you will discover Sliab Mis and be able to enter Glenn Bearna.After completing the last quest of the scenario, you will be able to enter Sliab Mis and Glenn Bearna without quest limitations.
Glenn Bearna Dungeon
Entry Details
Enter Glenn Bearna through the barrier in Sliab Mis, north of Sidhe Sneachta.Dungeon Entry Conditions:Cumulative level 20,000 or higher Arcana total level 50 or higherCompleting the final Glenn Bearna scenario quest: [Content] A Fantasia of Endless WinterA minimum of 2 to a maximum of 8 party members can enter the dungeonNote: If you enter with an odd number, party members without pairs can have difficulty with some dungeon objectives.Glenn Bearna has two dungeon difficulty levels: Normal and Hard. There is no entry limit, but clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.
Entry Details
In order to clear the dungeon, you must overcome the frost’s grasp within Glenn Bearna.Solve the paradox between the Day and Night timelines of Glenn Bearna. The dungeon is played in pairs with the Lifeline system.The party will be split up into Day and Night groups, and you will be paired with someone from the other side.You can select which side to join and the pair will be randomly determined.You share Lifeline Health with your Lifeline Partner.Lifeline Health gauges the shared health bar of the two paired party members depending on the dungeon difficulty.Lifeline Health can be reduced or restored by certain monsters or scenarios within the dungeon.When one gets knocked unconscious while paired in a Lifeline, the Lifeline Health will be reduced by the HP of the unconscious character. Resurrection is possible unless the Lifeline Health reaches 0, and the character who got knocked unconscious and used up the Lifeline Health cannot be revived.When Lifeline Health is reduced to 0, characters with remaining health can still play. If all of the party members' Lifeline Health decreases or there are no pairs left on either side, the dungeon will fail and you will not be able to proceed further.There is a 30-second cooldown when using potions in the dungeon.You can re-enter the Glenn Bearna Dungeon up to 3 times if disconnection occurs.You will move through the dungeon to clear the areas of enemies, and gather the necessary materials to survive the cold.Party members in the Daytime are tasked with acquiring Firewood, while those in Nighttime are tasked with acquiring Ember. These are accumulated as points and can be gathered by defeating certain enemies. Which party members have accumulated the Firewood and Ember is shown in the party details on the left of the screen.The party must work together to stop the enemies and correct the paradox affecting the areas of Glenn Bearna.Strategically use the braziers, lit brightly by the gathered Firewood and Embers, to collect the souls of enemies and unleash them upon your foes.What else may you encounter in the chill of the winter?You will encounter the following enemies and Boss monsters in Glenn Bearna:Fianna GeimhridhSnuggly SneachtaGwyllionCarnivorous SnowtrapMan-Eating SnowtrapEnkindled WraithEmber SpriteIcicle SpriteAbominable RabbitAbominable Rabbit of EquilibriumFrostwork SoulFolach CattGwyllgiIce GolemPallid SoulUnfinished ReverieCnoc OighirCailleach
Dungeon Rewards
Rewards can be obtained when clearing the boss of Glenn Bearna. EXP and guaranteed rewards will be dropped from the Dungeon End Chest.Additional rewards such as gems, crafting materials and manuals, enchant scrolls, and set effect enhancement scrolls are also possible to obtain from the Dungeon End Chest. Clear rewards can be obtained up to 3 times a week per character.Normal and Hard difficulty levels share the number of rewards obtained. (Resets every Saturday at 7:00 AM PT)You can check the weekly reward count by touching the dungeon entrance or entering the dungeon.[table][tr][th]Difficulty

Introduction of Erg GradeThe Erg Grade system has been implemented into the Erg System. B-Grade and A-Grade Erg Enhancement methods have been added. Existing Erg enhancements are categorized as S-Grade Erg, being the highest grade.Note: Existing Erg enhanced weapons will become S-Grade Erg enhanced weapons.Advancement Catalyst B and Advancement Catalyst A items have been added.These Catalyst items can be crafted using the Magic Craft skill with at least Rank 9 Magic Craft.Advancement Catalyst B:Shyllien Crystal x2Fine Firewood x20Hay Bale x5Holy Water of Lymilark x20Advancement Catalyst A:Shyllien Crystal x5Divine Mineral Fragment x5Desecrated Charm Chunk x2Thorny Blue Shackle x2Massive Turtle Shell Chip x2When attempting to apply Erg to your weapon, you can select one of the three grades which are B, A, and S to start grade enhancement.Weapons with a lower Erg grade will have a lesser Erg effect compared to a higher grade, however the effect is easier to achieve.The basic effect of B-grade Erg starts from level 11.A-grade Ergs show the basic effect from level 16 and the bonus effect from level 26.After leveling up a B Grade Erg to level 50, you can talk to Kaelic with an Advancement Catalyst B to upgrade it to A Grade. After increasing the grade, the Erg level will start again at level 30.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1134/erg-advancement.png
A-grade and B-grade Erg weapons can also be transferred using the Transference Catalyst, but cannot be transferred if the transfer target has a different Erg level.Erg Grade is added to the Auction House as a detailed search option.Additional Weapon Erg Effects have been added for the following weapon types:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/1207/erg-weapon-types.png
*Note: Erg effects for each level based on S grade.
Erg Enhancement has been improved to add an increased chance of success after a failure when attempting to level break. When attempting to level up Erg, the success rate now increases as the number of consecutive failures increases.Example: Success Rate: 0.70% → Failed Upgrade → Success rate: 0.71 (0.70+0.01)%Erg can now be removed from a weapon by talking to Kaelic and selecting the Remove Erg option.Caution: If an Erg is removed from a weapon, the Erg cannot be recovered. Erg cannot be removed from weapons that are sealed with a Seal Scroll.
Additional Enhancement ChangesThe readability of the equipment upgrade menu has been improved.Upgrades made to items can now be reverted using the Upgrade Reversion Kit.Normal Upgrades, Artisan Upgrades, and Gem Upgrades can be removed to return to the previous upgrade. (Special upgrades cannot be removed.)When reverting an upgrade, the proficiency used for the upgrade is restored up to 100.This item can be used on equipment that has been specially upgraded, and does not affect the special upgrade status.This item cannot be used on equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).Upgrade Reversion Kit can be crafted using the Handicraft skill or purchased from the Item Shop.Items that have been upgraded will now show the list of current upgrades applied in the item tooltip.You cannot check the list of upgrades for equipment that has been upgraded or in the process of being upgraded before the addition of the Upgrade Reversion Kit (before maintenance on July 13, 2023).The number of possible Echostone advancement attempts within Sidhe Finnachaid has been increased from 3 to 5.The number of Echostone awakenings has been limited according to the character's cumulative level.The AP cost per awakening attempt has not been changed.The limit is refreshed upon entering the dungeon again.[table][tr][th]Cumulative Level

notes.title: Mabinogi Fantasy Party - Announcement Recap
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2548/230616_mabinogifantasypartycampfirerecap_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Hi Milletians,

Fantasy Party is an event that our partners and development team hold in Korea for the Milletians of the Korean Mabinogi service. This showcase is broadcast live to celebrate the Anniversary and reflect on Mabinogi, and new updates and concepts are often revealed! 

Did you join CM Arciellia during her livestream to listen in and watch the showcase? If not, we’re here to share a recap of the exciting updates to come to all Mabinogi services. 

If you would like to watch the livestream with CM Arciellia and GM Seeing (our Localization Translator), check it out here: 
Twitch Video Link

You can also watch the Fantasy Party livestream here: 
KR YouTube Broadcast Video Link

During our livestream, CM Arciellia and GM Seeing watched the showcase together and shared their reactions and thoughts to all of the information presented. GM Seeing has also provided an English translation of the Korean presentation, live! (Please keep in mind that this is a first for our team and context from a live interpretation can differ slightly from the original presenter’s intention.)

We highly recommend watching the livestream to hear the developer’s intentions and see all of the concept art that was showcased. Below, we will share a brief list of the contents discussed during the event:

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2533/fantasy-party-summer-update-infographic.png

Summer Showcase

*This content is expected to be released in Summer 2023 for the Korean Mabinogi service. We are excited to share these contents with you, and the release plan for our service will be shared at a later time. As the contents plan is not yet finalized and these contents are still in development, some details are subject to change.  

Contents Leader Choi Dongmin presents the upcoming contents: 

In July 2023 (KR):
As a major Life contents, Part-time Jobs will receive a major update. This update will make Part-time Jobs more accessible and convenient, and the rewards will see an improvement. Additionally, a server-wide buff will be added to boost the rewards!With an improvement in Blaanid's Brave Boost, a new Spirit Weapon Tutorial will be introduced, with a familiar returning face, Eiry. Eiry is a spirit weapon for all Milletians and does not take up a spirit slot. She also loves all gems and accumulates EXP quickly!Changes to mainstream quests will be added to improve the playability of RP dungeons, and the difficulty of certain dungeons will be reduced. The Quest UI will be improved, and the camera angle when talking to NPCs as a Giant will be updated.A new content growth guide for Combat and Life will be implemented as a content progression system with rewards.
In August 2023 (KR):
Two new Arcana Talents and new NPCs in charge of those talents have been revealed! 
*Localized names subject to change“Alchemic Stinger" - Battle Alchemy + Archery "Dark Mage" - Chain Slash + Magic Enchanting will see a change where upon failure of an enchantment, you can choose between losing all durability on the Enchant Scroll, or the weapon receiving failure penalties. 
Special Upgrade changes will bring a new conversion feature where current special upgraded items can be converted to the opposing type using a new stone (released through events and as a crafting recipe). Blue Upgrades will also have a Bonus Max Damage effect added on top of the current effects. 
In September 2023 (KR):
New "Chronicle" Missions will be introduced in Avon. The first mission will relay the story of The First Battle of Mag Tuireadh.Rewards introduced in the dungeon will include Untradable Rank 1 reforged Celtic Weapons and Protective Upgrade Stones, and New Celtic Series weapons are finally here: the Celtic Bow, Celtic Two-handed Sword, Celtic LanceNew Perseus Weapons will be added!New Nightbringer One-handed Blunt Weapon will also be added, and other Nightbringer weapons will be buffed to keep the value of these weapons above the new Perseus Weapons.Dungeon Reward Drop Rates will be improved!
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2534/mabinogi-x-unreal-engine.png

Mabinogi Eternity
*A special look at the future development of Mabinogi.

[previewyoutube=wrbmZQF8g3E;full][/previewyoutube]

Director Min Kyunghoon highlights the start of a new journey for Mabinogi; replacing the game’s engine with Unreal Engine 5. Though this will be a long and difficult process, two main goals have been briefly shared with us. The first is the focus on the unique and captivating points of Mabinogi and the game’s visuals. It is expected that many graphical issues will be resolved. The team will continue to show improvements in the future through many more quality of life and content renewals. Though, certain contents that seldom see activity may be phased out. 

Further on, the expansion of fantasy life will be strengthened for Milletians to dream more broadly, such as underwater adventures, in-flight commerce fights, crafting your own boat to fish on, and more that we can only imagine thus far.

We hope this glimpse of what is to come for Mabinogi this year, and beyond, is as exciting for you as it is for us! We’re so happy to share these details with you. Please also look forward to an upcoming Producer Letter soon, where we will share more information about the upcoming updates expected this year.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Renovation Season 4: Archery, Magic, and Race-Specific Skill Changes
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2291/230530_juneupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2235/archer.png Archery

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2237/archery-compilation-resized.gif

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2306/ranged-attack.png Ranged Attack
The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect is added. (+20% at Dan Rank 3)The ranged attack minimum aim rate effect can be stacked.There is a maximum upper limit for the ranged attack minimum aim rate which cannot be exceeded. (Max +40%)
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2240/magnum-shot.png Magnum Shot
The damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.
Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 560%After: 590%
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2238/crash-shot.png Crash Shot
The fragment damage multiplier for each skill rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill: Before: 280%After: 370%
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2241/urgent-shot.png Urgent Shot
The Urgent Shot effect has been changed:Before: Increased aiming speed for ranged attacks after Urgent Shot.After: Damage with Ranged Combat Skills +% for 10 sec. after Urgent Shot.After using Urgent Shot, damage with Ranged Combat Skills will be increased for 10 seconds. (12% at Rank 1)When using Urgent Shot, 10% of maximum health and stamina will be used.The Yellow Echostone awakening ability of “Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use” is replaced with “Urgent Shot Effect Duration.” (Increased by 0.1 seconds per level with a max of 2 seconds at level 20)The title effect of “the Master of Urgent Shot” has been changed:
Before: DEX +20, Urgent Shot Aiming Speed after Use 30%, STR -20, Will -10After: DEX +20, Urgent Shot HP and Stamina Cost -2%, STR -20, Will -10

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2236/magic.png Magic 


https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2262/magic-compilation-resized.gif

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2260/hail-storm.png Hail Storm
When knocked down while casting, it has been changed so that the number of charges accumulated will be reduced by 1.The skill is canceled when knocked down with 1 charge.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2258/blaze.png Blaze
The target range is increased.Before: Melee attack distance + 0.5 metersAfter: Melee attack distance + 2 metersThe casting time to max charge has been reduced.Before: 3 secondsAfter: 1.5 secondsA marker is displayed on all enemies within range while preparing the skill.The 2 second delay after using the skill has been removed, as well a the immunity to some negative effects that were applied during the delay.Improvements have been made to the mouse cursor when using the skill.The knockdown gauge dependence is reduced by 50% in the explosion damage formula.Previously, 70% of the knockdown gauge could draw out all the explosion damage, but now it is possible to draw out all the explosion damage with only 35% of the knockdown gauge.Fixed an issue where damage was applied abnormally when switching weapons before applying explosive damage.Fixed an issue where Wind Blast damage was applied abnormally when using it after using Blaze.Improved skill so that it is not canceled when an enemy is selected outside the range while charging.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2261/lightning-rod.png Lightning Rod
Added a directional display effect that lets you know the attack direction while preparing the skill.The duration of the magic circle effect has been changed.Before: 20 secondsAfter: Unlimited
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2264/shockwave.png Shockwave
The delay after using the skill has been reduced.Before: 1 secondAfter: 0.3 secondsFixed an issue where the direction the character is facing changed after using the skill.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2265/spellwalk.png Spellwalk
Improvements have been made so that skill use is maintained even when moving to a different area.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2263/meteor-strike.png Meteor Strike
Improvements have been made so that the skill slot remains visible during the flashing effect when the skill hits.This is also applied when using the “Mini Effects” performance option setting.You can now turn off the flashing effect of Meteor Strike by using the "Mini Effects" performance option setting.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2259/fusion-bolt.png Fusion Bolt
When attacking with the skill, 50% of the opponent's magic defense is applied for each bolt.
For bolt magic combinations, a total of 2 magic defense calculations are applied, once for each bolt magic combination.

Race-Specific Skills

Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.Ladeca skills (Breath of Ladeca, Vision of Ladeca, Might of Ladeca) for all three races will no longer be canceled when changing channels, logging off, or rebirthing.

Human

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2257/human-compilation-compressed.gif

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2254/arrow-revolver.png Arrow Revolver
The damage multiplier for each shot is increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Before: 110% / 120% / 125% / 145% / 190%After: 170% / 180% / 185% / 205% / 250%The aim rate bonus that was applied only to the first hit has been removed.You can now perform a volley attack by pressing Ctrl + Right-Click on an enemy while preparing the skill. This will take into account the current aiming accuracy rate and damage multiplier of the current number of shots.Example 1: When attacking with a volley immediately after preparing a Rank 1 skill, the first hit will attack 5 times in a row with a damaging multiplier of 170%.
Example 2: When attacking with a volley after firing 2 shots with a Rank 1 skill, the 3rd hit will attack 3 times in a row with a damage multiplier of 185%.
An issue where the skill use status was not displayed normally when cast during knockback has been fixed.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2255/breath-of-ladeca.png Breath of Ladeca
A 10% bonus damage effect has been added for close combat skills when dual swords are equipped.Applicable skills include:Normal Attack, Smash, Counterattack, Charge, Assault Slash, Rage Impact, Bash, Windmill, Final Hit
Elemental Knight skills are not directly applied, but instead indirectly applied due to increased damage of Smash/Windmill/Assault Slash.
Note: The bonus damage effect will stack with additional damage buffs for a combined calculation.

Elf

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2244/elf-compilation-resized.gif

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2247/mirage-missile.png Mirage Missile
The effect duration of the Mirage Missile has been increased. Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill: Before: 21 secondsAfter: 22 secondsDamage over time interval has been reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second.Damage for Mirage Shot based on the character’s Intelligence has been increased.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2245/elven-magic-missile.png Elven Magic Missile
The Elven Magic Missile can now be used while Final Shot is active.The way to use the skill has been changed from the existing mini-game method to selecting and using the desired attribute.When using the skill, 3 attribute options are activated. You can select the desired option by using F1~F3 keys and the chosen option will be used.It has been changed so that you can move while casting the skill.The cooldown of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.Before: 9 secondsAfter: 5 secondsCasting time of Elven Magic Missile is reduced.The projectile speed of Elven Magic Missile is increased.The Fire, Lightning, and Ice attribute damage of Elven Magic Missile is increased.The splash radius of Elven Magic Missile's Lightning and Ice attributes is reduced.The freezing effect specifications of the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile are changed to be the same as the Ice Spear specifications.It is changed so that you can attack a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect.When attacking a frozen target with the Ice attribute Elven Magic Missile effect, the damage dealt is reduced by 30%.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2246/final-shot.png Final Shot
When Final Shot is active, it has been changed so that the character cannot be stunned or knocked down.The duration of Final Shot has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 45 secondsAfter: 50 seconds

notes.title: Quality of Life - Patch Notes - May 11th
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the May Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Wandering Troupe Box: Thursday, April 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 25th, Before MaintenanceCotton Candy Sheep Event: Thursday, April 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 25th, Before MaintenanceInquisitor's Box: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 8th, Before MaintenanceSweet Coffee Event Returns!: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 8th, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: A-May-Zing 2x Boost Up!: Thursday, May 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 18th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 3: Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 1st, Before MaintenanceMay Update: Permanent
Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: May Quality of Life UpdatesEnchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.The Adventurer Seal system has been renewed, and the shop has been updated with new items.The Mabinogi BGM song titles have been improved greatly, thanks to our localization team! And more!
Hey all, GM Quuku here from the Quality Assurance team!

You may have noticed that we've done some Spring Cleaning as of late- we've been correcting more older bugs in each of our patches, and trying to hit newly released bugs as soon as they crop up.

If you'd cast your eyes below, you'll notice that our Known Bugs list has shrunk. We want to shift this from an incomplete backlog of our bugs into a parseable list that contains the largest, newest, and most relevant issues. We still have a (sizeable!) internal backlog that we're cruising through- these bugs haven't just gone away. Our team is dedicated to bringing you a quality play experience, and working through all bugs (new and old) in this distinguished game we play is one of our goals.

Many Milletians have been extremely kind in assisting us in squashing these issues as well, thank you so much for your support and patience. If you spot an issue, feel more than welcomed to report it to us via the official Mabinogi Discord!

The following changes have been made to the game:
Players will now have more time during the G23 Card Flip minigame. Blaanid's Song "Where Memories Come Together" during Memoir Book 2 now properly plays. Yay Blaanid!The Set Item name for Movement Speed Increase has been modified to differentiate the movement speed types.Eweca Movement Speed Increase Example: Items such as Fleet Feet or Shooting Star shoes. Ladeca Movement Speed IncreaseExample: Items such as Abyss Dragon Armor or Imperial Knight Boots.
Eweca and Ladeca Movement Speed Increase effects can be applied to the character at the same time.
Note: At least 10 points of a set item effect must be equipped to activate the effect. Equipped items that exceed 10 points of a set item effect will not grant additional effects. Additionally, the highest value of a set effect type is applied to the character.Revised several in-game BGM song titles to accurately reflect the songs and their details.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing in-game lag after maintenances.Fixed an issue where players experienced extreme instances of increasing login lag after maintenances.Fixed an issue where the G10 quest "Prophecy of Irinid" would fail to start from the Crystal Ball.Fixed a few minor graphic issues with the following items:Dragon Guardian ShoesSpecial / Imperial Commander Uniforms (M)Special Casual Tech Chic Outfits (M)(F).The map and region name for Gairech Hills have been properly translated.Fixed an issue causing the Daily Messages from specific Support Puppets to not display.The Space Cadet pet skill text for "Cleansing Dust" will now display correctly when the pet is unsummoned.Corrected the Set Item descriptions for the following set bonuses: 
TroubadourDemolitionRuinationPerseusElemental HarmonyForest RangerFound a rare issue where Cliona would only sell four items, instead of the expected five, during the Tara Auction.Sheared a looming timer on the Cotton Candy Sheep (Aspiring to TRUE STRENGTH!) description. A f-ewe other edits were made as well, worthy of sheeps of praise. Mutton's gonna stop us now! We're on the lamb! We can-dy this all day, we have a cot-ton of these!
The following are known bugs:
If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.During the Master Plan event, when you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the in-game shop, but can be on the web-shop.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.

notes.title: May Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1774/230505_mayupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngMay Quality of Life UpdatesThe maximum stack size for Golden Magic Wool has been increased to 100.The logic when mounting a summoned pet has been improved.The problem of failing to mount a pet that is moving has been alleviated. An issue where the character did not respond to the mounting hotkey (Default: ‘R’ key) has been fixed.When using the hotkey to mount, if the pet is a certain distance away from the character, improvements have been made so that mounting takes place after the command to call the pet has been used. (Hotkey setting “Call the pet” in Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings)After using the hotkey command to guide the pet to you, it will no longer return to the target it was attacking after returning to its owner. However, if the AI of the animal character is in the Collaborative Attack/Auto Attack mode, you can set another target and proceed with the battle again.
The visual effects of the Phantasmal Sight Technique have been changed. It has been improved so that each effect can be distinguished by a difference in shape.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1636/technique.png
Improvements have been made so that higher enchant rolls can be received when the enchantment is successful, and the penalty that decreases durability when the enchantment fails has been alleviated.Great Success: It has been changed to apply the enchantment with a value of 80% or more of the floating value when a Great Success enchantment occurs.Example: For an effect outlined as, "When Bash is Rank 1 or higher, Max Damage +22-48", and a Great Success occurs, the enchant roll will have a value of 80% or more of the possible enchant rolls. The available rolls would be between +42-48.Catastrophic Failure: The equipment durability penalty has been reduced when a Catastrophic Failure enchantment occurs.Improvements have been made so that you can check detailed information such as the type of firewood used when burning an item, whether an Enchant Extraction Protection Potion has been applied, and the success rate of the enchant burn.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1790/enchant_burning.png
An updated report function has been added.When you right-click on a character, the “Report” option is now available.The Adventurer Seal System and Shop have been renewed.The daily quests that award Adventurer Seals are the same as before, and the number of Adventurer Seals given as rewards has been doubled.The Adventurer Seal has been changed so that bank sharing between characters is not possible.New items have been added to the Seal Shop of NPC Seal Merchant in Dunbarton and Belvast. For a full list of available items, check the chart below. The following items have been removed from the Seal shop:Exploration Journal, Page 1Exploration Journal, Page 2Exploration Journal, Page 3Exploration Journal, Page 4Exploration Journal, Page 5Golden Elephant StatueGolden Sundial ArtifactGolden Dragon StatueDowra SETaunes MK3Hermit's StaffFox Enchant ScrollBowman's Enchant ScrollSkilled Enchant ScrollMana Needle Enchant ScrollWolf Hunter's Enchant ScrollPenetrating Enchant ScrollWater Drop Enchant ScrollVine Enchant ScrollPrecise Reforging Tools, types of Dungeon Passes, Marionettes, Skill Training Seals, or Stardust materials purchased with Adventurer Seals are not tradable.The purchase limit is applied per account, and the reset time is as follows.Items sold at all times or on specific days of the week will reset at 12:00 AM PT.
The purchase limit for Precise Reforging Tools will reset every Thursday at 7:00 AM PT.
In the Stardust Material Selection Box, you can acquire 5 Core Fragments and 5 Regulators of the material type of your choice.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1791/adventurer-seal-shop-table.png
Several revisions have been made to the titles of many songs in Mabinogi. You may notice these changes in the Jukebox or MabiNovel. After a diligent review by our localization team, we have improved the song titles to focus the original intention of the title and included tags to detail where the theme is from.
Click on the button below to view the full list of song titles and their changes!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/1645/song-tiitle-button.png

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Regarding the Recent Lag Issues
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Dear Milletians,

As we shared during the April 6th maintenance, the servers were updated from an older version to a much newer version. Although the deployment issue was resolved with our extended maintenance, we began observing login delays and lag issues. To resolve these issues in the short term, we opted to run an unscheduled maintenance in the middle of the week to restart the servers as we continued to investigate the cause.

After various investigations, we decided to revert the login server to the previous version during the April 24th maintenance. While this resolved the login delay/lag issue, the in-game lag, including skill usage and pet summoning delays, continued to occur. As such, our teams have continued to investigate, and during the May 4th maintenance, we made another server change to help address the in-game lag issue we were seeing. We will be working with the development team and performing additional tests to identify and resolve the root cause so that future server changes can be applied smoothly.

We truly appreciate the support and patience you've shown us through Discord and other platforms as we looked into this. Thank you for understanding! We will be running weekly buff events for the remainder of May. Please enjoy the following events as noted in Milletian Events: A-May-Zing 2x Boost Up! :
2x Stardust BoostMaterial rewards from completing Society Sponsorship Quests are doubled.2x Spirit EXPThe Weekly cap for the Spirit EXP is also doubled.2x Combat EXP 2x AP2x All Skill Training
Sincerely,
~ GM Mewlynne, Mabinogi Producer
& The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: NEXT Step UP!
notes.content:
BANNER goes HERE
NEXT Step UP! Update Details
New Celtic and Divine Signets
New signet effect items have been added to amplify the Celtic and Divine equipment.You can use a Celtic/Divine Signet or Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet item to grant a signet effect to the corresponding Celtic or Divine equipment, or to increase the level of the given signet effect.Each Celtic/Divine Signet and Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet item can only be used on the designated target equipment. At this time, it is not affected by other enchantments of the target equipment.
Example 1) Celtic Signet: Celtic War Hammer item can only be used for the Celtic War Hammer that has no signet effect or is level 1~4.Example 2) Advanced Celtic Signet: Celtic War Hammer item can only be used for a Celtic War Hammer with a signet effect of level 5~9.
Example 3) Divine Signet: Divine Crossbow can only be used for a Divine Crossbow that has no signet effect or is level 1~4.
Example 4) Advanced Divine Signet: Divine Crossbow item can only be used for a Divine Crossbow with a signet effect of level 5~9.Granting a signet effect or enhancing the signet effect level succeeds with a certain probability for each item, and the used signet item is consumed regardless of the result.Celtic/Divine Signet: Success Rate 10% 
Advanced Celtic/Divine Signet: Success Rate 5%
The signet effect level of an item can be enhanced up to 10, and the effect increases in proportion to the signet effect level.Example) In the case of Celtic Tribolt Wand's signet effect, “Fusion Bolt Final Damage”, the 1st level effect amount is 0.8%, and the 10th level effect amount is 8%.The applied signet effect can be checked in the ‘Signet Effect' area of ​​the item description.Different signet effects are added to the equipment depending on the equipment type.[table][tr][th]Equipment[/th][th]Signet Effect Details[/th][/tr][tr][td]Celtic Royal Knight Sword[/td][td]Increases Final Hit Final Damage by 0.4% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Celtic War Hammer, Celtic Royal War Hammer, Celtic Battle Axe, Celtic Royal Battle Axe[/td][td]Increases Bash Damage by 0.5% per level

Increases Final Strike Rage Obtained by 0.8% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Tribolt Wand[/td][td]Increases Fusion Bolt Final Damage by 0.8% per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Spell Book[/td][td]Increases Magic Attack Power by +1.5 per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Crossbow[/td][td]Crash shot final damage per level increased by 0.8%, archery skill final damage increased by 0.5% while final shot was activated per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Short Lance[/td][td]Increases Max Damage by +1 per level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Cinnsealach L2[/td][td]Increases final damage of dual gun normal attacks while Way of the Gun is active by 1% per level
