New Journeyman's Reforging Tool
The Journeyman’s Reforging Tool has been added.Three types of Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool (Basic/Intermediate/Advanced) items can be acquired according to the difficulty of the dungeon.The items can be obtained from certain dungeons and missions. 
The Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can also be obtained from the Dungeon Voucher Shop. Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool items have an expiration date of 1 day and cannot be traded.When used, a specified amount of Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can be obtained. If a Huge Lucky Bonus is activated, you can obtain a larger amount than usual.You can obtain 1 ~ 5 tools upon use of the Basic Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.You can obtain 5 ~ 10 tools upon use of the Intermediate Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool. You can obtain 10 ~ 15 tools upon use of the Advanced Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.You can acquire up to 60 Journeyman’s Reforging Tools per day when using Calcified Journeyman’s Reforging Tools, and you can check the number of daily acquisitions through the notice message on the left of the screen. 
If you use the Calcified (Basic/Intermediate/Advanced) Journeyman’s Reforging Tools after reaching 60 daily acquisitions, you can acquire 1 Journeyman’s Reforging Tool Fragment each.If you collect and use 20 Journeyman’s Reforging Tool Fragments, you can exchange them for 1 Journeyman’s Reforging Tool.Journeyman’s Reforging Tool will expire in 5 days from acquisition, and cannot be traded.
The daily acquisition limit is reset every day in real time at 7:00 AM PT.
When using the Journeyman’s Reforging Tool:[table][tr][th]Function[/th][th]Journeyman's Reforging Tool[/th][/tr][tr][td]Number of Attribute Slots Increased[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rank Upgrade[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Granting Attribute[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Minimum Level[/td][td]None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Maximum Level[/td][td]Up to 75% of the maximum level[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limit Break Appearance[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][/table]The number of attribute slots is limited to 1 reforging line.When using a reforging tool with no limit on the number of attribute slots (line), new options can be granted again.Rank upgrades are possible.The attribute level range is limited to 75%.The reforge attributes available are limited to 75% of the maximum level for each reforge rank.The maximum level does not include the limit breakthrough level.When reaching the maximum level that can be reached with the Journeyman’s Reforging Tool, a notice message indicating that the maximum level has been reached will be displayed.Attributes with a maximum level of 1 can be granted at level 1.
Updates to the Dungeon Guide
The following dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Guide:Ciar AdvancedRabbie AdvancedBarri AdvancedFiodh AdvancedRundal AdvancedFrom the time of update, when clearing the dungeon, you can acquire dungeon vouchers according to the difficulty of the dungeon.From the time of the update, when you clear the dungeon, you can acquire newly added repeated clear rewards for these dungeons.Clear records before the update are not retroactive.Journeyman’s Reforging Tool has been added to the Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop when speaking to NPC Eavan.Journeyman’s Reforging Tool will be included in the Second, Third, and Fourth Shop tabs.You can purchase up to six Journeyman’s Reforging Tool per day per account which will reset at 7:00 AM everyday in real time.This weekly purchase limit for this item is shared across the Second, Third, and Fourth Shop tabs.Each Journeyman’s Reforging Tool can be purchased with 10 vouchers from the corresponding shop tab.You can purchase Journeyman’s Reforging Tool regardless of the daily acquisition limit.The price of certain items in the Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop have been reduced from 70 vouchers to 25 vouchers each.Unrestricted Dungeon PassUnlimited Shadow Mission PassBaltane Elite Mission Pass Selection BoxNote: Only one pass of each type can be purchased per day.
Additional Changes
The Beginner difficulty level has been added for some Tech Duinn missions: Revived Illusion, Feth Fiada, and Seven Nightmares.On Beginner difficulty, the stats of bosses and normal monsters and the difficulty of some dungeon puzzles have been adjusted to a lower level than Normal difficulty.Quests that can be performed in Tech Duinn missions that do not have a difficulty level requirement can also be performed on Beginner difficulty.Even on Beginner difficulty, you can acquire a small amount of Briogh Crystals of Achievement, Briogh Crystals of Challenge, and Briogh Crystals of Discipline.On Beginner difficulty, Smoldering Thread and Enchant Scrolls, which are dropped from Tech Duinn missions on Normal difficulty and higher, do not drop.The clear journal for the Tech Duinn Beginner difficulty mission will not be added.The title acquisition requirements for the Mystic Pathfinder title is not affected by the Beginner difficulty.The required number of Restorative Potions required when crafting the Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon Pass has been reduced from 15 to 12.Tech Duinn - Elite Passes can now drop from all Elite Tech Duinn missions.The drop rate of Mangled Ciar, Alby, and Rundal Dungeon Passes from the corresponding Advanced Dungeons have been increased. Set Effect item descriptions have been improved so that detailed information can now be seen in the description of the item.Example) Before: Enhanced Bash 5 IncreaseAfter: Enhanced Bash 5 Increase (Bash Damage +10%)

New Dungeon Rewards
New item rewards can be obtained from the reward box of certain dungeons and missions.Celtic Signets, Divine Signets, Spirit Gems (100/500/1000), and Journeyman’s Reforging Tools have been added.Spirit Gems and Journeyman’s Reforging Tools drop from every reward box.The Celtic or Divine Signet items can be obtained from every reward box, however only one Signet (Celtic or Divine) can be obtained from a reward box at one time. The Celtic Signet, Advanced Celtic Signet, Divine Signet, and Advanced Divine Signet items drop at different rates. Each equipment-specific Signet within the same category drops with an equal probability.Note: In Alby Advanced dungeons, instead of being dropped from the reward box, the items are dropped at the feet of each party member the moment the dungeon is cleared, and these items cannot be obtained from Yarn Key opened chests.

Complete the quest each day for some cute rewards, including the Hungry Fluffy Bunny Doll Bag Coupon, Bunny Rain Coat Shopping Bag and the Fluffy Bunny Chair! Known Issue: Currently, the rewarded AdoraBunny Gift Box is an outdated box from a previous event. This issue is under further investigation and additional updates will be provided. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Mister AdoraBunny's Egg Hunt
Event Details

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the March Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Secret Forest Box: Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 30th, Before MaintenanceSpectacular Wings Box: Thursday, March 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 13th, Before Maintenance15th Anniversary Starlight Festival: Thursday, March 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 13th, Before Maintenance15th Anniversary Sale: Thursday, March 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 13th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 3: Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 1st, Before MaintenanceMarch Update: Permanent
Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: March Quality of Life UpdatesThe Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon has been added.   The Tara Auction House will be improved with new wares. Re-entry to Tech Duinn Dungeon is now possible.And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
Changed the sitting pose for the Homestead Blooming Romance Seat that could be earned from Yuri’s Valentine Event.Giant character hands appeared awkward as their hands were floating so the pose has been adjusted to correct this issue.Though the issue didn’t occur for Human/Elf, the change will also be applied to those races to be consistent.Several changes have been made to the Saga Mission “Proceed with the ritual!”.The amount of gold that monsters drop has been decreased. Monsters will spawn about 10 seconds after defeating all monsters. Monsters will now only spawn up to 25 times maximum. Added the following missing items to the Dressing Room. Thank you for reporting these items, Milletians!Chairs:Snowflower Parade PodiumSnowflower Table and ChairKotatsu with PanNice Fishing ChairComfortable Fishing ChairDancing Far DarrigVanity Lounge Studio Set Romantic BalconyAccessories:Red Forest Aura HaloGold Forest Aura HaloBlack Forest Aura HaloWhite Forest Aura HaloNatural Forest Wood HaloGold Forest Wood HaloBlack Forest Wood HaloWhite Forest Wood HaloFull BalloonPersian Support PuppetPersian Flying PuppetAncient Persian Support PuppetRevised previous season's All Wings Orb item names.Fourth All Wings Orb -> Fabulous All Wings OrbFifth All Wings Orb -> Glorious All Wings OrbSixth All Wings Orb -> Magnificent All Wings OrbSeventh All Wings Orb -> Extravagant All Wings OrbImprovements to several dialogues within the Arcana storyline quests have been made. Several minor typo revisions to item descriptions and dialogue texts have been updated.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where it was difficult to proceed during the G21 Quest, "Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight".The following items will no longer show in both Dressing Room gender filters:Eluned Pitch Black Eye Patch (F)Men's Sleek Shades (M)Height-Boosting Insoles (M)Fixed an issue where the "Wait until Nighttime" version of Tarlach would not properly respond to requests for a Baol Dungeon Pass during the G3 Quest, "Decisive Battle".
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where certain NPC Transformations are missing the models for their bodies.There is an issue where Shadow Mission Tarlach does not grant Baol Dungeon Pass.There is a minor issue where the Pet Skill Window is unable to collapse properly.When a Partner on the Homestead is using the Bird Buddy Gesture, certain UI menus will close erratically.The Tara Auction House notice may overlap with Event notices on the scrolling banner.

notes.title: March Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2662/230310_marchupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngMarch Quality of Life UpdatesThe Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon has been added.You can purchase a Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass from the Researcher at Poulnabrone. You can enter Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon by using the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass at the entrance of the dungeon.Weapon durability does not decrease while in the practice dungeon, and if you become incapacitated, you will automatically revive after 5 seconds.The monsters appearing in the practice dungeon are the same as those from Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon.Defeating monsters will not reward items, gold, or experience.Completing the practice dungeon will not have a reward box and will not count towards the dungeon guide completion.Quest progression relating to Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon will not count, and you cannot acquire titles or Journal achievements.When entering the dungeon, you will receive the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Guidebook which can be used to help clear the dungeon.The Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Guidebook can only be used within the Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon.Changed the progression of A Dreamy Story quest for the objective “Receive a special pass from Manus after hearing his story.”In addition, 1 Rabbie Phantasm Practice Dungeon Pass will be given.Re-entry to Tech Duinn Dungeon is now possible.Re-entry is allowed up to 3 times in all difficulties of the Tech Duinn missions Revived Illusion, Feth Fiada, Seven Nightmares, and Awakened Abyssal Lord.Leaving and re-entering a mission with a time limit will still reduce the mission timer for as much as the time you left the mission.If you have already cleared the mission or the time limit has expired, you will not be able to re-enter the mission regardless of whether or not you received a reward.Optimized the progression of area 1 of Tech Duinn mission, Awakened Abyssal Lord to reduce delays.The announcements that appeared when reaching the 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th Grand Master will be changed to only appear on the 1st and 20th achievement.You can now update a message in the best Cooking dish pop-up without displaying the announcement.If you click the goddess statue in the Uladh dungeon or mission, or leave the dungeon with the exit button, the combat mode will be canceled.It is now possible to move with the Traveler’s Guide as soon as you exit the dungeon or mission.It has been changed so that you can now select and produce Avon Theatre Mission Passes with 20 Gold Play Pages.The New King’s Request (Hard), Warden of the Gods (Hard), Guardian of Avon (Hard), Fortinbras’s Expedition (Hard).The expiration time for each crafted pass is 9 hours.Note: Hard Theatre Mission Pass can still be crafted using 5 Gold Play Pages as before.The minimap UI size and zoom level is now saved separately per character.The mini-map setting values are saved locally on the PC that you are using and can be copied over and used on another PC.These files can be found notes.title: 15th Anniversary Starlight Festival
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2715/230314_15thanniversaryevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

It's time to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of Mabinogi! Log in during the Event Hotdays to earn items that are out of this world! Help Neo and his friends, and win stellar prizes. Explore all sorts of mini games, such as Guess the Gesture, Dice Battle, or Enter the Stage of Trials! This is an event you won't want to space out on! Check out the full details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, March 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 13th, Before Maintenance
Welcome to the 15th Anniversary Starlight Festival!
During this event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] The Light of the Stars.Talk to Neo in Dunbarton to register a main character.You can only register one main character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing the guide quest:Tiny Starbrite x1010,000 EXPOnly the main character can participate in the quests and mini-games.When issuing a check from any bank in Erinn, all characters can receive a 15th Anniversary Check design.Note: You will be able to see shooting stars at night between 8 PM - 6 AM Erinn Time.During the event, Star Cards can only be used at night.15th Anniversary Hotdays
Login any time during the event period to receive the *NEW* 15th Anniversary Fantasy Star 2nd Title Coupon (Not Tradable).Max Damage +15Magic Attack +15Fire/Wind/Earth/Water Alchemic Damage +10Strength +15Intelligence +15Dexterity +15Will +15Luck +15Movement Speed +1%Every week (resets every Monday at 7:00 AM PDT), you will receive a special 5 Tiny Starbrite by logging in during the event period.Every weekend on Saturday and Sunday, you will receive 10 Tiny Starbrite and other items by logging in during the event period.Claim the item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your character or choose Claim Later if you want to receive it on another character.The item can be moved between characters through the bank.You can only claim the item once during the event period.

[/td][/tr][/table]15th Anniversary Quests
Neo and his friends crash-landed their spaceship in Erinn! Everyone got scattered across the land and Neo needs your help finding everyone. A series of story quests will be available:[Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1[Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 2[Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 3[Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 4Each quest must be completed before you can receive the next quest.i.e. After completing [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1, you will receive [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 2, and so on.When completing each quest, you will receive the following rewards:Tiny Starbrite x1010,000 EXP
Achievement Quest - [Event] Party Favors
You will receive the achievement quest, [Event] Party Favors.Complete the daily quest, [Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous, 5 times to receive the following reward:Tiny Starbrite x60Complete the daily quest 10 times to receive the following reward:Tiny Starbrite x110Complete the daily quest 20 times to receive the following reward:Tiny Starbrite x160*NEW* Communicator Gesture Card
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2481/communitcator-gesture-card.pngComplete the quest, [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 4After completing all of the previous objectives, talk to Neo in Dunbarton to receive the following rewards:Tiny Starbrite x210*NEW* Flying Saucerhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2479/flying-saucer.pngComplete the [Event] Party Favors quest to receive the following rewards:Tiny Starbrite x300*NEW* Homestead Erinn Command Outpost https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2480/homestead-erinn-command-outpost.png10,000 EXP
Daily Quest - [Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous
Every day, you will receive the daily quest, [Event] The Fast and the Festive-ous.You will need to complete different tasks around the Starlight Festival:Help out Neo’s friends 1 timeReward: Tiny Starbrite x5Claim victory in a mini-gameReward: Tiny Starbrite x5Enter the Stage of TrialsReward: Tiny Starbrite x5Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:10,000 EXPThe daily quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT every day.
[Daily Quest Task] Help out Neo’s friends
Each of Neo’s friends will offer a daily quest.Daily quests from each friend will become available after completing the event quests, [Event] All Aboard the Friend-Ship 1 through 4.Each quest will reward a different Star Card. Ruelle's missions also reward festival food!Only one daily quest can be completed each day.The daily quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT every day.
[Daily Quest Task] Claim victory in a mini-game
Talk to Neo to play the Guess the Gesture or Dice Battle mini-game.Dice Battle will be available after the 3rd week of the event: March 30th, after maintenance.You can play either mini-game, but you can only win one mini-game each day.Guess the GestureEnter a mission with Neo and start the game. Neo will perform different gestures. Guess five gestures correctly in a row to win!You can only win this mini-game once each day.Dice BattleBattle against Neo with dice!Each player will start with 100 HP.Roll the dice to deal damage to the other player.If Neo’s HP reaches 0, you win!You can only win this mini-game once each day.
[Daily Quest Task] Enter the Stage of Trials
Talk to Neo to enter the Stage of Trials mini-game.The Stage of Trials is a one room dungeon with 15 waves of enemies.You can enter the Stage of Trials up to 3 times each day. (resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.)Note: You cannot enter the Trials if you have Remote Coupons, or summoning dolls (Tiger Rag Doll, Marshal Cat Claw, etc.) in the inventory. Please deposit them in the bank or pet inventory to continue.Two modes are available:Stage of TrialsYou cannot revive.You cannot bring a party or summon pets.Stage of Trials (Veteran Mode)All restrictions of Stage of Trials.You cannot use potions.You cannot use Anchor Rush or Tumble.EXP reward is quadrupled.Depending on how many rounds you clear, you can earn Combat EXP, Exploration EXP, Music Renown EXP, or Life Renown EXP.Talk to Neo and choose “Change Reward Type” to select your preferred EXP type.If you fail a round, you will be automatically revived and healed.Clear at least one round in the Stage of Trials to receive the 1st title:who is Just Getting StartedLuck +18Clear all rounds in the Stage of Trials (any mode) to receive the 2nd title:Stage of Trials ChampionMax Damage +18Magic Attack +18https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2478/stage-of-trials-champion.gifTiny Starbrite Event Shop

notes.title: Irusan's Check-In Attendance Season 3
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1245/220124_irusanattendanceevent_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Folamh outfit set. Admire your favourite Fomor from the comfort of your own homestead instead of from Crom Bás when you finish the calendar, too! Check out the details below.
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, March 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 1st, Before Maintenance
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.pngDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] Help Wanted, Meow!Find A Kitty in Need in front of the Unicorn Statue.Register for the event with A Kitty in Need.Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. 
You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 27 days of log in.You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.A new Event Clock timer is available so you can check your Check-in progress at a glance without opening up the Event Menu.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2079/irusans-clock-ui.pngStay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.You will only receive 1 stamp per day.Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from Thursday, June 1st, After Maintenance - June 8th, Before Maintenance.When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/2078/irusans-ui.png
Attendance Pass PurchaseIf you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for 29 Pon.The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.

Commerce Related AdjustmentsTo increase trade inventory resilience, the maximum inventory of trade items, excluding limited items, is adjusted and the inventory has been reset.Inventory recovery speed now increases up to 5 times.The overall yield rate has been adjusted for Commerce Trading Post goods for a smoother inventory circulation of the entire trade system through general trading.In order to minimize the phenomenon that only some trade goods are exhausted, the difference in the basic yield rate between trade goods has been reduced.As a result, some items are also improved to make higher profits depending on inventory.The number of weekly exchanges for exchanging materials for trade goods at each Barter Trading Post has been reduced.The price of the Air Transport License has been lowered to 5,000,000 Seasonal Ducats. Commerce Season 3 ChangesSeasonal Commerce Imbolic Season 3 will begin at 12:00 AM PST on March 1st, 2023 and run until July 1st, 2023 12:00AM PDT.Several sewing patterns will be available for purchase from Sayiv’s shop, including newly added Portia and Bassanio outfits and shoes sewing patterns. The Season 3 Erinn Merchants' Guild Erg Material Box will be available.The Imbolic Season 3 Challenger Title and Challenger Box will be available.The Seasonal Commerce Guide has been updated with archived Season 1~2 information and Season 3 information.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Cabbage Pancake and Seafood Pancake have been renamed Cabbage Jeon and Seafood Pajeon.Made the descriptions for the Horn Bugles consistent.Portia’s Shoes can now be worn by Female Giants.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixes for typos found across C6 and C7 Generations reported by our players!
"Thanks, Milletians!" - GM Quuku, CM Arciellia, Prod. MewlynneThe enemy debuff "Phantom's Roar" has been renamed to "Wraith's Roar" to match the enemy source. 
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.There is an issue where certain NPC Transformations are missing the models for their bodies.There is an issue where Shadow Mission Tarlach does not grant Baol Dungeon Pass.There is a minor issue where the Pet Skill Window is unable to collapse properly.

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2023 First Half Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Dear Milletians,

After the release of the New Beast updates and Arcana talents, we are happy to see Mabinogi flourishing with new and returning faces. We feel the excitement and passion from our loyal Milletians, too. We’ve been reviewing your feedback on these updates and appreciate you sharing your thoughts with us. If you haven’t already, please tell us what you think! Share with us on Discord by joining the discussion with the community or check out the Arcana Feedback Thread.

This year, we have more updates to come. We’d like to share a high level overview of some upcoming contents to be expected in the first half of this year. Please look forward to the following updates:

Masterpiece Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 Update, recently released in January
Replay ability for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 Generations.Changes to some NPC interactions and permanent NPCs in Avalon. New replay reward boxes and Jukebox songs.
64-bit Client Update
To improve game performance and reduce memory issues, we will implement the 64-bit client update. Please check out the dedicated notice for more details about this change.
Mabinogi's 15th Anniversary
With events, fun rewards, GM shenanigans and more, we hope to celebrate 15 years of Mabinogi with all Milletians.
Quality of Life Improvements

Improvements to several game features are being prepared this year. We are excited to share some of the changes, including:
New Dressing Room categories for Chairs and Accessory items, including halos and support puppets.New Accessory slot added to the Style tab for halos and support puppets.Improvements to the Dye Ampoule system for ease of finding that perfect color code.Improved production gathering distance so you don’t have to chase those potatoes down!The Tara Auction House will be updated with new wares for auction soon.The Adventurer Seal system and shop will be renewed with new items.New Dungeon features, such as re-entry to Tech Duinn missions and craftable Avon mission passes.Enchant improvements to make highly successful enchantments more effective while reducing the penalty of huge failure.And more!
NEXT Step Up!

To help new and returning Milletians to progress through to higher levels, we’re making a few changes intended to improve the performance limit of intermediate equipment and make reforging tools more accessible.
In an effort to improve the phenomenon where you stay with the Celtic or Divine weapons for too long while struggling to get better equipment, Celtic Symbol and Divine Symbol items will be introduced to bridge the gap between these weapons and advanced equipment.We plan to add Beginner’s Reforging Tools obtainable through playing dungeons, so that you can obtain reforging tools and try out limited reforging options with less stress. These changes may not completely resolve current issues, but we hope it will become natural to try and experience various options before reaching a higher level, and help newer Milletians to smoothly move on to the later game stages.
Renovation Season 4

Changes to skills for Humans, Elves, and Giants will bring improvements to combat.
Improvements will be made for Archery skills, including race specific skills.Elven Magic Missile, Mirage Missile, Final Shot, and Human’s Arrow Revolver.Ranged Attack, Magnum Shot, Crash Shot, and Urgent Shot.Throwing Attack will also see an improvement.Improvements for Giant skills, including Taunt, Stomp, Final Strike, and Giant Full Swing.Minor improvements for several Magic skills will be added.
Although the mentioned contents are in the current pipeline, depending on testing and development plans, the plan could change. More information regarding confirmed content will be shared in our regular Update posts and Patch Notes! As always, we thank you for your support and love for Mabinogi.

Sincerely,
GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer

notes.title: Mabinogi 64-bit Client Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2686/200922_announcement_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Hello Milletians!

In an upcoming maintenance, we will be implementing our 64-bit Client Update. We highly recommend that you update your Mabinogi game clients, but this does not require a full re-install of the game when upgrading to the 64-bit Client.

With the February update, Mabinogi's game client will be upgraded to 64-bit, enabling improved performance on modern systems and to help us support Mabinogi long into the future. As part of this update, Mabinogi will no longer be playable on 32-bit (x86) operating systems.
Why Upgrade to a 64-bit Game Client?
Mabinogi on 32-bit was limited in its memory usage, depending on the needs of the operating system. With the change to 64-bit, it will allow the Mabinogi client to use more memory and improve client performance in various memory-intensive situations. It has been a recurring issue that any Mabinogi client exceeding more than 4GB of memory during normal gameplay would result in memory allocation failure, ultimately resulting in client crashes. In order to avoid such problems, the transition to 64-bit client may improve overall service quality. 

While the 64-bit client will improve some client performance issues, please keep in mind that it will not resolve every issue you may have encountered previously.
How can I learn what Operating System I have?
If you are unsure of what sort of operating system you have running on your PC, you can find out in the "About Your PC" System Setting page:
Use the Windows key to bring up the Start Menu, and click on the Gear icon to open up the settings.Under "System" menu, select "About" at the bottom of the sidebar.Look under "System type", which will tell you which type of operating system and processor you have.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1531/about-windows-64-bit-operating-system.png

It should show one of three possible options:
64-bit operating system, x64-based processor: No changes required, your computer is already set-up and good to go!32-bit operating system, x64-based processor: Your computer's operating system is still 32-bit, however your system's processor is able to support a 64-bit operating system. In order to play Mabinogi after the update, you will need to upgrade your operating system to a 64-bit version.32-bit operating system, x86-based processor: Unfortunately, your computer is not able to support a 64-bit operating system, and will not be able to run Mabinogi after this update.Updated Sound Library
Finally, with the future update, Mabinogi's sound library will also be updated. The sound library (MSS) used in the existing 32-bit client will be replaced with FMOD. When it came to the previous sound library, it was difficult to provide a stable environment when loading high-quality sound sources or loading sound sources of multiple instruments at once. As a result, the addition of an updated sound library will further reinforce "sound", one of the indispensable facets of Mabinogi. We will continue to strive to provide audio content that will satisfy all Milletians in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!

- The Mabinogi Team

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Imperial Knight Box: Thursday, January 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 2nd, Before MaintenanceDesperate Designer Event: Thursday, January 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 16th, Before MaintenanceWinter Premiere Pet Box: Thursday, January 19th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 16th, Before MaintenanceMasterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update: Permanent
Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: January Quality of Life UpdatesA new Lock function for Combo Cards has been added.4 new basic Stardust appearances have been added and can be purchased from Melwyn.Minor changes have been made to Dan Advancement Exams.And more!
Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update
The Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update is here. See the full post for more information: Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update
Chapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse generations can now be replayed.New Replay Rewards such as the new Homestead items, Mini-Gems, Balloons, Titles, and 20 new Jukebox BGMs are available.Overall improvements have been made to C6 and C7 NPCs and Missions.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where visual effects for certain Spirit Liqueurs were not appearing on the player's weapon.Fixed an issue where visual effects for certain eyes' were not displaying properly.Fixed an issue where Queen Eirawen's eyes were occasionally misaligned.Fixed an issue with the [Pet/Partner?] help button's information.Fixed a text error where Arcana Talents' text was being cut-off in the Talent Select Menu when rebirthing.Fixed a text error with the rank up requirements for the skill "Hydra Transmutation".Fixed an issue where after completing G7 Quest "Atrata’s Wind Bell", the Storyline Menu doesn't update.Fixed an issue where the G25 quest "Love's Flame Enkindled" was not properly progressing.Fixed an issue where after completing G24, the first quest of G25 would not arrive, and could not be manually started in the Storyline Menu.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.Shop items with expiration times start counting down upon the player logging in or changing channels, rather than having their count down start when the item is purchased.

notes.content: https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1381/201009-mbw-2123-qualityoflife-940x290.jpgJanuary Quality of Life UpdatesCombo Card lock functionA lock function has been added to Combo Cards.You can lock or unlock combo cards with the right mouse button.The “Remove All” toggle will now exclude all locked Combo Cards when using the “Eliminate” function.Activated Combo Cards are not removed when using the “Remove All” function.4 new basic Stardust appearances have been added.Form of Basic Stardust Type B ~ E can be purchased in Melwyn's shop for 1x Royal Society Sponsorship Badge.The “Manage Crystals” button for Guard Cylinders has been adjusted to appear at the top of the item menu.The items “Shyllien Assimilation Essence” and “Hillwen Assimilation Essence” items have been added.When using each item, the character will not be recognized by monsters in the Shyllien Nature Reserve and Hillwen Mine.The effect will last for 10 minutes.These items can be crafted with Magic Craft and Hillwen Engineering skills respectively.Minor changes made to Dan Advancement ExamsIf there is not enough room in your inventory during an Advancement Exam, the item will be dropped on the floor.The Mysterious Purple Bag will be added to your inventory during the Advancement Exam quest.The Potion Making Kit has been added to the NPC shop during the Advancement Exam quest. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png

notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 6 and 7 Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q1/1117/230106_januaryupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngUpdate DetailsChapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse generations can now be replayed.If you have played all of G19 The Divine Knights, G20 The Gate of Sanctuary, and G21 The Guardian's Path, you can start the replay for the Chapter 6 Generations.You can obtain the C6 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.If you have played all of G22 Apocalypse, G23 Tempest, G24 Ascension, and G25 Eclipse, you can start the replay for the Chapter 7 Generations.You can obtain the C7 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.You can replay a completed Generation by clicking the Start Replay button belonging to that generation and chapter in the Storyline menu.Only one replay can be played through one Generation at a time.While replaying a Generation, some NPCs may not be available or it may be difficult to enter or move to certain areas. Upon completion or forfeiting of the replay, NPCs are normally visible again and you can enter certain areas.You cannot start a replay from the middle of a Generation.If you forfeit a replay or start a replay of another generation while a replay is in progress then, all replay progress of the generation will be reset.If the daily replay count limit has been reached for the part, the replay progress for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will be saved and you can start from the next part the next day.During replay, there is no delay in accepting quests, and it has been improved that the next quest will be received immediately.Replay quest has been improved to receive quests while indoors.Quests given between Generations Part 1 and Part 2 that are not related to the story have been excluded from Replay.Optional titles can be collected through repeated replays.Completing Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 replays will award C6 Replay Reward Box and C7 Replay Reward Box:Opening the box will reward a chance to receive a variety of items such as new C6/C7 Homestead Housing decorations, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.Balloons obtained from the replay reward box cannot be traded.Replay starting conditions require all chapters of a Generation to be completed.
Example: To replay G1, you must have completed Chapter 1 by clearing all of G1, G2, and G3.If you are currently replaying G1, G2, or G3, the replay progress will be reset upon logging in after the update. You will receive one C1 Replay Reward Box and 3,000 gold by mail.The number of replay episodes that can be started per day has been changed from 5 to 7.Improvements to existing Chapter 6: The Divine Knights and Chapter 7: Apocalypse are as follows:When progressing through a generation in Chapter 6, optional dialogue will be presented even when talking to a character outside of the quest progression order.Completing all the Generations in Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will permanently add NPCs in Avalon.After the update, you will need to complete the Generations for Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 for the first time or complete a replay once.Even if you have cleared all previous Generations for Chapter 6 and 7, you must complete a replay for any belonging to the chapter at least once to encounter the NPCs.Depending on the day of the week, the NPCs that are available will be split amongst the days; however, they won’t appear on Saturday.You cannot meet them during the replay though they will appear normally again when replay is completed or forfeited.In the case of NPCs that can be met in the sanctuary, they will appear or disappear normally only after entering the sanctuary once, even on the specified day of the week.Improvements have been made so that you can present some items to the permanent NPCs you can meet at the entrance of Tech Duinn.Travel Diary conversation keywords for some NPCs will be modified or added.
Upon clearing G19, keywords for Altam or Avelin are acquired. 
This does not apply if you have previously cleared G20 and possessed the keyword and possession history remains.Upon clearing G20, keywords for Caswyn or Pihne are acquired.Upon clearing G21, keywords for Talvish or Llywelyn are acquired.After the update, you can learn the keywords when you complete each generation first and the replay.For those that have previously cleared all Generations, you must complete each Generation through replay at least once to obtain the keywords.For some NPCs, special dialogues that are only displayed during replays will be added.For some NPCs, reaction dialogue lines when wearing specific outfits are added.The description of Port Ceann in some generations will be modified to match the situation after the Great Era of Commerce update.Many typos and awkward expressions throughout the G19, G20, G21, G22, G23, G24, and G25 storyline have been corrected.A number of situations in which conversations with an NPC are impossible due to the storyline dialogue have been improved.Camera direction has been changed to the following missions within G19, G20, and G21.G19: “Incidental Inevitability,” “The Wolf and the Man,” “Things with Wings,” “Shattered Trust,” and “Do or Die”G20: “Graveyard Night,” “Grave Keeper 1,” “Any Way the Wind Blows,” “A Knight’s Musings,” “Circle of Damnation,” and “Clashing Blades 1”G21: “First Communication,” “Second Communication,” “Third Communication,” “Sixth Communication,” “Colossal Enemy by the Shore,” “Ambush,” “Seventh Communication,” “Avelin’s Nightmare,” “Gravebound,” “Sanctuary Erg,” “The Keeper of the Gate,” “That Which Remains,” “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight,” “Winds of Madness,” and “Guardians”In G20, issues have been fixed where the change in the NPC’s relationship and emotional lines were inconsistent.
If you don’t select a speech option when offered to accompany Altam in the Budding Beginning quest, it will increase Avelin’s favorability instead of Altam.If you ask the reason for Pihne’s request in the quest Circle of Damnation, Caswyn’s favorability will drop instead of increasing.If you interrupt Pihne’s conversation in the quest Forward Progress, it will decrease Talvish’s favorability instead of Pihne’s.The balance for some of the G21 story missions has been modified.When using the item “Prayer of Protection” in the shadow mission “Twilight, Moonlight, Starlight”, the duration of the protection effect is increased.In the shadow mission "Guardians”, the boss has been modified so that it does not attack while dialogue is in progress. If the boss’ HP is reduced to 80%, the boss becomes invincible until entering phase 2 of the fight.The appearance of characters in some G22 cutscenes has been changed.In G24, information for “Things That Go Bump in the Night“ has been changed to include more details under the Story Guide.Fixed an issue where Enya and Etain’s gloves were displayed incorrectly when playing G25 RP Missions or using Transformation Medals.The G25 Storyline start method has changed.If you select “Start G25 Eclipse” in the Storyline Menu, the related cutscene will play and you will immediately enter the story mission.This has changed so that you can proceed with the first quest regardless of whether or not you have cleared the first story mission to enter.20 new BGM themes have been added to the Jukebox.C6/C7 Replay Reward BoxesWhen you complete a Generation Replay for C6 and C7, you will receive a C6 Replay Reward Box and C7 Replay Reward Box respectively.Opening the box will reward one item from the following droplist, and unlock one BGM for the Homestead Jukebox.
The acquired BGM will be one that you have not yet unlocked.Both C6 and C7 Replay Boxes have the possibility of dropping Mini-Gems/Mini-Gem Selection Boxes, and Balloons!

notes.title: NEXT: Arcana - Patch Notes - December 15
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the NEXT: Arcana Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th 2021, After Maintenance - January 19th, 2023, Before MaintenanceDark Moon Box: Thursday, December 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 29th, Before MaintenanceSnow Cloud for Sale!: Thursday, December 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 29th, Before MaintenanceSnowflower Tree Festival Event Returns!: Thursday, December 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 12th, Before MaintenanceNEXT Update Celebration Events: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 19th, Before MaintenanceNEXT: Arcana Update: Permanent
NEXT: Arcana Update
The NEXT: Arcana Update is here. See the dedicated microsite and the update post  for more information!
New Arcana Talents, Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint have been added.You must be over cumulative level 10,000 in order to start prerequisite quests.New Skills are added for both Arcana Talents.New titles have been added for the new Arcana Talents.The existing Grandmaster Guide quests have been removed and replaced.New UIs have been added for Managing Arcana and Arcana Links.Information related to Arcana has been added to the Basic Info tab of the Character Info menu.The Arcana tab has been added to the Talent menu.An active Arcana Talent tab is added to the Skill menu.New NPCs Laoire, Cowenna, and Eochaid have been added.A new area, the Arcana Association Room, has been added.And more! 
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where certain Moon-Gates and Mana-Tunnels when used on the World Map would lead to incorrect destinations.Fixed an issue where during the Memoir Quest "Nele's Music Basics", some objectives were displayed incorrectly.Fixed an issue where  Beach Vacation Pedicure was invisible on Giant characters wearing Morrighan's Regalia (F).
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.Nascent Divinity causes players with Almond skintones to become teal.There is an issue where one-time/limited item cannot be purchased from the ingame shop, but can be on the web-shop.The Intricate Braid Hair (F) does not animate properly in some cases.After completing G24, the first quest of G25 does not arrive, and cannot be started in Storyline UI.There is a text error with the rank up requirements for the skill "Hydra Transmutation".The talents that are used for Arcana Talents have text cut off on the Rebirth screen.In the Storyline menu, Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 will inaccurately allow players to start a replay, though this will only consume resources.Certain Moon Gates and Mana Tunnels are leading to wrong locations when teleporting with the Traveler's Guide.

notes.title: NEXT: Arcana Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2042/221201_decemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update Details
Arcana
New Arcana Talents, Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint have been added. New Skills are added for both Arcana Talents.Arcana Talents combine the elements of two Grandmaster talents.Additional details for Arcana can be viewed on the dedicated microsite.
How to Learn Arcana
Characters over cumulative level 10,000 will receive the quest, [Guide] The Grandmaster’s Path.The existing Grandmaster Guide quests have been removed.You can receive the Arcana Guide Quest, [Guide] One Step Higher after progressing in the quest.After completing [Guide] One Step Higher, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame.You must complete the Arcana guide quests [Guide] One Step Higher and [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame to learn Arcana talents.After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, the permanent NPC Laoire will be added to the Arcana Association Room in Tara Rath Royal Castle.You can accept the Arcana Talent acquisition quest by talking to NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates.In order to acquire Elemental Knight, the character must meet the following requirements:Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher Acquire the Grandmaster Spellsword Talent TitleRequires the Grandmaster Mage and Grandmaster Warrior talent levelsComplete the quest, [Elemental Knight] A Dress Too Hot to HandleYou can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Spellsword and talking to NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates - Elemental Knight.When completing the quest, NPC Cowenna will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Elemental Knight Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.In order to acquire Harmonic Saint, the character must meet the following requirements:Cumulative level of 20,000 or higher Acquire the Grandmaster Choirmaster Talent TitleRequires the Grandmaster Bard and Grandmaster Cleric Talent levelsComplete the quest, [Harmonic Saint] An Unremembered DreamYou can start this quest after achieving Grandmaster Choirmaster and talking to NPC Laoireabout Promising Arcana Candidates - Harmonic Saint.When completing the quest, NPC Eochaid will reside in the Arcana Association Room and the Harmonic Saint Arcana talents, related skills, and journal achievement will be acquired.
Manage Arcana
A new area, the Arcana Association Room is added.You can enter through the Great Hall on the 2nd floor of the Tara Rath Royal Castle.To enter the area, you must complete the [Guide] One Step Higher quest.After completing the [Guide] Lighting the Arcana’s Flame quest, you can go directly to it by pressing the Go to Arcana Association Room button in the Talent menu under the Arcana tab.You can check the Manage Arcana menu at the Arcana Enkindling Lectern located in the area.Several options related to Arcana Level and Arcana Link are available to enhance the Arcana talents.Information related to Arcana has been added to the Basic Info tab of the Character Info menu.You can check the Arcana level, experience, and link level of the currently active Arcana Talent.The Arcana tab has been added to the Talent menu.In the Arcana tab, you can check the details of all Arcana talents.You can check the Arcana bonus effect applied to the character and the upper limit increase in stats.An active Arcana Talent tab is added to the Skill menu.You can check Arcana's exclusive skills in the corresponding tab.Through the skill management button, you can acquire and rank up Arcana specific skills.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2162/talent-ui-hud.png

Arcana Talent Enhancement
At the Arcana Enkindling Lectern, you can select and activate one of the acquired Arcana Talents.100 AP can be consumed to switch the active Arcana talent.Acquired Arcana level bonuses are maintained even if you switch to another Arcana talent.Whenever the character level increases, the currently active Arcana talent experience increases.When the Arcana Talent's EXP reaches its maximum level, the Arcana Talent's level increases.Each Arcana Talent level can be increased up to 50.Depending on the Arcana level, you can get bonus stats or learn additional skills for the talent.Training Arcana skills requires the character to reach specific Arcana Levels or rank other Arcana skills to a certain rank.AP is required when ranking up the skills.The Total Arcana Level is the cumulative level of all Arcana Talents, and the upper limit of the character's stats increases according to the Total Arcana Level.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/2163/manage-arcana-hud-ui.png

Arcana Link
You can unlock Arcana Link stages when reaching a certain level of an Arcana talent.Arcana Links can be unlocked up to 5 stages, and more bonus effects can be obtained as the stage increases.The Arcana Link Bonus applies only to the currently active Arcana Talent.In order to unlock Arcana Links, the Link Unlock Requirements must be met, requiring a certain Arcana Talent Level, AP, and Scorching Crests.Arcana Talent-Specific Scorching Crest items are required for each stage.Scorching Crests can be obtained by converting the Smoldering Thread item and 10,000 Gold via the Crest Forging menu when Managing Arcana.Smoldering Thread can be obtained from certain dungeons.When reaching certain Arcana Link stages, Arcana Link Quests will be available for both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana Talents.You can proceed with the Link Quest when each Arcana Talent Link stage 1, 3, and 5 is achieved.You can unlock the next link stage without completing the link quest.Stage 1 and 3 link quests are accepted automatically upon reaching the link level.If you do not complete the previous stage link quest, you will not be able to progress or accept the next stage quest.If you do not receive the quest automatically or in the case of the 5th stage link quest, you can accept the quest by talking to the NPC Laoire about Promising Arcana Candidates.Stage 5 link quests can be accepted after learning both Elemental Knight and Harmonic Saint Arcana talents.
Elemental KnightElemental Knight skills can only be used while equipping a melee weapon.
Instill Flame
An active skill that grants the power of the fire elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Flame skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.Splash damage range is added during normal attack.Increases skill damage of Blazing Assault Slash.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using fire magic.Increases the Fire Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Fire Elemental to equipment.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.
Instill Frost
An active skill that grants the power of the ice elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Frost skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.Reduces the target's movement and attack speed when using normal attacks.Increases skill damage of Shattering Windmill.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click]Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using ice magic.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.Increases the Ice Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Ice Elemental to equipment.Movement speed and attack speed reduction effects are refreshed based on the last applied effect.
Instill Thunder
An active skill that grants the power of the lightning elemental to an equipped melee weapon for a certain period of time.You cannot use different elemental instillment skills at the same time.While the Instill Thunder skill is active, you gain the following effects.Increases minimum/maximum damage.When using a normal attack, the target’s Defense and Protection are partially ignored and the stun time is increased. In higher ranks, it also negates target’s Heavy Stander effect.Increases skill damage of Dynavolt Smash.Depending on the skill rank, you can cast Bolt, Intermediate, and Advanced magic skills at the same time while using the skills of your Close Combat Talent.Allows Bolt magics to be cast while using Close Combat Talent skills with [Control + Right Mouse Click].Increases casting speed and magic damage by a certain percentage of maximum damage when using lightning magic.Increases the Lightning Elemental attribute value by one, the same effect as applying Lightning Elemental to equipment.Mana is slowly consumed continuously, and the skill is automatically canceled when MP is depleted.
Blazing Assault Slash
It is an active skill that jumps towards the enemy and damages surrounding enemies.Able to select a landing location during the jump animation after using the skill.If you do not select a landing location, you will land at the point where you attacked.Damage increases while Instill Flame skill is active.Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Assault Slash skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Blazing Assault Slash skill increases.
Shattering Windmill
An active skill that attacks enemies around the caster.Damages and freezes enemies on hit.
The movement speed and attack speed are reduced for enemies that are immune to being frozen.Deals additional damage when the freezing effect ends.Damage increases while Instill Frost skill is active.Depending on the damage and Attack Range of the Windmill skill, the damage and Attack Range of the Shattering Windmill skill increases.
Dynavolt Smash
An active skill that attacks enemies in a straight line.Damage increases while Instill Thunder skill is active.Depending on the damage of the Smash skill, the damage of the Dynavolt Smash skill increases.
Dauntless Defense
An active skill that blocks enemy attacks and counter attacks while in defense.While you hold down the skill button, you will continue to defend against enemy attacks, and in this state, if you release the button or after a certain period of time, you will attack the surroundings.Each enemy's attack blocked while in this defensive state will increase the counter attack damage inflicted to the target up to three times.The higher the defense proficiency of the Defense skill, the higher the defense proficiency of the Dauntless Defense skill.Reduces incoming damage based on the size of the shield.Small shield = 20% damage reductionMedium shield = 40% damage reductionLarge shield = 60% damage reduction
Harmonic SaintHarmonic Saint skills can only be used while equipping a staff or wand.
Hand of Restoration
A single target skill that recovers Health and Wounds.Additional HP recovery based on Healing skill’s recovery value.The maximum HP recovery amount does not exceed the maximum injury recovery amount.
Echoes of Salvation
A skill that restores the Health of party members within an area of effect.Increased MP and Stamina Recovery Speed for affected party members for a short time.Increased HP recovery based on Party Healing skill rank.Additional MP and Stamina Recovery Speed based on Enduring Melody’s skill rank.
Voice of Vitality
A skill that continuously recovers the Health of all nearby party members for a certain period of time.HP recovery occurs at regular intervals for affected party members and their elemental resistance is increased.Increased elemental resistance of Voice of Vitality based on the skill ranks of Fire Shield, Ice Shield, and Lightning Shield.
Pulse of Purification
A skill that continuously inflicts damage to surrounding enemies within a certain range centered on the caster. (Can be channeled for up to 15 seconds)While holding down the skill button, enemies will receive damage at regular intervals, but Health and Mana will be consumed continuously.When channeling ends, additional damage is dealt in proportion to the channeling duration.Skill casting will stop if the HP/MP required to maintain the skill is insufficient or if you are hit by an enemy.
Pall of Ruination
An active skill that grants a stat reduction effect to all enemies around the caster.Reduced stats are as follows:
Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic ProtectionMovement Speed, Attack Speed, and Casting SpeedIncreased Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection reduction of Pall of Ruination based on the Dance of Death skill rank.Increased speed reduction effect of Pall of Ruination based on the Fantastic Chorus skill rank.The Time Shift technique cannot be used for the Pall of Ruination skill.
Blessing of Protection
A skill that amplifies the survivability of nearby party members by creating a shield for a short period of time.The shield negates most attacks for a short period of time. (It is not effective for certain gimmicks and instant kills.)Party members affected by Blessing of Protection gain the following stats for a certain period of time:
Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic ProtectionIncreased Defense and Protection effects of Blessing of Protection based on the Enduring Melody skill rank.
Hymn of Resurrection
A skill that revives an incapacitated party member.A party member revived with Hymn of Resurrection recovers some of their Health and Wounds.After reviving, incoming damage is reduced for a short time.Increased recovery of Hymn of Resurrection based on the First Aid skill rank.
Additional Changes
You can obtain the Arcana Collection Book from NPC Laoire.Laoire, Cowenna, and Eochaid have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Campfire Invitation.Laoire: Jet 10cmCowenna: Picnic Chicken KebabEochaid: 20 Finest Handmade BandagesArcana related items have been added.Smoldering ThreadScorching Crest: Elemental KnightScorching Crest: Harmonic SaintYou can obtain Smoldering Thread from various dungeons.It can be obtained from the dungeon end chest each time the dungeon is cleared.At least one Smoldering Thread is dropped, and there are variations depending on the dungeon and difficulty.A large amount of Smoldering Thread can also be obtained at a low probability.Alby Advanced Hard ModeCiar Advanced Hard Mode Rundal Advanced Hard ModeAlby VeteranCiar VeteranRabbie VeteranMath VeteranFiodh VeteranBarri VeteranCoill VeteranRundal VeteranPeaca VeteranCoill AbyssPeaca Abyss Rabbie Phantasm (Excludes Mirror World) Mag Mell -  Forest of the Four Seasons (Normal, Hard)Mag Mell - Dynamic Lands (Normal, Hard)Tech Duinn - Revived Illusion (Normal, Advanced, Elite)Tech Duinn - Feth Fiada (Normal, Advanced, Elite)Tech Duinn - Seven Nightmares (Normal, Advanced, Elite)Tech Duinn - Awakened Abyssal Lord (Normal, Advanced, Elite)Crom Bas (Normal, Advanced, Elite)Grandmaster Spellsword and Grandmaster Choirmaster Hidden Talent titles have been added.When talents related to Hidden Talents become Grandmasters, the level of hidden talents automatically increases.In the talent selection window that appears during rebirth, a guide to Arcana-related talents has been added.The increased casting speed effect of the Echostone is modified so that it is applied to the wand twice, the same as the reforge of the same effect.If both the increased casting speed effect from an Echostone and the casting speed increase effect from a reforge are equipped, only the highest effect value will be applied.When equipping items with related set effects, it has been modified so that only the highest effect value is applied regardless of the order in which they are equipped.Movement Speed IncreaseThe movement speed increase effects of certain shoes are separate effects, so they can be stacked.
