notes.title: NEXT: New Beast - Patch Notes - November 17
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the NEXT: New Beast Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceAn Impish Impasse Event: Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceClassic Maid Box: Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 1st, Before MaintenanceErinn Beauty Box: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 15th, Before MaintenanceNEXT Update Celebration Events: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 19th, Before MaintenanceWelcome Milletian Packages: PermanentNEXT: New Beast Update: Permanent
NEXT: New Beast Update
The NEXT: New Beast Update is here. See the dedicated microsite and the update post  for more information!
Skill Training Improvements have been added. Reduced training requirements make it easy to reach higher ranked skills, including the removal of CP Training. Changes have been added for Renown and Crusader training. Dan Advancement tests can be completed up to twice a day.Grandmaster now only require 10 Talent Seals to achieve a Grandmaster Talent.Changes to Blaanid’s Brave Boost have been added, easing the progression of questing and leveling for new Milletians.New rewards, including pets, Blaanid’s Blessing buff, and more!The Memory Book has been reset, so any character can start Blaanid's Brave Boost from the beginning again.Additional quest changes and the addition of the Receivable Quest Board have been added.Modifications to the Beginner Benefits have been added, and characters under level 10,000 will now receive Beginner Benefits.And more! 
The following changes have been made to the game:
Party Boards have been removed from Uladh and Iria towns. The Party Board can still be accessed through the Party Menu (P) -> Party Board option.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue causing the Book of the Sacred Chalice to be named incorrectly. Fixed an issue where characters could not progress in the G8 questline.During the G1 questline, a certain song is now properly synced with the cutscene.Fixed text and spacing discrepancies in Chapter 7 Storyline UI display.Fluttering Demon Headband and Fluttering Devil Headband display properly.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.A rare issue has been reported where raids do not spawn correctly on certain channels. A textural error in Port Ceann has been reported.During the Memoir Quest "Nele's Music Basics", some objectives are displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: NEXT Update Celebration Events - Part 2
notes.content:
The Grand Guild Gathering Event
Event Dates: Thursday, November 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 19th, 2023, Before Maintenance
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering.Talk to Roy in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Roy.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering:10,000 EXPGuild Activity JournalThis item can be stored in the "Me" inventory.In order to participate, your character must be in a guild.If you have just joined a guild, you will be considered a new guild member. You can participate in certain parts of the event after 3 days have passed since you've joined the guild.If you are not in a guild, you can still receive Guild Activity Coins, but you will not gain Guild Activity EXP Points.If you quit a guild while participating in the event, the Guild Activity EXP Points you've earned will reset. The Guild Activity Coins will still remain, but you will not be able to use Roy's Guild Event Shop, and the special Guild Member Buffs.If you quit a guild while participating in the event, and rejoin another guild, you will be considered a new guild member and will need to wait 3 days to participate in certain parts of the event.Right-click "Use" on the Guild Activity Journal to open it and check information related to guild activities.Check Guild Activity EXPYou can check your Individual Guild Activity EXP Points and the Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points that have been obtained for the week.There are several ways to gain Guild Activity EXP points.Guild Activity EXP resets every week on Thursday at 7:00 AM PST in real time.Please note that it can take up to 5 minutes for the Guild EXP to update in the Guild Activity Journal.Claim your Weekly Guild RewardTo achieve the weekly guild reward, you and your guild will need to obtain a certain amount of Guild Activity EXP Points.5,000 or more Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points500 or more Individual Guild Activity EXP PointsOnce both of the above requirements have been meet, the Weekly Guild Reward Box can be claimed.This reward can only be claimed once per week.You can only claim the reward during the week, before the reset.

Earning Guild Activity EXP and Coinshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1686/the-grand-guild-gathering-ui.pngTo earn Guild Activity EXP and Guild Activity Coins, you must participate in various activities.One way to earn EXP and coins is by clearing the Erinn Adventure Journal missions.Open the Event menu https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1685/guild-event-icon.png to view the Daily, Weekly and Challenge Objectives.Daily Objectives will reset each day at 7AM PST.Weekly Objectives will reset each week on Thursdays at 7AM PST.Challenge Objectives will not reset.Special Guild Missions that you can participate in with other guild members to earn EXP and coins.Speak with Roy to Enter Guild Cooperative Mission.There are 3 Missions available.Eliminate MokkurkalfiFor the first clear, you will receive the following rewards:150 Guild Activity EXP150 Guild Activity CoinsMokkurkalfi Reward BoxEliminate the Sylvan DragonFor the first clear, you will receive the following rewards:150 Guild Activity EXP150 Guild Activity CoinsSylvan Dragon Reward BoxEliminate HasidimFor the first clear, you will receive the following rewards:150 Guild Activity EXP150 Guild Activity CoinsHasidim Reward BoxYou can enter solo or in a party with up to 8 guild members.All party members must be in the same guild.If you are a new guild member, you will not receive Guild Activity EXP until 3 days have passed since you joined the guild.You can still enter the mission multiple times, but you can only receive the rewards once per week for each mission.The weekly clear will be reset every week on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PST in real time.

Special Guild BuffsDuring the event period, you will receive the special Power of Guild Pride buff after registering your main character.New guild members can acquire the buff by talking to Roy after 3 days have passed since joining a guild.Power of Guild Pride BuffIncreases Attack Power by 15Increases Magic Attack by 10When participating in a special guild mission with a new guild member, the Refreshing Aura Buff will be granted to the entire party.2 or more players must be in the party for the buff to be applied.Refreshing Aura BuffIncreases Movement Speed by 30%Reduces Attack Delay by 15%

Use Guild Activity Coins in Roy's Guild shop to exchange for rewards.Guild Activity Coins can also be sold to an NPC for Exploration EXP 5%.The Special Gem Selection Box can only be purchased 3 times per week.The weekly purchase limit resets on Thursdays at 7:00 AM PDT.The Style Tab Key (30 days) can only be purchased once during the event.[table][tr][th]Consumable Shop Item Name[/th][th]Purchase Limit[/th][th]Duration[/th][th]Cost[/th][/tr][tr][td]Comprehensive Recovery 1000 Potion (Event)[/td][td]Unlimited[/td][td]7 Days[/td][td]100 Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td]Comprehensive Recovery 500 Potion (Event)[/td][td]Unlimited[/td][td]7 Days[/td][td]50 Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td]Nao's Soul Stone (Event)[/td][td]Unlimited[/td][td]7 Days[/td][td]50 Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td]Party Phoenix Feather (Event)[/td][td]Unlimited[/td][td]7 Days[/td][td]50 Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Gem Selection Box[/td][td]3 times a week[/td][td]7 Days[/td][td]300 Coins[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fixed Dye Ampoule Set[/td][td]Unlimited[/td][td]1 Day[/td][td]300 Co[/td][/tr][/table]

During the Event Period, Guild Leaders can set a Custom Guild Title for the Guild!Visit the Guild Stone at its placed location or the Guild Hall to open the “Guild Event” menu.  Title Requirements:itles may contain 2 to 10 characters.The title may contain spaces.The title may not contain symbols or numbers.Titles that contains profanity or inappropriate words will be deleted without notice.Once a title is deleted, it cannot be restored.During the event, the title may be changed as many times as you like. There is a 1 minute cooldown in between changes. You may only change the title once you’ve met the requirements.To change the title, the Guild must accept 5 newly recruited members into the Guild.The title will automatically be acquired when the recruitment requirement is achieved.All Guild members will receive the title after the Guild Title is set, even if a member joins after the initial acquisition.The title will show up as the set custom title at the end of the regular title selection list.When the event period ends, the Guild Title that is acquired will be available for use by the Guild permanently.A custom Guild Title will grant the following stats:HP +10Strength +10Intelligence +10Luck +10Will +10MP +10Defense +1Protection +1

notes.title: NEXT: New Beast Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1638/221107_novemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.png
Update Details
Skill Training Improvements
Skill Training has been greatly improved across Skills and Talents to improve training requirements and shorten the time it takes to reach high ranked Skills. The number of training requirements has been reduced and the EXP received from training will be increased. (The adjusted amount varies depending on the Skill)Training has been adjusted so that the training items related to failure of production Skills are not essential for Skill advancement.CP (Combat Power) Training requirements have been removed from Skills.Skills that required training with monsters of a specific level (Combat Power) have been changed so that it can be trained without this requirement.A function has been added to automatically rank up a Skill when maximum training has been reached.You can activate the function by checking the Rank Up Skills upon Completing Training box at the bottom of the Skill window or the Skill Info menu.If you uncheck this option, it will be disabled again.Skills that become available for rank up by reaching 100 or more training experience while the function is activated will be automatically promoted without a separate verification process.Note: Dan Skill Advancement will still require participating in the Advancement Ceremony.AP required for Skill rank up will be consumed, and if there is insufficient AP, automatic rank up is not possible.Note: Skills that are already available for ranking at the time the feature is activated will not be promoted immediately.The Dan Skill Advancement Test has been adjusted so that the promotion test can now be completed up to twice a day.Failing the promotion test does not reduce your daily count towards it.The conditions for acquiring the Master title for each Skill has been reduced.Skills that are rank 1 or higher will only require 100% training experience for the master title to be awarded for that Skill.The conditions for acquiring a Grandmaster Talent have been adjusted.The required Talent Seals to achieve Grandmaster has been reduced from 20 to 10.It is now possible to start Grandmaster challenges for a Talent that is not actively set.Crusader level training and sub-skill acquisition adjustments have been added.Crusader EXP gained has been increased for Daily and Weekly Orders, Apostle Raids, and Alban Knights Training Grounds.Daily Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy related Daily Order: 100 → 200Hasidim related Daily Order: 150 → 300Intermediate Bonus: 300 → 500All Clear Bonus: 300 → 1,000Weekly Order Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy related Daily Order: 300 → 500Hasidim related Daily Order: 400 → 700Intermediate Bonus: 1,000 → 2,000All Clear Bonus: 1,000 → 3,000Apostle Raid Crusader EXP completion increase is as follows:Girgashiy: Easy 100, Normal 200, Hard 300, Very Hard 400 (Limit 800 per day)Hasidim: Hard 600 (Limit 1200 per day)Zebach: Hard 800 (1600 per day limit)Alban Knights Training Grounds Crusader EXP is doubled when clearing.The function of the Dogma Books (Dogma of Smithing, Dogma of Warding, Dogma of Binding) have been changed so that the selected sub-skill training is completed and the maximum level rises by 1 when used on a sub-skill.It can only be used for sub-skills with a maximum level of 14 or less.Renown training has been adjusted.The upper limit of Renown EXP that can be obtained per day has been increased by 5 times. (2,000 -> 10,000 EXP)The Nele Renown training requirements that had a negative impact on the use of the Bard Bulletin Board has been replaced with a new training requirement.When using the Music/Life Renown Seal items, you will now be able to acquire Renown EXP regardless of the daily limit of Renown EXP.To coincide with changes to Skill training requirements, adjustments to Skill training bonuses have also been added.The maximum multiplier of Skill training buffs you can receive has been changed to a maximum of 8x Skill Training.The effect from Skill Training EXP Potions will no longer stack. Alongside the change, you will be unable to use another Skill Training Potion while already having the same effect from a potion active.For example, when you are receiving 2x Magic Training EXP from the Double Magic Training EXP Potion, you will be unable to receive the EXP bonus from a Complete Skill Training EXP Potion.However, you can use the Double Ninja Skill Training EXP Potion while receiving the buff from Double Magic Training EXP Potion.If item bonuses surpass the maximum amount of training available, the maximum amount of training received will still be capped at the Max Training EXP Bonus: x8.The Character Level Effect that boosted the Skill training of an active talent when when a character reached level 100 or higher has been removed.NPC Duncan's skill untrain function will no longer be available.
Memoir Renewed
Blaanid’s Brave Boost has been renewed with changes to quests, rewards, and leveling while progressing through Blaanid’s Memoirs and the four Memory Books. If you have already completed or are in the process of completing the Memory Book, you can proceed from the beginning again with the new changes.If you have previously progressed through the Memory Books, you can acquire additional Blaanid Weapons when replaying. However, in the case of the Blade of Blossoming Memories item, even if you have two, you cannot dual wield them.Book 4 of the Memory Book has been replaced with objectives that require progressing up to Chapter 5 of the Generation Storyline quests. Certain quests and dialogue that were lacking in guidance will be improved, and the progress of some quests will be reduced.The experience point acquisition method when completing Memoir quests has been changed to increase the cumulative level of the character automatically.It is possible to reach cumulative level of up to 20,000 when you progress through the 4th Memory Book.As the cumulative level increases through the progress of Memory Book, the AP also increases by the same value.Note: AP gained is not affected by events, items, etc. that affect AP acquisition amounts.Characters over level 20,000 will receive 1/5th of the value of levels and AP when completing Memoir quests.Some of the Rebirth Potions that were rewarded during the Memoir quests have been changed to the Talent Coupon item.Talent Coupons can be used to change your currently active combat or life talent without requiring a Rebirth.Essential items and Blaanid’s weapons are now provided early on, and you can acquire additional skills of various talents to help you in battle by progressing through the Memoirs.When you clear the guide quest [Brave Boost] A Blue Fragrance on the Wind, you will receive a pet, the Brainy Sheep Whistle (Once per account).When you clear Memory Book 1, 2, and 3, you can acquire 3 Doll Bag Box items.First Memoir: Baby Bunny Doll Bag Box (7x7)Second Memoir: Fennec Fox Kit Doll Bag Box (7x7)Third Memoir: Bear Cub Doll Bag Box (7x7)When you clear Memory Book 2, you can acquire the Memorial Link skill.This skill is only available for characters who do not have the Divine Link skill, and will disappear when Divine Link is acquired.This skill is a lesser version of Divine Link.When Memorial Link is used with a pet, the pet will take enemy aggro, and both the character and pet will receive a temporary stat boost.When you clear Memory Book 4, you can acquire the Support Bone Dragon Whistle item.A new support effect, Blaanid’s Blessing, can be obtained by each volume of the Memory Book progress for the character.Blessing Effects do not overlap and the effect is applied to the character by the highest Stage.The Blessing can be set in Character Info > Additional Info > Blaanid’s Blessing to switch the Halo effect above the character.The Recall Book allows you to register a specified location, which can be teleported to by using the ‘Move’ function in the Recall Book. Blaanid’s Blessing unlocks the following effects at each stage:Stage 1Recall Book Stage 1Movement Speed +2%All Stats +1Acquire 1 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 1 (White Halo effect)Stage 2Recall Book Stage 2Movement Speed +4%All Stats +2Acquire 2 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 2 (Red Halo effect)Stage 3Recall Book Stage 3Movement Speed +6%All Stats +3Acquire 3 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 3 (Blue Halo effect)Stage 4Recall Book Stage 4Movement Speed +8%All Stats +4Acquire 4 additional AP at rebirthBlessing Effect Stage 4 (Yellow Halo effect)It has been changed so that the Blaanid’s Brave Boost notification banner is not displayed on the menu bar at the bottom of the screen.
Additional Changes
Generation progression has been improved.Generation quests for Chapters and Generations are now started in sequential order, and the delay time when awaiting the next quest has been removed.In G7, some information for quests that were lacking in guidance have been added. (Using Kousai's Lipai Tea)The shadow mission acquisition method has been improved in G11 and G12 so that you can enter the shadow mission immediately when talking to the NPC.The Shylock RP mission in the G15 'Price of Love' quest has been changed so that 1 to 3 players can enter it.Talking to the Bear NPC in Sidhe Sneachta during the day and selecting the Wait until Nighttime option will now allow you to enter a mission to meet NPC Tarlach in Sidhe Sneachta at night time.The dungeon length of some RP missions in Chapter 1 is shortened and the movement speed is increased by 40%.The Receivable Quest Board has been added.It has been changed so that new characters will no longer receive non-essential quests all at once.Only non-essential quests that satisfy the conditions after the quest board has been added will be moved to the quest board. Therefore, it does not affect existing quests.After completing the quest, Memories of a Chain Slasher in Book 3 of Blaanid’s Brave Boost, characters will receive the guide quest, [Guide] About the Receivable Quest Board.Characters that progress through quests will unlock quests available to select through the Receivable Quest Board.Characters can select and start the quests anytime through the quest board.Improvements have been made to the quest location check function and it is now possible to warp to locations using the world map.When checking the quest location, the viewpoint of the mini map will be modified to show the quest location and the character's current location at the same time. (May not be applicable in some areas)For quests in other areas, you will be guided to the world map as before, and the Moon Gates and Mana Tunnels will now be displayed on the world map.You can use the warp function of Traveler’s Guide by selecting the Moon Gate or Mana Tunnel displayed on the world map.It is also possible to set a hotkey to open the world map in Options > Game > Control > Hotkey Settings > World Map.Enchantment system specifications have been improved.Enchants of rank 9 or higher can now be enchanted regardless of rank.This means that no step enchantment process will be required when using Enchant Scrolls above rank 9. The phrase 'Enchant enabled regardless of Rank' in the Enchant Scroll description of certain enchants has been removed.The Portable Diffuser (Spider) item has been added.You can obtain the item by passing the hill in front of Alby Dungeon in Tir Chonaill or talking to NPC Trevor.The Portable Diffuser (Spider) can be activated by right clicking the item to Activate it.When the Diffuser is activated, spider monsters will appear in the form of an Aroma bear. This is visible only to you.Some contents of the Dungeon Guide have been improved.It has been changed so that all characters can acquire Vouchers without having to designate a main representative character.You can change it so that certain characters do not receive vouchers through NPC Eavan in Dunbarton.The expiration date of the Forgetful Potions obtained from the 1st ~ 4th Support Boxes has been changed to 30 days. (It does not apply to items that have already been acquired.)The Skill Training Seal (30) for Combat and Magic talents has been added to the 2nd ~ 4th Voucher shop.The image and text has been improved to increase the visibility of the recommended dungeon display on the Dungeon Guide UI.The recommended dungeon will be displayed based on the character's maximum damage.The Lorna and Pan tutorial has been improved.The part where the new character had to unnecessarily re-talk to Lorna during the First Steps in Erinn quest has been fixed.It has been fixed so the Item Equipping and Usage quest flow started shortly after completing the previous quest.The content of the Talent selection window has been changed when rebirthing or creating a character.The Glyphwrighting talent is excluded from the recommended talent.Magic talent and Gunslinger talents are added to the recommended talent list.The NEW mark of Glyphwrighting talent has been removed.A preset function is added when creating a character for the first time.When creating a character, you will be able to set the appearance based on several presets with premium appearances.Character presets can only be used when creating a character using a character card that can use a premium appearance, such as a Novice card.If you are using a character card that cannot use a premium appearance, the character appearance can be selected in the same way as before.Some appearances have been changed to premium appearances, indicated by the ‘P’ icon.These appearances can be selected by creating a character using a character that can use premium appearances, or by using a Pon during Rebirth or in the Dressing Room.Beginner Benefits have been updated.The criteria for Beginner Benefits has been increased to characters under cumulative level 10,000.Free warp using the Traveler’s Guide has been increased up to level 10,000.It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive 3 types of beginner potion items when logging in.It has been changed so that beginner characters do not receive Heart Sticker items when logging in.All heart sticker items will be deleted.Heart Points Info has been removed from the Character Info > Additional Info menu.The reduced time between Rebirths of a beginner character has been changed as follows:Cumulative level 1 ~ 4,999: 1 day (24 hours)Cumulative level 5,000 ~ 7,999: 2 days (48 hours)Cumulative level 8,000 ~ 9,999: 4 days (96 hours)Cumulative level 10,000 or more: 6 days (144 hours)The [Return Incentive] Explorers League Patronage quest which can start the Returned Milletian benefits will no longer be available.You can continue to use the benefits you have already received and the ongoing Ten Missions of the Returned Milletian quests until the validity period of the Returned Milletian title expires.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1120/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussonforums-nxabtn.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1121/nxa-buttons-150x35-discussondiscord-7289dabtn.png

Help out Imp Fizzy and Imp Dizzy with their requests! Play a new mini-game each week to earn Fresh Dewdrops, then exchange them in Fizzy’s Exchange Shop for new rewards! Check out all the details below.
Event Details
Event Dates: Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] I'm trying to find a Milletian.Find Imp Fizzy in Dunbarton Square.Register a main character with Fizzy the Imp.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] I'm trying to find a Milletian:10,000 EXPFizzy’s Request itemThis item can be used to play mini-games or view information about them.Unlock the Daily Event quests and Achievement Quest.The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.Daily and Weekly Quest DetailsEach week, different mini-games will be unlocked! All mini-games will be available throughout the event period, however the Daily quest will change depending on the week.You can receive the mini-game rewards a total of 5 times a day, regardless of which mini-game you play.This resets daily at 7:00 AM PT.The EXP rewards from successfully completing mini-games are doubled during the weekend! Weekend: Saturday 7:00 AM PT to Monday 6:59 AM PT(Excludes Fresh Dewdrops rewards)
Week 1 (Thursday, November 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 10th, Before Maintenance)

Crack the Coded Box

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1385/crack-the-coded-box-ui.png
On Week 1, you will receive the Daily Quest, Crack the Coded Box!Dizzy and Fizzy need help unlocking all the boxes that have different passcodes!Play the mini-game by using the Fizzy’s Request item and select Crack the Coded Box.You will be required to create a mini-game party. After creating the party, click “Start mini-game” through the Party menu [Default key: P] to begin!You can play the mini-game alone or in a party up to 8.In a party, EXP rewards are granted based on the party member’s rank. The Fresh Dewdrops reward is rewarded the same in a party or alone.You can attempt to unlock a box 10 times. There is a time limit.Once the timer hits 0 and the round is over, the number of correct digits in the correct spot will be displayed under the Circle column and the number of correct digits in the incorrect spot will be displayed under the Triangle column. Incorrect digits in the incorrect spot will be displayed under the X column.When you complete the daily quest by playing the mini-game 1 time, you will receive the following rewards:15,000 EXP 3,000 Gold50 Fresh DewdropsAfter successfully finding the correct code, you will receive the following rewards:30,000 EXP or up to 100,000 EXP when in a party10 Fresh Dewdrops

Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
The Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update is here. See the full post for more information: Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess can now be replayed.New Replay Rewards such as the new Homestead items, including the Jukebox and Goddess Statue, Title, and Journal Achievements are available. NPC Voiceover, in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole, with graphic updates and minor quest changes.The Chapter Info menu has been replaced with the Storyline Menu with improved generation information.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Several changes to the Campfire Spirit have been implemented.The cooldown for obtaining Burning Firewood has changed to be within 5 to 10 hours. The duration of the Burning Firewood and Campfire Invitation items have been reduced from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.Improvements have been made so that, when burning an item in a campfire, an additional notice message appears during the time period when Burning Firewood can appear.Brielle and Gillach have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited through the Campfire Invitation.Brielle: Cotton Cloud CandyGillach: Tourmaline 10cmThe reward items sent by some NPCs after using a Campfire Invitation have been changed to the following items:Duncan: Physical Power Potion (1 hour)Castanea: Magic Power Potion (1 hour)Melwyn: Stardust Dye AmpouleSeasonal Commerce Imbolic Season 2 will begin on November 1st, 2022.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue with certain G3 cutscenes not playing and deducting gold when using the Crystal Ball.Fixed untranslated notice message when using Supply List item during trade action.Fixed several names of Enchant Scrolls that Stewart requests to exchange for Restoration Powder are incorrect. (Sheep Raising is Sheperd's, Excavator is Digger, Gusty is Windy, Boar is Wild Boar, Earthling is Earthen)Fixed the unnecessary line breaks within the Field Raid Messenger's dialogue.
Fixed the few text discrepancies when a Field Raid boss monster attempts to recover or recovers from Pragarah and Brionac attacks.Fixed the known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".Fixed the line break issue in the notice message when burning an item in a campfire.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Minimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.

notes.title: Masterpiece Chapter 1 Update
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1203/221011_octoberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngUpdate DetailsChapter 1 Advent of the Goddess can now be replayed.
If you have played all of G1 Advent of the Goddess, you can replay G1.If you have played all of G2 Paladin, you can replay G2.If you have played all of G3 The Dark Knight, you can replay G3. However, side quests cannot be replayed. You can obtain the C1 Replay Reward Box by completing the replay.NPC Voiceover, in Korean, has been added to NPCs appearing in Chapter 1 throughout the generation quests.The volume of the voice can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Voice Volume.Voices are not provided in general conversations and keyword conversations.A microphone icon is displayed in the upper left corner of the NPC's chat window when voiceover is playing.Audio is not provided for lines without this microphone icon.Voices are also provided for Chapter 1 NPC's speech bubbles.The volume may be loud or low depending on the distance from the character.The volume of the speech bubbles can be adjusted in Options > System > Sound > Sound Effect Volume.Chapter 1 Advent of the Goddess will be renewed as a whole.Quest information for some of Chapter 1's quests has been improved to provide more detail.Some story dialogue has been improved throughout the Chapter 1 Generations. Some changes to cutscenes and RP dungeons have been added, including graphic overhauls for major Chapter 1 NPCs such as Mari, Ruairi, and Tarlach. The pictures that appear during quests have been adjusted to a larger size.The length of Math dungeon in some quests has been shortened.The difficulty of some RP dungeons in some G2 quests has been adjusted lower.The length of Baol dungeon in some G3 quests has been shortened.During the first playthrough of Chapter 1, the Goddess Teleportation Support Scroll items will be provided for movement convenience.This scroll can be used to move to a Moon Gate location.The time for receiving certain quests has been shortened, and the quest dialogue will indicate the amount of time to wait to receive the next quest.The performance of the Adventurer’s items received when playing the Chapter 1 quests for the first time has been increased.The Smash Enhancement and Decreased Durability Loss set effects have been added and will activate when equipping all 4 Adventurer’s items. A Clear Reward Box can now be obtained when clearing the G1, G2, and G3 generation quests for the first time, containing Gold, EXP, AP, and an Adventurer’s Bag Coupon (7x7).Notice: Some character’s quest status for “Old Advent of the Goddess” quests have been reorganized.“Old Advent of the Goddess” refers to quests from Pre-Genesis Chapter 1 (G1~G3) received before June 2012.Characters who log in after the update will receive the proper quest progress automatically and the status will be revised to the progress of current "Advent of the Goddess" quests.G1~G3 completion rewards will be sent to the character's mailbox.Title/Journal achievements will automatically be obtained when logging in after 10/20 (Thu) maintenance.Data related to the "Gathering Dark Knight Armor Pieces" quests will not be reset.The “Bind” quest will be removed from all characters.Storyline Menu
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1190/storyline_menu.png
The existing Chapter Info menu has been updated to the Storyline Menu with improved information.You can start a Generation directly through the Storyline Menu. You can check the Summary information of the Chapter, story information by Generation, and detailed story information alongside quest progression.Chapter: Shows chapter information, distinguishing the Generations within the Chapter. Generation: Shows the generation information, including starting conditions, and completion reward information.Quest: You can check the list of quests that make up the story.Story Guide: You can check the information necessary to progress the story depending on which part of the story is selected in the menu.You can check your character's Chapter progress at a glance.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1176/ch_ns.png Chapter has not been started.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1175/ch_ip.png A Generation within the Chapter is 'In progress'.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1174/ch_complete.png You have completed all of the Generations of that chapter.You can also check your character's Generation progress.  https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1178/g_ip.png   The Generation is 'In progress'  https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q4/1177/g_complete.png   You have completed all of the quests of that Generation.Generation ReplayThe Replay function is added so that you can begin the story again at any time.Only Chapters that have already been completed can be replayed.To replay a single generation, you must complete all Generations in the Chapter that the Generation belongs to.For example, to replay G1, you must clear all of G1, G2, and G3 to complete Chapter 1 first.The Replay function is currently only available for Chapter 1: G1, G2, and G3 storylines.Replays can be started by using 3,000 gold. The replay is specific to each story part in the Storyline menu.Only 5 stories per day per character can be replayed, and only one story can be replayed at a time.The daily replay count is reset at 7:00 AM PDT.You can complete a replay immediately using 50,000 gold, 1 Pon, or 1 Instant Replay Completion Ticket to receive a C1 Replay Reward Box.However, this does not count towards the “Completed Replays” completion count (Title and Journal Achievements).While undergoing a replay, you can Forfeit Replay, however the 3,000 Gold is not refunded.Even if the replay is canceled through this method, the replay will still count towards the daily replay count.Replay RewardsYou can check the total number of replay completions for your character in the Storyline > Replay Rewards section of ​​the Storyline Generation Info window.Regardless of the selected story, the total number of replays completed by your character is displayed in this section.

After completing a total of 100 replays, you will be awarded the 1st title, Master Storyline Binger.

notes.title: Quality of Life and Raid Improvements - Patch Notes - September 22nd
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out this month's Patch Notes below!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeStudy Event Season 2: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 29th, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Check-In Attendance Season 2: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceAbsolute Box: Thursday, September 8th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 6th, Before MaintenanceYoung Miss and Master Box: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 20th, Before MaintenanceBalloon Festival Returns: Thursday, September 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 27th, Before MaintenanceSeptember Quality of Life Updates: PermanentField Raid Improvements: Permanent
Field Raid Improvements
Several changes have been added to the Field Raid system. See the full post for more information: Field Raid ImprovementsChanges to the Field Raid schedules have been made.Field Raid Announcements have been improved with more detailed information.Contribution quests have been renewed.Earn Field Raid Mementos when defeating Field Raid monsters and exchange them for materials.And more!
September Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: September Quality of Life UpdatesImprovements to Enchanting and Special Upgrades have been added: Improvements have been made to the Inventory Search function with a new Inventory list menu and new item tags. UI Improvements have been added for Synthesis, Fragmentation, Metal Conversion, and Mana CrystallizationThe flashy effects for skill rank-up, Critical Hits, Meteor Strike, etc. have been reduced.You can now sell Fynni Pet Whistles all at once to Fionnait.And more!
The following changes have been made to the game:
As announced, prior to the upcoming NX Merge, changes to the Trade Restriction Protection system have been made.For security reasons, there are restrictions on how NX can be spent. When NX is purchased for the first time on an account and when certain other criteria are met, the Trade Restriction Protection begins and a 4-day restriction timer is started on the account. The account will be restricted from certain trade-related actions in-game. Players will be notified in-game when attempting the restricted trade actions.The criteria in place that requires a certain Cumulative Level limit to purchase certain Cash items in the Mabinogi Item Shop have been removed.Information regarding Enchant Burning has been added to the Enchant and Campfire Skill Descriptions and several related menus. With the August update, there were several issues with Campfire Spirit contents. Since these changes were not stable, the following changes have been removed:Gifts from some NPCs had been changed.You could invite some NPCs that hadn't officially been added.Fixed a typo in the mini-map for Errans Gorge name.Fixed an issue with not being able to end the dialogue with the Fashion Contest Helper.Fixed an issue where the Cherry Delight 2nd title appeared untranslated.Fixed a typo in the listed items for Finishing Materials for Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.Fixed an issue in south Pantay Swamp mini-map where Lutra River appeared untranslated.Fixed an issue in La Terra Highland mini-map with the Mana Tunnel appearing untranslated.
The following are known issues:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.Found an issue with the Fahmes Ruin ranking rewards distribution and further investigation is in progress. If you are affected by this issue, please submit a Player Support Ticket.There are unnecessary line breaks within the Field Raid Messenger's dialogue.There are a few text discrepancies when a Field Raid boss monster attempts to recover or recovers from Pragarah and Brionac attacks.Several names of Enchant Scrolls that Stewart requests to exchange for Restoration Powder are incorrect.Sheep Raising is Sheperd's, Excavator is Digger, Gusty is Windy, Boar is Wild Boar, and Earthling is EarthenMinimizing the game client for an extended period of time while at an active Field Raid may cause the window to stop responding.

notes.title: [Updated] Field Raid Improvements
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2035/220919-mbw-2843-fieldraidrevamp-940x290.jpg

Field Raid Improvements are here! New Raid schedules, improved announcements, and Field Raid Mementos can be collected to exchange for guaranteed rewards.
Field Raid DetailsField Raid Boss monsters only appear on designated channels: Channel 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10.White Dragon and Black Dragon Summon Scrolls can be used regardless of channel.The Field Raid announcements have been improved with more detailed information.The Quest zone will open and announcements will take place 3 minutes before the start of a Raid. The announcement will include the channel, time, and region for the Raid. Announcements will appear in all channels.A dedicated “Field Raid” tab has been added to the chat window.Scrolling announcements appearing at the top of the screen can be turned off in Options > Game > ETC. > View Field Raid AnnouncementsEven when the announcements are turned off, you can check the announcements in the Field Raid tab of the chat window.Announcements do not appear for Raids started through a summon scroll.The Field Raid Messenger will always be available in the following towns: Tir Chonaill, Dunbarton, Tara, Filia, and Vales.You must have completed G3 in order to see the Messenger.Talk to the Messenger for more information about the Field Raids.When a Field Raid monster spawns, you can talk to the Messenger with Move to Field Raid to select an ongoing Raid and move to the location.The improved Raid Schedule can be found in the Traveler’s Guide > Raid menu, including Raid information for Sylvan Dragon and Mokkurkalfi. It has been changed so that Field Raid monsters appear at a fixed time, not randomly during a specific time range. The Field Raid will start at certain times on certain days.Appears on the hour (White Dragon, Black Dragon)Appears at 15 minutes of the hour (Red Dragon, Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon)Appears at 30 minutes of the hour (Mokkurkalfi, Sylvan Dragon)Appears at 35 minutes of the hour (Ifrit, Mammoth, Yeti)Appears at 45 minutes of the hour (Giant Lion, Giant Alligator, Giant Sandworm)Raids do not spawn from 2:15 AM PDT to 10:00 AM PDT.Contribution and RewardsContribution is a score that shows how much you contributed during a Field Raid.Contribution can be earned by attacking the Raid monster, summoned enemies during the Raid, healing or resurrecting other Milletians, or other methods depending on the Field Raid Quest.The Field Raid quest zone is activated 3 minutes before the Field Raid monster appears.Contribution cannot be acquired before the monster appears.Field Raid Quests are automatically received when entering the Field Raid quest zone. For the Sylvan Dragon Raid, the quests are received after selecting a role.Some existing quests and Contribution methods have been revised.You will now receive a Hunter’s Role or Vanguard’s Role quest related to the Field Raid monster. The requirement to use Smash and Magnum Shot skills has been removed.The amount of Contribution that can be obtained by attacking the Raid monster has been increased.The contribution value that is reduced due to death has been increased.You can check how you can obtain Contribution from the quest in the ‘Field’ tab of the Quest window.In some Field Raids, your Contribution may decrease upon death: Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon, Red Dragon, White Dragon, Black Dragon, Sylvan Dragon, MokkurkalfiThe amount of gold you can receive from a successful Raid increases according to the Contribution obtained, up to a maximum of 50,000 gold.There is a minimum Contribution required in order to obtain the main rewards from a successful Field Raid. The minimum contribution of some Field Raids has changed.Prairie Dragon, Desert Dragon, Red Dragon, White Dragon, and Black Dragon: 5000 ContributionMokkurkalfi and Sylvan Dragon: 1500 ContributionThe more Contribution you earn, the more likely you will obtain the main rewards. Contribution for the maximum main rewards probability has been increased. If your Contribution is below a certain level, you will not be able to obtain major rewards, including new Field Raid Mementos.Field Raid Mementos can now be earned by defeating Field Raid monsters.The amount of Field Raid Mementos earned is based on the defeated Field Raid and your Contribution.[table][tr][th]Field Raid Boss Monster[/th][th]Quantity of Mementos Obtained by Contribution Level[/th][/tr][tr][th]~4,999 Contribution[/th][th]5,000~49,999 Contribution[/th][th]50,000~ Contribution[/th][/tr][tr][td]Giant Lion, Giant Alligator, Giant Sandworm[/td][td]none[/td][td]2 to 99 [/td][td]100~[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ifrit, Yeti, Mammoth[/td][td]none[/td][td]               1 to 30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Prairie Dragon, Red Dragon, Desert Dragon[/td][td]none[/td][td]5 to 199[/td][td]200~[/td][/tr][tr][td]White Dragon, Black Dragon[/td][td]none[/td][td]10 to 249 [/td][td]250~[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sylvan Dragon, Mokkurkalfi[/td][td]none[/td][td]6 to 299[/td][td]300~[/td][/tr][/table]Field Raid Mementos can be exchanged through the Field Raid Messenger for rewards.[table][tr][th]Type[/th][th]Item[/th][th]Cost

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 22nd, 2022
notes.content:
The maintenance has been completed at 11:48 AM PDT. Thanks for your patience.

Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 22nd. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 6:00 AM PDT and last approximately 6 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

Thursday, September 22nd


Pacific (PDT, UTC -7): 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Eastern (EDT, UTC -4): 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC +2): 3:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Weekly server upkeep.The September Quality of Life Updates has arrived, along with the new Field Raid Improvements!We hope you've had enough tea to drink, because the sale of the Fairytale Gardener Box sale is ending.Get ready to snuggle up to some new plushies in your brand-new comfortable cardigans with the Young Miss and Master Box sale!You'll be blown away with the returning Balloon Festival Event! notes.title: September Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2020/220916_septemberupdate_socials_newsarticleheader_940x290.pngSeptember Quality of Life UpdatesEnchant & Special Upgrade Experience ImprovementsThe [Suffix] and [Prefix] tag has been added to the item description of an enchanted item.The result of failing an Enchant or Special Upgrade has been changed. If an enchantment of rank 6 or higher fails, the item status is changed to the (Unable to enchant) state instead of being destroyed.If the special upgrade of level 6 or higher fails without using a Protective Upgrade Stone, the item will be changed to the (Unable to Special Upgrade) status instead of being destroyed. The status of the item is displayed with a red background, and in the item’s name and item description.The following search filters have been added to the Auction House’s Advanced search settings to filter items by the Enchant or Special Upgrade status.Enchant Enabled - Available or Unavailable optionSpecial Upgrade - Available or Unavailable optionThe function of the Enchant Protection Potion has been changed to protect items from receiving the (Unable to enchant) status if the enchantment fails, instead of protecting the item from item destruction.You will be unable to use an Enchant Protection Potion on an item that already has this status applied to it. The status must be removed through NPC Stewart.The function of Protective Upgrade Stones have been changed to protect items from receiving the (Unable to Special Upgrade) status, instead of protecting the item from item destruction.Enchant Recovery Essence, Special Upgrade Recovery Essence, Restoration Scroll and Restoration Powder items have been added.The Enchant Recovery Essence and Special Upgrade Recovery Essence can be crafted using Handicraft Rank 5 or higher.[table][tr][th]Crafting Materials[/th][/tr][tr][th]Enchant Recovery Essence[/th][th]Special Upgrade Recovery Essence[/th][/tr][tr][td]-Magic Powder (10)

Using the Enchant Recovery Essence will remove the (Unable to Enchant) status from the item. Talk to Stewart using the Exchange Enchant option to convert specific Enchant Scrolls into Restoration Powder.The Enchant Scroll that can be exchanged for each day of the week is changed every Odd/Even month.Each Enchant Scroll can be exchanged for one Restoration Powder.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2039/09222022-patch-notes-table.pngEdern:Talk to NPC Edern using the Nearby Rumors keyword to unlock the Remove Special Upgrade Unavailability option.Talk to Edern using the Remove Special Upgrade Unavailability option with Special Upgrade Recovery Essence to select an item to use it on. Using the Special Upgrade Recovery Essence will remove the (Unable to Special Upgrade) status from the item. The repair cost increase indication on an Enchant Scroll or when enchanted on an item has been changed to “Repair Fee +OOO%”.For example, the Repair Fee x5 of the Foretold Enchant Scroll has been reduced and changed to Repair Fee +200%The repair cost multiplier of the following enchantments has been reduced:900% > 100%: Rocket Arrow, Designer, Deadly Blow, Robin Hood, Intense, Encyclopedic, Sage Stone, Master of Martial Arts, Will of Doll, Rapid Fire Maniac, Wild Ninja, Chained in Darkness 900% > 300%: Moist, Fresh900% > 400%: Novel, Rift, Solitude, Pillar, Roaring, Exiled, Guardian600% > 300%: Interlocking, Sniping, Disaster400% > 300%: Girgashiy400% > 200%: Reliable, Stunning, Division, Knocking, Apathetic, Key, Encore, Sonata, Conqueror, Running, Cartel, Clashing, Spiraling, Agile, Melting, Raging, Amplified, Frozen, Chorus, Used, Dazed, Release, Scholar, Foretold, Meteoroid, Supernova, 56th Floor, 67th Floor300% > 200% : Brainstorm, Nobility, Timid, Paradise200% > 100% : Virtuous, Ample, Amnesia, Glorious, Welcome, Seething, Tripod, Sparring, Allegory, Coma, Experienced, Ensemble, Resolution, Long-lasting, Solar Eclipse, Trader, Nebula, Might, Target, Tournai, Symbolic, Created, Genius, Resistance, Proficient, Challenger, Backbreaking, Heroic, Dreamlike, 35th Floor, 48th FloorThe repair cost multiplier has been removed from the following enchantments:Thin, Small, Vicious, Scrap, Goddess's, Obsidian, Caliburn, Alchemist's, Broken ArrowInventory Improvements
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2024/inventory_magnifying_glass.png
The item Search function in the inventory has been improved.The Inventory Magnifying Glass menu provides functions to search for existing items and displays search results in the form of an inventory list.The search by term function is available within this menu.Items can be filtered by the following options:By Name: Items are displayed in numerical and alphabetical order.By Period: Only items with an expiration date are displayed in the list.NEW: Only items with the NEW status are displayed in the list.By Size: Items by inventory size are displayed in the order from smallest to largest.These filters are sorted in ascending order, and can be sorted in descending order by pressing the filter button once more.Items can be sorted by bag Tags or by Favorites.You can sort by the item type, such as equipment, gems, dyes, etc.Items can have a Favorite tag added to them to sort and organize items with specific icon tags.Only 6 items can be designated per icon.Only items stored in the following bags or inventory slots can be searched:Character’s inventory bagsEquipment slots, including Style TabExtra Equipment slotsSoul Stream Inventory,Master Plan Inventory,Falias relic slotsStardust slotItems stored in the Echostone Slot, Point Inventory, Bank, Pet inventory, etc. cannot be searched with this menu.The option to Open with Inventory can be turned on or off within the menu. If this option is checked, the Inventory Magnifying Glass menu will open when opening the inventory.Clicking on an item within this menu allows you to pick up the item.Right-clicking an item within this menu has the same behavior as right-clicking the item in the inventory.You can use Alt+Click when selecting items from this menu to sell to NPCs, trade, move to crafting menus, or add items to a pet’s inventory.Additional ChangesThe transparency of the flash effect that appears in the following situations has been adjusted:Skill rank upTechnique rank upSpirit level upPet skill rank upFynn SlashChargeSmashMagnum ShotLance ChargeCrash ShotWindmillSand BurstFlash LauncherShooting RushFireballLightning RodShuriken ChargeKunai StormThe Small Ice Pillar has been added to drop when Wendigo, the boss of Par Ruins Dungeon (Snow Crystal), uses the Stomp skill.The Small Ice Pillar can be used by humans and elves and has the same effect on Wendigo as the Ice Pole.If you defeat Wendigo while equipping the Small Ice Pillar, the Mirror Witch will spawn.It has been changed so that you can sell multiple Fynni Pet Whistles at once through Fionnait using any of the following methods:Sell Individually: The selected Fynni Pet Whistles will be sold.Sell All: All Fynni Pet Whistles in your inventory will be sold.Sell by Rank: All Fynni Pet Whistles of the selected rank in the inventory will be sold.If you choose 'Sell All' or 'Sell by Rank' while holding 30 or more Fynni Pet Whistles, only 30 whistles will be sold. (30 Pet Whistles can be sold each real-life day.)The Fynni Blossoming Cage UI has been changed so that Fynni Gems can be placed in the cage quickly when pressing the "Alt" key when clicking on a Fynni Gem in the inventory.You will now be able to exit or enter even when having the following active summons for Avalon Gate, Berg Mesa/Sanctum, and Festia:. Pet (It is not possible while mounted.)PartnerDoll BagMini-gemIt is not possible to move if there is a summons from a Lord item (collaboration items). You will be able to enter missions while in a party that you could not enter before with a pet summoned.RP mission entered through Shakespeare's JournalOutlaw's Homestead PassThe restricted area around the Emain Macha Performance Stage has been reduced. During performances, skills, summons, transformations, etc. will be restricted while within the area.The UI menus for Synthesis, Fragmentation, Metal Conversion, and Mana Crystallization (Crystal Making) have been improved. When using a Dry Oven, you can select between Synthesis, Fragmentation, Conversion and use it independently.Changes have been made so that each production UI can also be opened using the Synthesis, Fragmentation, Metal Conversion, and Mana Crystallization skills within the Skill menu.The UI has been changed to be the same as the existing Life Skill UI format.It has been modified so that material items can be registered with Alt+click.The Auto Register Tools and Materials function has been added to Metal Conversion and Mana Crystallization skills.A "Favorite" function that allows you to register frequently used synthesis recipes for the Synthesis skill has been added. Up to 20 recipes can be favorited at one time.You can use the Auto Register Tools and Materials function for Synthesis after selecting a registered favorite.When using the Synthesis skill, even if the number of registered material items is greater than the required number, only the required number of materials will be consumed.Metal Conversion recipes to convert 10 or 100 materials at a time has been added to Rank 1 of the skill.More materials are required than when converting one by one, and skill training and success bonuses are acquired only once. An issue where the acquisition ratio of Mandrake and Base Herb was reversed when fragmenting HP and Stamina Potions will be fixed.When using the Catering skill, it has been modified so that material items can be registered to the skill menu with Alt+click.The frequency of monsters entering the deadly status has been reduced as follows:It has changed so that deadly does not occur when killing monsters with a critical attack.The higher the damage you deal to the monster, the lower the deadly chance, and if the damage is more than 80% of the total health, the deadly will not occur.The objective to put 10 Fox enemies in a deadly condition in the '[Exploit Weakness] Ultimate Strike' Technique quest has been changed to defeat 10 foxes in one strike.The Bangor Moon Gate has been moved into Bangor next to the Trading Post.The speed at which a weapon’s durability is decreased when using the following skills has been reducedWarrior: BashMagic: Thunder, Fireball, Ice Spear, Lightning Bolt, Firebolt, Icebolt, Fusion BoltAlchemy: Flame Burst, Water Cannon, Shock, Frozen Blast, Sand Burst, Heat Buster, Wind Blast

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/2023/mabinogi-stardust-change-appearance_new.png
The Stardust appearance change function has been improved.You can now set the appearance of all 5 Stardust orbs individually.You can select the appearance of any grade and mix and match Stardust appearances. Within the Change Stardust Appearance menu, you can select a Stardust orb, then select any unlocked Stardust Appearance to change to that appearance. The icon of Null (Blank) Stardust has been changed to a transparent icon.Note that the appearance of the Stardust can only be changed based on the currently reached Stardust Rank. (Rank 15 to unlock all 5 orbs, or all 4 appearances of a style)When using the Rain Casting skill, a circle effect on the ground will display the effective range for the duration of the skill. This effect is only visible by the caster or members in a party with the caster.The Potion Poisoning Danger condition has been added.If you are under the condition, you can check the current potion poisoning level and the threshold of potion poisoning in the Character Status Effects List.The amount of potion poisoning accumulated when using recovery potions has been lowered, and the threshold for potion poisoning has been adjusted according to the character's HP, MP, and Stamina, making it less prone to poisoning.HP, MP, and Stamina 50, 100, and 300 potions have been added to the following NPC shops:Tir Chonaill: DilysDunbarton: ManusEmain Macha: AgnesBangor: ComganTaillteann: Royal Guard PhysicianTara: NessaBelvast: Beirnes Tech Duinn Lobby: Royal PhysicianCrom Bas: Belvast MedicQilla Base Camp: HeulfrynFilia: AtrataVales: KirineCor: KousaiCalida Exploration Camp: BelitaScathach Patrol Camp: SieveRemote Healer CouponThe Skip Cutscene with ESC option has been added.This option can be checked on or off in the Options > Game > Control tab.When you press the ESC key, you can skip the cutscene right away, without a confirmation popup.However, for some content cutscenes, you can use the skip function only after completing the content.In the Iria Ruins Dungeon, the effect where monsters “hide” and cannot be targeted until this status stops has been changed.Depending on the dungeon room, the monsters will not hide, or if you defeat all of the preceding monsters, the monsters will immediately stop hiding.

notes.title: Upcoming NX Prepaid and NX Credit Merge
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

In early October, we will be making a major change to how NX, the paid currency for many Nexon games including Mabinogi, is handled. With this change, NX Prepaid and NX Credit will be merged, with every Nexon player's balance of the two currencies being combined together. We hope to make for a simpler process for our customers, no longer having to sort out between the two forms of currency, and how each is acquired.

As part of this, within an upcoming Mabinogi update, there will be some changes to how certain Cash Shop purchases and actions function, in order to prevent fraudulent charges and protect the game economy. These changes include:
Level Restriction on Cash Shop purchases will be removed from all items.Trade Restrictions will be changed to accomodate the combined NX currency.Note: First Charge restrictions that are in place for NX Credit will also be applied to the merged NX. If you have cleared those restrictions in the past, then that status will be carried over to the new merged NX.
We will let you know more as the update approaches.

- The Mabinogi Team

Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Morrighan outfit set. And if you finish the attendance calendar before the end of the event, there is a bonus attendance calendar with more rewards! Check out the details below.

Event Details

Event Dates: Thursday, September 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 24th, Before Maintenance
During the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] A Girl's Request.Find A Girl in Need in front of the Unicorn Statue.Register for the event with A Girl in Need.Registration is available for the account, so you can participate in the event on any character.Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 9 days of log in.You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.You will only receive 1 stamp per day.Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).Rewards that weren’t claimed from the event calendar can be claimed by talking to Lorna in various Uladh towns.The rewards will be available for 1 week after the event ends from Thursday, November 24th, After Maintenance - December 1st, Before Maintenance.When talking to Lorna after the event has ended, any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character's Point Shop Inventory.

If you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for 29 Pon.The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1264/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-purchase-ui.png

Check out this month's Patch Notes below!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice2022 Summer Master Plan: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance

Quality of Life Updates:
Several quality of life changes have been added. See the full post for more information: August Quality of Life UpdatesEnchant Scrolls can now be traded once. (Applies to scrolls obtained after the August 25th update.)Bag Order Settings have been added, so you can control the order of where obtained items go into your inventory.New changes have been added to the Friends List.And more!
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.Fixed an issue where players would encounter NGS errors more often.Fixed various typos and grammar errors in some Commerce related tooltips.Fixed an issue where players would abnormally receive the Memento Scenario event quest.Fixed an issue where a character's neck would become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.There is untranslated text in the mini-map at La Terra Highland zone and south Pantay Swamp zone.There is a typo in the world map for Errans Gorge.
