Partner's Gift Box, Partner Laighlinne's Gift Box, and Partner William's Gift Box. Barri Basic Fomor PassBarri Intermediate Fomor PassFiodh Intermediate Fomor PassRabbie Basic Fomor PassRabbie Intermediate Fomor PassMath Basic Fomor PassMath Intermediate Fomor PassCoill Basic Fomor PassCoill Intermediate Fomor PassItems will now automatically bundle in the inventory when purchased from an NPC shop (Ctrl+Click) or when acquiring the following items:Pet Expedition rewardsAdventurer SealFestia VIP PassDan Advancement BadgeFull Recovery Potion and Massive Holy Water of Lymilark when acquired from VIP Advanced ItemsOnyx and Fine Onyx (during Halloween Events)Note: This only applies to items without duration or trade count limits. It has been changed so that the "Rebirth" option in the character lobby is available only for pets that have a corresponding pet character card.The "Get Same Animal Character" menu that appears when you right-click another pet character has been removed.When transferring Erg to a weapon that has been trade unlocked, it has been changed so that the trade unlock status is maintained.It has been changed so that when you obtain an Exclusive Enchant Scroll, it can now be traded one time. This includes enchantments received from monsters, treasure chests, or quest rewards. This change applies to items obtained after the August 25th update.Exclusive Enchant Scrolls obtained through Enchant Burning will not be eligible for the one-time trade count.Note: The Scroll Trade Unlock Potion cannot be used on Exclusive Enchant Scrolls that have remaining trade counts.The "Complete All" function has been added to both the Baltane Squire’s Special Unit Training Board and Pet Expedition Bulletin Board so you can complete all ongoing missions at once.The "Exclude Song Part" checkbox has been added to Composing. When selected, the Song part is excluded, and the available characters are distributed evenly between the Melody, Harmony 1, and Harmony 2 parts so that you can compose longer Score Scrolls.Several changes have been made to the Friends List and message function to be more convenient.It has been changed so that the friend request window does not disappear if the channel is changed while receiving a friend request.You can now send and receive messages to others that you do not have added on the Friends List.This can be disabled through the Friends List > Option > "Receive Messages from Friends Only" checkbox setting. Characters who have been blacklisted cannot send or receive messages from the party who blacklisted the character.It has been improved so that the open chat window does not close when changing channels.A new option to disable closing the chat window with the ESC key has been added. This can be enabled through the Friends List > Option > "Disable ESC from Closing Chat Window" checkbox setting.A new function to expand/collapse all groups in the Friends List has been added.All groups can be expanded or collapsed at once via the button added to the Friend Menu. Right click on the group, then select Expand All or Collapse All.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1500/friends_group.pngYou can also expand or collapse all groups at once by double-clicking a group name while holding down the Ctrl key.The Combat and Horn message channels have been added, so it is now possible to separate system messages.You can set up these channels via the Options > Game > Chat > Combat and Horn settings.The notice message when the dungeon is cleared has been simplified for all difficulties of Sidhe Finnachaid (Curiosity, Fear, and Sorrow).You can now skip the cutscene when entering Sidhe Finnachaid by choosing the "Enter (No Cutscene)" option through NPC Enn.The following items can now be registered to a slot in the hotbar.Full Recovery PotionPhoenix FeatherParty Phoenix FeatherAdvanced Phoenix FeatherA change has been made so that the trees will no longer obscure the camera vision in the second area of the Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission.The visibility of the portal pattern on the floor in the Falias area in Alban Knights Training Grounds has been improved.It has been improved so that when the ALT key is pressed to view item name tags, the character name tags will not overlap and change the order of the name tags on the screen.The name tags of summoned doll bags will no longer be visible when the ALT key is pressed.Doll bags can now pick up items that dropped from monsters killed by the Baltane Squires in Baltane Missions.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1499/bag_order_settings.pngA function has been added to allow you to set the order in which items are placed into inventory bags when acquiring new items.The "Bag Order Settings" menu is available as a newly added button at the top of the main inventory.If you set the bag order, items will be placed in the order of the bag starting from number 1.If there are empty slots in the basic inventory (Normal, Me, VIP), items will go into the main inventory first, then the bag inventory.If the bag is tagged, the item is preferentially placed in the bag in which the tag is set.However, in the case of equipment items, even if there are bags that have tags set, they will go into the clothing bag first.

Try again next time!For each correct answer, you will receive Combat EXP or Renown EXP:Combat EXP - 10,000 EXPMusic Renown - 35 EXPLife Renown - 175 EXPYou can change your preferred experience reward as the main character by talking to Locke.If you are not a main character, you cannot change the reward, and you can only receive 1,000 combat experience for each correct answer.If you answer all 30 in a round correctly, you will receive an OX Quiz Gift Box.The main character is eligible to achieve 1st titles according to the results of the OX Quiz. who was Foiled by a Cat (Luck +30)who was SO CLOSE  (Luck +30)the Quiz Pro (Luck +30)

notes.title: Producer’s Letter: 2022 Year End Upcoming Contents
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1304/mbw-2715-220202-producers-letter-news-article-header-940x290.png

Dear Milletians,

It is a pleasure to share more with you in my second Producer’s Letter. Thanks to your support, the Great Era of Commerce update has been completed throughout the Summer. The Mabinogi Team is now focusing on the updates for the second half of the year to bring various and exciting content to you in Autumn and Winter.

To provide you with useful rewards and items, we have prepared a new version of the Portrait Attendance event called the “My Own Attendance” event. You can start the event anytime during the registration period to begin receiving daily rewards. As you may have noticed, this will reward the Mysterious Blue Bag (10x17 inventory slot bag) that we know you’ve been asking for! I hope this will give you a bit more space in your inventory~

I’d like to share more information about the upcoming contents that we expect within the rest of 2022. Here is a preview of what’s to come: 

Quality of Life Updates

Many quality of life updates are being prepared to improve features and options in the game. Some of the notable changes are:

 Inventory Bag re-order function   
 Exclusive Enchant Scrolls can be traded once
 Full Recovery Potions and Phoenix Feathers can be added to the hotbar
 Reduced flashy effects for skill rank-up, Critical Hits, Meteor Strike, etc
 You can sell Fynni Pet Whistles all at once to Fionnait
 Item Enchanting and Special Upgrade Improvements
 Improved Inventory Search function, allowing a list view of the Inventory
 And more!


Field Raid Revamp


 Field Raid Bosses will be rebalanced to become stronger and more resilient.
 Participating in raids will become more convenient (announcement for all channels, fast travel, etc.)
 Rewards improvements
 - A voucher shop will be added for guaranteed prizes.
 - You will be more likely to get rewards if you have a higher contribution. 


Masterpiece C1


 The Chapter Info UI will be revamped.
 Replay feature for Chapter 1 Generations (G1, G2, and G3) will be added. 
 Graphic overhauls for major NPCs from C1. 
 Korean voiceover will be added for NPCs in C1.

Progression Improvements

To help Milletians adapt to Erinn life more easily and improve the beginner’s experience, we will bring multiple updates to Mabinogi.



 The level standard for “Beginner” characters will be increased to 10,000, and you will be able to receive various benefits based on revamped level standards.
 Blaanid’s Memoir will be revamped with better rewards. 
 - Significantly, a lesser version of the Divine Link skill, which could only be obtained through playing G19, will be available through the Memoir.
 - We will also add new rewards that will be useful to beginners, such as pets and doll bags.
 Skill training, Renown, Grandmaster, and leveling for Crusader skills will become a lot easier. 
 - The amount of skill training required will be reduced greatly, especially notable for the skills that required extremely huge amounts of training.
 - Skill training requirements centered around character and monster CP, which has been a hurdle for many Milletians, will be removed.
 - There will also be many other changes including increased Renown EXP, unlocking Crusader sub-skills at once, and more.



Arcana Update


 The Arcana Talent is a new talent that has the characteristics of two combined talents, and it will bring a new charm to your combat experience, different from the other talents.
 This Winter, we will introduce the Elemental Knight – a damage-dealing talent with Close Combat and Magic talents combined – and the Saint Bard – a supporting talent with Holy Arts and Music talents combined, which will both be added as new Arcana Talents.
 Of course, new skills and bonus stats for these talents will be added as well.
 We are also hoping to introduce more and more new Arcana Talents in the future.


We will be reviewing and testing these contents and the plan could change, but I am excited to bring all of these listed contents to you soon! 

Sincerely,
GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce Part 2 - Patch Notes - July 28th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Great Era of Commerce Part 2 update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
2022 Summer Master Plan: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before Maintenance
Return of The Beautiful Lights for the Night Event: Thursday, July 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 4th, Before MaintenanceRoyal Brawler's Box: Thursday, July 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 11th, Before MaintenanceReturn of The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3: Thursday, July 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 18th, Before MaintenanceReturn of the Family Weekend Fishing Event: Friday, July 22nd, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, August 14th, 11:59 PM PDTLet's Fly Together Now!: Thursday, July 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 11th, Before MaintenanceSealed Dragon Pet Box: Thursday, July 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, August 25th, Before MaintenanceThe Great Era of Commerce Part 2 Update: Permanent
Great Era of Commerce Part 2
Take to the skies with the second part of the Great Era of Commerce! For full details, check out the Great Era of Commerce Part 2 update on its dedicated webpost.Merchant Group Commerce is now available.To create a Merchant Group, visit a Merchant Group Commerce Bulletin Board near an Iria Trading Post.Merchant Group Exclusive Trading Posts and exclusive trade goods have been added.Airships have been added exclusively for Merchant Groups.You can now encounter enemies while traveling in airships.New side quests have been added for the Iria Trade Association NPCs.New items have been added to the Trade Merchant shops.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The name of the “Ascension Boost” 2nd Title has been changed to “Ascension”.Some skill ranks of Succubus Fiends from Fahmes Ruin Stage 6 have been reduced.Adjusted the option name and announcement text for the Plain Bandit Badge exchange when speaking to a Trade Merchant.Doll Bags can now be summoned during Commerce.Doll Bags with Movement Speed buffs will be applied to Backpack and Handcart trade mounts.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed the issue where the purchase limit of the Edgy Enchant in the Summer Master Plan shop appeared as 0, and the purchase limit has been removed.Fixed an issue where players using Windows 11 would encounter NGS errors more often.Fixed several text issues on the Connous map.Fixed the typo for Belvast on the World Map.Fixed four Sewing Patterns that showed no data.Fixed an issue where talking to Iven or Eirwana while being in a Commerce Trade and having a Stowaway ticket would show XML text.Fixed several text issues on the Rano map.Fixed the NPC name for Reminiscing Old Man.Fixed an issue where the was a space in front of the name "Fragrant Wild Rose Outfit (F)", causing it to be at the top of the Tailoring List.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.There is untranslated text in the mini-map at La Terra Highland zone and south Pantay Swamp zone.

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce - Part 2
notes.content:
Merchant Group CommerceMerchant Group Commerce is now available.
This is a party group where 2 to 8 party members can do Commerce together.Merchant Group Commerce can only be formed at the Qilla, Fillia, Cor, and Vales trading posts.Group trading can only be performed in Iria.There are two types of group trading: 
On-Foot Travel when trading on land.Air Travel when trading by air.Visit the Merchant Group Commerce Bulletin Board near an Iria trading post to create a new group.
Merchant group parties cannot be registered to the Party Board.The group leader can choose the method of travel, the starting trading post and the Destination trading post, and modify the Finishing and EXP rules for the party.From the Group Info menu, you can view the group status, transportation method of the party members, or right-click a party member for more options such as appoint a new leader, or check a member’s purchased trade goods information.To start trade for the merchant group, the party leader can purchase trade goods when there are at least 2 people in the group.
Trade goods can only be purchased at the trading post designated as the launch point.When the leader purchases trade goods and trading starts, no additional party members can be recruited until the trade ends.Once the leader has purchased the trade goods, members can purchase trade goods.You can get additional bonus profits when selling to the trading post designated as the Destination.
Each member can go to any desired trading post and sell trade goods, it does not have to be the Destination point for the merchant group.When all members sell the trade goods, trade ends for the merchant group and new trade goods can be purchased.The Merchant Group Exclusive Trading Posts and exclusive trade goods have been added.
Access to the exclusive trading posts is only possible while in a merchant group.Exclusive trade goods can be bought and sold at the Qilla, Filia, Cor and Vales Trading Posts in Iria.
The number of purchases available for trade goods differs by each trade good at each Trading Post.The number of exchanges available resets weekly on Saturdays at 7 AM PT.The characters within the account share trade counts.All merchant group members can choose and purchase the trade items they want.If you close the Trading Post UI after purchasing a trade item, you cannot purchase again until the trade ends for the group.When one of the party members arrives first at the Destination and sells a trade good, the sale price is fixed for the merchant group.
Party members who arrive late can also sell trade goods at the same price without a drop in the market price.When all members sell trade goods and trade ends, the saved market price ends.On-Foot Travel:Party members can use any transportation methods owned by the individual (Backpack, Camel, etc.).Air Travel:The Airship has been added as a means of transport exclusively for Air Travel while in a Merchant Group.
18 Slots, 2500 WeightAn Air Transport License can be purchased by talking to an Iria Transportation Association NPC.
Requires Seasonal Commerce Rank Silver 5 and 10,000,000 Seasonal Ducats to unlock during the season.The Airship transportation method rental will expire when the Commerce Season is over.If the leader of the merchant group has an Air Transport License, the Airship can be boarded by all members in the group.The Airship can only be operated by the leader of the merchant group. 
Use the Airship controls and click on the ground or select a waypoint on the minimap to move to an area.TIP: Hold Shift and Left Click to select multiple waypoints!You can board the Airship and fly around Iria to trade. All members must board before it can take off.Pets and Partners cannot be summoned while aboard the Airship.A new Event Encounter system has been added during merchant group trading. 
You can encounter it randomly during trade.If one of the merchant group party members triggers an event, all members within a certain range can receive the effect.Different events occur during On-Foot Travel and Air Travel.On-Foot Travel 
Discover an Ancient Stela and interact with it to increase trade profits by 2% for all party members within range. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)Discover hidden chests and open them to find 50,000 to 500,000 Seasonal Ducats within!Air Travel
Two effects can be approached during Air Travel, granting one of the following:
Gust of Wind - increase the Airship’s speed.Wind Essence - recover the Airship’s HP.The encountered enemies while merchant group trading are stronger than the regular trade bandits, so defeat them together with your party members!
During On-Foot Travel, you can encounter bandits during merchant group trading.During Air Travel, you can encounter Wyverns and Red Dragon.Combat missions may occur randomly during Air Travel.
Wyvern Battle: 
Defeat all Wyverns using ranged skills and the Airship’s ballista to earn one of the following buffs. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)
Increased Airship Movement SpeedIncreased Seasonal Ducat acquisition when trade is completedIncreased Merchant Rating when trade is completedIf the Airship’s HP is reduced by 30%, the battle will fail and the Airship Movement Speed will be decreased until the trade ends.Red Dragon Battle:
Attack the Red Dragon using ranged skills and the Airship’s ballista. If you hit the dragon more than a certain number of times, the dragon will retreat and you can earn one of the following buffs. (Effect can stack up to 10 times)
Increased Airship Movement SpeedIncreased Seasonal Ducat acquisition when trade is completedIncreased Merchant Rating when trade is completedIf the group fails to hit the dragon a certain number of times within the time limit, the battle will fail and the Airship Movement Speed will be decreased until the trade ends.When the Airship’s HP reaches 0%, the Airship crashes to the floor, returns 75% of the purchase price of trade goods as Seasonal Ducats, and lowers the Merchant Rating.To prevent the Airship from crashing, all party members must work together to defeat the monsters!Iria Trade Association merchants now sell the following items to help you during Air Travel Battles in the “Merchant Group” tab which can be purchased using Gold:
Enhancement Stone: Increases Ballista's attack speed for a certain period of time during combat.
You will also receive 5 when starting a new trade by Airship.Protection Stone: Airship's durability is not consumed for a certain period of time during combat.
You will also receive 5 when starting a new trade by Airship.Ballista Bolt (Merchant Group): Can be used for the ballista of the Airship during combat.Side Quests related to the Iria Trade Association NPCs have been added. The quests can be obtained by meeting the following requirements: 
Coming Home Late 
Complete G22 and G25Achieve Seasonal Commerce Rank Silver 5 or higherTalk to Sayiv with the keyword “Piran” to receive the quest.High Tea on the High Seas
Achieve Seasonal Commerce Rank Bronze 1 or higherTalk to Igerna with the keyword “Nearby Rumors” to receive the quest.Longing Flowing through the Desert Sea
Complete G17 The Saga Iria Part 1Achieve Seasonal Commerce Rank Gold 5 or higherTalk to Caoimhin with the keyword “Nearby Rumors” to receive the quest.Other Commerce related additions and improvements have been added:
You can obtain the Great Era of Commerce Collection Book from Sayiv.Linden, Sayiv, Igerna, and Caoimhin have been added to the list of NPCs that can be invited using a Campfire Invitation for the Campfire Spirit.7 new Journal Achievements related to the Merchant Group Commerce can be obtained.The following products will be added to the Trade Merchant NPCs and Sayiv’s Shop.
Commerce Mount Extra Style Ticket - Airship (Imbolic) - 150,000,000 Ducats or Seasonal Ducats
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q3/1210/mabinogi-commercept2-imbolic-ship.png
Exchange 10 Million Seasonal Ducats has been added to the Ducat Exchange function of the Trade Merchant NPC

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Team Status Update and News for 2022
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

I am writing to you today to update you on the current status of our team and share a brief outlook of what’s next for us in Mabinogi this year!

Please let me introduce myself; I am GM Mewlynne, your new Mabinogi Producer. It’s nice to meet you! And for those who already know me, hello! We last left off with our Producer, GM Supreme, sharing his farewell as he has moved on from Nexon America. I am honored to have worked alongside Supreme while he was on the team. He is an admirable mentor and friend, and I am proud to be his successor.

To share a bit about myself, I’ve been working with the Mabinogi team since 2016, and have been a Milletian since 2008. I’ve spent countless hours playing, testing, and living my fantasy life in Mabinogi, so I’ve been an advocate for Milletians since the very beginning. I started my journey at Nexon on the Customer Support team before joining the Production team. To be honest, it’s hard to believe that I have made it here; it was always my dream! I will continue to support you and the game moving forward, and I’m very delighted to be in this role. Please give me a bit more time to get settled, and I’d love to see you all in-game for a GM event sometime.

The Mabinogi Team has been working on quite a few things this year. We are so excited to have brought the community together in Erinn and hope to continue the adventures with our upcoming content updates. In the fall, we will first focus on polishing older content with updates such as the Chapter 1 Masterpiece update, Raid improvements, and multiple Quality of Life changes. We are also working hard to bring the progression improvement update that has been recently introduced in Korea along with exciting new talent content to NA by this winter.

I’m looking forward to sharing more details with you in the near future through the Producer’s Letter again.

Sincerely,

GM Mewlynne
Mabinogi Producer

—

Hi Milletians,

I have important news to announce: Friday, July 29th, 2022 will be my last day as your Community Manager, as I will be leaving Nexon America for a new adventure. I have been on the Mabinogi team since 2017 and have been a Milletian since 2008.

My time spent being your Community Manager has been an amazing experience and I will miss each and every one of you. Thank you to everyone on the Mabinogi Team for believing in me and helping me take the next step from a QA tester to a Community Manager. I know that Mabinogi will continue to do great things in my absence; just take a look at all of the exciting updates that we have coming this year alone!

To everyone in the community, thank you for welcoming me with open arms and for attending each and every one of my streams. I loved being your Community Manager and I look forward to seeing your excitement for the upcoming content as a player in the future. Until next time, Milletians.

Sincerely,

Katherz
Queen of Cheese Management
Milletians Don’t Read Club President
 
—

Thank you for your constant support, Milletians. While our team bids farewell to Katherz, she has made an everlasting impact that will not be forgotten. Please join us in Discord and keep an eye on our future posts as we will continue to update you on what’s to come.

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce Part 1 - Patch Notes - June 30th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Great Era of Commerce Part 1 update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
Small Draconian Box: Thursday, June 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 7th, Before MaintenanceShopkeeper's Sale: Commerce Preparations: Thursday, June 16th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 14th, Before MaintenanceThe Secrets of the Commerce Champion: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 28th, Before Maintenance2022 Summer Master Plan: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 1st, Before MaintenanceGlass Trim Box: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 28th, Before MaintenanceDazzling Reforging Tool and Reforging Time Weekends: Thursday, June 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 14th, Before MaintenanceThe Great Era of Commerce Part 1 Update: Permanent
Great Era of Commerce Part 1
Trade has now been expanded into Iria! For full details, check out the Great Era of Commerce Part 1 update on its dedicated webpost.8 new Trading Posts have been added in Iria.There are new NPCs in Iria as part of the Iria Trade Association.There are new daily quests related to Commerce.3 new transportation methods have been added.2 new ports have been added.A new Seasonal Commerce system has been added.Seasonal Ducats are a new type of currency that can be used for trading during a season.The Seasonal Commerce Rank Board has been added.Seasonal Rank Rewards have been added.The Outlaw Pursuit Wanted Board bounty tracking system has been revamped.7 new Outlaws have been added.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The naming format of the “Increases Attack Delay” Set Effect has been changed to “Attack Delay Reduction”.The training method of Commerce Mastery has been changed from Ducats to Seasonal Ducats.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the Production Boost Potion's effect disappeared before calculating the production success rate.Fixed an issue where when you entered Tech Duinn or Baltane Elite Missions, the passes with shorter expiration would appear first in the selection UI.Fixed an issue with active Personal Shops displaying untranslated text when holding down the Alt key.Fixed an issue with two Red Flame Fire Dragons appearing in the Transformation Diary UI.Fixed an issue where the journal achievement for completing 1,000 crafts was stating 100 crafts.Fixed an issue where several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary had text that was cut-off or was overlapping.Fixed some Weaving crafting recipes that were incorrectly labeled:Fabric -> Cheap FabricCommon Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)Silk -> Cheap SilkCommon Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)The material for crafting Ice Silk was incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost ThreadSewing Patterns and Blacksmith manuals showing no data have been fixed and can now be used. Crafting these items will also collect them in the Production Diary.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Existing Guilds cannot create guild stones or invite new members.Some players have encountered an issue when using Fynn Sync for Corgi pets.A further uncommon issue can occur where placing items into the pet's inventory will disappear.

notes.title: Great Era of Commerce - Part 1
notes.content:
Iria Trade ExpansionCommerce has been expanded into the Iria region!Characters who have completed the third Memoir of Blaanid's Brave Boost will receive the quest, [Guide] Iria, the Land of Opportunity.8 Trading Post have been added to the continent of Iria.4 General Trading Posts: Qilla, Filia, Cor and Vales Trading PostsThese Trading Posts function the same as the existing Uladh Trading Posts.Purchase goods using Seasonal Ducats and sell them to other trading posts.4 Barter Trading Posts: Karu Forest, Oasis, Calida, and Pera Trading Posts
These Trading Posts function similarly to the existing Scathach Beach Trading Post. You can exchange materials for trade goods and sell them to other Trading Posts.In order to use the Barter Trading Post, you must reach a Seasonal Commerce Rank of Silver 5.Items required for exchange can be obtained via crafting using life skills, such as Potions, Firewood, Leather, and more.You cannot purchase trade items using Seasonal Ducats at the Barter Trading Posts.The exchange count for exchanging materials for trade goods differs by each trade good at each Barter Trading Post.The number of exchanges available resets weekly on Saturday at 7 AM PT.The characters within the account share trade counts.In the newly added Trading Posts, you can trade with members of the Iria Trade Association, similar to the Merchant Imps on Uladh.New daily quests related to Commerce in Iria have been added.You can receive daily quests from the Iria Commerce Association NPCs at the Iria Trading Posts.New BGM has been added when engaging in Commerce in Iria.Additional Commerce transportation methods are now available, including three types of rental transport mounts:Dog SledCamelTrader's SkiffThese mounts can be rented after unlocking the permanent Commerce transportation methods: Backpack, Wagon, and Elephant.
These mounts can only be rented using Seasonal Ducats.The rental period lasts the duration of the current Commerce trade season, and the mounts must be rented again during the next trade season.After renting both a Dog Sled and Camel, you will be able to rent a Trader's Skiff.Each mount has a different weight capacity and number of slots available for transporting goods.Camels can move quickly in the desert of Connous, and move slower than usual in the snowy areas of Physis.Dog Sleds can move quickly in Physis.Two new ports, Port Connous and Port Sella, have been added. The existing ports, Port Ceann and Port Cobh, have been upgraded.Ships in Port Cobh, Port Qilla, and Port Ceann have been replaced with gigantic ships.Port Sella has been added to Sella Beach in Iria.Port Connous has been added to Connous Beach in Iria.A new port route has been added to Port Ceann on Uladh that leads to Port Sella and Port Connous in Iria.A new port route has been added to Port Cobh on Uladh that leads to Port Qilla.Four new NPCs are available to help you sail and trade with Iria:Igerna (Port Sella - Port Ceann)Caoimhin (Port Connous - Port Ceann)Linden (Port Qilla - Port Cobh)Sayiv (Port Qilla)The existing navigator for Port Cobh, Karis, is now vacationing in Port Connous.A Smuggler NPC has been added to each new port to help smuggle Milletians; Iven at Port Sella and Eirwana in Port Connous.If you bring the Stowaway Ticket item to the Smuggler during the evening and nighttime, you can immediately move to Port Ceann through the Smuggler.Smuggling will decrease your Merchant Rating 20,000 each for all trading posts in Uladh and Iria.Stowaway Tickets can be obtained by Bandits that appear during Commerce and Bandit Hunting.Improvements have been made so that the remaining time until departure and time remaining until arrival during a voyage between ports are displayed.A unique BGM will now play while sailing.Commerce ChangesA new Seasonal Commerce system has been introduced.Seasonal Ducats are a new type of currency used for trading during the season.Earn rewards as you raise your Seasonal Commerce Rank.Place on the Ranking Board to become a Commerce Champion and receive rewards at the end of the season.The market price cost range and Ducat yield of trade goods for each Uladh Trading Post have been improved.The weight and max quantity per slot of some Uladh trade goods have been changed.You can now check the current Market Price for the trade goods you have when you click on the INFO button at the top right corner after starting Commerce.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2206/mabinogi-commerce-current-market-price.png
The Outlaw Pursuit Wanted Board bounty tracking system has been revamped.All Outlaws are shown on the Wanted Board regardless of their criminal records.The reward for bounties registered on the board will increase in value periodically.As before, the reward will increase if a Milletian's goods have been stolen.If you succeed in catching the Outlaw, the bounty will be re-registered on the bulletin board after 30 minutes.You cannot use the Wanted Board when playing as a pet.An urgent wanted alert system has been added for Wanted Outlaws.If you catch an Outlaw with a wanted bounty, you can get a bonus amount of Seasonal Ducats.Any Outlaw with an urgent wanted bounty will be marked on the board.If an Outlaw with an increased bounty is not defeated and another event occurs on the same Outlaw, the bounty is increased, up to a maximum of 1,000,000 Seasonal Ducats.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/2205/mabinogi-commerce-wanted-poster.png
Seven new Outlaws have been added.You can obtain a journal achievement once for defeating each Outlaw.The way Bandits are encountered during Commerce has been changed.It has been changed to spawn within a random range around the character when moving into a Dangerous Area, rather than appearing at specified coordinates.The Bandits can still be avoided if you proceed with caution.A new Iria Bandit group has been added. They consist of Humans, Elves, and Giants.These Bandits only appear in Iria.A function to limit the number of weekly exchanges has been added to Barter Trading Posts.Scathach Beach Trading Post's trading feature now has a limit of 200 times per material.The number of exchanges available resets on Saturday at 7 AM PT weekly.Characters on the same account share trade counts.In order to use the Barter Trading Post, you must reach a Seasonal Commerce Rank of Silver 5.The Trade Assistant Imp's conversation UI no longer shows during trade (some support puppet's dialogue function still appears).PVP is no longer possible during Commerce.The stock of each trade item is displayed in the Trading Post.If you stop engaging in Commerce, the stock of the Trading Post you purchased goods from will be restored.A new bridge across the Suytu River, near the town of Cor in Iria, has been added.Yvona sells the following items for Ducats, which can now also be purchased with Seasonal Ducats. Note that her shop's stock changes every Erinn day:Pitfalls of CompositionA Composer's LifeUnknown Song Vol. 1Portable First Aid KitThe following items have been added to the Limited Items tab when trading with the Iria Trade association or the Merchant Imps in Uladh. notes.content:
The Great Era of Commerce is among us, Milletians, and it is time to become the Champions of Commerce! Check in with Commerce Joe and complete all of the Commerce objectives. Can you rise to the top of the Rankings Board and become the Number 1 Commerce Champion? Check out the details below.
Event Details

Log in during the event period to receive the quest [Guide] Champions of Commerce.Talk to Commerce Joe in Dunbarton Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account.Once completed, you will receive the following:10,000 EXPCommerce Joe's Trade JournalUse Commerce Joe's Trade Journal to view the event details and objectives.Today's ObjectiveEvery day, you will be tasked with Today's Objective.Perform Commerce - 3 times a dayAfter completing 3 Commerce trades, you will receive 15 Commerce Coins.Note: Commerce trades conducted through Smugglers will not be counted.Setting Up the Iria Trading Posts - once a dayCommerce Joe has a selection of missions for you to lend a hand with the efforts to get the Iria Trading Posts up and running.Choose a mission and you will be sent straight to the location (enter the mission).On your first clear, you will receive 15 Commerce Coins.For each time you clear, up to 5 times per day, you will receive 5 Commerce Coins.After clearing both objectives, you will receive the following items:20 Commerce Coins*NEW* Trading Post Merchant Rating Potion (7000)Use this potion to select a Trading Post and increase your Trading Post Merchant Rating by 7,000.If you use the potion after the Great Era of Commerce Update (June 30th), you can increase the Merchant Rating of the Iria continent's Trading Post.The potion can only be used once per day in-game time. It can be used again after 7 AM Erinn time.The daily objectives will reset at 7 AM PDT in real-time.Event Period ObjectivesDuring the event period, you will be tasked with the following objectives:Commerce Count [Today's Objective]Complete Today's Objective 10 times by performing Commerce.Setting Up the Iria Trading Posts [Today's Objective]Complete Today's Objective 10 times by clearing the mission through Commerce Joe.Uladh Trading Post Merchant Rating TotalRaise your Uladh Trading Post Merchant Rating and reach a cumulative total of Level 30 between all 8 Uladh Trading Posts.Note: If your Trading Post Merchant Rating is already at or above a cumulative Level 30, the objective will be completed when you register the main character for the event.After clearing the Meiling is back and needs your help to craft the dragon! Brave Uladh's Dungeons and Shadow Missions to collect the items needed for the dragon. Or, log in in every day to make this majestic pet your own! Check out the details below.
Event Details

Log in during the event period to receive the quest [Guide] Return of the Dragon Clan.Talk to Meiling in Dunbarton Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account.The character must be above Level 1,000.Once completed, you will receive the following:20,000 EXPAttendance ScrollCrafting a Marshal Fire Dragon's HornDuring the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn.You can only craft one Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn during the event period.You can also obtain a Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn as a reward from the Attendance Scroll event.The event items (Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Old Dragon, Fire Dragon's Hard Red Leather, Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, Strength Essence, Incomplete Horn, and Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.You must gather one Horn of Ten Thousand-Year Dragon, one Fire Dragon's Hard Red Leather, one Golden Yarn of the First Dawn, and one Strength Essence for Meiling to attempt to craft the Marshal Fire Dragon's Horn.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1836/mabinogi-dragon-master-s2-marshal-fire-dragon-horn.png

notes.title: Renovation Season 3 - Patch Notes - May 26th, 2022
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Renovation Season 3 Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:

The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before Maintenance
Shopkeeper's Sale: Enhancement Package: Thursday, May 5th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 2nd, Before MaintenanceSweet Coffee Returns!: Thursday, May 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 9th, Before MaintenanceHydrangea Box: Thursday, May 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 9th, Before Maintenance Milletian Events: Renovation Buffs and Hotdays: Thursday, May 26th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before MaintenanceGuardian of the Divine Beast Box: Thursday, May 26th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 30th, Before MaintenanceGold Renewal Update: PermanentRenovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes: Permanent 
Renovation Season 3
Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Dual Gun, Ninja, and Puppetry Talents! For full details, check out the Renovation Season 3 dedicated webpost.
Gold Renewal Update
Improvements to the Gold system have been made! For full details, check out the Gold Renewal Update dedicated webpost.Gold no longer occupies your inventory space and is instead stored as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.The maximum Gold limit that your character can hold is 1 million Gold. However, there are different ways to increase the maximum Gold limit.One way is by using Gold Boxes and Special Gold Boxes as these items have been turned into a consumable object.You can still withdraw Gold from your inventory.Gold Pouch items have been removed the game.Gold Purse items are now Item Bags.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The Mana Shield Enhancement Set Effect of the Elemental Harmony Gloves (M) and the Elemental Harmony Gloves (F) has been changed:Before: Increases Magic Defense by 10 and Magic Protection by 8 when you use Mana Shield.After: Increases Mana Shield's damage reduction per 1 MP by 0.30.The Medium-sized Bag (5x5) can be purchased from the General Shop for 3,980 Gold."Defense Penetration" has been changed to "Armor Pierce" in the skill description for Axe Mastery, Crossbow Mastery, and Dual Wield Mastery skills.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
On May 19th, the character deletion issue and the log off issue were fixed.The "Macaroon" recipe and food item name has been changed to "Macaron".Enchanted Thread has been renamed back to Enchanted Thread after being accidently renamed Magical Golden ThreadThe following Sewing Patterns have been fixed:Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature's BeautySewing Pattern - Robe of NatureSewing Pattern - Gloves of NatureSewing Pattern - Shoes of Nature
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.>A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:Common Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)Silk -> Cheap SilkCommon Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost ThreadThe issue regarding Sewing Patterns and Blacksmith Manuals not having any data is still being investigated.Special Small Draconian Wings (3 types) and Coupon can be found in the Auction House, but these items won't be available when the other wings are released.They will be released under a different name, the Special Forgotten Draconian Wings (3 types).The Special Small Draconian Wings have a Dressing Room entry, while Special Forgotten Draconian Wings do not have a Dressing Room entry.

notes.title: Renovation Season 3: Dual Guns, Ninja, and Puppetry Talent Changes
notes.content:
Gunslinger
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1715/dualguns.png

System Changes
The stat calculation for determining damage while using Dual Guns has been changed.Before:For every 6 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.For every 5 Strength and 6 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.After:For every 5 Strength and 5 Intelligence, Minimum Damage is increased by 1.For every 4 Strength and 4 Intelligence, Maximum Damage is increased by 1.The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.The stun time is adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:Awakening Attack EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Dual Gun Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cm
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
Flash Launcher

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1706/mabinogi-renovations3-flash-launcher.gif
Flash Launcher has been changed to a skill with ranged attack properties so you can attack from a distance.The skill casting time has been greatly reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before: 950% DamageAfter: 1300% Damage
Bullet Storm

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1705/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-storm.gif
The attack method of Bullet Storm has been changed so that it fires a set number of bullets at enemies within a certain range.The more enemies there are within the skill casting range, the more powerful the attack. If there is only one enemy, all bullets are concentrated in one place.When the Technique Seal: Pragarah is activated, the Magic Defense and Protection of the target are reduced according to the number of Bullet Storm hits.The Mana Bullet consumption amount is fixed by Rank.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 24 Mana BulletsThe maximum number of targets per Rank has been changed:Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 9 maximum targetsThe skill's attack range has been expanded.Skill casting time has been reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.A basic damage multiplier per bullet has been added to each skill Rank.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 50% per bulletThe damage multiplier per additional target has been adjusted from 2 or more targets.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 120% damageAfter: 60% damageThe final damage multiplier is now determined by adding up the base damage multiplier and the damage multiplier that increases per target.
Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:For 3 targets: 50% + (60% *2) = 170% DamageThe maximum damage limit has been adjusted per bullet and is applied at a fixed amount.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 400% Damage
Grapple Shot

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1707/mabinogi-renovations3-grapple-shot.gif
Grapple Shot has been changed so you can now use the skill by directly clicking on the ground where you want to move.When you arrive at the targeted location, damage is inflicted to enemies near the targeted location within a certain radius.The skill has been modified so that you no longer get hit for a short time while moving, similar to Chain Slash's Anchor Rush skill.The skill cooldown has been reduced for skill Ranks Novice to Rank 2. Rank 1 remains unchanged at 10 seconds.Example: Based on Rank Novice of the skill:Before: 16 secondsAfter: 13 secondsThe damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 200% damageAfter: 400% damage
Bullet Slide

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1710/mabinogi-renovations3-bullet-slide.gif
Bullet Slide has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.The skill's casting range has been increased to a range similar to that of a normal attack.Skill casting time has been greatly reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 250% DamageAfter: 1200% DamageSkill motion can no longer canceled with the ESC key.
Shooting Rush

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1709/mabinogi-renovations3-shooting-rush.gif
Shooting Rush has been changed so that regardless of the number of attacks, the target's defense and protection are only applied once.The skill will be cast in the direction of the location selected by the cursor, regardless of the direction the character is facing when attacking.The enemy will be knocked back according to the direction of the skill attack.Skill casting time has been slightly reduced.The knockback distance of the target has been reduced.The damage for each Rank has been increased.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before: 520% DamageAfter: 600% Damage
Reload
Reload has been changed so that the skill is not canceled even if you are attacked by an enemy while casting the skill.The skill is only canceled if you are knocked down or die while reloading.
Way of the Gun
Bonus Damage has been added to all Ranks of Way of the Gun.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 15% DamageBonus Damage will also be provided to other Gunslinger skills while Way of the Gun is activated.
Ninja
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1714/ninja.png

System Changes
The damage calculation method for Ninja skills have been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage.The stun duration has been increased based on the weapon's Attack Speed and hit count.The stun time has been adjusted to 1 second or more, varying according to Attack Speed and number of hits.Weapons with fewer hits compared to their Attack Speed have a longer stun time.Evasion based on an enemy's Luck stats will no longer occur.The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed: 
Awakening Attack Enhancement
Example: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range Enhancement
Example: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been changed to Spirit Shuriken Awakening Attack Range Radius +50cm
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect changes.
Explosive Kunai

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1708/mabinogi-renovations3-explosive-kunai.gif
Skill activation time has been slightly reduced.The method of triggering the skill's explosive attack has been changed.When an enemy steps on the explosive kunai, all kunai explode at the same time.All enemies in a 3m area around each kunai that explodes will take damage.Depending on the location, one enemy may receive damage multiple times.Enemies caught in the explosion are stunned for 3 seconds, and at the same time, the target's movement speed is decreased for 6 seconds.The damage for each Rank is increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 200% DamageAfter: 300% Damage
Shuriken Charge

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1711/mabinogi-renovations3-shuriken-charge.gif
Shuriken Charge has been changed so that you no longer have to charge the skill. Instead, the attack hits at full damage when the skill is used on an enemy.The previous animation that played when charging the skill is now played while you have the skill activated.You can now move your character while the skill is activated.You can also cancel the skill using the ESC key or by clicking on the skill balloon.Splash damage now always occurs when the skill is used on an enemy within 2m, and the same damage multiplier as the selected target is applied.The damage for the skill has been changed to be a fixed amount at each skill rank instead of requiring it to be fully charged for the full skill damage.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill - 690% DamageThe "Successfully use a fully charged attack" training requirement for Rank A and higher skill ranks, has been changed to "Defeat an enemy with Shuriken Charge".
Shadow Bind

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1712/mabinogi-renovations3-shadow-bind.gif
Shadow Bind has been changed so that binding an enemy persists while you are using the skill, keeping your character in place as you bind.A max binding duration has been added.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 20 secondsThe continuous binding can be stopped by canceling the use of the skill. It will also be stopped if you are stunned or knocked back due to an enemy's attack.Even if the skill use is completed or canceled, an additional binding time is applied to the target.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 5.5 seconds
Shadow Cloak
A bonus damage effect has been added for Ninja skills used while Shadow Cloak is active.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill - 10% Bonus DamageThe skill duration has been increased to 10 seconds.The damage of the skill's Tornado attack has been increased.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Before: 120% DamageAfter: 300% Damage
Smokescreen
Smokescreen has been changed so that it now reduces the target's Magic Defense and Magic Protection. The reduction is the same as the Defense/Protection reduction.The smoke effect of the skill will now disappear naturally.
Kunai Storm
Damage for Kunai Storm has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been changed to the damage amount rather than the damage multiplier.Example: Based on Dan Rank 3 of the skill:Before:  +460% DamageAfter: 560% Damage
Sakura Abyss
Sakura Abyss has not been changed, however the skill description for each Rank has been updated to include more information.Puppetry
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1713/puppetry.png

 System Changes
The damage calculation method for Puppetry skills has been changed. The way of applying the target's defense and protection values has been changed to match that of other talent skills. The damage multiplier of the skill is applied first before the enemy's defense and protection reduces the damage. The description of certain Spirit Enhancement attributes have been changed:Awakening Attack EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage +150% has been changed to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Damage Multiplier +150%Awakening Range EnhancementExample: At Skill Level 1 - Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Range +50cm has been change to Spirit Control Bar Awakening Attack Area Radius +50cmThe formula that applies the increased Marionette Damage from the Spirit Enhancement Attack effect "Spirit Training" has been changed. Damage is now increased when using a Spirit.The "Marionette Critical Damage" set effect has been changed.Before: Increases Marionette's Critical Damage by 40%After: Increases the Marionette's Critical Damage multiplier by 80% when a Critical hit occurs.
Skill Changes
For each updated skill, the skill info and description has been updated to reflect the changes.The following skills have not been changed, however the Skill Info has been slightly updated:Act 1: Inciting IncidentAct 4: Rising ActionAct 6: CrisisAct 7: Climactic CrashWire PullPuppet's Snare
Control Marionette
The Marionette will now gain 70% of the Puppeteer's Armor Pierce and Piercing Level.
Act 2: Threshold Cutter
The Combo Card damage bonus has been changed. It will now be applied to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd consecutive hits while using the skill.Additional information has been added to the skill info and description.
Act 9: Invigorating Encore
While using Act 9: Invigorating Encore, the Marionette's Defense, Magic Defense, Protection, and Magic Protection is increased. Bonus damage is also applied when the Marionette attacks.Example: Based on Rank 1 of the skillMarionette Attack Bonus Damage +10%Defense, Magic Defense Increase: +580Protection, Magic Protection Increase +80The skill effect is maintained, even if the Marionette dies and is resurrected or if the summon is canceled and re-summoned. The skill effect will continue to be applied to the Marionette for the remaining effect duration.The skill's activation time has been reduced.

Additional Content Changes Some content and NPC dialogue of the following tutorial missions have been changed to match the talent changes:Intro Gun TrainingIntro Gun Training: Movement SkillsIntro Gun Training: Ranged Attack SkillsTry TalentsContinue to Try TalentsLearn Shuriken ChargeThe following NPC's Gunslinger and Ninja talent skill Ranks will be lowered and their AI has been changed:Enemy NPCsCessair's Heart in the following missions:Heart Awakening MissionFading Pulse MissionInto Battle MissionCave of Trials MissionLlywelyn in the following mission:Fading Pulse MissionLlywelyn's Thoughts in the following mission:Alban Knights Training Grounds MissionSuccubus Fiend in the following mission:Rabbie Phantasm DungeonRabbie Phantasm Mirror World DungeonDisciple, Dark Disciple, and Melci Diafol in the following dungeon:Crom Bás DungeonAlly NPCs
Treasure HunterLlywelynThe attribute option text has been changed slightly for certain content to reflect the talent changes.Only the name of the option has been changed. The content, appearance, and probability are unchanged.This affects certain descriptions for Reforging and Echostone attributes, Glyphwrighting stats, Erg stats, and the Skill Master titles related to Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry.

notes.title: Gold Renewal Update
notes.content:
Gold Update
Improvements to the Gold currency system have been made!
Gold no longer occupies inventory space. It is now stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.All Gold stored in your inventory in the form of Gold, Gold Pouches, and Gold Boxes has been changed to the value amount of Gold you have.Immediately after the update, your Gold amount may exceed the maximum Gold storage limit. You will be unable to obtain Gold until you store the amount you have in the Bank or in a Pet's inventory.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1733/mabinogi-gold-amount-of-gold.png
The maximum Gold limit that each character, Pet, or Partner character can store is 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).A character's maximum Gold limit can be increased by an additional 1 Million Gold when the character achieves cumulative level 10,000. This is not applicable to Pets/Partners.Characters who have already reached cumulative level 10,000 or higher will have their maximum Gold limit increased the first time they log in after the update.The maximum Gold limit can be increased further up to 100,000,000 Gold (100 Million).Gold Box items have been changed to a consumption item that increased the maximum Gold limit for the character that consumes it.When using Lorna or Pan's Gold Box, the limit is increased by 50,000 Gold.When using Lorna, Pan, or Blaanid's Special Gold Box, the limit is increased by 100,000 Gold.Important NotesPet and Partner gold limit cannot be increased.The Gold Box Upgrade Coupon items function as usual to upgrade a Gold Box to the Special version.If you obtain Gold that exceeds your character's carrying capacity, the excess amount will fall to the floor.If the total amount of Gold you are holding reaches the maximum limit, you can no longer pick up Gold.When selling items at an NPC shop, you cannot sell any items if the sale price exceeds your maximum Gold limit.Gold can be exchanged through the Give and Claim buttons in a Pet's or Partner's inventory.Give can be used to store Gold in a Pet/Partner's inventory, up to 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million).You can also pick up Gold and transfer them directly.Claim can be used to withdraw and receive the Gold amount to your character's inventory.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1732/mabinogi-gold-give-gold.png
Gold now stacks to 50,000 when picked up from the character's inventory or when obtained from certain content.Example: Gold dropped from a Dungeon End Chest will now be dropped as a Gold stack instead of a Big Gold Pouch.Gold can be divided and picked up from a character's inventory by clicking on the Gold button in the main inventory.50,000 Gold is the maximum amount that can be picked up.You can drop Gold on the ground or give them to NPCs this way.If you put the Gold back into your inventory, it will return your Gold value.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1731/mabinogi-gold-pick-up-gold.png
When Trading (including Trading during Pet battles), the Gold button can be clicked to select the amount of Gold you wish to trade.A maximum of 1,000,000 Gold (1 Million) can be traded at once through this method.Checks can be traded as normal and the total value of Gold being traded will be shown as the cumulative amount of Gold and Checks added to the trade.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1730/mabinogi-gold-checks.png
If the trade recipient does not have enough room in their inventory to receive the Gold amount, Gold cannot be added to the trade window.Note: Gold cannot be picked up from the main inventory window while trading.If you attempt to withdraw Gold from the Bank and you have already reached the maximum Gold limit in your inventory, the Gold value will be shown as 0.You are still able to issue a Check however.The "Gold" tag has been removed as a selection from the list of bag tags for Item Bag organization.The acquisition method for obtaining Gold from certain content has been changed to distribute Gold to your Gold value automatically.Example: Raids, Alban Knights Training Grounds, Sidhe Finnachaid, certain quests, etc.Gold Pouches have been removed from the game.The Gold Pouch and Big Gold Pouch items have been removed and you will no longer be able to obtain these items through NPC shops, quest rewards, Dungeon/Shadow Mission reward boxes, and monster drops.As previously announced, this removal includes Gold Pouch items that have not been retrieved from the Auction House.After the update, any Gold stored in Gold Pouches that you own will be added to the Gold value for the character, Pet, or Partner who had the item.The Gold value equal to the sales price value of the Gold Pouch (i.e. when sold to an NPC) will be added to your Gold amount automatically.The sales price of a Gold Pouch is 880 Gold, and the sales price of the Big Gold Pouch is 4,900 Gold.The way that the Small Gold Purse, Medium Gold Purse, and Large Gold Purse items function have been changed.Before: Storage bag for Gold Pouches and Gold Boxes.After: Storage bag for items.The name of Gold Purses have been changed to Item Bag.The quest objective, NPC dialogue, and TIP have been changed for Blaanid's Brave Boost quest, "How to be a Prepared Milletian 1".The quest objective that requires you to obtain an item from the General Shop has been changed from a Big Gold Pouch to a Medium Sized Bag (5x5).Blaanid's voice will not be available for this memoir.

notes.title: Gold Pouch Removal
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

Recently, we’ve posted a Producer’s Letter with more information on what is to come for Mabinogi in the next few months. We’ve announced that the Gold Renewal Update is coming soon... on May 26th, 2022!

A few changes to come with this update include:
Gold coins stored in gold pouches, gold boxes, and in the inventory will be changed to be stored in your main inventory as a currency amount, similar to Ducats.The maximum Gold storage limit in your character’s inventory will start at 1,000,000 Gold, and will be increased by another 1,000,000 Gold when you reach cumulative level 10,000.The carrying capacity can be increased even higher using gold boxes up to 100,000,000 Gold.
With the update, all gold pouches will be removed from the game. This includes gold pouches being traded on the Auction House. Please remove all gold pouches from the Auction House so that you do not lose any Gold from the auction sale.

We are excited to share more about the update and all that is to come on May 26th!

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Producer's Letter: Upcoming Summer Content
notes.content:
Dear Milletians,

Now that we are all together in Erinn, I would like to share a list of updates that we have planned for the remainder of Q2 and the start of Summer. Much of this content has been pre-determined, and we are looking into adding more content, events, improvements, sales, and more for you to enjoy. We are checking your feedback regularly and we are doing our best to include them in our current and future plans.

May

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1629/mabinogi-producer-letter-renovation-s3.png

Renovation Season 3: Combat Talent Update (Gunslinger, Ninja, and Puppetry)

Updates to 3 classic combat Talents including Skills, Stats, and more. Damage calculation of these Talents will become more effective, and some of the inconvenient or ineffective aspects of some Skills will be improved.

Gold Renewal

Storing Gold will be changed to be similar to the Bank/Ducats. Existing and newly acquired Gold boxes can be used to increase the Maximum Gold limit in your inventory.

June

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1501/220204-mbw-2719-banners-nocopy-5.png

Fahmes Ruin

In early June, a new 30 level solo dungeon in Iria will be available called the Fahmes Ruin. Higher levels of the dungeon should prove to be challenging for even the most seasoned Milletians. There will also be a monthly ranking system that provides rewards for those who reach the highest ranks.

Great Era of Commerce

Later in June, Commerce will be renewed with new transports and updated commodities to trade. New ports will be added, bringing Commerce to Iria and further connecting the world of Erinn. 

Summer Master Plan

Weekly Buffs, Missions, etc are back again for the bi-annual event.

July

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1628/mabinogi-producer-letter-commerece-2.png

Great Era of Commerce expansion throughout Erinn

New stories will be shared, and air trade is on the horizon. Grab a party and commerce together and discover the wealth of being a merchant.

Thank you for your continued support of Mabinogi.

Sincerely,

-Enrico “GM Supreme”
Mabinogi Producer
