notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the RE:Life Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
Milletian Events: Server Merge Celebration!: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Multiple End DatesErinn Adventure Journal: Special Server Merge Season: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceThe Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance
Elemental Harmony Box: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance
Life Master's Order Event: Thursday, April 28th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12, Before MaintenanceErinn Academy Box: Thursday, April 28th, After Maintenance - May 26th, Before MaintenanceRE:Life Update: Permanent
RE:Life
The Life Talent is getting an update! Read the full details of the RE:Life Update on the dedicated webpost.The Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.You can view production completion records for crafted items.Crafting items will reward you with items.6 new Journal Achievements have been added.The crafting menu has been updated for life skills.The Crafting Success Rate has been increased to 100%.18 new Tailoring Sewing Patterns have been added as drops to certain Tech Duinn Missions.30 new Cooking recipes have been added.2 new Potion Making recipes have been added.The Weaving crafting recipes for Fabric and Silk have been changed.New material pouches have been added.New Homestead gathering props have been added.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The purchase limit, previously limited to 3 purchases per Erinn day, has been removed for the Teardrop Gem. This item has also been moved to the General tab of the shop and can be purchased at the Trading Post Merchant Imp for 35,000 Ducats each.The Netherlands Trade Restrictions that were previously applied during the December patch have now been removed.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
The Iria Quest board will no longer cause a crash when clicked on.[strike]Players are able to delete characters again.[/strike]Unfortunately, during today's testing, it was found that the issue still occurred on the live servers. We apologize for the inconvenience and we will continue investigating the issue.Unclaimed rewards from Irusan's Attendance Check-in event will be available in your Point Shop Inventory.The Blooming Roses 2nd Title will no longer appear as XML text in the title list.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.There is a chance that when logging off, you will not return to the character selection screen and will be kicked to the start menu with the error, "Server cannot be reached". This means you will need to shut down your game client and log in to the account again if you are attempting to switch characters.Guild stones can be placed very close to each other.
Several menus and buttons in the Production Crafting Diary have text that is cut-off or is overlapping.The Journal Achievement for completing 1000 crafts incorrectly states "100" crafts.A few Weaving crafting recipes are incorrectly labeled:Fabric -> Cheap FabricCommon Fabric: Make Fabric (Normal) -> Make Fabric (Common)Silk -> Cheap SilkCommon Silk: Make Silk (Normal) -> Make Silk (Common)
The material for crafting Ice Silk is incorrect; Cold Thread -> Frost Thread"Macaroon" recipe and food item name is incorrect and will be changed to "Macaron".Attempting to delete a character may result in a "Failed to delete the character." error message.

notes.title: RE:Life Update
notes.content:
Production Crafting DiaryThe Production Crafting Diary has been added to the Collection Journal tab of the character information window.
You can also set a hotkey shortcut for this menu in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings -> Crafting Diary.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1446/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary.png
You can view the production completion records for all items crafted for the following skills:TailoringWeavingHandicraftBlacksmithingPotion MakingCarpentryHillwen EngineeringMagic CraftStationery CraftingFynn CraftingRefiningMillingAny time an item is crafted, it is automatically collected in the Crafting Diary.Note: Items made with Sewing Patterns and Manuals that can only be obtained from specific ways, such as part-time jobs or events/mainstreams quests, are excluded from the collection of the Crafting Diary.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1448/mabinogi-relife-production-crafting-diary-ui.png
The Crafting Diary is divided into two sections; Collection Items and Achievements.When viewing an item from the Collection Items tab:You can view all craftable items that can be collected in the Crafting Diary and view the date you've first crafted an item.You can sort by View All, Completed Items, or Uncompleted Items.You can view any related achievements that the item is associated with and your achievement progress. Clicking on a related achievement will bring up the achievement details.Example: Crafting a Hairband fulfills the requirement for the achievement, "Novice Crafter - Tailoring".You can open the corresponding crafting menu by clicking on the hammer icon.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1444/mabinogi-relife-crafting-diary-achievements.png
On the Achievements tab, you can view items needed to complete each achievement.If you craft all the items related to an achievement, you can obtain the Completion Rewards for each achievement.You can only obtain the Completion Rewards once per crafting achievement.You only need to craft an item once for it to count towards all related achievements that require collecting the same item.You can obtain different item rewards when completing each achievement, such as crafting materials, Forgetful Potions, Training Potions, and more.The following rewards are new items that can be obtained from the Crafting Diary:Crafting Quality Increase Potion Selection Box (Not tradable)
Select a potion for one of the following skills:
Hillwen EngineeringMagic CraftBlacksmithingTailoringCarpentryWhen the potion is used, your skill's production quality is increased by 5 for your next crafting finishing attempt.The effect disappears after completing your item craft.Echostone Advancement Assist Potion
Increases the level up chance for your next Echostone level advancement attempt by a set amount of 10%. It is consumed once the advancement attempt has been made.This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.Erg Unlock Assist Potion
Increases the unlock chance for your next Erg level break attempt by a set amount based on the current Erg level. It is consumed once the unlock attempt has been made.This item can also be crafted using Potion Making.

notes.title: Server Merge - Patch Notes - April 14th, 2022
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the server merge of Alexina and Nao into the Erinn server!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Crom Bás Fever Time: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeTidal Guardian Box: Thursday, March 31st, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Server Merge Celebration!: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Multiple End DatesErinn Adventure Journal: Special Server Merge Season: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceThe Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 3: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 23rd, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceShopkeeper's Sale: Server Merge Fun!: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 28th, Before MaintenanceElemental Harmony Box: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before MaintenanceCash Shop Renewal: PermanentAlexina/Nao Server Merge: Permanent
Server Merge
The Alexina and Nao servers have been merged into the Erinn server. For full details about the merge, please read FAQ 1 and FAQ 2.If you are a returning player to Mabinogi, we highly recommend checking out the Returning Milletian Guide for a quick recap on recent updates.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Guild Management and Guild Creation no longer requires Mabinogi Premium Service or VIP Service.Known Issue: We are investigating the issue where some guilds cannot place a guild stone or invite new members.Extra Equipment Slot Tabs can now be increased to a maximum of 12 tabs, up from 8 tabs.Bank Limit Changes 
The default bank limit has been increased by 50,000,000 gold for the first character created on an account. (20,000,000 -> 70,000,000 gold)When visiting any Bank, you can view your current maximum bank limit. 
E.g. Current: Gold Amount / Max: 3,500,000,000Your current bank limit is determined by the amount of characters you have on the account and can be increased in other ways: Character Bank Limit DetailsYou will not be able to deposit any more gold to the bank once the Current maximum gold is reached for your account.The maximum bank limit that can be reached is 3,500,000,000 gold.
The maximum amount that can be reached by creating characters is 2,100,000,000 gold.You can increase your account’s bank limit by using a Bank Limit Expansion Coupon to increase the capacity by up to 10 million, 50 million, or 100 million gold at a time.If the bank limit is increased using Expansion Coupons up to 3,500,000,000 gold, the limit cannot be further increased by other methods.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the Bhatair, Morfydrianas, and Tani Doll Bags had the incorrect dimensions in their descriptions.Fixed an issue where the recipe for the Item Illusion T46 recipe stated that it required Steel Plates.Fixed a grammar issue in the item attribute section of the Trader Enchant Scroll.Fixed a grammar issue in the Tidal Guardian Box description.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a minor graphical issue with the Special Shining Stage Concert Costume (M) when the character equipped with the outfit is running.Scathach's hands do not match her skin color.The Tail Chasers mini-game in Festia is currently inaccessible.The Iria Exploration Quest Board will cause a crash when clicked on.A character's neck will become detached from their body when wearing the Mysterious Thief outfit.

notes.title: Milletian Events: The Grand Guild Gathering
notes.content:
Have you ever wished you had a chance to do more activities with your guild and earn rewards for it? Well now you can, Milletians! Roy is here to help you earn rewards for playing with guild members! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance
The Grand Guild GatheringDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering.Talk to Roy in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Roy.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] The Grand Guild Gathering:10,000 EXPGuild Activity JournalThis item can be stored in the "Me" inventory.In order to participate, your character must be in a guild. If you have just joined a guild, you will be considered a new guild member. You can participate in certain parts of the event after 3 days have passed since you've joined the guild.If you are not in a guild, you can still receive Guild Activity Coins, but you will not gain Guild Activity EXP Points.If you quit a guild while participating in the event, the Guild Activity EXP Points you've earned will reset. The Guild Activity Coins will still remain, but you will not be able to use Roy's Guild Event Shop, and the special Guild Member Buffs.If you quit a guild while participating in the event, and rejoin another guild, you will be considered a new guild member and will need to wait 3 days to participate in certain parts of the event.Right-click "Use" on the Guild Activity Journal to open it and check information related to guild activities.
Check Guild Activity EXPYou can check your Individual Guild Activity EXP points and the Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points that have been obtained for the week.There are several ways to gain Guild Activity EXP points.Guild Activity EXP resets every week on Thursday at 7:00 AM PDT in real time.Please note that it can take up to 5 minutes for the Guild EXP to update in the Guild Activity Journal.Claim your Weekly Guild RewardTo achieve the weekly guild reward, you and your guild will need to obtain a certain amount of Guild Activity EXP Points.5,000 or more Total Guild Member Activity EXP Points500 or more Individual Guild Activity EXP PointsOnce both of the above requirements have been meet, the Weekly Guild Reward Box can be claimed.
This reward can only be claimed once per week.You can only claim the reward during the week, before the reset.Earning Guild Activity EXP and CoinsTo earn Guild Activity EXP and Guild Activity Coins, you must participate in various activities.One way to earn EXP and coins is by clearing the Erinn Adventure Journal missions.You will receive an equal amount of Guild Activity EXP and Guild Activity Coins as the EXP awarded when completing an Erinn Adventure Journal mission.IMPORTANT NOTE: We recommend registering for this event and the Erinn Adventure Journal on the same character as the Guild Activity EXP and Coins are obtained through the Erinn Adventure Journal. Eliminate Mokkurkalfi is a special mission that you can participate in with other guild members to earn EXP and coins.Speak with Roy to Enter Guild Cooperative Mission.You can enter solo or in a party with up to 8 guild members.All party members must be in the same guild.If you are a new guild member, you will not receive Guild Activity EXP until 3 days have passed since you joined the guild.If you complete the mission after 3 days have passed, you can earn the 500 Guild Activity EXP.For the first clear, you will receive the following rewards:500 Guild Activity EXP500 Guild Activity CoinsEliminate Mokkukalfi Reward BoxYou can still enter the mission multiple times, but you can only receive the rewards once per week.The weekly clear will be reset every week on Thursdays at 7 AM PDT in real time.Special Guild BuffsDuring the event period, you will receive the special Power of Guild Pride buff after registering your main character.New guild members can acquire the buff by talking to Roy after 3 days have passed since joining a guild.Power of Guild Pride BuffIncreases Attack Power by 15Increases Magic Attack by 10When participating in the Eliminate Mokkurkalfi mission with a new guild member, the Refreshing Aura Buff will be granted to the entire party.2 or more players must be in the party notes.title: Erinn Adventure Journal - Special Server Merge Season
notes.content:
The Erinn Adventure Journal is here! Complete different tasks to update the Journal and gain rewards each time the Journal levels up. If you want extra rewards, you can use Pon to activate special rewards! Check out the details below.

Season Dates: Thursday, April 14th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 12th, Before Maintenance
Erinn Adventure JournalDuring the Special Server Merge Season (Season 1), you will receive the quest, [Guide] Chronicling an Adventure.Talk to Eavan in Dunbarton to register a main character.You can only participate with one character, and this CANNOT be changed.IMPORTANT NOTE: We recommend registering for this event and the Grand Guild Gathering event on the same character as the Guild Activity EXP and Coins are obtained through the Erinn Adventure Journal. To open the Erinn Adventure Journal, on the main task bar click on Character -> Adventure Journal.You can also set a hotkey shortcut for it in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey SettingsWith the Journal, you will receive various Daily, Weekly, and Challenge missions.Daily missions reset every day at 7 AM PDT.
Weekly missions reset every Thursday at 7 AM PDT.Challenge missions can be completed once during the season period.
When some Challenge mission are completed, a newly linked mission will be available for the following missions:Fish Fear Me - Catch a fish 100 times (any type) -> 200 times -> 300 timesA Time to Reap - Gather 100 times (any type) -> 200 times -> 300 timesPet Projects - Complete a Pet Expedition 15 times -> 30 times -> 45 timesExpert Exterminator - Defeat 500 monsters (any type) -> 1,000 monsters -> 1,500 monstersComplete Sidhe Finnachaid of -  Curiosity 1 time -> Fear 1 time -> Sorrow 1 timeEach time you complete a task, the mission will automatically complete and you will receive Adventure EXP.Collect Adventure EXP to raise the Journal Grade.There are 21 grades in total and each grade requires 200 EXP to reach the next grade.Reaching Grade 21 requires 4,200 Adventure EXP.A total of 5,400 Adventure EXP can be obtained by completing missions during Season 1.Daily Missions = 1,960 EXP (70 EXP daily * 28 days)Weekly Missions = 1,640 EXP (410 EXP per week * 4 weeks)Challenge Missions = 1,800 EXP (including linked missions)Normal Rewards can be claimed any time you reach a new grade.Special Rewards can be unlocked using 150 Pon.Note: You can only Claim Rewards while the Erinn Adventure Journal season is active. Unclaimed rewards will be sent to the character’s Point Inventory after the season ends.

notes.title: Together in Erinn - Updated FAQ
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

We’re a few days away from being Together in Erinn! You can view the maintenance details here: Scheduled Maintenance - April 14th

We’ve verified several details during testing and have updated several questions below. We have also removed the Bard Bulletin Board and MabiNovel Bulletin Board from the list of contents that will be reset with the merge, as these contents will be merged and not reset.

As noted previously, there are several restrictions that are required when merging the Alexina server data with the Nao server data. Please review the below restrictions which will mainly affect characters from Alexina, and check the FAQ for further details on each content.
[table][tr][th]Content[/th][th]Alexina[/th][th]Nao[/th][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Character Name across servers (Character/Pet/Partner)[/td][td]Will be changed to "Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Homestead Names across servers[/td][td]Will be changed to "Homestead Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Duplicate Family Names across servers[/td][td]Will be changed to "Family Name+Alexina"[/td][td]Names will not be changed.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marriage Info and Marriage Title[/td][td]Marriage Info will be merged.

If the character's name is changed, the new name will not be reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title.[/td][td]Marriage Info will be merged.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wedding Rings[/td][td]Cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Wedding Rings remain in-game for Nao characters.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets[/td][td]Cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets remain in-game for Nao characters.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pet Houses, Pet Expeditions, and Partners in Homestead[/td][td]Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will not remain in this state.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will remain in this state.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Housing Shop Marketplace[/td][td]Items stored in the Shop will be merged. Unfortunately, Gold used to bid on the shop originally and Gold stored in the Shop will not be merged. 

If you have any Gold stored in the marketplace before the merge maintenance, please claim it so that no gold is lost.[/td][td]Will not be affected. Items and gold stored in the Shop will be merged.[/td][/tr][tr][td]UI/Hotkey Reset[/td][td]Will be affected by Hotkey/UI Reset.
Unique to Alexina characters, the pets assigned to a Fynn Pet's Friend Summoning hotkey slot will be reset. Pets can be added to the hotkey slot as normal after merge.[/td][td]Will be affected by Hotkey/UI Reset.
Pets assigned to a Fynn Pet's Friend Summoning hotkey slot will not be reset.[/td][/tr][/table]
We’ll see you all very soon!

- The Mabinogi Team

Updated FAQ

[Updated] Q: When is the server merge?
A: You can view the maintenance details on the webpost.

[Updated] Q: How will this affect my character? 
A: Please check the full restrictions posted at the top of the FAQ.

[Updated] Q: Will I be able to change my character name? Can I change my name back to my original name if it was changed?
A: We will offer additional name change support for Alexina characters in certain cases. Please view the Customer Support article for more information.

[Updated] Q: Will anything happen to my Family or Family Name?
A: Duplicate family names across both servers will be changed for Alexina characters: 'Family Name+Server Name', e.g. My Sweet Family+Alexina. Nao family names will not be changed.

[Updated] Q: Will my Marriage Info be affected by the merge?
A: For both Nao and Alexina characters, Marriage Info will be merged. If the character's name is changed, the new name will not be reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title.

Wedding Rings for Alexina cannot be merged, and will be removed from the game. Though the ring will be removed, please be assured that this will not break the character or the character’s marriage status. Should you wish to divorce and re-marry, it may be necessary to perform a ‘Forced Divorce’ option through both spouses first. Wedding Rings for Nao characters will remain intact.

[Updated] Q: What happens if I have a Shop in the Marketplace (formerly Housing)? What about the items that are left in the Shop Inventory?
A: The Marketplace contents will not be merged. The option to bid on a Shop has been temporarily turned off with the March 24th maintenance, and any currently leased shop contracts will expire before the merge date. Please retrieve any items placed in your Marketplace Shop Inventory or any items in the 'Retrieve Items' menu accessed through the Marketplace bank NPC before the merge date on April 14th so that any items are not lost. Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Items stored in the Marketplace for Alexina characters will be merged. Unfortunately, the gold or the gold used to originally bid on the Shop will not be merged. If you have any Gold stored in the marketplace before the merge maintenance, please claim it so no gold is lost. Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Items and gold stored in the Marketplace for Nao characters will be merged.

After the merge, accounts that owned a Shop will be able to claim the items stored in the Shop through the Bank NPC in the Marketplace where the original Shop was.

[Updated] Q: Will the Meet-Cute Bracelet/Rose Couple’s Bracelet effect still work after the merge?
A: For Alexina characters only, after the merge, the paired effect will no longer work and will be removed from the game.

All current Meet-Cute Bracelets/Rose Couple's Bracelets will be removed for Alexina characters, and the Peas in a Pod Gift Box/Rose Couple's Bracelet Gem Box will be distributed back to the character that originally opened the box. The Couple’s Bracelets will need to be traded to your preferred partner again after the merge. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Meet-Cute Bracelets and Rose Couple's Bracelets remain in-game for Nao characters.

[Updated] Q: Will the merge affect my Ego Spirit Weapon?
A: All Spirit Weapons will be merged. The Spirit Bond, Spirit Level/EXP, Spirit Skills, and Spirit Appearances will all remain intact.

[Updated] Q: What will happen to my data from newer contents, such as the Dungeon Guide, Stardust, Pet Houses, Fynn Pets, Fynni Pets, Pet Perks, Beauty Slots, Spirit Weapons, etc.?
A: All data will be merged for your character.

Pet Related: Pets resting in Pet Houses, Pets in an ongoing Expedition or completed Expedition, or Partners placed on the Homestead will not remain in this state for Alexina characters only. Pets/Partners will be removed from the Homestead and can be summoned normally or placed back in the Homestead after the merge.

If you have any ongoing or completed Expeditions, please claim the rewards before the merge maintenance.

Nao characters will not be affected by this.

Dungeon Guide: For accounts that registered for the Dungeon Guide across servers, the Dungeon Guide clear counts will be merged.

Example: If you cleared Alby Dungeon 10 times on Nao and 10 times on Alexina, your Dungeon Guide clear count for Alby Dungeon will be at 20 clears after the merge.

After the merge, you can change your registered main character to receive Vouchers at NPC Eavan in Dunbarton. Additionally, Vouchers received across characters can be transferred across characters through the bank.

Unclaimed rewards will be merged. However, we suggest claiming any unclaimed Dungeon Guide Repeated Clear Rewards before the merge if you played on both servers.

[Updated] Q: What contents will be reset with the merge?
A: The following contents will be reset with the merge:
Altruist LeaderboardApocalypse Raid first party clearAuction House Market Price DataBard Bulletin BoardCommerce Trading Board Information (each town)Cooking Journal: The 'Master Chef' and Master Chef's comments for the server.Current Guardian GuildsFashion Contest WinnerFestia Weekly Ranking BoardMabiNovel Bulletin BoardRoyal Alchemists and Upgrade Methods found by Royal Alchemists.Seal Stones
The Seal Stones will need to be broken again in the new server, granting the respective Seal-Breaker titles to the character who breaks the seal.Characters who obtained the Seal-Breaker title previously will still be able to use the Seal-Breaker title.Though all events should end before the merge date, please be advised that the main character selection will be reset.General UI saved settings will be reset, including hotkey bar placements, extra skill slots, and saved pet organization and tabs.
We know this can be an inconvenience, so we sincerely apologize in advance! We strongly suggest taking screenshots of your hotkey placements so you may set up your hotkeys again once the merge is complete.

[Updated] Q: Will the Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward be reset for the Erinn Server?
A: The Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward will be reset. Who will be the next party to claim the Gravedigger title?

[Updated] Q: Will anything happen to my Homestead?
A: Duplicate Homestead names across both servers will be changed for Alexina characters: Homestead Name+Server Name', e.g. My Sweet Home+Alexina. Nao Homestead names will not be changed.

[Updated] Q: Will I still receive royalties for a MabiNovel that has been posted prior to the merge?
A: As the MabiNovel Bulletin Board has been reset, you may not receive these royalties. We apologize for any inconvenience.

The MabiNovel Bulletin Board will no longer be reset.

notes.title: Together in Erinn
notes.content:
Hello Milletians!

By the time you are reading this post, we have just had our 14th Anniversary livestream where we've announced a super special TOTALLY SECRET surprise!

Together in Erinn
April 14th, 2022

Alexina and Nao servers will be merged together into a new server, Erinn. The anticipated server merge date is Thursday, April 14th. We know that this merger has been highly anticipated and are excited to announce that all players of Mabinogi will be together on one server moving forward. We hope that this will bring new opportunities for you as a community to come together and create more memories in the world of Erinn.

Please carefully read below for the information related to the upcoming April 14th server merge.

March 24th Changes

Several restrictions to the game have been added in order to prepare for the upcoming server merge. As of the March 24th maintenance, the following changes have been made, affecting Alexina and Nao servers:
New character, pet, and partner creation has been turned off until April 14th.
New characters will be unavailable to be created using character cards or pet whistles.Guild creation and guild stone creation will be unavailable until April 14th.
Note: The 'Guild Formation Permit' and 'Guild Stone Installation Permit' will be available for purchase, but cannot be used.Leasing a Taillteann farm option will be disabled until April 14th.Leasing a Shop Marketplace (Housing) option will be disabled until April 14th.Any currently leased shop contracts in the Marketplace will expire before the April 14th merge. Please be sure to retrieve any items left in the Shop inventory as these items cannot be merged.The Name Change page on the website will be unavailable for use until after the server merge on April 14th. 
We apologize for the inconvenience that these restrictions hold for this duration of time as we prepare the servers.

Important Notice

Below we have compiled several frequently asked questions about the server merge, many of which have not changed since the Nao server merge.

However, we want to highlight an important difference for the merge this time. During the Nao merge, there were several restrictions that impacted all characters. As we felt it was crucial to reduce the impact to Nao characters, who have already been through a merge previously, certain restrictions will only affect Alexina characters. For example, duplicate character names across servers will only be changed for Alexina characters to “Name+Alexina” and Nao character names will not be changed. As there are certain limitations when merging servers together, these restrictions affecting Alexina characters cannot be avoided. We are still verifying how this will affect each server and the details for certain data unable to be merged, such as Wedding Rings.

We will follow up with the full list of restrictions for each server when we are closer to the merge date, as this will need to be fully confirmed during our testing. Thank you for your understanding, and please find the answers to the FAQ below.

Server Merge FAQ

Server Information

Q: When is the server merge?
A: The anticipated server merge date is Thursday, April 14th, 2022. Details on the merge maintenance will be shared at a later date.

Q: Which servers are merging?
A: The Alexina server will be merged together with the Nao server into a new server, Erinn.

Q: How many channels will the Erinn server have?
A: The Erinn server will have 10 main channels. We will be monitoring this in case we need to increase the number of channels in the future.


Character and Pet Information


Q: How will this affect my character? 
A: All characters will be merged. Certain restrictions, such as name changes, will only apply to Alexina characters. In many cases, Nao characters will remain unaffected as we prepare to merge the data. More information will be provided regarding the differences of these restrictions for characters on both servers once confirmed.

Q: Will my character name be changed during the merge? What happens if there are multiple characters with the same name?
A: Only characters on Alexina will be affected by name changes. Characters (pets, partners, characters) with duplicate names will have their name changed to 'Name+Server', e.g. Name+Alexina.

A duplicate name can be a pet, partner, or character name, across Alexina and Nao servers.

e.g. If a pet is named 'Potato' on one server, and a character is named 'Potato' on another server, the Alexina character’s name will be changed to Potato+Alexina.

However, if there are no duplicate character names, the character name will remain unaffected. Nao character names will not be changed.

Q: Will I be able to change my character name? Can I change my name back to my original name if it was changed?
A: All accounts that have character names changed during the merge process will receive an equal amount of free Character Name Changes automatically added to their account after the server merge is completed on April 14th. More information on the Name Change system can be found here. All name change limitations will remain the same.

Unfortunately, if the name has been changed, it may not be possible to change the name back to the original name if it is already taken by a pet or character on the new server, Erinn.

Q: What happens if an account is inactive during the merge?
A: All accounts will be merged regardless of whether or not you have logged in recently.

Q: Will I be able to change my pet's name?
A: The pet name change option will not be available at this time.

Q: Will anything happen to my pets if the pet name is changed because of the merge?
A: You will be able to summon and interact with your pets as normal even if their name is changed. However, if a partner character's name is changed, the partner's likeability toward your character will be reset. If the character’s name is changed, the partner’s likeability towards that character will also be reset. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Q: After the merge to the Erinn server, can I summon any pet regardless of which server they were originally created on?
A: All pet and partner characters created on both servers on an account will be merged with their inventory and stats intact. You will be able to access all of your pets on the Erinn server!

Q: Will anything happen to my Family or Family Name?
A: Families will be merged. We are still confirming the details regarding Family Names for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

Q: Will anything happen to our Friends List and Notes? Will these contents be wiped?
A: The Friends List and Notes will be merged and will not be wiped. However, if a character’s name is changed, any notes in the character's Notes Inbox will be lost. In the case that the original sender's name is changed, the name change will be reflected on the Friend's List, but may not be reflected on the Notes Inbox.

Q: Will my Marriage Info be affected by the merge?
A: Marriage Info will be merged. During the Nao merge, if a character's name was changed, the new name was not reflected on the Marriage Info or Marriage Title. Additionally, Wedding Rings could not be merged and were removed from characters. We are still confirming the details for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

Q: What is the current limit on characters and pets? Will the merge cause me to be unable to use characters or pets if I've reached the max limit?
A: The merge will not affect your character limit, as the character limit is the same across the account. The current character and pet limit for an account is 300. An account may not have more than 300 total combined characters and pets. However, once an account has 200 characters on it, then only pets and partners may be created up to the 300 limit.

Q: Will unused character and pet cards on the account be merged? What about pet whistles?
A: Yes, all unused character cards will be available on the account, as well as any pet whistles that may be in any character inventories.

Q: Will the Anniversary Milletian title change, or will the character creation date change when merged to the new server?
A: Your character creation date and your titles will all remain intact.

Item Information

Q: Will anything happen to my items if my name is changed because of the merge?
A: All of your items will be merged, even if the character name is changed. Items stored in a character's inventory, bank, and pet's inventory, will be merged. Your items will be available in their respective places after the merge maintenance has completed! Please read the notices regarding the Shop Marketplace and Dressing Room in the below answers.

Q: What happens to items that are character-exclusive if the character name is changed?
A: Items that are character exclusive (via upgrade, special upgrade, or enchant exclusive) will be able to be equipped as normal, even if your name was changed. However, if the item is currently unbound as a result of using a Trade Unlock Potion, the item will become re-bound to the character. The item will need to be unbound again by using another Trade Unlock Potion, should you wish to trade it. Customer Support will not be able to help unbind the item again.

Q: What happens to the contents in my bank?
A: Any gold and items in the bank across both servers on an account will be merged. If the amount of gold in the bank exceeds the account's bank limit, gold cannot be deposited into the bank.
Please be advised that the account's bank pin will be reset and can be changed after the merge.

Q: What happens to items that are left in the Auction House?
A: Auction House contents will be merged, and any items currently left in the Auction House inventory can be retrieved after the merge. If you have items across servers on the Auction House, the items will be stored in the Auction House, and new listings cannot be posted until the items are retrieved.

Q: What happens to items that are left in the cash shop Item Shop Inventory?
A: All cash items stored in the cash Item Shop Inventory will be merged. This includes characters whose names are changed during the merge.

Q: What will happen to items in the Point Inventory?
A: Items stored in the Point Inventory will be merged, and any items currently left in the inventory can be retrieved after the merge. However, the Point Inventory will also be used to merge duplicate items stored in the Dressing Room. As such, please be aware of the condition below regarding the Dressing Room.

Q: What will happen to items in the Dressing Room?
A: Duplicate items across characters on both servers on an account will be moved to the Point Inventory after opening the Dressing Room for the first time after the merge. If you only play on one server, your Dressing Room contents will merge with all of the items intact.

The Point Inventory can hold up to 1000 items. If the amount of duplicate items (across servers) is over 1000, up to 100 items will go into the temporary inventory of your character. If the amount of the remaining duplicate items is over 100, the items will be dropped. We strongly suggest to place items in pets or bank storage if you believe you have over 1100 duplicate items in the Dressing Room across characters on different servers on the account, so that any items are not lost. There is no guarantee the items can be recovered if they are dropped from the temporary inventory.

Q: What happens if I have a Shop in the Marketplace (formerly Housing)? What about the items that are left in the Shop Inventory?
A: The Marketplace contents will not be merged. The option to bid on a Shop has been temporarily turned off with the March 24th maintenance, and any currently leased shop contracts will expire before the merge date. Please retrieve any items placed in your Marketplace Shop Inventory or any items in the 'Retrieve Items' menu accessed through the Marketplace bank NPC before the merge date on April 14th so that any items are not lost. Any items that are lost during this time cannot be recovered. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Q: Will the Meet-Cute Bracelet/Rose Couple’s Bracelet effect still work after the merge?
A: We are still confirming the details for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

Q: Will the merge affect my Ego Spirit Weapon?
A: As the Spirit Weapon system has been updated, we are still confirming the details and will share more information regarding this system once confirmed.

Q: What happens to items and mail left in the mailbox?
A: All contents in the Inbox and Outbox of a character's mailbox will be merged.

Q: Will my Pon amount be affected by the merge?
A: The Pon amount will merge and can be accessed across all characters on an account

Content Information

Q: What contents will be reset with the merge?
A: The following contents will be reset with the merge:
Altruist LeaderboardAuction House Market Price DataBard Bulletin BoardCommerce Trading Board Information (each town)Cooking Journal: The 'Master Chef' and Master Chef's comments for the server.Current Guardian GuildsFashion Contest WinnerFestia Weekly Ranking BoardMabiNovel Bulletin BoardRoyal Alchemists and Upgrade Methods found by Royal Alchemists.Seal Stones
The Seal Stones will need to be broken again in the new server, granting the respective Seal-Breaker titles to the character who breaks the seal.Characters who obtained the Seal-Breaker title previously will still be able to use the Seal-Breaker title.Though all events should end before the merge date, please be advised that the main character selection will be reset.General UI saved settings will be reset, including hotkey bar placements, extra skill slots, and saved pet organization and tabs.
We know this can be an inconvenience, so we sincerely apologize in advance! We strongly suggest taking screenshots of your hotkey placements so you may set up your hotkeys again once the merge is complete.

Q: What will happen to my data from newer contents, such as the Dungeon Guide, Stardust, Pet Houses, Fynn Pets, Fynni Pets, Pet Perks, Beauty Slots, Spirit Weapons, etc.? 
A: We are checking contents such as these with the merge testing and will share more information regarding these contents once confirmed.

Q: Will the Apocalypse Raid first party clear reward be reset for the Erinn Server?
A: We are checking this content with the merge testing and will share more information regarding it once confirmed.

Q: Is there a safe location we can log off before the server merge because of the Seal Stones?
A: You do not need to log off in a certain location, as all locations can be accessed regardless of a Seal Stone's current status. If you need to move from a specific location for any reason, you may use 'Continent Warp' in the Actions menu, or the Traveler's Guide to travel to any Moon Gate or Mana Tunnel.

Q: Will anything happen to my Homestead?
A: Homestead contents will be merged, including favorited homesteads, homestead visitor's list, and all of your props placed inside of the homestead. If the Homestead was expanded using the Homestead Expansion Permit, the homestead will keep the expansion.

We are still confirming the details regarding Homestead Names for the April 14th merge and will update you as soon as possible.

Q: What will happen to my guild?
A: Guild names will not be changed, as guild names are unique across all servers. Guild GP and Gold stored in the guild stone will be merged. Any accumulated Play Points can still be converted into GP when visiting the guild stone after the merge. Any guilds that have a Guild Title will be able to use the Guild Title as normal.

Q: What happens to my guild stone location?
A: All guild stone locations will be removed during the merge, and the guild stone will need to be placed again by the guild leader after the merge.

Q: What if I am in a Guardian Guild prior to the merge?
A: Any current Guardian Guilds prior to the April 14th merge day will be reset.

Q: How many Royal Alchemists can there be on the new server?
A: 100 Royal Alchemists. The maximum amount of Royal Alchemists will not change.

Q: Will the Baltane Squire Special Unit be affected by the merge?
A: The Baltane Squire Special Unit will not be affected by the merge. You will be able to access your Special Unit and interact with your squires as normal after the merge!

Q: Will the contents of the Collection Journals be reset?
A: The various Collection Journals within the Character Info menu will be merged with your character's collections intact. However, the 'Master Chef' and the Master Chef's comments will be reset on the Cooking Journal.

Q: Will the Commerce contents be reset with the merge?
A: A character's Commerce Merchant Rating will not be reset. However, the specific town's Commerce Trading Board Information will be reset.

Q: Will I still receive royalties for a MabiNovel that has been posted prior to the merge?
A: As the MabiNovel Bulletin Board has been reset, you may not receive these royalties. We apologize for any inconvenience.

If you have further questions, please reach out to us through Discord, Forums, and other community channels, as we will be reviewing your concerns and will be providing further updates through upcoming posts related to the Server Merge as we come closer to the merge date.

We are looking forward to future adventures, Milletians!

- The Mabinogi Team

Repair Cost Reduction
The cost of repairing equipment has been lowered to 1/5th (80% per repair point) of the original price.Example: If the repair cost was 260 gold per repair point before the update, it is now 52 gold per repair point after the update.If the discounted repair cost after the update is less than 1 gold, the repair cost is set to 1 gold.Example: "Beginner" equipment repair cost per point is 1 gold before and after the update.The reduced repair cost applies to Gold and Ducat repair methods.All repair types benefit from the discount, including Falias Artifacts.However, keep in mind that this reduction does not benefit Brionac repair as it uses AP and not gold.Cost-modifying effects such as enchantments and upgrades will still apply the cost modification, but the cost of the repair will still be lower as the base repair cost has been reduced.NPC repair rates have not been changed. 
Crom Bás Dungeon Polishing
The overall dungeon length for Crom Bás has been reduced.
The appearance of magic circles and destinations to certain rooms and puzzles will change accordingly.The puzzle requiring you to rescue endangered citizens has been lowered from 30 waves to 16 waves.The location of campfires and traps has been changed.The number of waves of monsters and amount of monsters that appear has been adjusted.The maximum number of Souls that appear has been changed from 4 to 6, depending on the Crom Bás Info score.There has been a change made so that Melci Diafol may not appear at a low chance.You can now use the following skills when fighting Irusan and Glas Ghaibhleann:Anchor RushTumbleWings of EclipseIrusan's HP has been greatly reduced in the Advanced and Elite difficulties.Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's movement speed has been increased.The delay time before and after the Giga Glas Ghaibhleann's Jumping Dash skill has been reduced.The combat AI of Completed Glas Ghaiblheann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann has been changed to be a little more aggressive.The movement speed of the Dark Shrieker that spawns during the Glas Ghaibhleann boss fight has been increased.When Dark Shrieker's self-destruct attack accumulates more than 5 times for Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and more than 9 times for Giga Glas Ghaibhleann, Confusion will be applied to the boss.The damage taken when Confusion is applied to Glas Ghaibhleann has been increased slightly.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The Weekly Reward Limit for Crom Bás has been changed from 7 times a week to 10 times a week.The drop rate has been slightly increased for some enchantments that were difficult to obtain in Crom Bás.The drop rate of the Nightbringer Huntsman has been increased in the Crom Bás dungeon.Mana, Stamina, and Hunger will no longer drop below 0 if you are possessed in Crom Bás.The time it takes to bless an item using Holy Water of Lymilark has been changed from 4 seconds to 0.5 seconds.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where certain boots would clip into the the Water Spirit Outfit (F) and Special Water Spirit Outfit (F).An issue with enhancement from the Souls in Crom Bas that reduced the Encore skill cooldown has been fixed. When you receive the Music Enhancement blessing, the cooldown of Encore is decreased.The issue where Glas Ghaibhleann intermittently rises after death has been fixed.Fixed an issue where, when the Dark Ritual failed in Crom Bas, the increased attack power value of Glas Ghaibhleann was applied differently than intended.

It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. notes.title: Client Reinstallation Notice and Hotday Event
notes.content:
Hello Milletians!

After the March 17th maintenance, you will be required to download new client files due to a change in the way Mabinogi installs to your game folder. As a thank you for your understanding, we have prepared the Client Update Package to all players who log in during the event period of March 17th, 7:00 AM PDT to March 24th, 7:00 AM PDT. 

Hotday Details
Claim the Client Update Package item from the Hotday menu to receive it on your current character or choose Claim Later if you want to receive it on another character.While the package itself can be moved between characters through the bank, some of the items cannot be bank-traded, so please open the package on the correct character.You can only claim the item once during the event period.
The Client Update Package contains the following items:
Style Tab Key (30 days) x1 (expires in 15 days)Extra Equipment Slot Coupon (30 days) x1 (expires in 15 days)Forgetful Potion x1 (expires in 15 days)Artisan Upgrade Removal Kit x2 (expires in 15 days)Combat Quadruple EXP Potion (30 min) (Event) x1 (expires in 15 days)Precise Reforging Tool x5 (expires in 5 days)Alban Knights Training Stone Selection Box x1 (expires in 15 days)Notorious Magic Powder (Event) x3 (expires in 15 days)Protective Upgrade Stone Selection Box x1 (15 days)
Client Update Details

Nexon Launcher
If you have “Enable automatic updates” checked in the Nexon Launcher Settings under Mabinogi -> Update, the installation will begin once the patch is made available.If you do not have “Enable automatic updates” checked in the Nexon Launcher Settings, after launching the Nexon Launcher, you may see the “Play” or “Update” button on the Mabinogi game page. Once you click the button, the update will begin installing.Approximately 5GB of data will need to be installed.Additional drive space required for this patch is not necessary, as the files being installed will automatically overwrite the current files in your Mabinogi folder.After installation is done, the Mabinogi folder will be approximately 8.12 GB.After patching the game, you can login and play as normal.

Steam
If you have "Automatic updates" enabled for Mabinogi on Steam, the installation will begin once the patch is made available.If you do not have "Automatic updates" enabled, after launching the Steam client, you will see the "Update" button on the Mabinogi game page. Once you click the button, the update will begin installing.Approximately 5GB of data will need to be installed.Additional drive space required for this patch is not necessary, as the files being installed will automatically overwrite the current files in your Mabinogi folder.After installation is done, the Mabinogi folder will be approximately 8.75 GB.After patching the game, you can login and play as normal.
If you encounter any issues with this update, please reach out to our Customer Support team by submitting a ticket.

- The Mabinogi Team

[Daily Quest Task] Receive Cotton Candy by talking to a Dessert Merchant

[Daily Quest Task] Get into a Great Mood
Use the Rest skill anywhere in the Break Zone for 10 minutes to receive the Great Mood buff.
[Daily Quest Task] Play 1 Night Bazaar Game
Talk to Karo the Night Bazaar Game Guide to browse the available Night Bazaar Games.To complete the daily quest task, you'll have to score a certain amount of points or complete the puzzle while playing the Night Bazaar Games.Memory MatchObjective: Match all pairs within 50 secondsHow to Play:Select a card to flip it over to the front, showing either a delicious drink or food item, then select another card to see if it is a match.If it is a match, the cards will stay flipped over.If it is not a match, the cards will flip back over.Match all the food and drinks to their pair, and clear the board to win.Whack-an-ArmadilloObjective: Achieve a score of 100,000 pointsHow to Play:Whack an Armadillo holding fruit or the Royal Armadillo holding a ring to score points and increase your Combo streak!If you click on a hole with no Armadillo or click on a Bomb Armadillo, your Combo will reset.Sliding PuzzleObjective: Match all the puzzle piecesHow to Play:Click on a puzzle piece to move it in the direction of an open spot.Slide the puzzle pieces into the correct spots to complete the puzzle.When any of the four corner puzzles pieces have been placed in the correct spot, a check mark will appear in the corner where it belongs.Balloon PoppingObjective: Pop all the balloons within 2 minutesHow to Play:Pop the balloons by typing out the exact letters written on them.Spacing matters as well, so keep that in mind when typing.The round will end when you've popped all 16 balloons.Completing any of the above mini-games will mark your Daily Task as complete.Note: Even after you've completed a mini-game for the Daily Quest, you can still play the mini-games by talking to Karo.If you are done with a mini-game press the ESC key to close the window.
[Daily Quest Task] Help 1 Night Bazaar Shopkeeper
You can find the shopkeepers Paula, Moirin, and Shaun in the Break Zone, wearing Panda Party Hats!Every day, you can choose to Help a shopkeeper and receive their corresponding quest.Each shopkeeper gives out different requests to deliver food, gather ingredients, pick up trash, or clear a shadow mission or dungeon depending on the shopkeeper's needs.Completing any shopkeeper's request will reward the following:Night Bazaar Sticker x5Instant Prize Ticket x3Note: Quest items will be removed at 7:00 AM PDT the next day if the quest is not completed.

notes.title: Secondary Password Removal
notes.content:
Hello Milletians,

As a result of the rollout of Two-Factor Authentication and the Trusted Devices system, we are excited to share with you that during the March 17, 2022 update, the Secondary Password system will be removed from Mabinogi. Two-Factor Authentication provides better security for our Milletians and we believe that is will be a welcomed change. 

The Two-Factor Authentication methods and Trusted Devices can be found in the "Password & Security" tab in the Account Settings page. We encourage all Milletians to set up one of the followings methods as soon as possible.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1372/two-factor-authentication-nexon.png
Authenticator App: This option allows you to generate a secure, single-use passcode through your smartphone, using the free Google Authenticator app. This code will be required whenever you sign into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer, and changes frequently to prevent the code from being reusable or guessable.SMS: The SMS (Short Message Service, better known as Text Messaging) option will allow you to register your phone number with your Nexon account, where you will be texted a single-use passcode to be used alongside your password in order to log into your Nexon account while on a non-trusted computer.Email Verification: Upon logging into the Nexon Launcher on a non-trusted computer, you will be sent an email with a secure, single-use passcode required to verify your account. This is required of all Nexon accounts, in order to limit the likelihood of an unauthorized user gaining control over your account.Trusted Devices: Once you have completed email verification, you will be given the option to trust the device you are logging on with, allowing you to bypass both Email Verification and any other Two-Factor Authentication protections on that device for an even smoother login process. You can remove trusted devices via the Account Settings page at any time.
Again, we strongly encourage everyone to set up Two-Factor Authentication on your Nexon Accounts, either with an Authenticator App or through SMS (Text) Messaging. Doing so will help keep your account as safe and secure as can be. Please note that you can disable either factor whenever you wish, and while we encourage you to add an additional layer of security to your account in one of the manners described above, this is by no means a requirement to play Mabinogi.

Thank you,

-The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: Custom Motion - Patch Notes - February 17th, 2022
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Custom Motion update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Extended Crom Bás Support: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice2021 Winter Master Plan: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before MaintenanceIrusan's Attendance Check-in: Thursday, January 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before MaintenanceShining Stage Box: Thursday 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 24th, Before MaintenanceBodacious Party Bag: Thursday, February 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 10th, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Style Tab Hotday: Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before MaintenanceDoki Doki Island 2022: Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 17th, Before MaintenanceCustom Motion: Permanent
Custom Motion
You can now swap between custom idle motions of any outfits that have special poses! Read up on the full details on the webpost.The View Outfits with Motion checkbox has been added to the Dressing Room under the Clothing tab.Outfits with motion have been tagged with the green Motion button in the Dressing Room.When an outfit with custom motion is worn in the Style Tab, a small icon is visible on the inventory image. Clicking on the icon will bring up the Dressing Room with the View Outfits with Motion option selected.
Hand Remodel Update
Character hand models have been updated to include separate fingers. There are certain gloves that cause a graphical issue when worn after this update. These issues will be fixed over time.
Cherry Blossom Rain Event
During the event period, February 17th to March 17th, cherry blossom flowers will fall, instead of rain, in the Uladh and Iria regions.
If there are weather changes due to the mainstream storyline, the rain will not be affected by the cherry blossom rain.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where incorrect pronouns was used in the quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".Fixed a rare occurrence where Completed Glas Ghaibhleann appears to T-pose after the cutscene once defeating it.Fixed an issue of missing dialogue in Gillach's text in the quest, "Ne'er to Linger in the Darkness".Fixed an issue where there was a missing sentence in the item description for the Divine Cinnsealach L2 Dual Guns.Fixed an issue where the Folamh Doll Bag item description incorrectly mentions minerals instead of various ores.Fixed a grammar issue when using the Erg Crystal from the Milletian Full Boost event.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.The training methods for Handicraft Rank E are not counted when you make a Fused Erg Sealing Box.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.

notes.title: Doki Doki Island 2022
notes.content:
Do you hear that? It's the sound of your heart. Doki...Doki...That's right, Doki Doki Island is back! There's new rewards, such as a new, romantic way to fly around Doki Doki's gorgeous beaches, as well as new outfits, 2nd titles, and Homestead items! Check out the full details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 17th, Before Maintenance
The Newcomer’s Guide to Doki Doki Island
Feel your toes sink into the warm sand as you step foot on Doki Doki Island. This secluded paradise boasts beautiful scenery, and beach parties that rage all day, all night... all the time.

The Guide Quest
A Guide Quest, "[Event] Doki Doki Island Festival", is given to all players so long as this special seasonal event is active. Your travel agent is none other than Caravan Joe, located in Dunbarton. Speak to him about arranging a journey to Doki Doki Island.

When you disembark, you'll find a Matchmaker on the beach, waiting to welcome you to Doki Doki Island.

As part of the Guide Quest, she can register your Matchmaking profile. Doki Doki Island is an experience best suited to couples, so find yourself a Soulmate and get your heart beating! Already have a partner in mind? Just right-click and “Select Soulmate” on anyone on the island.

Finish the Guide Quest, and earn your very first Doki Doki Commemorative Box by talking to Wenger the Caretaker – he knows how to get you home.
[table][tr][th]Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/th][/tr][tr][td]
This special item is awarded for completing various events and mini-games around the island, or by redeeming Cat's Paw to Mansur the Jeweler. Click here for a full list of items you can obtain from this box.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1458/mabinogi-doki-doki-commermorative-box.png
[/td][/tr][/table]

The Soulmate Systemhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1460/mabinogi-doki-doki-soulmates.jpg
Matchmakers all over Doki Doki Island are ready and willing to set you up with the Milletian of your dreams! Existing couples can skip the formalities, but singles are advised to set up a profile. If you're not one for online dating, there’s nothing stopping you from meeting that special someone on your own! You can proposition any unclaimed player regardless of race or gender.

You can break up with your Soulmate at any time. Just remember that if you do, you’ll lose all the Romantic Points you’ve built up with that player and will have to start all over again.

Romantic Points
They say love can’t be measured… except on Doki Doki Island! By enjoying all of what Doki Doki has to offer, you’ll acquire Romantic Points.
[table][tr][th]Action[/th][th]Romantic Points[/th][/tr][tr][td]Score 50 points or more in a Doki Doki Dance Party[/td][td]40 Romantic Points[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stand by your Soulmate (within 20m)[/td][td]10 Romantic Points every 5 minutes[/td][/tr][tr][td]Successfully complete the Depths of the Heart Test[/td][td]100 Romantic Points (1% of overall likeability)[/td][/tr][/table]
The more points you accrue, the more you’ll fall in love with your partner, as indicated by the likability meter. 100 Romantic Points = 1%. The Soulmate UI has also been improved to show the decimal point, so you can now see the increase in 0.1% increments to show how precise your love is.

Earn enough points and you’ll earn the greatest gift of all…

TRUE LOVE.

Oh, and the power of Flight.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1461/mabinogi-doki-doki-island-midnight-flight.png

Couples Flight: Fly with the Power of Love!https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1462/mabinogi-doki-doki-flight-image.png
If you want love to lift you up off your feet, you’ll need to reach 20% likability with your partner, though your new abilities will be confined to the island. You’ll be pretty in love… but you know – not really in love.

If you want to see the entirety of mainland Erinn from amongst the clouds, you and your Soulmate will need to achieve 100% likeability.
Flight - The ability to fly anywhere on Doki Doki Island.Couples Flight - The ability to fly anywhere in Erinn where flying is permitted.Sweethearts Flight - Fly around Erinn with your partner, embracing them as you do so. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.Moonlight Couples Flight - Fly around Erinn with your partner, dancing with them as you do. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.Harmony Flight - Fly around Erinn with your partner, lifting them in the air as you do so. Obtained with Cat's Paw from Mansur.*NEW* Midnight Flight - Fly around Erinn and dance the night away with your sweetie. Obtain with Cat's Paw from Mansur.

Getting to Know the Island
Doki Doki is a beautiful place, and simple to navigate once you’ve memorized all the major landmarks.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1471/mabinogi-doki-doki-map.png

The Harmony Torch
An ancient, mystical torch in the center of Doki Doki’s Town Square is the hub of the island's activity. Celebrate the Harmony Torch by lighting a fire of your own! Building a campfire and resting nearby will award EXP every 5 seconds. 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1463/mabinogi-doki-doki-harmony-torch.jpg

Starting to feel a little intoxicated? Spend too much time resting at the Torch and you’ll get a tingling Lovey Dovey feeling…

[table][tr][th]Lovey Dovey Buff[/th][/tr][tr][td]
- All Stats +20
- Max HP +100
- Max MP +100
- Max Stamina +100
- Max Damage +30
- Critical +5
- Defense +5
- Protection +5
- Magic Defense +5
- Combat EXP +50%
[/td][/tr][/table]
This special buff will last for 30 minutes, beginning the moment you stop resting. You can also receive up to 5 Doki Doki Commemorative Boxes when receive the Lovey Dovey Buff each day. This will reset every day at 7:00 AM PT.

The Depths of the Heart Test
Psychology Students can be found throughout Doki Doki, studying the effects of love and romance on volunteer test subjects. Show one how well you know your Soulmate by taking the Depths of the Heart Test.

You’ll be asked a random question, and if you and your match answer simultaneously and prove you’re in-sync, you’ll win a Doki Doki Commemorative Box and advance 1% on your likability meter.

This special test is only available once per day. It will reset at 12:00 AM PT.

Fun & Games
There’s no end to the amount of fun you can find on Doki Doki Island. Take a little time off from your daily routine to play mini-games and win a variety of Romantic Rewards…

The Doki Doki Dance Party is an opportunity to strut your stuff for all the Town Square to see. Match the steps in order and on-time to execute strong, effective dance moves. If you and your Soulmate score 50 points or above you'll both earn 40 Romantic Points!

To start dancing, you’ll need a Boom Box. Browse Mansur the Jewel Collector's shop.

Grab your band mates and rent out the special Stage found on the south side of the island for anywhere between 5 to 30 minutes. You won't take home any points or boxes, but Starlet will be the first to tell you: the joy of performing is its own reward.

The Soulmate-Seeking Milletian is waiting on the island with a special request. Provide them with 1 Silk Snapper, 1 Salmon, and 1 Bluefin Tuna to feed their pet seal, Cotton Candy, and they will reward you with 15 Silvervine Fruit and 15 Potatoes! You can only complete this request once per real life day, only on one character per account.

Helping Out & Kicking Back
Games are all well and good, but this island doesn’t sustain itself. If you’re planning on spending any amount of time here, ask Wenger about how you can give back to the community and lend a helping hand.


Daily Quest: Fishing, Cooking, and Metallurgy
Doki Doki's old caretaker sure has his hands full catering for all the guests. How about helping out a little in return for some Cat's Paws?
[table][tr][th]Quest Name[/th][th]Details[/th][th]Rewards[/th][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: Taters Please[/td][td]Deliver 30 Potatoes[/td][td]3 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: A Fine Fruit[/td][td]
Deliver 15 Silvervine Fruit

Tip: When collecting Silvervine Fruit, Phantasmal Sight can be used
[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: A Good Meal[/td][td]Deliver 5 Onion Fried Tuna
(Cooking Method: Mixing)[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: On the Line[/td][td]Deliver 7 Salmon[/td][td]3 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: On the Line[/td][td]Deliver 1 Pink Starfish[/td][td]5 Cat's Paw[/td][/tr][tr][td]Help Wenger: The Cat's Meow[/td][td]
Deliver 5 Cat's Paw

Note: The Cat's Paw is not automatically delivered when talking to Wenger. Instead, the [Hand Over Cat's Paw] button is now available for use.
[/td][td]1 Doki Doki Commemorative Box[/td][/tr][/table]
Prefer to get your hands dirty? If you've got a Metallurgy Sieve, you could find all sorts of treasures buried in the sand, including Cat's Paw. 

Their unique shimmer makes night-time the best time to find them, but they’re easily missed with the hot sun beating down on the sand.

There are rumors that they’re most prevalent in the Southeast corner of the island…

Daily Quest: Natural Dyes
Want to make your own dyes with organic ingredients? Register a main character at the Natural Dye Helper near the Festival Market on Doki Doki Island. In doing so, you will also be rewarded 5 Cat's Paw. The Natural Dye Helper will let you play a fun mini-game, allowing you to add blueberries, cherries, and herbs to create your own dye! Dyes are based in RGB form for the mini-game.

However, keep in mind that the Natural Dye Event and quest will only available during Week 1 and Week 3 of the event.
Week 1: Thursday, February 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 24th, Before MaintenanceWeek 3: Thursday, March 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 10th, Before Maintenance
Once the dye is made you can click on the Dye Ampoule or Metal Dye Ampoule icon in the bottom right hand corner to convert the left-overs into a new dye. You can only choose one though! These special dyes are not tradable. Take the Natural Dye Ampoule to one of the sheets located around Doki Doki Island to dye it a new color for 3 Cat's Paw and 1 Doki Doki Commemorative Box!

Daily Quest: Dancing with DJ Romantic
Dance the night away, under the moonlight of Doki Doki Island! Register a main character with DJ Romantic at the Town Square in Doki Doki Island. After registering, you will be rewarded with 5 Cat's Paw. Show off those moves by talking to DJ Romantic and selecting Dance Challenge. Use WASD and the Space key to dance to the rhythm. If you earn 50+ points, DJ Romantic will reward you with 15 Cat's Paw. You can challenge DJ Romantic as many times as you want, but you can only earn the reward once per day. 


Since DJ Romantic is very famous, he will only be available during Week 2 and Week 4 of the event as he needs to go do some judging for a gig.
Week 2: Thursday, February 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before MaintenanceWeek 4: Thursday, March 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 17th, Before Maintenance

Cat's Paw
Take Cat's Paws to Mansur the Jewel Collector, who hangs out beside Wenger. He’s crazy for these little gems, and he’s got some very rare items he’s willing to trade if you collect enough…
