notes.title: Irusan's Attendance Check-in
notes.content:
Time to check in, meow! Log in everyday for new rewards, including the Incubus King outfit set. And if you finish the attendance calendar before the end of the event, there is a bonus attendance calendar with more rewards! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, January 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 14th, Before Maintenance
Event Detailshttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1267/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-icon.pngDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] A Girl's Request.Find A Girl in Need in front of the Unicorn Statue.Register a main character with A Girl in Need.You can only register one character per account.Once registered, an Irusan icon will appear on your screen. 
You can view the calendar by clicking on the icon.There are a total of 3 calendars. The first two calendars will each have 36 days, while the last calendar will only have 9 days of log in.You can also view how many stamps you have, how much time is remaining before you receive a stamp, or how far along you are.Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a stamp.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a stamp.You can only receive the stamp prizes on your main character.If you still have time remaining on your calendar and it is already 7:00 AM PT, the remaining time will not reset.If you log out and log in after 7:00 AM PT the next day without completing the previous day's attendance, the remaining time you had is still counted and you can continue to stay logged in to complete the attendance.Once the attendance is complete, for the two situations above, you can no longer continue with the current day's attendance.You will only receive 1 stamp per day.Every weekend, you will receive 2 stamps per day (for a total of four).Rewards that aren't claimed when the event is over will automatically be added to the registered main character's Point Shop Inventory.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1265/mabinogi-irusan-attendance-calendar-ui.png
Attendance Pass PurchaseIf you miss a day, you can purchase an Attendance Pass for 29 Pon.The Attendance Pass will stamp one day you missed on the calendar.The Attendance Pass is not an item that is stored in your inventory; instead, when purchased, the pass is immediately used.The amount of passes you can buy increases daily, if you missed a previous day's login. It is increased by 2 on weekends.

notes.title: Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2 - Patch Notes - January 13th, 2022
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Crom Bás Part 2 update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Extended Crom Bás Support: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeMischievous Pet Box: Thursday, December 30th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 27th, Before MaintenanceWinter Fishing Event 2022: Thursday, January 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 3rd, Before MaintenanceCrom Bás Doll Bag Box: Thursday, January 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 10th, Before MaintenanceCrom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2: Permanent
Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss Part 2
Part 2 of the Crom Bás Update is here! To learn more about the Crom Bás update, check out the microsite and the dungeon guide.Additional story quests have been added.Crom Bás Quest Mode has been added:Weaker enemies and automatic revivals are available in quest mode.Only gold rewards can be obtained from this mode.Two final Bosses, Completed Glas Ghaibhleann and Giga Glas Ghaibhleann lurk in the deepest depths of the Crom Bás dungeon.Gillach's Shop has been unlocked. You can use Adamantine Coins to buy new rewards.New crafting materials can be obtained from the Crom Bás Advanced and Elite dungeon difficulty.
Dark Erg ChunkAdamantineGlas Ghaibhleann HeartDamaged Glas Ghaibhleann Feather16 new weapons of the Nightbringer series can now be crafted:Nightbringer Assault - One-handed SwordNightbringer Predator- BowNightbringer Rogue - CrossbowNightbringer Elementalist - Wand Nightbringer Technician - CylinderNightbringer Trickster - Control BarNightbringer Warlord - Two-handed SwordNightbringer Berserker - Two-handed AxeNightbringer Inquisitor - StaffNightbringer Spearhead - LanceNightbringer Vagabond - KnucklesNightbringer Vanquisher - Dual GunNightbringer Infiltrator - ShurikenNightbringer Wraith - Chain BladeNightbringer Vanguard - ShieldNightbringer Prophet - Spell BookAdditionally, you can obtain the new Nightbringer Huntsman - Arrows from the two final bosses.The Fused Erg Sealing Box can be crafted using Handicraft (Rank 1), and contains various rewards such as the Nightbringer Wings and Crom Bás NPC 2nd Title Coupons.The Sturdy Loop item and crafting recipe has been added to Weaving.Blessings that were given by the Soul have been removed, and have been changed so that Blessing above level 2 will be reduced by 1 level upon death. If the Blessing is level 1, it will still be removed when you die.The Extended Crom Bás Support Event has been updated.3x Adamantine Coins can be obtained from Advanced and Elite mode during the event period.On Sundays only, the Dark Erg Fragment can be purchased from Gillach's Shop.
Doll Bag AI Improvement
Dolls will now pick up to 20 of all available items within a certain range around the doll at once, instead of picking up each item one at a time.Dolls now move in a more efficient way in certain situations, such as when there are obstacles, or when moving away from the character.The interval between the doll's attempts to reacquire items that you do not own, such as other party member's drops, has been changed from 10 seconds to 10 minutes.Dolls will now search for the next item instead of wandering around an item it can not pick up.There is no longer a notice message that appears when a Doll fails to pick up an item.
The following changes have been made to the game:
The following set effects can now be seen in the Character Status Effects list:Battle Alchemy EnhancementTransmutation EnhancementHero Alchemy EnhancementMarionette Stun Resistance RateMarionette Critical DamagePuppetry Skill Cooldown DecreasedEnhanced Critical DamageEnhanced BashDecreased Durability LossIncreased Movement SpeedReduced Attack DelayIncreased Max DamageIncreased Magic AttackWith the November 2021 update, the attack speed of Divine Cinnsealach L2 weapons was increased.Weapons created before the update had a slower attack speed than weapons created after the update.The attack speed of all Divine Cinnsealach L2 weapons have now been updated to the same Very Fast attack speed.  
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed some minor spacing issues in the Crom Bás shadow mission quest dialogue.Fixed an issue where the "Continue" button would disappear during the Crom Bás quest, "The Souls Speak - Part 2".Fixed an issue where XML code would appear when you obtained the title, "whose Flow was Hotter than Raspa Volcano" and "who Dropped the Mic".Fixed text issues in the dialogue for the Crom Bás quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".Fixed the inconsistent naming for the Belvast Supplier when opening their shop.Fixed minor text issues when speaking to the Belvast NPCs.Fixed multiple typos in the dialogue for the quest, "Waves Amidst the Calm".Fixed the overlay of the World Map when using the Tory Ravine Moon Gate.Changed the event name of the Winter Master Plan Hotday UI to 2021 Winter Master Plan Weekly Hotday Event.Fixed a typo in the tooltip for Rank 8 First Aid.Fixed a text issue in the Dungeon Notebook where it incorrectly stated that Heavy Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Dungeon instead of Light Armor Fragments.Fixed a text issue in the Dungeon Notebook where it incorrectly stated that Light Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Hardmode Dungeon instead of Heavy Armor Fragments. Fixed a typo in Melwyn's dialogue during the quest, "[Guide] An Astronomical Discovery".Fixed a typo for Spirit Control that incorrectly stated that Alchemic Damage is increased as a percentage of base HP, when it is actually increased as a percentage of base STR.Fixed an issue where the incorrect pronouns were used during the quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.There is a rare occurrence that Completed Glas Ghaibhleann will appear to T-pose after the cutscene once defeating it.The training methods for Handicraft Rank E are not counted when you make a Fused Erg Sealing Box.There is a missing dialogue line for Gillach during the quest, "Ne'er to Linger in the Darkness".There is a missing sentence in the item description for the Divine Cinnsealach L2 Dual Guns.The Folamh Doll Bag item description incorrectly mentions minerals instead of various ores.When you first open the Master Plan Inventory, it will incorrectly show as locked. Closing and reopening the inventory will fix the issue.There is a grammar issue when using the Erg Crystal from the Milletian Full Boost event.

notes.title: Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss - Patch Notes - December 9th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Crom Bás update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Forgotten Tomb Dungeon 2021: Thursday, December 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 23rd, Before Maintenance
Crom Bás Celebration Events: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 13th, Before Maintenance2021 Winter Master Plan: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 3rd, Before MaintenanceExtended Crom Bás Support: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further NoticeCrom Bás: Unveiled Abyss: Permanent
Crom Bás: Unveiled Abyss
To learn more about the Crom Bás update, check out the microsite and the dungeon guide.The Crom Bás area and dungeon have been discovered in Tory Ravine.You will receive the Crom Bás Dungeon quest, [Contents] Waves Amidst the Calm, and a Wings of the Blue Goddess (The Dunbarton Mailbox) if your character's Total Combat Skill Level is 1,500 or higher.
New enemies have been added, including the dungeon Boss, Irusan.Clear the Crom Bás dungeon to earn new rewards as well as Adamantine Coins which can be used in Gillach's Shop.Gillach's Shop will unlock in the Crom Bás Part 2 update.New enchant scrolls and crafting materials can be obtained from the Crom Bás dungeon.A new accessory, Irusan's Bell, can be crafted using the new material, Grumpy Cat's Marble.The Moon Gate - Tory Ravine - Crom Bás Entrance has been added and can be teleported to using the Traveler's Guide.
Holiday Decorations
Erinn is celebrating the holidays from Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance to Thursday, January 13th, Before Maintenance, and the following areas will be decorated with holiday cheer:
The town of DunbartonThe Dunbarton Church TreeFestiaAdditionally, it will snow instead of rain during the event period.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Players from the Netherlands now have trade limitations placed on them. For more information, please refer to the announcement post.Female Giants will no longer have closed hands when standing.With the above change, the standing model of all characters, regardless of race or gender, has been changed so that the hands are either opened or closed randomly. 
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed a minor typo in the G16 quest, "The Crow's Call".Fixed an issue where the title "the Super Diligent" would be incorrect when equipped.Fixed an issue where the movement speed of an Elf character would be slow if they had a Bouquet item equipped.Fixed an issue where the Chef's Passion item could not be reforged.Fixed an issue where the newly added Shadow Missions did not drop Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Tickets.Fixed an issue with the Pet Skill window not being able open with a shortcut key.Fixed a visual issue with the Fynn Bead Skill details button in the Pet/Partner Information window.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.The inventory image for the Mace of Mercy is incorrect.Feeding a Pet Instructor Stick to a Level 100 Spirit weapon will cause the character to freeze.If you had a unicode heart on your wedding ring, the heart appears as a question mark.The Shaggy Perm hairstyle can be saved in a Beauty Slot.Cobweb Mummy enemies do not appear in the Alby Advanced Dungeon.Guilds are not appearing in the Guild List.There are minor spacing issues in the Crom Bás quest dialogue.There are multiple typos in the Crom Bás quest, "Waves Amidst the Calm".There are minor text issues when speaking to the NPCs near the Crom Bás entrance.The Belvast Supplier's name changes when you open up their shop.There are minor text issues in the Crom Bás quest, "The Dark Beneath the Veil".During the Crom Bás quest, "The Souls Speak - Part 2", there is an issue during the shadow mission "Sleeves Wet with Bloody Tears" where the Continue button is not visible. This can be resolved by resizing the client window while in windowed mode, or entering/exiting fullscreen mode.The Dungeon Notebook incorrectly states that Heavy Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Dungeon instead of Light Armor Fragments.The Dungeon Notebook incorrectly states that Light Armor Fragments can be obtained in the Ciar Advanced Hardmode Dungeon instead of Heavy Armor Fragments.

notes.title: Netherlands Trade Limitations Update
notes.content:
Dear Dutch Milletians,

We've updated more details on the trade functionality changes that we announced in our Notice for Netherlands Players: Part 2. In order to comply with Netherlands regulations, the following in-game trade functions will be restricted for Dutch players:
Give and Receive items via 1:1 Exchange tradeItem droppingBuy and Sell via the Auction HouseMailing messages with items attachedPersonal shop sales or purchases (viewing other players' shops is still possible)Even if you have a Personal Shop Bag, you cannot open a Personal Shop.You can still buy the Merchant License from the Bank, but you cannot use it.Housing shop purchases (viewing items is still possible)Kiosk sales or purchases (viewing other players' Kiosks is still possible)Items given in exchange for an Enchant EntrustmentItems acquired through pet battlesEntering Uladh/Iria Dungeons using Item Drops, or touching the statueIf you are in a party as a party member, you can enter the dungeon with other players when they enter.You can enter a dungeon if you use a Unlimited Dungeon Pass.Receiving Mail Delivery part-time jobs from the Tara Bank
The above limitations will be implemented during the December 9th, 2021 maintenance.

Thank you,

- The Mabinogi Team

notes.title: [UPDATED] Extended Crom Bás Support
notes.content:
To help out Milletians with the exploration of Crom Bás, we are running support events! Equipment in Crom Bás will lose durability at a slower rate and Milletians will be rewarded with more Adamantine Coins! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, December 9th, After Maintenance - Until Further Notice
Crom Bás Durability Event DetailsDuring the event period, the durability of equipment items decreases slowly.This effect is only applied within the Crom Bás Dungeon.This is automatically applied when entering the Crom Bás Dungeon during the event period.This effect is also applied even when a character dies and re-enters the dungeon.It will not be applied when you exit the dungeon or change channels.The effect does not apply when using Life Skills in the Crom Bás Dungeon.The Blessing effect from Holy Water of Lymilark and the event effect overlap.During the event period, you can speak to Gillach about the event details at the entrance of Crom Bás.Crom Bás Fever Time Event DetailsEvery weekend during the event period (Friday, Saturday, and Sunday), the Crom Bás Fever Time event will be available.On Sundays, in real-time, Dark Erg Fragments can be purchased in Gillach's Shop for 500 Adamantine Coins.You can combine 5 Dark Erg Fragments to obtain 1 Dark Erg Chunk.When you clear Crom Bás, you will get 3 times more Adamantine Coins.The amount of coins rewarded is based on the Dark Erg % level when the dungeon is cleared.

notes.title: [UPDATED] Forgotten Tomb Dungeon 2021
notes.content:
Adventurous Milletians can trek to the Forgotten Tomb, where high-tier Gear, Weapons, and Treasures await. Defeating the enemy can lead to great riches, if you dare. This year, you can even find the Forest Ranger Set! Check out the details below.

Event/Sale Dates: Thursday, December 2nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 23rd, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsTalk to the Explorer of the Forgotten Tomb near the Dunbarton Town Square to enter the Treasure Hidden in a Chest Shadow Mission.
You must have at least one Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket or Forgotten Tomb Special Key Exchange Ticket to enter the Forgotten Tomb dungeon. Tickets are exchanged for keys that will open the treasure chests.
You can find high-tier items when using the Forgotten Tomb Special Key Exchange Ticket.Tickets obtained during the event/sale period will only grant rewards from the reward lists below.You can only exchange tickets within the dungeon.When you enter the dungeon, one Goblin, Poison Goblin or Goblin Archer will spawn.When the monster is defeated, 66 treasure chests are spawned. Use the Forgotten Tomb Treasure Chest Key or Forgotten Tomb Special Treasure Chest Key to open the chests. Each key will open one chest.There are several ways to obtain tickets.
There is a chance to obtain a Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket (Event) after clearing any Tara or Taillteann Shadow Mission during the event. Your chance to obtain a Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket (Event) increases with the Shadow Mission difficulty, with harder missions having a higher chance to drop the item.UPDATE 12/3: The following Shadow Missions will not grant Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Tickets. We apologize for the inconvenience:Sniper War - Tara Shadow MissionShadow Realm Champion - Tara Shadow MissionLet Them Fight - Taillteann Shadow MissionAll-Out War - Taillteann Shadow MissionMaster of Corrib Cabin - Lord MissionFragments of a Trivial Fate - Lord MissionA Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket (Event) will expire 30 days after you obtain itYou can also purchase tickets through the Cash Shop.Tickets are bound to the character and cannot be traded.When you exit the dungeon with any remaining keys, the keys are destroyed. However, all destroyed keys will be returned as tickets.The Explorer of the Forgotten Tomb NPC, and the Treasure Hidden in a Chest Shadow Mission will be available beyond December 23rd.
You will be unable to purchase additional tickets after the sale period ends on December 23rd.The ability to receive the Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Ticket (Event) from the Shadow Missions also ends on December 23rd.Note: Forgotten Tomb Key Exchange Tickets (Event) will be REMOVED at the end of the event. This includes event tickets from last year and this year.

notes.title: Milletian Full Boost!
notes.content:
To prepare all Milletians for the upcoming abyss, Boost Joe has created a special training program for everyone! Boost Joe will run weekly boost events that include Stardust, Techniques, Echostones, Spirit Weapons, Renown, and Erg! Additionally, you will be able to create a Black Combo Card. Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, November 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 9th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] Milletian Full Boost!Talk to Boost Joe in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Boost Joe.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Milletian Full Boost:12,000 EXPIncomplete Black Combo CardThe event resets daily at 7:00 AM PST.Boost Joe's Special TrainingYou will receive the daily quest, [Daily] Boost Joe's Special Training.You will also receive one Boost Joe's Special Training Mission Pass.Use the Boost Joe's Special Training Mission Pass and complete the mission. To enter the mission, right-click "Use" on the pass.You are able to choose the difficulty level for the mission.Beginner is about the same as the Hard difficulty Shadow Missions.Intermediate is about the same as the Elite difficulty Shadow Missions.Hard is as hard as Tech Duinn Missions.You can complete this mission with a party of up to 4 people.When completing this mission, you will receive EXP, Gold, and a Mission Reward Box depending on the difficulty level.The Mission Reward Box will grant a random Skill Combo Card Fragment of a Talent.The higher the difficulty of the mission, the more Skill Combo Card Fragments you will receive.Combine 10 Skill Combo Card Fragments of the same Talent to receive a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon of that Talent.By completing Boost Joe's Special Training Missions, you can receive 30 Combo points, up to 90 Combo points per day.Combo points can be used to modify the Incomplete Black Combo Card.Right-click "Use" on the Incomplete Black Combo Card in your inventory, then click Customize Combo Card.Select a Slot Number of the Incomplete Black Combo Card and choose to change the skill, or unlock the slot.You can use 40 Combo points and a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon to change one skill of the Incomplete Black Combo Card to a skill of the Talent.You can use 60 Combo points to unlock a new skill on the selected Slot Number.Note: Slots must be unlocked in order from Slot Number 4 to Slot Number 6.You can click on Bonus Reset for Slots 2 through 6, and reset the bonus value of the Slot using 35 Combo points.When you are satisfied with the Black Combo Card, click on Complete Combo Card to receive the Black Combo Card in your Combo Card menu.Do not complete the card until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.Completing the Combo Card is NOT reversible. Even if you complete the card by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.The Black Combo Card will expire in 30 days, but can be extended or made permanent using the Permanent Combo Card Coupon item.Once you have completed the card, you can no longer edit it.Similar to normal Combo Cards, you can customize it using Advancement Badges.Weekly Boost Events
Week 1 (November 18th, After Maintenance - November 25th, 7:00 AM PST)
Stardust Boost Event
During the event period, you will receive double of the following materials received from completing Melwyn's Society Sponsorship quests:
Stardust Core Binding AgentStardust Core Fragment (All Types)Stardust Regulator Frame ConnectorStardust Regulator Frame (All Types)Royal Society Sponsorship Badges are not doubled during the event.The bonus from the Royal Academy Crystal will stack with the event bonus.
Technique Growth Boost Event
During the event period, you will obtain double Briogh. The maximum Briogh that can be earned per week will also be increased.Briogh of Achievement
Each time your character levels up, 20 Briogh is obtained.Briogh of ChallengeEach time you complete a Dungeon or Mission, 100 Briogh is obtained.Briogh of DisciplineEach time you complete a repeatable quest, 100 Briogh is obtained.Note: Using 1 AP to exchange for 10 Briogh will not be doubled, however the System message will state "Obtain 2x Briogh" as other methods to gain Briogh during the event is doubled.The maximum amount of Briogh that can be earned per week is increased by 2x.The weekly Briogh limit is increased to 3,000 during the event.The weekly Briogh limit resets on Saturday at 12:00 AM PST.If you reach the 1,500 Briogh limit before the event, you can still acquire the additional 1,500 Briogh up to the event cap of 3,000 Briogh until the weekly reset.When the event ends, the weekly gain is reduced back to 1,500. If you are over this weekly limit, you can no longer acquire Briogh, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event until the weekly reset.Note: The maximum amount of Briogh you can store at a given time is still 5,000 per Briogh type and it does not change during the event.
Week 2 (November 25th, 7:00 AM PST - December 2nd, Before Maintenance)
Echostone Boost Event
During the event period, the Echostone Advancement success rate is increased by 10%.
Spirit Growth Boost Event
During the event period, your Spirit Weapons will earn double EXP, and the weekly Spirit EXP limit will be increased.The Spirit Growth menu will show EXP 2x when selecting items to feed the Spirit Weapon.The weekly Spirit EXP limit increased to 800,000 EXP during the event period.This weekly Spirit EXP limit resets on Saturday at 7:00 AM PST.
If you reached the 400,000 EXP limit before event starts, you can still acquire the additional 400,000 EXP up to the event cap of 800,000 until the weekly reset.When the event ends, the weekly gain is limited to 400,000 again. If you are over this weekly limit, you can no longer acquire EXP, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event period until the weekly reset.
Week 3 (December 2nd, After Maintenance - December 9th, Before Maintenance)
Renown Growth Boost Event
During the event period, you will receive double Renown EXP when completing a requirement for accumulating Renown. The daily Renown EXP limit will also be increased.Note: Using Music or Life Renown Training Seals will not be doubled.The maximum amount of Renown that can be earned per day will be increased by 2x.You can receive up to 4,000 Renown EXP for Nele, Yvona, and Briana.You can receive up to 20,000 Renown EXP for Endelyon, Edern, and Eluned.This daily Renown EXP limit resets at 7:00 AM PST.If you reached the daily Renown limit before the event starts, you can still acquire the additional Renown up to the event cap for the Music and/or the Life Renown NPCs until the daily reset.When the event ends, the daily gain is limited once again. If you are over this daily limit, you can no longer acquire Renown, but the UI will show the excess experience gained during the event until the reset.
Erg Boost Event
When you log in during the event period, you will receive different items to help you with Erg. On the first log-in during the event you will receive:Lv. 10 Erg Infusion CatalystThis item can only be used after the event ends on December 9th, After Maintenance.Known Issue: If you try to use this item while the event is in progress, the message that appears is untranslated.Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster CouponOn subsequent log-ins during the event, up to 4 times:Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster CouponNote: The Erg Infusion Catalyst Booster Coupon can only be used during the event. If you use the coupon outside of the event, you will receive an AP 5 Potion instead.The daily event reset time is 12:00 AM PST.Use the Booster Coupon to upgrade the Erg Infusion Catalyst by 2 levels each time.Use up to 5 coupons to increase the Erg Infusion Catalyst to level 20.The upgraded Erg Infusion Catalyst will expire in 15 days.Note: Only the main character registered for the event can receive the rewards.

notes.title: Reflections: Reforged - Patch Notes - November 4th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections: Reforged update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceThe Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before MaintenanceMidnight Loot-o'-Lantern: Thursday, October 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before MaintenanceMilletian Event: Erinn Attendance: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceAutumn Night Camping: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before MaintenanceRoyal Mage's Box: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before MaintenanceErinn Revitalized - Quality of Life Updates: PermanentReforging Renewed - New Reforging Tools: Permanent
New Reforging Tools
To learn more about the New Reforging Tools, check out the full details here.New Reforging Tools have been added to the game:Basic Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through in-game contents.Precise Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through in-game contents.Exquisite Reforging Tools - These tools can be obtained through the Cash Shop.A new item, Hope Essence, can be obtained by using Exquisite Reforging Tools.You can exchange Hope Essence with Lassar in Tir Chonaill or Stewart in Dunbarton for additional items that can help you reforge items.Existing Reforging Tools can still be used in-game, but they have been discontinued from the Cash Shop.The Reforging Tool menu and overall UI has been changed and usability has been improved.The way that Reforging Attributes are displayed in the item tooltip has been changed.
Quality of Life Updates
To learn more about the November 2021 Quality of Life updates, check out the full details here.Several Combo Card improvements have been added to the Combo Card menu.There are also several new improvements made to the Spirit menu.You are also now able to seal items to exclude them from the list of available items to feed your Spirit.Some of the enchants on the Blossoming Memories weapons have been changed to enchants that do not increase the repair fee for the weapons.There are new changes to the Auction House.New buttons have been added to the Auction House for your convenience.New functions have been added to prevent mistakes when buying or selling items on the Auction House.Expired items, excluding Enchant Scrolls, can no longer be listed on the Auction House.A feature to check the Item Details of items not currently being sold on the Auction House has been added.
The following changes have been made to the game:
A change has been made so that when the Shadow Effect in Options>System>Effect is set to Not Used, the Shadow Blurring option will be deactivated.A change has been made to include the bank fee when purchasing items back from the Repurchase tab if originally sold to an NPC using Direct Bank Transaction.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the Dexterity stat did not increase when you consume certain amounts of specific food items.Fixed an intermittent issue where the Echostone Advancement UI and Inventory closes while upgrading Echostones.Fixed an issue where a Trade Unlock Potion could be used on a Falias Treasure that was equipped.Fixed an issue where the icon displayed above the targeted enemy will disappear if you press the skill hotkey again while Spinning Slasher is already loaded.Fixed an issue where the character’s Skill window gets closed when you view the pet or partner's Skill menu while the character’s Skill window is open.Fixed the skill Arrow Revolver so that it no longer inflicts elemental damage to elemental damage immune monsters.Fixed an issue where the incorrect image was used for the Bebhinn 2nd Title when equipped.Fixed various text issues in the Uladh Dungeon section of the Dungeon Guide.Fixed a typo in the description of the Subject Theta Bag Fragment item.Fixed a typo in Ethel's dialogue for the Billionaire's Bankroll Event.Fixed a typo in Blaanid's dialogue.Updated the Dungeon Guide for main rewards information to clarify [Refined] Blacksmith Manual Fragment Set.Fixed an issue where Music Buffs extended by the Spirit of Tuan pet were not reflected in the Status List.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charge gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.Fine Reforging Tools can still be obtained in the Eweca Orb.There is text cut-off in the Buy Item UI when buying the Royal Society Appreciation Box from Melwyn.There is an issue with movement speed when an Elf character equips bouquet items.Chef's Passion is unable to be reforged.

notes.title: Erinn Revitalized - Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
Combo Card ChangesSeveral Combo Card improvements have been added to the Combo Card menu.
The maximum number of Combo Cards that you can have at one time has been expanded to 30.The Multi-Delete function has been added. 
When ‘Multi-Delete’ is checked, select the Combo Cards to remove, then click Eliminate to remove them from the list.Note: Combo Cards cannot be recovered once deleted.https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1360/mabinogi-qol-nov-combo-change-order.pngThe Change Order function has been added.When 'Change Order' is checked, select a Combo Card then use the arrows in the menu to change the card’s position in the list, then click Save to confirm.An improvement has been made so that when trying to delete the currently activated Combo Card, a Warning message highlights that an activated card is selected.Spirit Menu ChangesSeveral improvements to the Spirit menu have been added. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1361/mabinogi-qol-nov-spirit-select-unseal.pngA new function to seal items has been added to the Spirit menu. This function allows you to exclude items from the list of available items to feed to the Spirit in the Spirit Growth section.To seal an item, open the Spirit Information menu -> Growth -> Etc. tab and right-click items to select them, then click the Seal Item button to seal them.Sealed items will appear in the Sealed Item tab under Spirit Information -> Growth.To unseal items, click to select items in this tab, then click Break the seal.Non-equipment items will be filtered as Miscellaneous items in the Sealed Item tab.The following equipment items will be filtered in the Misc. tab:Empty BottlePoison BottleStrawberry Cookie WandChocolate Cookie WandVanilla Cookie WandSelecting 1 Misc. item of the same type will automatically select all items, and will appear as 1 Misc. Item in the Sealed tab regardless of how many items of the same type are in the character’s inventory.The Spirit’s Fav. Gem information has been moved to the top-left, above the Spirit’s portrait in Spirit Information -> Growth.Blossoming Memories Weapons ChangesSome of the enchants on the Blossoming Memories weapons given in Blaanid's Brave Boost have been changed to enchants that do not increase the repair fee. 
The Blossoming Memories weapons that you already own will have their enchants changed during the November 4th, 2021 maintenance.Obtaining any of the Blossoming Memories weapons from Blaanid's Brave Boost will come with new enchants without the Repair Fee increase.The new enchants have the same effects as the previous enchants, excluding the repair fee increase.The Blue Fragrance enchant substituting the Girgashiy enchant will increase Max HP by 80 regardless of the equipped title.Auction House ChangesWhen purchasing items on the Auction House, the confirmation menu that used to display after clicking the Purchase button has been removed. 
Current process: Click the item listing -> Item Details menu is displayed -> click Purchase button -> purchase is completed.When selling items on the Auction House, the confirmation menu that used to display after clicking the List button has been removed. 
Current process: From the My Auctions tab, click Listings button -> Listings menu is displayed -> click List button -> listing is completed.The Price information for listings has been aligned to the left on the My Auctions tab.When listing an item on the Auction House, the Duration time selection box now populates in descending order, sorted in order of longest (60 hours) to shortest duration (6 hours).When claiming a successfully purchased item, the Claim Item button has been added to the right of the Price column. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1362/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-claim-item.pngWhen claiming the gold for a successfully sold item, the Get Paid button has been added to the right of the Price column. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1364/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-get-paid.pngWhen a listing has expired and the item has not sold, the List Again and Reclaim buttons have been added to the right of the Price column. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1363/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-list-again-reclaim.pngThe Select All and Claim/Reclaim Picks buttons have been added to the bottom right on the My Auctions tab.
To use these buttons, the Auction Status column must be filtered to Purchase Failed, Purchase Succeeded or Sold items.After clicking Select All, click Claim/Reclaim Picks to retrieve all items or the gold for the successful sales.Some functions have been added to prevent mistakes when purchasing or selling items on the Auction House.
When registering an item for sale, a waiting time of 1 minute is added. 
The listed item will appear in Auction House searches 1 minute after listing.The On Waiting List time is displayed in Auction House -> My Auctions -> Auction Status.The Purchase Settings option has been added.This option restricts the purchase of items if the price of the item listing deviates from the recent average price by more than a set value.To set the value, click the Settings button at the top right of the Auction House. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1366/mabinogi-qol-ah-purchase-settings.pngOnce the value is set, if attempting to purchase an item that deviates from the recent average price, the Confirm Purchase box must be checked before the item can be purchased.Changes to item listings for items with an expiration timer have been added.Expired items cannot be listed on the Auction House.Note: Enchant Scrolls can be listed regardless of the time duration.A notification will appear if the item being purchased has less than 3 hours remaining.The listing duration cannot exceed the expiration time of the item.If the duration of the item to be listed is less than the listing duration, the listing duration will be automatically adjusted to match the item’s remaining time.Items with a shorter expiration time than the listing waiting time will not be able to be listed on the Auction House.A feature to check the Item Details of items not currently being sold on the Auction House has been added.When searching an item, if no current listings for that item are available, a Notice pop-up will appear. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1367/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-no-listings.pngWhen clicking the OK button, you can view the Item Details such as the Average Recent Price, check the Market Price Data, or Preview the item, if applicable.You can now search for items in the All (Total) tab using partial terms. The search will bring up listings from all different categories at the same time.Example: Searching “Ribbon” shows listings that contain the word Ribbon in the name. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1368/mabinogi-qol-nov-ah-search-partial-term.pngIf an item has been previously listed on the Auction House, the next listing for the same item type is filled with the same details such as unit price and listing duration.Example: A Direct Dye Ampoule is listed for a gold amount with a listing duration of 24 hours. The next listing for an item of the same type (Direct Dye Ampoule) will automatically have the details filled in for the same gold amount and same listing time.

notes.title: Reforging Renewed - New Reforging Tools
notes.content:
New Reforging ToolsBasic Reforging Tools, Precise Reforging Tools, and Exquisite Reforging Tools have been newly released.Exquisite Reforging Tools can be purchased from the Cash Shop.Basic Reforging Tools and Precise Reforging Tools can be obtained through in-game contents.
Basic Reforging Tool
The Basic Reforging Tool can be purchased for 5,000 gold from some General Shops such as Walter in Dunbarton and some Partner Shops.This Reforging Tool can only be used on items that have not been reforged before.This Reforging Tool has no expiration and cannot be traded.
Precise Reforging Tool
You can now obtain Precise Reforging Tools from the following in-game shops:[table][tr][th]Content[/th][th]Cost[/th][th]Weekly Purchase Limit (per account)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Melwyn's Royal Society Sponsorship Shop[/td][td]Royal Society Sponsorship Badges x80[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Mag Mell Fionnait's Shop[/td][td]Gold-Leaf Pine Cones x60[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Explorer's League Adventurer Seal Shop[/td][td]Adventurer Seals x40[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Commerce Ducat Shop[/td][td]350,000 Ducats[/td][td]3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Eavan's Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop[/td][td]20 Second, Third, or Fourth Vouchers[/td][td]4 (The purchase limit is shared across Voucher types)[/td][/tr][/table]This Reforging Tool has a 5-day expiration and is not tradable.The weekly Purchase Limit resets every Thursday at 7:00 AM PT.
Exquisite Reforging Tool
The Exquisite Reforging Tool can purchased from the Cash Shop.This Reforging Tool does not expire and can be traded once.The Exquisite Reforging Tool can increase the number of Attributes, and the Reforging Rank.When using this Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher Minimum Level, depending on the Reforging Rank of the item.The Attributes will not be granted lower than the Minimum Level.When using this Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher level than the Maximum Level, known as the Limit Break.The appearance and availability of a Limit Break depends on the Available Attributes for an item, and can be checked in the Reforging Menu.By using this Reforging Tool, one Hope Essence will be obtained.Hope Essence can be exchanged with Lassar in Tir Chonaill or Stewart in Dunbarton for additional items that can help you reforge items.[table][tr][th]Exchange Amount[/th][th]Item[/th][th]Function[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x7[/td][td]Blossoming Hope Gem[/td][td]- Increases the number of Attribute Slots to 3 of a selected item
- Only items that have less than 3 Attributes can be selected
- When the item is reforged next, it is guaranteed to receive 3 Attributes
- Tradable once[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x15[/td][td]Exquisite Reforging Tool (Not Tradable)[/td][td]- Use this item to reforge a selected item.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hope Essence x50[/td][td]Surging Hope Gem[/td][td]- Increases the Rank of a selected item to Rank 1
- Only items that are below Rank 1 can be selected
- Tradable once[/td][/tr][/table]
Reforging Tool Comparison
[table][tr][th]Function[/th][th]Exquisite Reforging Tool[/th][th]Precise Reforging Tool[/th][th]Basic Reforging Tool[/th][/tr][tr][td]Number of Attribute Slots Increased[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rank Upgrade[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Granting Attribute[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Possible[/td][/tr][tr][td]Attribute Minimum Level[/td][td]Yes[/td][td]None[/td][td]None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limit Break Appearance[/td][td]Possible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][td]Impossible[/td][/tr][/table]Existing Reforging Tools ChangesExisting Reforging Tools can still be used as before. However, they have been discontinued from the Cash Shop.Reforging ToolFine Reforging ToolCredne's Reforging ToolCommerce Reforging ToolRefined Reforging ToolRefined Reforging Tool PLUSPremium Reforging ToolAmazing Reforging ToolReforging Tool of MemoryObtaining Attributes and Reforge Rank ups while using Existing Reforging Tools is the same as before.New Reforging Tools and features such as the List of Available Attributes only applies to new Reforging Tools.The Reforging Tools that can be obtained in-game have been changed as follows:[table][tr][th]Content[/th][th]Before Change[/th][th]After Change[/th][/tr][tr][td]Festia Commemorative Gift Box[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool[/td][td]- None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Festia Treasure Hunt[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool
- Credne's Reforging Tool[/td][td]- None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Guardian Guild Tournament Trophy Box[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool
- Credne's Reforging Tool[/td][td]- None[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blaanid's Brave Boost Quest “Be Stronger: Winning Weapons for Warriors”[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool[/td][td]- Precise Reforging Tool[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dungeon Guide “Repeated Clear Guaranteed Reward” for certain dungeons[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool
- Credne's Reforging Tool[/td][td]- Precise Reforging Tool[/td][/tr][tr][td]General Shops, Partner Shops (Rem, Ram, Butler)[/td][td]- Reforging Tool[/td][td]- Basic Reforging Tool[/td][/tr][tr][td]Eavan’s Dungeon Guide Voucher Shop[/td][td]- Fine Reforging Tool (Support)
- Credne’s Reforging Tool (Support)[/td][td]- Precise Reforging Tool[/td][/tr][/table]Reforging Menu
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1372/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-reach-rank1-reforging.gif
The Reforging Tool menu and overall UI has been changed and usability has been improved.Improvements have been made so that you can see at a glance the number of Attributes, Reforging Rank, and Attribute changes before and after using a Reforging Tool.When a high-level Reforging attribute appears, it has been improved so that it can be easily checked within the Reforging Menu instead of the existing cutscene method that was inconvenient to use. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1374/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-reach-high-level_reforging.gifYou can conveniently check the Reforging Attributes that appear on the equipment you are trying to reforge from the List of Available Attributes menu. https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1404/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-available-attributes-list.pngTo access the menu, click on the “Check List of Possible Attributes” button in the top right of the Reforging Menu.The populated list is relevant to the item currently placed in the Reforging Menu.The List of Available Attributes and Level Available columns are displayed based on the Reforging Tool being used and the current Rank of the item that is being reforged.
The Level Available column is displayed as a level range.
When using the Exquisite Reforging Tool, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher Minimum Level depending on the Reforging Rank of the item.The Attribute levels will not be granted lower than the Minimum Level.The Maximum Level column is displayed based on Reforging Rank 1.When using the Exquisite Reforging Tool on items that are Reforging Rank 1, it is possible to obtain Attributes that are granted at a higher level than the Maximum Level, known as the Limit Break.The appearance and availability of a Limit Break depends on the Available Attributes for an item.The Limit Break column is displayed based on Reforging Rank 1.The minimum/maximum level of the Limit Break level is determined according to the maximum level based on Reforging Rank 1 of the Attribute.
Example: Attribute with a maximum level of 20 based on Rank 1: Limit Break Level 21~25Example: Attribute with a maximum level of 10 based on Rank 1: Limit Break Level 11~13Click the question mark icon the top-right corner of the Reforging menu to open the Help menu to read more about the Reforging Tool and its functions.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1375/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-help-menu.png
Additional ChangesThe way Reforging Attributes are displayed in the item tooltip has been changed to indicate the maximum level when displaying the Reforging Attribute. This change applies to all items reforged prior to the change in the display method.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1371/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-reforging-before-after-arrow.png
Before/After
The contents displayed in parentheses are as follows:Attribute Name (current Attribute level/maximum level of the Attribute: Attribute effect increase).The maximum level displayed is based on the Exquisite Reforging Tool.The maximum level does not include the Limit Break level.
Limit Break levels will appear as follows:
 https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1369/mabinogi-reforging-tools-update-limit-break.pngIn order to provide information on which Reforging Attributes can be obtained when reforging, the item type information that classifies equipment items has been added in the Item Attributes section of the item tooltip.The actual item name and item type classification of some items may be different.
Example: Royal Diamond Leather Light Boots item is classified as Heavy Armor Shoes.The item type for enchantment, upgrades, Erg, and Spirit Contracts may differ from the item type for reforging.
Example: The Practice Short Sword item is classified as a One-handed Sword when reforging, but One-handed Sword Erg enhancement and the One-handed Sword Spirit Contract cannot be performed.Example: The Gamyu Wizard Robe Armor (M)/(F) item is classified as Light Armor when reforging, but both enchantments for Clothing and enchantments for Light Armor can be applied.The 'Classic Spirit’ weapon type has been integrated into the general weapon type. 
‘Classic Spirit’ weapons are classified as such when using existing Reforging Tools.Example: 'Classic Spirit One-Handed Sword' is displayed as 'One-Handed Sword' and reforges are applied as a 'One-Handed Sword' type when using a new Reforging Tool, but is still classified as 'Classic Spirit One-Handed Sword' when using existing Reforging Tools.[*Sun Road Colt, Mana Knuckles, Chef’s Passion, Royal Pumpkin Rapier, Romeo's Rapier, Lambent Light Rapier, Rose's Thorn Rapier, and Scythes can now be reforged using existing and new Reforging Tools.Item tooltip details have been added to the Item Attributes section for the items listed below. The available reforging Attributes will differ for items with these labels when compared to other items.
Added the “Giant Full Swing Exclusive Weapon” label to Giant Full Swing-only weapons.Added “Unable to use Enthralling Performance” to instruments that cannot be used with this skill.Added “Commerce Enhancement Outfit” label to Commerce Outfits.Shield-Mastery related Attributes that only appeared on Reforging Rank 3 items have been removed.Unlike the previous system where a Reforging Tool purchased from the General Shop must be used on items that have not been reforged before, any item can be reforged using any new Reforging Tool.Attributes can be received at an equal probability.The minimum level of all Attributes has been adjusted to level 1.The maximum level of Attributes is unified based on the highest level at which the Attribute can appear and can be reviewed in the Reforging Menu.Attributes that can only be used by a specific race appear only on equipment that that race can wear.
Example: The Final Hit Cooldown Reduction Attribute, which can only be used by Human races, is organized into 'Heavy Armor' and 'Hat' item types, and can be worn by Humans in equipment items categorized for all races, Human only, Human/Elf only, and Human/Giant-only.Example: The Magnum Shot Damage Attribute, which can only be used by Human and Elf races, is organized into 'Heavy Gauntlets', 'Gloves', and 'Accessory' item types, and can be worn by Humans or Elves in equipment items categorized for all races, Human only, Elf-only, and Human/Elf-only.The following Attributes can now appear for all items.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - November 4th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on November 4th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-

Thursday, November 4th

Pacific (PDT, UTC-7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM 
Eastern (EDT, UTC-4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CET, UTC+1): 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM

To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.Thank you for restoring the reputation of the Willie Aknow's Candy Factory! The Milletian Detective's Journal event is ending.Last chance to update your look! The Erinn Beauty Sales 2021 are ending.It's that time again to take attendance and collect stamps every day. The Erinn Attendance event is starting.Dust off your tents and gather some firewood cause it's time to go camping! The Autumn Night Camping event is starting.Spice up your Dressing Room with a new collection of outfits! The Royal Mage's Box sale is starting.More quality of life updates are coming to Mabinogi! notes.title: Autumn Night Camping
notes.content:
The leaves have turned from green to beautiful shades of red, yellow, and orange and the night air is crisp with the smell of a burning campfire nearby. Grab your tents, Milletians— it is time to go camping! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, November 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 2nd, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the guide quest, [Guide] Camping Under the Autumn Night Sky.
You will also receive an Orange Wings of the Goddess (Camping Site) that can be used to teleport to the Camp Site event area.You can also use the wings to teleport to the Dunbarton Town Square and the Tara/Taillteann Shadow Mission Boards.The Wings can be used every 10 minutes.Find the Camp-Loving Milletian at the Camp Site in Blago Prairie.You do not need to register a main character, and can play the event on any character on the account.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Camping Under the Autumn Night:21,000 EXPHappy Camping Coins x10The event resets each Thursday at 7 AM PDT.Weekly Quest DetailsYou will receive the weekly quest, [Event] A Week of Happy Camping.Complete Camping Helper quests 15 times to receive the following rewards:21,000 EXPHappy Camping Coins x50To receive Camping Helper quests, talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian and select "Receive Camping Helper Quests".These quests can be received every hour in real-time between the top of the hour to 10 minutes after the hour.Once you receive the Camping Helper quest, there is a 12-minute time limit to complete the quest. (8 hours Erinn time)
Camping Helper Quests
There are different Camping Helper quests that you may receive:Making Bonds While Camping!You will receive Autumn Camping Fireworks Kits to deliver to the people around the Camp Site.Autumn Night Dance Party!Get 3 Combos during a Freestyle Jam.Delicious Food Shared at Camping Site!Share Food with other players 5 times.To share food with other players, press "Use" on a food item in your inventory while sitting in one of the chairs at the Camp Site.Fireworks Over The Campgrounds!Use the 3 Autumn Camping Fireworks Kit items that you received.There is a 24-minute time limit to complete the quest. (16 hours Erinn time)Each Camping Helper quest will reward you with the following items:21,000 EXPHappy Camping Coins x10Achievement Quest DetailsYou will receive the achievement quest, [Event] To Everyone Who Loves Camping!To complete this quest, you need to complete the following objectives:Complete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping onceComplete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping twiceComplete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping three timesComplete [Event] A Week of Happy Camping four timesYou will receive the following rewards after completing [Event] To Everyone Who Loves Camping:21,000 EXPHappy Camping Coins x200Blissful Aura BuffCamp out under the autumn night sky and rest near the Camp Site for 5 EXP per second.You can obtain this buff for up to 6 hours real-time.The EXP gain will reset at 7 AM PDT.Once you have rested for 10 minutes, you will receive the Blissful Aura buff. This buff lasts 1 hour:Combat EXP +30%1.5x Item Drop RateMovement Speed +5%Happy Camping Coins and Coin ShopHappy Camping Coins can be obtained by completing Camping Helper Quests as well as donating food to the campers at the Camp Site.Talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian between 7:00 PM to 9:50 PM Erinn time and select "Deliver Daily Food".Food can be delivered once per in-game day.Select a food item in your inventory to donate it, and you'll be rewarded with 3 Happy Camping Coins.If you deliver a food that fits the camping theme, you'll be rewarded with 5 Happy Camping Coins.The Camping Guide Bulletin Board will provide you with a hint on what food to deliver.Talk to the Camp-Loving Milletian to purchase items in the Happy Camping Coin Shop.
You can buy Cooking Tools and Ingredients at the shop.Exchange Happy Camping Coins for items in the Happy Camping Coin Shop tab.Exchange Happy Camping Outfit Exchange Tickets for outfits in the Happy Camping Outfit Shop tab.You can buy Happy Camping Outfit Exchange Tickets in the Happy Camping Coin shop tab.

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 7th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Dungeon RE:Fine Update and Beauty Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceErinn Merchant's Bottomless Pack: Thursday, September 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 21st, Before MaintenanceMilletian Events: Free Repair Weekends!: Friday, September 24th, 11:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October 10th, 11:59 PM PDTThe Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before MaintenanceErinn Beauty Sales 2021: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 4th, Before MaintenanceDungeon RE:Fine Celebration Hotdays!: Saturday, October 9th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October 10th, 11:59 PM PDTBeauty Update: PermanentDungeon RE:Fine: Permanent
Dungeon RE:Fine Update
To learn more about the Dungeon RE:Fine Update, check out the full details here.The Dungeon Notebook has been added to Mabinogi.This item will list main rewards from dungeon end chests.Four new Refined Armor sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.New materials have been added.A new reward acquisition condition system has been added to Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.There are new changes to Uladh Dungeons, including changes to how Dungeon Keys work, how long a dungeon is, the view inside Fiodh and Coill Dungeons, etc.There are dungeon reward changes that have been made.Some Enchant Scrolls can now be obtained in dungeons.Four new Exclusive Enchant Scrolls have been added.There are new reward changes made to Shadow Missions.A new item, Erinn Spirit, can now be obtained from Elite Shadow Missions.Combining 10 Erinn Spirits will grant a 2nd Title Coupon according to their drop rate.Spirit Gems (100) can now be obtained from Shadow Missions.This items provides 100 Spirit EXP when fed to a Spirit Weapon.
Beauty Update
To learn more about the Beauty Update, check out the full details here.30 new eye colors have been added to the Dressing Room.30 new skin colors have been added to the Dressing Room.The Beauty Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.Beauty Slots will allow you to store and change your Hair, Eye, Face, and Mouth appearances.The Blinking System has been added to the Dressing Room, allowing you to set different options to your character's blinking.
The following changes have been made to the game:
Rich Chaotic Rune has been renamed to Condensed Chaotic Rune.Quivers can now hold 1,000 arrows.The price of the item has been updated to 1,520 Gold.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed a naming inconsistency issue with the Erinn Merchant's/Erinn Trader's items. All items have been renamed to "Erinn Merchants' Guild".Fixed an issue in the Homestead UI where item names were overlapping with the time duration.Fixed a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appeared abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a Partner has something equipped in their left hand.The incorrect image for the Bebhinn 2nd Title is displayed when you equip the title.There is an issue after using the Thunder skill, the character can't charge Thunder again until after the Thunder bolt hits/damages enemies.If you try to change your style to an appearance already saved in a Beauty Slot, it will say it failed.There is a minor visual issue with the Beauty Slot text if you scroll up and down after expanding the Beauty Slot.The outline color when clicking on an empty Beauty Slot is incorrect.

notes.title: Beauty Update
notes.content:
Beauty Updates30 new eye colors have been added to the Dressing Room.Changing your eye color will cost 3 Pon.Sandy BrownPoppy BrownDeep Olivehttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2268/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-eye-colors.pngIrish Mint GreenRainy GraySmog GrayAncient Blue-GreenThunder GrayGloomy GrayBold Sky BlueSoft Blue-GreenShadow NavyPremier VioletCaramelScented PinkSophie GreenLovely PinkSweet VioletSoft MagentaForest BrownNostalgic GrayLight BeigeLight ApricotClear Gray-BlueSnow GrayDeep Dark GrayDevil's ShadowSoul RedApricotSilky Pink30 new skin colors have been added to the Dressing Room.Changing your skin color will cost 4 Pon.Soft TanDark MudAlmondhttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2269/mabinogi-beauty-update-new-skin-colors.pngLight PeachDeep BrownSilverLight RedDark TanSoft EbonyPale ApricotDark AlmondPale CopperPale WaterCloudLight TanWaterPeanutMauveOakDark WaterBerserkButterMudSweet PotatoRed SnowZombieBlackPoisonSpectral SoulLight PinkBeauty SlotsThe Beauty Slot system has been added to the Dressing Room.This system allows you to store and change your Hair, Eye, Face, and Mouth appearances.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2279/beauty-slots.png
[olist]Access the Slot Section in the Dressing Room by clicking on the Beauty Slot icon.Select an appearance tab: Hair, Eye, Face, or Mouth.Click on "Save Appearance", depending on which tab you are currently viewing, to save the current appearance of your character.Click on "Save All Appearances" to save all currently applied appearances of the character.If an appearance has not been saved, each appearance will be saved in an applicable empty Beauty Slot.Appearances that have already been saved will not change.If there are not enough empty Beauty Slots available, this option will not be available for use.Select an appearance in a Beauty Slot, then click "Delete Appearance" to remove the selected appearance from the saved Beauty Slot.Deleting an appearance cannot be reverted.After a saved appearance is deleted, the Beauty Slot will become empty and will be available for use.Click "Beauty Slot Expansion" to increase the number of empty Beauty Slots using Pon.60 Pon can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the Hair tab.45 Pon can be used to add an additional empty Beauty Slot to the Eyes, Face, and Mouth tabs.[/olist]
Additional Details
All appearances can be saved once in a Beauty Slot.When saving an appearance, the Hair, Eye, and Skin colors are also saved.You can change the character's appearance between all saved appearances at any time.After clicking on a saved appearance, click the "Change" button to apply the saved appearance to the character.If you change to an appearance saved in the Beauty Slot, without saving the current character's appearance, you will not be able to revert back to the unsaved appearance.Beauty Slots are exclusive to a character, and are not shared across your account.Each character receives 3 free empty Beauty Slots per appearance type.Saved appearances are available only for the individual character that saved the appearance.Additional empty Beauty Slots can be expanded up to 300 for each appearance tab.Eye Blinking
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2271/access_blinking_settings.png
The Eye Blinking feature has been added.This feature can be accessed in the Dressing Room under (1) Appearance Change -> (2) Eye -> (3) Blink Settings.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2272/blinkingsettings.png
[olist]Click on the "Enable Blinking" checkbox to turn the blinking settings on or off.
If checked, the blinking settings are applied to the character.If unchecked, the blinking settings are not applied.The "Blinking Interval" can be set from a minimum of 1 second to a maximum of 60 seconds.This determines the time between eye blinks. The character will blink randomly between the set times.Example: If set to a minimum of 1 second and a maximum of 10 seconds, the eyes blink randomly between 1 and 10 seconds. Immediately after blinking, the cycle is reset, and blinks randomly again.The "Number of Blinks" can be modified for the blinking setting.Blink OnceBlink Twice (consecutive blinks)RandomizeIf selected, your eyes will blink once or twice (consecutively) at randomThe "Blinking Speed" can be adjusted.This is the time it takes for a character to open and close their eyes.This time can be set from a minimum of 0.03 seconds to a maximum of 0.15 seconds.[/olist]Once the blinking settings have been set up, click Apply to save it to the character.To apply the default eye blinking settings, click on the Default option, then click Apply.
 

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2274/default.gif

Default Blinking Speed

notes.title: The Billionaire's Bankroll: Season 2
notes.content:
Ethel the Billionaire is here to support your growth needs again! Ethel will be providing support to all Milletians by covering 90% of your repair cost fees and selling Elite Shadow Mission passes. Along with Ethel, you can also obtain the maximum amount of keys, regardless of how many players are in the dungeon! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, October 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 18th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Investing in the Future.Find Ethel near the Bank in Dunbarton.Register a main character with Ethel.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Investing in the Future.10,000 EXPDungeon Key DropDuring the event period, upon completing Tech Duinn Missions, your party will receive the maximum amount of keys available, regardless of how many party members are in the mission.
Tech Duinn Missions4 keysIf the number of keys available cannot be divided equally between party members, leftover keys will be given to party members at random.Example: If 3 players clear a Tech Duinn Mission, each party member will get 1 key and one party member will receive an extra key.Tech Duinn Missions may have more end chests than the max available keys given to the party.Example: Depending on the number of party members who cleared Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission, there may be 6-8 chests. However, the party will still only receive a maximum of 4 keys.Repair Fee SupportDuring the event period, Ethel will help support your growth by paying for 90% of your repair fees.Talk to Ethel and select "Repair Fee Support".Elite Mission Pass SupportDuring the event period, Ethel will sell Ethel's Elite Mission Selection Box.Talk to Ethel and select "Purchase Pass". The selection box costs 200,000 Gold.The selection box has a 7 day expiration.You can choose either an Elite Pass for Tara or for Taillteann.The selected pass has a 24 hour expiration.You can only purchase 20 selection boxes per week.The purchase limit is reset at midnight every Sunday.Level Growth SupportIf you are between cumulative level 5,000 and 15,000, you can participate in the Level Growth Support event.Talk to Ethel and select "Level Growth Support".You will receive two quests, the daily quest, [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Level, and the achievement quest, [Challenge] Billionaire's Level Growth Support.For the daily quest, clear the Advanced Uladh Dungeon that is specified in the quest details.This quest can be received once a day.This quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT.Reminder: You can now purchase Advanced Dungeon Passes from the Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock in Dunbarton.You will receive the following items after completing [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Level:8,000,000 EXPRebirth Potion x1Does not expireCannot be tradedFor the achievement quest, your objective is to reach cumulative level 15,000.Once you complete the objective, talk to Ethel for the following rewards:10,000 EXPEthel's Celebratory Gift Box x1Skill Growth SupportIf you are under Total Combat Skill level 1,700, you can participate in the Skill Growth Support event.Talk to Ethel and select "Skill Growth Support".You will receive two quests, the daily quest, [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Skill, and the achievement quest, [Challenge] Billionaire's Skill Growth Support.For the daily quest, clear the daily Shadow Mission in Tara or Taillteann.This quest can be received twice a day.The quest resets at 7:00 AM PDT.You will receive the following items after completing [Daily] A Stepping Stone for Growth - Skill:Combat Skill Training Seal (10) Selection Box x10For the achievement quest, your objective is to reach Total Combat Skill Level 1,700.Once you complete the objective, talk to Ethel for the following rewards:10,000 EXPEthel's Celebratory Gift Box x1Erinn Spirit Additional Drop Event When clearing Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions on Elite difficulty, there is an additional chance to obtain Erinn Spirit.This is in addition to the normal end chest rewards.Tech Duinn Mission Pass BoxWhen clearing Tech Duinn Missions on Normal or Advanced difficulty, there is a chance to obtain an Elite Tech Duinn Mission Pass Box:
Feth Fiada (Elite) Pass BoxSeven Nightmares (Elite) Pass BoxRevived Illusion (Elite) Pass BoxAwakened Abyssal Lord (Elite) Pass BoxThe Pass Box expires after 3 days.The Pass Box is tradable 1 time.When the Pass Box is opened, an Elite Pass for the mission is granted and the pass will expire in 24 hours.Ethel's Celebratory Gift BoxLadeca Combat 4x EXP Potion (1 Hour) (expires in 15 days)Unrestricted Dungeon Pass (expires in 15 days)Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (expires in 15 days)Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box (expires in 15 days)Skill Training Seal (30) (Not tradable) (expires in 15 days)AP Potion (50) x2Guardian Soul Stone (Event) x3Combat Skill Training Seal (10) Selection BoxClose Combat Skill Training Seal (10)Archery Skill Training Seal (10)Martial Arts Skill Training Seal (10)Lance Combat Skill Training Seal (10)Ninja Skill Training Seal (10)Music Skill Training Seal (10)Puppetry Skill Training Seal (10)Transmutation Skill Training Seal (10)Dual Gun Skill Training Seal (10)Magic Skill Training Seal (10)Battle Alchemy Skill Training Seal (10)Chain Slash Skill Training Seal (10)

notes.content:
New ChangesThe Dungeon Notebook has been added to the game.The Dungeon Notebook can be obtained by speaking to the Researcher near Poulnabrone Rock using the "Dungeon Notebook" option.The Main Rewards that can be obtained from dungeon end chests and dungeon boss kill drops are now listed in the Dungeon Notebook for the following dungeons and their corresponding difficulties: Uladh DungeonsShadow MissionsBaltane MissionsTech Duinn MissionsYou can reference the Recommended Dungeon based on your Total Skill Level in the Dungeon Notebook.The Dungeon Notebook can be stored in the Me tab.If you destroy the item, talk to the Researcher again to obtain a new one.Four new Refined Armor sets, their respective Blacksmith Manuals, and Blacksmith crafting recipes have been added.
