In Uladh Dungeons and Tara and Taillteann Shadow Missions, you must meet a certain level of participation time in battle to fully obtain all rewards.
60 seconds of battle is required for Uladh Dungeons30 seconds of battle is required for Shadow MissionsThese conditions apply to individual characters within the dungeon or mission.These conditions apply to the following:
Uladh Dungeons: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode AdvancedShadow Missions: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Hard, and EliteSome dungeons are excluded from this reward acquisition system, such as Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, Lord Missions, Sinead’s Secret Missions, and special dungeons and missions exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.A dedicated icon has been added to the top left of the screen next to the list of party members when entering Uladh Dungeons and Shadow Missions.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/2280/grey_combat_icon.png
If you do not meet the conditions for obtaining rewards, the following penalties will be applied:
Uladh Dungeons: The dungeon itself is cleared, but the key to the reward box is not obtained after the boss is defeated.Shadow Missions: The mission itself is cleared, but the key of the reward box is not obtained and only half of the completion experience and completion gold is rewarded.Avon Theater Mission passes of the Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced difficulty can now be purchased from Marlowe in Avon.Crafting recipes for the Play Pages that can be collected from Avon Paper Sheep have been added so that it is now possible to create Play Pages of a higher difficulty when using the Magic Spinning Wheel.
5 Faded Play Page -> 1 Bronze Play Page5 Bronze Play Page -> 1 Silver Play Page5 Silver Play Page -> 1 Gold Play PageColor values ​​have been applied to Avon Theater Mission passes to make it easier to distinguish passes by difficulty.During a Grandmaster Mission, the durability of items equipped and used inside the mission will not decrease.
The durability will still decrease if using certain Life skills in the mission, such as Handicraft or Cooking.The issue of walls blocking the view has been improved for the following:
The boss room in the Lord Mission: Fragments of a Trivial FateThe Alby Battle Arena room in the Alban Knights Training GroundsThe Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon Pass can now be stacked up to 10 passes.The newly added rewards to several dungeons have been added to the Dungeon Reward List on the Dungeon Guide.Repeated Clear Guaranteed Rewards have not changed.Uladh Dungeon ChangesThere have been several changes made to Uladh Dungeons.
These changes apply to Basic, Intermediate, Advanced and Hard Mode Advanced Uladh Dungeons.These changes do not apply to Normal Dungeons, Siren Dungeons, Veteran Dungeons, Rabbie Phantasm Dungeon, Abyss Peaca Advanced Dungeon, Abyss Coill Advanced Dungeon, Musical Math Dungeon, and special dungeons exclusively for Tutorial or Generation quests.The length of the entire dungeon and the number of rooms have been reduced.

The shop tabs are now separated by Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Dungeon Passes.The shop list of Tiro, who appears in some dungeons, has been changed.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - September 30th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on September 30th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 5:00 AM PDT and last approximately 5 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-

notes.title: Reflections - Patch Notes - September 9th, 2021
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Reflections Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzles 2021: Thursday, August 26th, 7:00 AM PDT - Wednesday, November 24th, Before MaintenanceBleugenne Viola Box: Thursday, August 26th, 10:00 AM PDT - Thursday, September 23rd, Before MaintenanceWish Upon a Star Candy: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before Maintenance[Shopkeeper's Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays!: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before MaintenanceRoyal Teacup Box: Thursday, September 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 7th, Before MaintenanceFamily Weekend Fishing Event 2021: Friday, September 10th, 12:00 AM PDT - Sunday, October, 3rd, 11:59 PM PDTRenovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes: PermanentRenewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates: PermanentRefresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update: Permanent
Reflections Update
September is a month of reflection, and we have several updates to renew your fantasy life in Erinn. Check out each of the individual posts below to learn more about each of the updates:
Refresh your Homestead!
The Homestead can be expanded to be even bigger than before.New Sales items and returning favorites are here, including Partner pets! Check out the Shopkeeper’s Sale: Homestead Refreshments and Hotdays post for more details.Changes have been made to the Homestead Options menu, and you can now view your Homestead visitor count.You can now place your Partners on your Homestead.Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
Several new changes and improvements have been made to the Close Combat, Archery, Magic, Puppetry, and Alchemy talents.Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Changes
Over 40 game changes and updates are here to improve your Quality of Life in Erinn, such as no durability decrease outside of combat, visual skill cooldown timers and music buff duration, a hotkey to pick up items off of the ground, and more!

The following change has been made to the game:
Changed the title for "a Soul Streamer" to "the Soul Streamer".
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where the crafting materials for Energy Amplifiers were switched.Fixed an issue where Weapon Magic Attack was incorrectly labeled as Weapon Magic Damage while Erging.
The following are known bugs:
There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue where certain G3 cutscenes will not play, but still charges gold.There is an issue where Homestead item information is overlapping.There is a text issue where the quantity of Glyph Recovery Scrolls used appears abnormally in the sentence after using the Max Recovery option.There is an issue where the Today Visitor Count does not reset to 0. When a visiting character visits the Homestead, the Today and Total Count accumulates normally.The available upgrades in the Item Upgrade may overlap in the UI if the window is increased.Homestead Anvils and Furnaces have settings to allow visitors to use them, but do not actually restrict the use of the items.There is a slight graphical error where part of the hose is missing when a William or Butler Partner uses the Water Hose gesture.Some Partner gestures that have them holding a weapon will appear as though the weapon is disconnected and floating.There are Partner gestures that do not activate when a partner has something equipped in their left hand.

notes.title: Refresh Your Homestead - Homestead Update
notes.content:
New Homestead ExpansionThe size of your Homestead can now be expanded to be even bigger than before.Increase the size of your Homestead past the existing Stage 3 size using the following all-new items:Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 4Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 5Homestead Expansion Permit Stage 6
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1865/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-stages.jpg

Homestead Size by Level
[table][tr][th]Homestead Level[/th][th]Size[/th][/tr][tr][td]Level 1[/td][td]9x9[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 2 - 3[/td][td]17x17[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 4 - 9[/td][td]25x25[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 10 - 13[/td][td]33x33[/td][/tr][tr][td]Level 14 - 15[/td][td]49x49[/td][/tr][/table]
Homestead Size when using a Homestead Expansion Permit
[table][tr][th]Stage[/th][th]Size[/th][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]55x55[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]61x61[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]67x67[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 4[/td][td]75x75[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 5[/td][td]83x83[/td][/tr][tr][td]*NEW* Stage 6[/td][td]91x91[/td][/tr][/table]
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1866/mabinogi-homestead-update-homestead-items.jpg

Homestead Expansion Permit Details
Homesteads that are Level 14 or higher can be expanded in size using Homestead Expansion Permits, up to Stage 6.Each Expansion Permit will increase the size of the Homestead.Stage 1 - 3: Size will be expanded by 6 tiles horizontally and vertically.*NEW* Stage 4 - 6: Size will be expanded by 8 tiles horizontally and vertically.Each Permit can only be used on a Homestead once.Each Permit, past Stage 1, requires the previous Stage Permit to be used on the Homestead.Example: The Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 4) cannot be used until a Homestead Expansion Permit (Stage 3) has already been used to expand the Homestead.Homestead Expansion Permits are permanently available and can be purchased in the Item Shop:Homestead Expansion (Stage 1)Homestead Expansion (Stage 2)Homestead Expansion (Stage 3)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 4)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 5)*NEW* Homestead Expansion (Stage 6)
[/td][/tr][/table]New Homestead Changes
Options and Permissions
Upon entering your Homestead, two new buttons can be accessed in the Homestead Information menu in the top right. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1879/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-1.png
Options: Apply overall Homestead permissions through this menu.
This option button replaces the need to click on the Homestead Entrance -> View Information button to open the Building information menu previously.Minimize: This Homestead menu can now be minimized.You can also minimize this menu when visiting other character's Homesteads.When you click on the Options button in the Homestead menu, you can view the Homestead Options.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1868/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-options-2.png
Entry Permissions: Set the permissions of who can enter your Homestead.Item Permissions: Apply permissions to all Homestead Props.This has been changed from needing to set the option for each Homestead prop.You can still set the option for each Homestead prop individually.However, if you set the permissions for a prop individually, the saved option in Homestead Options -> Item Permissions will be unchecked. If checked again, it will change the permissions of all props once more.When placing a new Homestead prop, the permission setting is reflected on the new item as well.
Visitor Count
The Homestead visitor count is now displayed.Open the Homestead menu (Default Hotkey: U) when outside of your Homestead to view the Today and Total visitor count.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1869/mabinogi-homestead-update-vistor-count.png
Today's Count: View the total number of visitors to your Homestead for the day.This will count once per visiting character per day, and resets at 7:00 AM PT daily.Total Count: View the total number of visitors who have visited your Homestead.
Partner Homestead Placement

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1870/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-1.gif
You can now place your Partners in your Homestead.Upon entering your Homestead, a new Partner Placement button is available underneath the Edit and Construction List Homestead buttons.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1871/mabinogi-homestead-update-hs-buttons-partnerplacement-added.png
Open up the menu to view the list of available Partners that can be placed in your Homestead.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1957/mabinogi-homestead-update-placement-menu.png
Select Static Placement from the menu to place a Partner anywhere in your Homestead.Select Interactive Placement from the menu to place a Partner on a Homestead Prop, such as a chair.A silhouette view will appear and it will show where the Partner can be placed on all available Homestead props.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1872/mabinogi-homestead-update-silhouette-before.png
You can move a Homestead prop that has a Partner placed on it and the Partner will be moved with it.If you remove a Homestead prop that has a Partner is placed on it, the Partner will also be removed with the prop. The Partner can be placed again from the Partner Placement menu.
You are unable to select a Partner that is already placed in another Homestead within the same account.Partners cannot be placed inside a Homestead House.Partner take up a 1x1 space when placing them in your Homestead.Partners cannot overlap existing Homestead prop grids.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1873/mabinogi-homestead-update-partners-2.png

Partner Homestead Options
While outside of the Partner Placement menu, click on a placed Partner to view the following options:Partner GestureMoveSwitch Out
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1874/mabinogi-homestead-update-partner-options.png
You can now modify the Gestures of Partners place in your Homestead.You are unable to modify Partner Gestures when a Partner is placed on a Homestead prop.Crossover Partners such as Ram and Rem from the Re:ZERO crossover cannot use Partner Gestures.
Basic Motion
Homestead Partner Cards can be used to add new basic motions to a Partner, like an idle stance.Homestead Partner Cards can be obtained from the Homestead Partner Basic Motion Card Box sold in the Maid and Butler Partner shops for 500,000 gold.You can obtain 1 of 85 Basic Motions with an equal chance when opening the box.Once you have a Homestead Partner Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Motions" column, click Add, then select a Card to give to your Partner, and then click OK.
Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.You can add up to 100 Basic Motions.You can Delete the added motion, but the Motion Card will not be returned.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1875/mabinogi-homestead-update-adding-motion.gif
If a Partner is wearing an outfit with an animation, the animation will play when the default "Basic Motion" option is selected.
Gesture Motion
Gesture Cards can be used to add Gestures that a Partner can use.Existing Gesture Cards can be used.Once you have a Gesture Card in your character's inventory, open the Partner Gesture menu. Under the "Gesture" column, click Add, then select a card to give to the Partner, and click OK.Each card is a one-time use and will only be applied to the chosen Partner.You can add up to 100 Gestures.You can Delete the added Gesture, but the Gesture Card will not be returned.You can change the time interval (in seconds) that the Gesture will repeat.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1876/mabinogi-homestead-update-interval.png
At 0, the Gesture will continuously repeat from beginning to end. If the set interval is shorter than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture is cut off and plays again.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1877/mabinogi-homestead-update-2sec-repeated-gesture.gif
If the Gesture interval is set longer than the length of the Gesture, the Gesture will play. When it ends, the Basic Motion will play until the Gesture plays again.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1878/mabinogi-homestead-update-15sec-gesture-then_basic-motion.gif
The max interval can be set is 999 seconds.If you do not want a Gesture motion to be played, select the default "Do Not Use" option and the selected Basic Motion for the Partner will play instead.
Move
You can move the Partner around your Homestead, similar to a Homestead prop.You are unable to move the Partner if they are placed on a Homestead prop.
Switch Out
You can remove a Partner from the Homestead.Once a Partner is placed on the Homestead, you cannot summon it until you've removed them from the Homestead.

Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Wishing Upon a Star Candy.Find Clodagh across from the Healer's House in Dunbarton.Register a main character with Clodagh.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing [Guide] Wishing Upon a Star Candy:21,000 EXPThe event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.Let's Make a Star Candy!
Achievement Quest
You will receive the quest, [Event] Let's Make a Star Candy!To proceed through the quest, you will need to make and eat different flavor Star Candies.Summon a Star Candy Sprite using a Star Candy Sprite Summon Ticket.Star Candy Spirit Summon Tickets can be received at a chance from the end reward chest when clearing dungeons such as:Uladh DungeonsAlban Knights Training GroundsShadow MissionsBaltane MissionTech DuinnMag MellSidhe FinnachaidEach week, a different Star Candy Sprite will be available to summon.Week 1: StrawberryWeek 2: LemonWeek 3: MelonWeek 4: GrapeAfter summoning the Star Candy Sprite, attack the sprite to get Star Candy Crumbs.The Star Candy Sprite summon will last for 5 minutes.You can attack Star Candy Sprites that other players have summoned.You can summon Star Candy Sprites in town.Only one Star Candy Sprite can be summoned per region.You cannot summon the Star Candy Sprite in instances such as Homesteads, or Avalon Gate, dungeons, or Shadow Missions.You will need 10 Star Candy Crumbs to make 1 Star Candy.You can receive a maximum of 5 Star Candies per day by taking them to Clodagh.Any Star Candy Crumbs that were not turned in to Clodagh for the day will be removed.Once a Star Candy is created, eat it!For every Star Candy you eat, you will receive 1 Star Candy Coin.Use Star Candy Coins to purchase rewards from Fovish in the Star Candy Shop.You can choose to make one wish while eating a Star Candy.Depending on the wish, you will receive a reward. The rewards differ between each type of Star Candy.Note: Rebirth Potions can only be redeemed once per real-world day.Once you have eaten 25 of each Star Candy type, you will receive the following rewards:21,000 EXP*NEW* Star Candy Dancer 2nd Title CouponLuck +30

notes.title: Renewed Adventures - Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
New ChangesThe Bank's Gold Deposit Fee has been removed.You can now turn off the PVP option in the revival menu when you become incapacitated by PVP.You can also turn this option off in the Options -> Game -> ETC -> Allow PVP settings.The channel you are currently on will now be highlighted in the Move Channel window.The Move Channel window has also been slightly increased in size.The number of characters you can register in the chat blacklist has been increased from 20 to 60.You can use this setting in Options -> Game -> Chat -> Blacklist Setting.This setting blocks chat from Bugles, Normal Chat, Party Chat, and Whisper Chat of the users registered on the blacklist.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1967/mabinogi-qol-sept-new-options-3.png
The max bundle/stack count for the Altar of Restoration item has been changed to 20.The cost of the Altar of Restoration item in NPC shops has decreased from 10,000 gold to 500 gold.The Partner conversation menu has been improved.When talking to a Partner, some actions have modified so that the conversation does not end automatically, and you can choose a different action.The camera no longer switches to a fixed angle when talking with a Partner.Rebirth Potions can no longer be used in a state when Rebirthing is already available.The description of a Rebirth Potion stating that you can drink it, even when Rebirth is possible, has been removed.A new hotkey option to open up the Dungeon Guide has been added.You can set the related shortcut for the Dungeon Guide Window in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings.Fixed an issue where characters would intermittently get stuck in the wall when entering the boss room of the Taillteann Shadow Mission, "Defeat the Shadow Wizard".Fixed an issue where the Spirit's bleeding damage ignored the PvP percentage setting and abnormally affected PvP battles.Fixed an issue where you were temporarily unable to attack a monster after it entered a deadly state from the Final Hit skill when using Knuckles with an Erg effect.To resolve the issue where music continued to play even after Enthralling Performance ended, it has been changed so that the music ends in the following situations:When the corresponding score is played to the endWhen re-using Enthralling PerformanceWhen logging out of the game clientFixed an issue where Ghost Pirates in the banquet hall spawned inside the wall during the Shadow Mission "Deep Sea Clues" in the G24 quest "A Sleepless Voyage".Fixed an issue where the Crystal Golems that appear at the Scathach Beach - Springs Mana Tunnel would spawn on cliffs.Fixed an issue where when the Succubus Queen used Sweet Illusion on a character that used a pet's hide skill, and the target character's pet was unsummoned, the hide state was not removed.Improvements have been made to the Exclusive Spirit Effect "Analysis" so that it will now apply on enemies with Magic Defense and Magic Protection reduction statuses.The description of the Analysis Effect has been updated.Fixed an issue where Defense, Protection, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection were not applied to damage once Mana Shield deactivated, and the character would be inflicted with high damage.The Demigod skills have been improved so that activating the skill will no longer consume Training EXP.The skill description has been modified to remove the mention of EXP consumption.Note: The Wings of Eclipse skill still works the same as before where EXP decreases each time an attack is blocked.Fixed an issue that prevents a pet from moving and acting due to a counterattack while mounted.If the Auto Combat option is unchecked in Options -> Game -> Control -> Reserve Attack, the pet will not automatically counterattack even if it is hit while riding.Fixed an issue that caused the screen to appear dark if the game client was terminated and reconnected during a dungeon.The durability decrease of equipment due to the passage of time has been removed.This applies to all equipment worn by the player character and Partners.The durability of equipment equipped in the robe slot will also decrease when being hit during combat.The durability decrease of equipment in the robe slot due to being hit is reduced by about half less than the existing time decay value.Changed the party count limit from 1 to 2 players for the "Light and Darkness" Shadow Mission in the G10 quest, "Courcle's Heart".The notice message that appears after clearing the daily maximum number of dungeons in the Dungeon Guide has been changed so that it displays only once upon reaching this daily limit.Instead of the Skill Rank up menu, only an on-screen notice message and a system message are now displayed when ranking up the Shine of Eweca skill.When Adniel's Horn is used, the name of the character who used it will now appear in the message log.The Targeting Options setting has been added to Options -> Game -> Control tab.You can select “Cursor Proximity” or “Character Proximity”.Cursor Proximity targets the enemy closest to the mouse cursor.Character Proximity targets the enemy closest to the character's position.You can now pick up items from monsters killed by Squires during Baltane Missions.The Auto-Decline Guild Invitation function has been added to Options -> Game -> ETC tab
When this option is checked, you will turn down any guild invitations automatically.The Lock Pet Skill Slot option has been added to Options -> Game -> ETC tab.
When this option is checked, the Pet Skill Slot that appears when a Fynn pet is summoned will be locked so you cannot remove any skills or move the window.A new clock icon has been added to make it easier to identify items in the inventory that have an expiration timer.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1969/mabinogi-qol-sept-clock-icon.png
A new function to stack items with different expiration timers has been added to the top right of the inventory window.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1964/mabinogi-qol-sept-stackable-expirables.png
A new hotkey option to pick up items from the ground has been added.
The default shortcut is set to Alt + C.You can set the related shortcut for Item Collection in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings.The item tooltip for the Forgetful Potion item now displays a cooldown timer.If there is no current cooldown for the character, it will state “Available Now”.Example: If you recently used a Forgetful Potion with a 7-day cooldown, this cooldown will be visible on other Forgetful Potion items.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1971/mabinogi-qol-sept-forgetful-cooldown.pnghttps://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1970/mabinogi-qol-sept-forgetful-available.png
A new hotkey option to target objects such as lamp posts and trees has been added.
You can set the related shortcut for Object Targeting in Options -> Game -> Control -> Hotkey Settings.A minimize function has been added to the Character Status List window.
This can be accessed by clicking the Details button on the Character Info window under Basic Info -> Status Effects.Status icons and the skill usage gauge no longer overlap above the character's head.
When the Character Status List window is activated, the status icon is not displayed above the character's head.Relevant information for active buffs are now displayed on the Character Status List for the following skills:
Battlefield OvertureVivaceEnduring MelodyHarvest SongMarch SongChain BurstBerserkSnap Cast
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1963/mabinogi-qol-sept-music-timer.png
Skill cooldown information is now displayed as a number at the bottom of the skill icon.
This also applies to the summon cooldown time for pets that are added to the hotkey bar.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1965/mabinogi-qol-sept-skill-cooldown.gif
The skill cooldown of Glyph Evocation has been changed from 150 seconds to 140 seconds across all Ranks.Increased the skill duration of Glyph Evocation by 10 seconds per Rank. 
Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:
100 seconds -> 110 secondsThe skill casting time of the Glyph Evocation has been greatly reduced.When using a Glyph Recovery Scroll (10), a new Max Recovery option has been added.This will allow the use of several scrolls to automatically recover the Glyph’s durability.The Combat Penalty notification window is now displayed when moving channels shortly after combat.This will show the Gold/EXP loss if the channel is changed and the remaining duration of the penalty.The Share Music Buffs option has been added to Options -> Game -> ETC tab.
When this option is unchecked, you cannot give music buffs to party members, or receive music buffs from party members.The Combo Card Slot Change Coupon can now be used on Combo Cards with permanent duration.The Combo Card Slot Change Coupon can now be used while using VIP service.The issue of the Blue Ghost enemy breaking through dungeon walls has been improved.The Field Raid optimization pop-up window will no longer be displayed.Two new Wall and Flooring options are available for use inside of the Homestead House and can be purchased with gold.Antique Wallpaper and Large Window: 103,000 GoldRefreshing Wallpaper and Large Window: 103,000 GoldThe Combo Card Slot Change Coupon (Trade Limit: 1) can now be listed on the Auction House.

notes.title: Renovation Season 2: Combat Talent Changes
notes.content:
Magic
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1836/mabinogi-talent-update-magic.png

System Changes
The magic system has been changed so that only 1 magic charge (previously 2 magic charges) is decreased if you are knocked down while charging Healing or any of the following intermediate magic skills:ThunderFireballIce SpearThe magic system has been changed so that the charge count is not removed if you are knocked down while charging any type of Bolt Magic.
Item Changes

Wand
You can now use all intermediate magic regardless of the type of Wand you have equipped.
For example, Thunder, Fireball, and Ice Spear can all be cast using a Lighting Wand, Fire Wand, or Ice Wand.Each Wand receives 5% bonus damage when the intermediate magic being used matches the elemental attribute of the Wand.Lightning Wand - Thunder Bonus Damage +5%Fire Wand - Fireball Bonus Damage +5%Ice Wand - Ice Spear Bonus Damage +5%Divine Tribolt Wand - Can receive Bonus Damage +5% effect from all intermediate magic
Staff
All Staves can use intermediate magic.You no longer need to collect elemental charges with some Staves, such as a Trinity Staff.
Skill Changes

Fireball

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1833/mabinogi-talent-update-fireball.gif
The damage of Fireball has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.Fireball can now be used from 1 charge, instead of requiring 5 charges.The charge can still be stacked to 5, and the damage will increase with each charge up to 5.Damage ratio per charge = 1: 2: 3: 4: 6.51 Charge: 1/6.5 Damage2 Charge: 2/6.5 Damage3 Charges: 3/6.5 Damage4 Charges: 4/6.5 Damage5 Charges: 6.5/6.5 DamageThe time that Fireball will fly in the air has been shortened to 1 second.Previously, the time was 2.5 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.
Ice Spear
The damage of Ice Spear has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.
Thunder

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1846/mabinogi-talent-update-thunder.gif
The damage of Thunder has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.The time it takes for lightning to strike has been reduced to one second, regardless of the skill Rank.This change does not apply to enemies.
Blaze
While charging Blaze, stun is now ignored, and no longer cancels the skill.Being knocked down will still cancel Blaze.Attacks that inflict a special stun will still cancel Blaze.
Hail Storm

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1835/mabinogi-talent-update-hail-storm.gif
Hail Storm can now be used with Spellwalk, enabling you to walk freely while the skill is charging, or while having active Hail Storm charges.
Spellwalk
The way Stamina is consumed for Spellwalk has been changed.Stamina no longer decreases while Spellwalk is active.Stamina will only decrease when moving while charging a skill, or before using a skill that has been charged.This only applies to skills that you cannot normally move with without Spellwalk active.10 Stamina points are consumed per second in this state.
Meteor Strike

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1844/mabinogi-talent-update-meteor-strike.gif
The damage of Meteor Strike has been increased.This increased damage also applies to some enemies.The casting time of Meteor Strike has been reduced to 2 seconds from 4 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.The time it takes for Meteor Strike to hit has been reduced to 2 seconds from 5 seconds.This change does not apply to enemies.The damage reduction based on the distance furthest from the center of impact has been removed.

Close Combat
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1830/mabinogi-talent-update-close-combat.png

Skill Changes

Windmill

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1853/mabinogi-talent-update-windmill.gif
The maximum damage per Rank has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:Human/Giant: 250% -> 400%Elf: 200% -> 320%Windmill's attack range has been increased depending on the Rank of the skill.When you have a melee Combat talent weapon equipped and are using Windmill, enemies hit by Windmill are knocked down in place. They are no longer knocked back and scattered.This change does not apply to enemies who use Windmill.
Charge/Lance Charge
The position lag issue when using Charge/Lance Charge has been improved.
Assault Slash
Assault Slash's cooldown has been reduced to 7 seconds across all Ranks.The activation speed has been increased when using Assault Slash after Smash.

Alchemy
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1841/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemy.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1854/mabinogi-talent-update-alchemic-damage.png
Alchemic Damage has been added to the Character Information menu.It now shows stats for Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth attributes based on the character's equipped titles, gear, and talent bonuses.The stats that affect Alchemy have been changed.
Damage is increased by the average of the character's Max HP, Max MP, and Max Stamina.The affected skills are as follows:Water CannonFlame BurstWind BlastHeat BusterSand BurstFrozen BlastShock
Skill Changes

Water Cannon
Water Cannon has been changed to apply a fixed maximum damage amount regardless of the distance from the target.This change does not apply to enemies.Before: Base damage 1x * Damage by Distance from target (0.6x to 1.4x)After: Base damage 1x * Distance 1.4x
Flame Burst

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1834/mabinogi-talent-update-flame-burst.gif
Flame Burst's duration has been increased for some Ranks of Flame Burst.If the new duration includes a time less than 1 second, the Flame hit will be calculated as 1 second.In this case, the last hit of Flame Burst will deal damage proportional to the original duration.Example: If the duration of Flame Burst's usage is 4.2 seconds, it will hit 5 times over 5 seconds. The last hit will be applied at 20% of the damage of 1 hit.
Wind Blast

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1839/mabinogi-talent-update-wind-blast.gif
Wind Blast's activation structure has been changed to be activated by clicking the ground after casting.When activated, enemies within a 4 meter radius around the character are pushed in one direction.Enemies behind the character are pushed in the direction the character is facing.This change does not apply to enemies.The reforge option, Wind Blast Range, has been changed to Wind Blast Attack Range.Previously, the reforge started at 1 meter, and increased the range by 0.25 meters per level.This has now been changed to an option that increases the attack range by 0.15 meters per level.The Stardust Support Effect for Wind Blast has been changed from Blast to Flare.
Heat Buster

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1837/mabinogi-talent-update-heat-buster.gif
Heat Buster has been changed so that you can activate this skill when the cylinder pressure is 50% or higher.Previously, it required 100% cylinder pressure.When activated, the damage is proportional to the pressure amount.Example: When activated at 50% pressure, it is activated at 50% damage.When activated at maximum pressure, an additional 20% damage is inflicted as before.
Life Drain

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1858/mabinogi-talent-update-life-drain.png
Life Drain can now be activated even when you have Max HP.
Summon Golem
The stats of the summoned Golem's HP, Magic Defense, and Magic Protection have been increased.The casting time and attack time of the summoned Golem's Smash, Defense, and Windmill skills have been reduced.Fixed an issue where the summoned Golem's Taunt skill did not have a cooldown.

Puppetry
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1838/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1855/mabinogi-talent-update-marionette-info.png
Marionette Information can now be viewed in the Character Information menu. It outlines the stats of the summoned marionette and can only be viewed when a marionette is summoned.This menu can also be opened by right-clicking the summoned marionette character and clicking on "View Status".A new option has been added.Options -> Game -> Controls -> Use Marionette CameraWhen activated, the camera moves around the doll instead of the player.Marionettes can now pick up items.
Skill Changes

Control Marionette

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1857/mabinogi-talent-update-puppetry-dismount-pet.gif
The Control Marionette skill has been changed so that if the marionette summon is canceled due to mounting a pet, the marionette will be summoned automatically after dismounting the pet. The Control Marionette skill will also be activated after dismounting the pet.
Act 1: Inciting Incident
The base damage of Act 1: Inciting Incident has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:200% -> 300% damage
Act 2: Threshold Cutter

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1843/mabinogi-talent-update-act-2.gif
The base damage of Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:700% -> 960% damageThe character and marionette motion when using the skill has been changed.The skill has been changed to an AoE attack skill that simultaneously attacks enemies within a 2 meter radius from the original targeted enemy.Attack speed has been increased.The Stardust Support Effect for Act 2: Threshold Cutter has been changed from Blast to Flare.
Act 4: Rising Action
The base damage of Act 4: Rising Action has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:300% -> 560% damage
Act 6: Crisis
The invincibility duration of enemies hit by the skill has been removed.
Act 7: Climactic Crash

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1847/mabinogi-talent-update-act-7.gif
The base damage of Act 7: Climactic Crash has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1 of the skill:550% -> 860% damageIt has been changed so that the control of the marionette is not canceled after the attack is completed so long as the position of the marionette is within the control range.The enemy is knocked back in the same direction as the skill casting direction, increasing the probability of enemies being hit by all 3 hits.Fixed an issue where the marionette would not move intermittently when using the skill in front of obstacles.Fixed an issue where you are intermittently unable to attack enemies when using the skill in front of obstacles.

Archery
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1845/mabinogi-talent-update-archery.png

System Changes

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1831/mabinogi-talent-update-archery-rework.gif
Archery has been changed so that regardless of the aiming rate, the Archery Talent attack will always hit an enemy.If attacking outside of the attack range, the attack will miss.The damage is determined by the character's minimum/maximum damage in proportion to the aiming rate at the time of the attack.When the aiming rate is 100%, the minimum/maximum damage is 100% reflected.Various effects that previously affected accuracy have been changed to now affect aiming rate.Certain text descriptions that mention Accuracy have been changed to Aim Rate.The delay time when aiming from 99% to 100% is now removed.The effect that appears when the aiming rate is 100% has been changed to now appear when the aiming rate is 70%.A bonus to the aim rate is now applied when reaching 70% aim rate, regardless of the aiming speed.This change only applies to player characters.
Item Changes
The Bow and Crossbow Erg Bonus Effects have been changed.Before: "Skill cooldown upon aim failure"
Decreased time by seconds per Erg levelAfter: "Archery Skill Cooldown"
Decreased time by seconds per Erg levelThe Erg effect reduction value per level has been decreasedExample - Based on level 50 Erg:Max 2 seconds -> 1 secondVarious arrows and bolts can now be bundled up to 500 pieces.The number of bundles of arrows/bolts sold by weapon shop NPCs has increased.1,000 arrows can now be inserted into the Quiver.The Piercing Forest Arrow description has been corrected to include the additional 12% maximum damage bonus.
Skill Changes

Crash Shot

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q3/1859/mabinogi-talent-update-crash-shot.png
Crash Shot has been changed so that the fragment attack occurs at the same time as Crash Shot hits an enemy.This change does not apply to enemies.
Urgent Shot
Urgent Shot has been changed so that you can use the skill regardless if the previous attack hit or missed.Skill cooldown has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1:
10 secondsThe skill training requirement has been changed.Before: "Use the skill successfully immediately after missing."After: "Use Urgent Shot to defeat an enemy."The Glyph Effect for Urgent Shot has been changed.Before: "Urgent Shot Available Time"Increased by 0.05 seconds per levelAfter: "Urgent Shot Cooldown Decreased"Decreased by 0.2 seconds per level
Final Shot
When using Final Shot, you can now immediately activate the skill without casting time.Previously, the casting time was 2 seconds.The duration of the skill has been increased.Example - Based on Rank 1:30 seconds -> 45 secondsSkill cooldown has been reduced.Example - Based on Rank 1:260 seconds -> 240 secondsThe skill has been changed so that the durability of the equipped weapon does not decrease when using the skill.

notes.title: [COMPLETED] Scheduled Maintenance - August 12th
notes.content:
Mabinogi will have a scheduled maintenance on Thursday, August 12th. During this time, the game will be unavailable. Maintenance is expected to begin at 7:00 AM PDT and last approximately 4 hours.

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

-Time-

Thursday, August 12th

Pacific (PDT, UTC-7): 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM 
Eastern (EDT, UTC-4): 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Paris (CEST, UTC+2): 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM

To address the following:
Weekly server upkeep.Unlock higher levels of your Stardust! The second part of the Stardust Update will be live.Did you complete the Attendance Book this time around? The Attendance Check event is ending.The sound of a Milletian's Battlefield Overture is fading away. The Troubadour's Box sale is ending.Week 5 of the Summer Master Plan buffs are ending. Week 6 of the Summer Master Plan buffs are starting.It's that time of year again! Time to spend the rest of summer in the sun! The Connous Beach Vacation event is starting.Rebirth Potions, Rebirth Potions, REBIRTH POTIONS! The Rebirth Potion Parade event is starting.It is time to craft in style! The Hillwen Engineer's Box sale is startingProcessing of requested name changes. Note: The Name Change submission site will be unavailable after 7:00 AM PDT time, and will be available after the maintenance.

notes.title: Connous Beach Vacation 2021
notes.content:
Have fun in the sun in Connous Beach! Enjoy a refreshing cocktail while opening up the Vacation Box each day you log in. And don't forget to play the Fun Fun Cart mini-games to earn Magical Pieces! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, August 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 2nd, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] A Time To Chill.Log in during the event period to receive the Orange Wings of the Goddess to travel to the Connous Beach Metallurgy Site.Register a main character with Hafgan located inside the Tropical Pineapple Drink Stand.Once you register your main character, you will receive a cocktail and a Vacation Box.Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:10,000 EXP
Talk to Hafgan each day to receive a cocktail and a Vacation Box.You will receive a different cocktail each day:Monday: June Bug (Instantly grants 500% of EXP needed)Tuesday: Cosmopolitan x3 (Recover full HP, MP, Stamina, and Wounds)Wednesday: Mojito (Gain 50 AP)Thursday: Martini (Increase EXP by 35% after Resting for 36 min. Lasts for 3 days)Friday: Blue Hawaii (Rewards from clearing a Shadow Mission will be increased by 360%)Saturday: Pina Colada x3 (Increase Movement Speed by 40%)Sunday: Long Island Iced Tea (All Skill Training EXP x2)These are event versions of existing consumables and will not stack with their non-event versions. For example, the Long Island Iced Tea item will not stack with a Complete Skill EXP Potion.

Vacation CoinsCollect Vacation Coins to redeem with Hafgan for cool rewards.The login time resets daily at 12:00 AM PDT.Earn one Vacation Coin for logging in.Earn two Vacation Coins for consecutive logins.Everyone will earn five Vacation Coins over the weekend.Earn two Vacation Coins for spending a day in Erinn (36 real-world minutes).Earn two Vacation Coins for clearing both of the Daily Quests: Finding Vacation Coins (1) and Finding Vacation Coins (2).To complete the objective, clear a daily Shadow Mission quest in Tara or Taillteann.Be sure to complete the quest, Finding Vacation Coins (1), to receive the next quest, Finding Vacation Coins (2).If you log in for 7 consecutive days, you will earn one Special Vacation Coin.If you log in for 10 consecutive days, you will earn two Special Vacation Coins.If talked to repeatedly, with the 'Start Conversation' option, Hafgan will offer to increase the player's Consecutive Logins Count or Total Logins Count by 1. This increase count can only be claimed once.Earn the Beat the Heat 2nd Title Coupon for 15 days of total logins.

Grade 1 being the lowest and Grade 5 being the highest.If you stack two pieces of the same grade, it will upgrade it to the next grade.To upgrade Grade 1 to Grade 2, you will need to stack 2 Grade 1 Magical Pieces together, then right-click it, and click "Use".Every other grade will automatically upgrade when you stack them together.You can use the pieces to exchange into EXP and AP or hoard enough Grade 5 pieces to exchange for a Cart of your own!Consume Grade 1 Pieces to receive 100% EXP and 1 APConsume Grade 2 Pieces to receive 300% EXP and 3 APConsume Grade 3 Pieces to receive 700% EXP and 7 APConsume Grade 4 Pieces to receive 1,500% EXP and 15 APConsume Grade 5 Pieces to receive 3,500% EXP, 35 AP, and a random item!You can exchange 3 Grade 5 Magical Pieces, for a Cart of your choice with Doug:Ice Cream CartPopcorn CartSandwich Cart

Stardust Part 1 Update
Discover the power of Stardust with Stardust: Part 1! After reaching cumulative level 3,000, help out the Royal Society of Astronomy by starting the quest [Guide] An Astronomical Discovery found in the "Society Sponsorship" quest tab.Learn more about the new Stardust System through the guide. 
The Stardust equippable item can be obtained from the Stardust quest, [Guide] Stardust Cores and Regulators.Equip the Stardust in a new special Stardust item slot in the bottom left of your main Inventory.Right-click the Stardust item to view “Stardust Info”.The Stardust Info menu details all things Stardust, including your Stardust Rank, Support Effects, and materials for Stardust. 
Stardust Rank can be advanced up to Rank 10 in Part 1.Learn more about the Royal Society of Astronomy Society Sponsorship quests through the guide.
Complete Society Sponsorship Quests to receive new materials necessary for ranking up your Stardust Rank and strengthening your Stardust Support Effects.The Total Skill Level has been added on the Additional Info tab of the Character Info menu, and can also be found at the bottom of the Skill window.

notes.title: Celebrate the Fourth of July!
notes.content:
It is time to celebrate America's Independence Day–the Fourth of July! Enjoy a display of Star-Spangled Banners in Tir Chonaill and Dunbarton. Light up the night sky with fireworks and be sure to log in for special rewards! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, July 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, Star-Spangled Banners will be displayed in Tir Chonaill and Dunbarton!Players who log in during the event period will receive the following item:*NEW* Star-Spangled Banner Bearer 2nd Title CouponMax HP +80Max MP +10Max Stamina +50Magic Attack +8Critical +1%Movement Speed +5%Combat 2x EXPThe Star-Spangled Banner Bearer 2nd Title will expire after 7 days of using the coupon.However, you can still equip the title without the effects.The coupon is only bank-tradable.You will also receive additional Hotday boxes for 3 days of sequential logins.Day 1 - First Independence Day Hotday Gift Box:
Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Refined Shadow Crystal x1 (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min.) (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Sky Blue Prism Box (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1*NEW* Flagpole (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable)Will be removed once the event endsDay 3 - Third Independence Day Hotday Gift BoxUnlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Refined Shadow Crystal x1 (Not Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Combat 2x EXP Potion (30 min.) (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1Blue Prism Box (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable) (Expires in 24 hours) x1*NEW* Thread (Not Tradeable) (Bank-Tradeable)Will be removed once the event endsYou can get one hotday box per day.The day resets at 12:00 AM PDT.If you are logged in before the reset time, you need to change channels or re-login to receive the hotday box.Click on either the Star-Spangled Fabric, Flagpole, or Thread and select "Use" to create the installable homestead prop, Homestead Star-Spangled Banner.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q2/1798/mabinogi-4thofjuly-homestead-star-spangled-banner.png
You need to receive the reward boxes on the same server in order to create the homestead prop.NOTE: Regardless of the server, the first character that logs in will receive the reward box.Independence Day FireworksVisit Walter in Dunbarton, or any General Store merchant, to purchase Firework Kits.General Store merchants in Taillteann, Tara, and Iria do not sell Firework Kits.
You can use the Fireworks Kits to shoot fireworks in the sky between 7:00 PM - 5:00 AM Erinn time.
Using a Firework Kit has a 1-minute cooldown.
If the firework reaches over 17m in height, you will receive a 4th of July Box.Note: Using a Firework Kit in the Marketplace Channel will not award a 4th of July Box.

notes.title: Doc Caravan Joe's Secret Method Class
notes.content:
Word on the street is that you want to become stronger, Milletian. Well, never fear because Doc Caravan Joe is here to help! Doc Caravan Joe is willing to tell you the secrets of strength...for a price. Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, July 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 15th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] The Secrets of Strength.Find Doc Caravan Joe in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Doc Caravan Joe.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following rewards after completing, [Guide] The Secrets of Strength:2,000 EXP2,000 GoldThe event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.Quests
Deliver Wondrous Elixirs (Daily)
You will receive the quest, [Daily] Deliver Wondrous Elixirs.You will need to deliver a Wondrous Elixir to Doc Caravan Joe daily.To craft a Wondrous Elixir, you will need the following items:Potion Concoction Kit x1Can be purchased in most Healer Houses Combat Talent Aura x10Can be received at a chance when using a Combat Talent skillLife Talent Aura x10Can be received at a chance when using a Life Talent skillSecret Method Potion x1Received every 10 minutes, up to 10 per dayUse the Potion Making skill to craft one Wondrous Elixir.There is no limit on how many Wondrous Elixirs you can craft per day.When you complete the daily quest, [Daily] Deliver Wondrous Elixir, you will receive the following rewards:Secrets of Strength Box x1Doctor Caravan Joe's Wondrous Elixir (100%)Using this item will provide 100% EXP10,000 EXPExtra Wondrous Elixirs can be consumed for 10% EXP or exchanged with Doc Caravan Joe for Secret of Strength Boxes.There is no limit on how many Wondrous Elixirs can be exchanged per day.
Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir (Achievement)
You will receive the quest, [Event] Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir.Deliver the Wondrous Elixir to Doc Caravan Joe 10 times and talk to Doc Caravan Joe.When you complete the quest, [Event] Regimen B - The Wondrous Elixir, you will receive the following rewards:100,000 EXP*NEW* 1 Mysterious Spirit Stone (300%)Using this item will increase your Spirit's EXP gain by 300%
Talent Training Quests
Talk to Doc Caravan Joe to select 2 Talents to train each day.You can select either Life Talents, Combat Talents, or a combination of both:Combat TalentsClose CombatLance CombatMartial ArtsTransmutationMagicMusicGunslingerArcheryPuppetryNinjaBattle AlchemyChain SlashLife TalentsAdventureTailoringMercantileMedicineHoly ArtsCarpentryCookingPet TrainingSmithingGlyphwritingOnce you select a Talent to train, you will receive a corresponding quest.You can only train two talents per day.Training quests that were not completed can be continued on the following day.Quests can only be completed once.Once you complete a training quest, you will receive the following rewards:Secrets of Strength Box x2
Regimen A - Train Your Combat Talents (Achievement)
You will receive the quest, [Event] Regimen A - Train Your Combat Talents.Train all 12 Combat Talents to receive the following rewards:100,000 EXPSecrets of Strength Box x10
Regimen A - Train Your Life Talents (Achievement)
You will receive the quest, [Event] Regimen A - Train Your Life Talents.Train all 10 Life Talents to receive the following rewards:100,000 EXPSecrets of Strength Box x10Secrets of Strength Box*NEW* Starry Ambiance Lamp

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 10, 2021
notes.content:
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
The Billionaire's Bankroll: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before MaintenanceEnchanting Peacock Box: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 24th, Before MaintenanceShopkeeper's Sale: Time to Train!: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before MaintenanceSupport Dasha's Inline Skating Team: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before MaintenanceApricot Blossom Box: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before MaintenanceReforging Tool Compensation: Thursday, June 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance
Fireflies in Tir Chonaill
To celebrate the start of summer, fireflies will appear in Tir Chonaill.Fireflies will appear from June 10th, After Maintenance to July 15, Before Maintenance.
Reforging Tools Update
 Reforging Tools have been updated.To view all of the updates, check out the Reforging Tools Update Details webpost.Due to the Reforging Tool update, there will also be compensation.To view the details of the compensation, check out the Reforging Tools Update Compensation webpost.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where a player would get a login alert of another player, even after already receiving that player's login alert.Fixed an issue where Blaanid would provide inaccurate information to players during the dialogue in the quest, "Be Stronger: Winning Weapons for Warriors".Fixed an issue where some tooltip screenshots in the New Memory Book help menu had Korean text in the UI.
The following are known bugs:
Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.This issue does not occur for all players.Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.There is a known issue where some players are unable to obtain the G1 quest "Find Goro's Ring".There is an issue with multiple Chinese Dragon Gauntlets sharing the same name, however, each item is race-specific.There is an issue where the "Start Mabinogi" and "Exit" buttons on the login screen become unresponsive.There is an issue with G25 text not using the correct localization.

notes.title: The Billionaire's Bankroll
notes.content:
Ethel the Billionaire is here to support your growth needs! Ethel will be providing support to all Milletians by covering 90% of your repair cost fees and selling passes to dungeons. Along with Ethel, drop rates will be increased and you can also obtain the maximum amount of keys, regardless of how many players are in the dungeon! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Investing in the Future.Find Ethel near the Bank in Dunbarton.Register a main character with Ethel.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Investing in the Future.10,000 EXPDungeon Key Drop During the event period, upon completing certain dungeons, your party will receive the maximum amount of keys available, regardless of how many party members are in the dungeon.Rabbie Phantasm (excluding Mirror World Rabbie Phantasm)4 keysVeteran Uladh Dungeons8 keysMag Mell Missions8 keysTech Duinn Missions4 keysIf the number of keys available cannot be divided equally between party members, leftover keys will be given to party members at random.Example: If 3 players clear Rabbie Phantasm, each party member will get 1 key and one party member will receive an extra key.Certain dungeons may have more dungeon end chests than the max available keys given to the party.Example: Depending on the number of party members who cleared Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Mission, there may be 6-8 chests. However, the party will still only receive a maximum of 4 keys.Repair Fee SupportDuring the event period, Ethel will help support your growth by paying for 90% of your repair fees.Talk to Ethel and select "Repair Fee Support".Dungeon Pass SupportDuring the event period, Ethel will sell Dungeon Passes.Talk to Ethel and select "Purchase Pass". Dungeon Passes are not tradeable.Dungeon Passes have a 7-day duration.[table][tr][th]Pass[/th][th]Price[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hardmode Ciar Advanced[/td][td]80,000 Gold[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hardmode Alby Advanced[/td][td]120,000 Gold[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hardmode Rundal Advanced[/td][td]200,000 Gold[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rabbie Phantasm[/td][td]400,000 Gold[/td][/tr][/table]Simple Investigation QuestionnaireTalk to Ethel and select "Participate in a Simple Investigation".Answer questions and obtain the following rewards:Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Event)Expires in 15 daysFull Recovery Potion (Event) x5Expires in 15 daysIncreased Dungeon Drop RatesDuring the event periods, drop rates of dungeon end treasure chests are increased. This means that there is an increased chance for items such as major enchant scrolls, Destructive Robe materials, Soluna Blade materials, and more![table][tr][th]Dungeon Name[/th][th]Start Date[/th][th]End Date[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hardmode Uladh Dungeons (Ciar, Alby, and Rundal)[/td][td]Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance[/td][td]Thursday, June 17th, Before Maintenance[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rabbie Phantasm[/td][td]Thursday, May 27th, After Maintenance[/td][td]Thursday, June 17th, Before Maintenance[/td][/tr][tr][td]Veteran Uladh Dungeons [/td][td]Thursday, June 17th, After Maintenance[/td][td]Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/td][/tr][tr][td]Alban Knights Training Grounds[/td][td]Thursday, June 17th, After Maintenance[/td][td]Thursday, July 8th, Before Maintenance[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.content:
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzle: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before MaintenanceThe Adventures in Paper Flipping: Thursday, April 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 20th, Before MaintenanceStreet Art Box: Thursday, April 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before MaintenanceA Fresh Memory Celebration: Check the post for the full dates of all the eventsNoble Chevalier Box: Thursday, May 13th, After Maintenance - Thursday, June 10th, Before MaintenanceA Fresh Memory Update: Permanent
A Fresh Memory Update
Blaanid's Memoir questline has been updated! For full details, check out the Update Preview.For details on what quests were removed during this update, please check out the previous announcement.
New and existing characters will receive the quest, "A Blue Fragrance on the Wind", which will start Blaanid's Brave Boost.You need to complete the quest, "Strange Signs" in order to get the quest, "A Blue Fragrance on the Wind".To open the Memoir Books, you can go to "Character" -> "Blaanid's Brave Boost".You can also use the shortcut, '.Blaanid is now fully voice-acted, in Korean, throughout the questline.You can turn off the voice over by going to Options -> Sound -> Voice Volume.Weapons and outfits obtained throughout the questline cannot be traded, dropped, bank traded, pet traded, upgraded, enchanted, or burned.You are able to dye the weapons and outfits.Some items received will also be enchanted during the questline as part of a quest objective.
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed script errors that appeared when accessing the in-game cash shop.Fixed an issue where a player will get a login alert of another player, even after already receiving that player's login alert.Fixed an issue where an untranslated notice message would appear for Elf exclusive items.Fixed typos in the dialogue during the quest, "Finding the Ideal Types".
The following are known bugs:
Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.This issue does not occur for all players.Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.During the Kraken Rex boss fight, Kraken Rex will use an attack that will cause players to lose protection, semi-permanently, until they change channels or relog.There is a typo in the Finishing Materials list when crafting the Dustin Silver Knight Greaves.

Help Blaanid recover her lost memories with the revamped Memoir questline! Obtain new rewards, level up your character, and train your skills as you proceed through your journey in Erinn. With the new Blaanid's Brave Boost quests, you can level up quickly and earn AP!
If your cumulative level is less than 5,000, completing Blaanid's Brave Boost quests grants 5x EXP.AP is also doubled when leveling up.This effect is applied only with the experience obtained through Blaanid's Brave Boost quests. AP is earned at a fixed rate of 2, regardless of the use of items that affect the amount AP that can be earned.Whenever you complete a quest, you will receive a Rebirth Potion. If you leveled up by completing a quest, reset your level by rebirthing.Please note that you will only receive a Rebirth Potion if you are under cumulative level 5,000.When a Rebirth Potion is used, the waiting time for rebirthing is reset, and you can rebirth immediately.Only characters under cumulative level 5,000 can use the Rebirth Potion given.

notes.title: The Adventures in Paper Flipping
notes.content:
Join Caravan Joe in a new paper flipping game! Use the Paper Flip Ad Board to challenge opponents and become stronger. Can you beat the Legendary Paper Flip Master and become a legend yourself? Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, April 29th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 20th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Famous Paper Flip Master.Find Dunbarton Paper Flip Prince Caravan Joe near the Healer's House in Dunbarton.Register a main character with Caravan Joe.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Famous Paper Flip Master:20,000 EXP2,000 GoldYou will receive the following items to help with the event:Paper Flip Ad BoardPaper Flip Folding InstructionsThe event resets daily at 7:00 AM PDT.Quests
Endless Training (Daily)
Use the Paper Flip Ad Board to find opponents.To play the Paper Flip game, select one of your tiles and use it in the match.You can make your own tiles with the Paper Flip Folding Instructions.These kits are given to you every 30 minutes, real time.These kits will be removed after 7:00 AM PDT, so remember to use them before the reset.There are 3 different tiles you can use:Paper Tiles: These tiles are balanced, having a good defense and offensive power.Newspaper Tiles: These tiles have a strong defense.Calendar Tiles: These tiles have a good offense.Use your selected tile to flip your opponent's tile.You need to match your tile against your opponent's tile.Watch the moving arrow and press either A (Attack) or D (Defend) when the time is right.If you select A (Attack), you'll attack your opponent's tile according to the position of the arrow when it stops.If you select D (Defend), your turn will end and you'll defend against the opponent's tile attack on the next turn according to the position of the arrow when it stops.If D (Defend) is successful, the ATT of your tile will increase on your next attack turn.You win when your opponent's tile runs out of HP!Caravan Joe can also make you a special tile, if you need a better tile, called a Golden Tile.You need to give Caravan Joe the following items to make a Golden Tile:Paper Tile x10, or Newspaper Tile x10, or Calendar Tile x10After the match ends, you will receive 1 Paper Flip Participation Reward Box.Play 3 games of the Paper Flip game to complete the daily quest.You will receive the following items when you complete the daily quest:20,000 EXP2,000 Gold

notes.title: The Quality Time with Pets
notes.content:
Clodagh and Fovish have arrived in Dunbarton with their pets and need your help. They have one, simple question: Who is the closest to their pet? Earn points with your pets and prove to Clodagh and Fovish that YOU are the closest to your pet! Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, April 15th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 13th, Before Maintenance
Event DetailsDuring the event, you will receive the quest, [Event] Who's Closest to Their Pet.Find Clodagh across from the Healer's House in Dunbarton.Register a main character with Clodagh.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Event] Who's Closest to Their Pet:10,000 EXP*NEW* Score Scroll: Peeping Cutie- SoloThe event resets daily at 12:00 AM PDT.

notes.title: Pals from Pixel World
notes.content:
Erinn is in trouble and needs your help! Help the pals from Pixel World defeat the evil Demon Lord for some pixelated prizes! Craft Legendary Weapons, find the Demon Lord's castle and defeat the evil Demon Lord. The fate of Erinn lies in your hands, hero. Check out the details below.

Event Dates: Thursday, April 1st, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 29th, Before Maintenance

Pals from Pixel World
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Pals from Pixel World.Find Pixel Rami in Tir Chonaill, near Duncan.Register a main character with Pixel Rami.You can only register one character per account.Once registered, for every hour you are online, you will receive 1 Pixel Box.Note: The Pixel Box will be REMOVED once the event period is over so remember to open the boxes before the end of the event.You will receive the following items after completing, [Guide] Pals from Pixel World:2,000 EXP2,000 GoldPixel Box x5The event resets daily at 7 AM PDT.
The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 1

In order to defeat the Demon Lord, you must first gather a party strong enough to take on the Demon Lord! Recruit Pixel Rami, Pixel Raiuri, and Pixel Carthal into your party by bringing them their Legendary Weapons. Ferghus will craft these weapons for you, but only if you bring him the Stone of the Legendary Weapon first. 

How to craft Legendary Weapons

Each Legendary Weapon can be crafted by bringing the corresponding stone to Ferghus. You can find the stone by completing Legendary Dungeons. You can enter the Legendary Dungeon by using a special pass, obtained through different NPCs. You can obtain a special pass once a day.

Legendary Weapons are amazingly strong and take a long time to craft...24 hours in fact! You can only craft 1 Legendary Weapon per real day. Check back in with Ferghus at 7 AM PDT to see if he has finished crafting a Legendary Weapon.

Note: If you have the quest [Daily] Uladh Dungeon, to clear an Uladh Dungeon, and you clear a Legendary Dungeon, the clear will count for the [Daily] Uladh Dungeon quest, instead of the event quest. Since you are only able to obtain one special pass daily, you will need to wait until the next day to clear the event quest. This issue will be fixed after the April 15th maintenance.

You will receive the following items after completing this questline:
2,000 EXP2,000 GoldPixel Box x10
The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 2

With your party recruited, you must now find the Demon Lord's castle. Find the 9 pieces of the map and put them together to find out the location of the castle. You will be given clues as to where each map piece is located. Your first clue is "the place above the bridge of Adelia Stream". Good luck hero!

Once the map is completed, head to the Dunbarton Library, to research more on the Demon Lord. Talk to Pixel Carthal to collect and combine 5 Demon Lord's Castle Notes.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2208/mabinogi-pixel-library.png?width=1111px&height=521px

Let's be realistic, 5 Demon Lord's Castle Notes is not enough data, so come back the next day after 7 AM PDT to collect and combine 5 more Demon Lord's Castle Notes. Just to be sure, return the next day, once again, after 7 AM PDT to collect and combine another 5 Demon Lord's Castle Notes. There is a lot of data needed to defeat the Demon Lord!

It takes a long time to cross-reference and compile all the data you collected and Pixel Carthal needs the extra time! The data should be compiled after 7 AM PDT the next day. Don't forget to give the compiled data to Pixel Rami.

Once the data is compiled, find the Suspicious Item in the Dunbarton Library. Once retrieved, bring the item back to Pixel Rami.

How to open the Sealed Box

To open the Sealed Box, you must crack the super secret code! The code is a number between 1 and 9 and any given number will not appear more than once in the code. If you get the code wrong 8 times, the code will change. Good luck!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2206/mabinogi-pixel-password.png

You will receive the following items after completing this questline:
2,000 EXP2,000 GoldPixel Box x10
The Demon Lord of Pixel World - Act 3

It is time to defeat the Demon Lord and save the world. But first you need your very own Legendary Weapon. Head to Bangor to craft a Legendary Shield by completing the Legendary Barri Dungeon. Elen will craft the Legendary Shield for you, but she can only create 1 Legendary Shield per day. However, you do not need the shield to start your siege on the Demon Lord.

notes.title: 13th Anniversary - Patch Notes - March 18, 2021
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the 13th Anniversary Update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Return of the Playful Puzzle: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before MaintenanceSweet Academy Box: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 1st, Before MaintenanceMagnificent Wings Box: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 15th, Before Maintenance13th Anniversary Update: Thursday, March 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, April 8th, Before Maintenance
13th Anniversary Update:
Happy Anniversary, Milletians! Celebrate the 13th Anniversary of Mabinogi with tons of festivities and earn amazing rewards! Check out the event page for in-depth details!Talk to Thirteen in Festia to start the 13th Anniversary celebration.Complete daily and weekly quests to receive 13th Anniversary Coins, 13th Anniversary Special Gift Boxes, and 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets.How fast can you type? Compete in the Balloon Popping Mini-game and see how you stack up against other Milletians.Grow some mysterious balloons and hand them over to Balune the Balloon Artists for daily rewards.Test your strength with the Clobbermeister Mini-game!Conquer the waves of enemies within the Cave of Trials to receive prizes and event titles celebrating your achievements! The title rewards will replace your existing Cave of Trials titles if you've been through the scenario previously.Use gold or 13th Anniversary Instant Prize Tickets from different events at the Capsule Machine in Festia.Exchange your 13th Anniversary Coins for special prizes!
Spirit Transformation Liqueur Update:
You can now have up to 3 Spirit Transformation Liqueurs on your Spirit Weapons.You no longer need to go to Berched to apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur.You can apply a Spirit Transformation Liqueur by simply clicking on it in your inventory.You can switch between the different Spirit Transformation Liqueurs in the Spirit Information UI.To remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur, right-click on the icon in the Spirit Information UI.[*IMPORTANT: If you remove a Spirit Transformation Liqueur from a Spirit Weapon, you will NOT receive the removed Spirit Transformation Liqueur item.
Note:Some Spirit Weapons may have overlapping text in the Spirit Transformation section of the UI and the Awakening Skill Enhancement section.
Chain Slash Skills Fix and Compensation:
Fixed an issue with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills not giving stats when ranking from Rank 2 to Rank 1.To receive the missing stats with the Spinning Slasher and Death Mark skills, you will need to rebirth with the age and level reset checked on after the fix is live.Users that have been affected by this issue will receive the following compensation:Rebirth Potion x1Skill Reset Capsule x2Perfect Skill Reset Capsule x1
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed the dungeon information for Erinn Martial Arts Competition in the Dungeon Guide UI to specify Final Round.Fixed the pop-up notice message to clarify that you cannot have more than one Check Folio in your inventory. Fixed the Autumnal Diligence Suit (M) outfit animation that had slight blinking near the bottom pockets.
Fixed the slight cutoff of hair texture when wearing a wig with the outfit.Fixed a typo in the pop-up notice message when an unknown error occurs when adding a friend or blacklisting a player.Fixed the Slurp gesture animation; the animation now displays the teacup in your hand.Fixed a quest progression issue in the G1 quest, "Fomor Medal".Fixed a typo in the Taurus Balloon item description.Fixed a typo in the stats for "the Price is Wright" title.
The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.There is a Friend's list issue where it displays the message "Attempting to access Friends List".This issue does not occur for all players.The Little Hopper is unable to be used with two players.The Kraken Rex boss fails to spawn in Awakened Abyssal Lord Tech Duinn Missions sometimes.This issue does not occur for all players.There is a game crash suspected to be related to the Intel Graphic Series.This issue does not occur for all players.Some players' hotkeys and pet menu settings reset after logging out.

notes.title: Return of the Playful Puzzle
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1061/200122_playfulpuzzlesevent_newsarticleheader_940x290-1.jpg 

The puzzle pieces have been scattered across Erinn and A Boy in Need could use your help. Log in daily to collect the puzzle pieces and fit them to the board. The more puzzle pieces you collect, the more rewards you can earn including Etain's outfit! Check out the details below.

Playful Puzzle Event

Event Dates: Thursday, March 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, May 27th, Before Maintenance

Event Details
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] A Boy's Request.Find the NPC A Boy In Need in Dunbarton in front of the Unicorn Statue.Register a main character with A Boy In Need.You can only register one character per account.Once registered, a Puzzle icon will appear on your screen.
Stay logged in for 1 hour every day to receive a puzzle piece.Staying logged in on any character will count towards the 1 hour needed to collect a puzzle piece.You can only receive the puzzle piece prizes on your main character.You will only receive 1 puzzle piece per day.Every weekend, you will receive 2 puzzle pieces per day (for a total of four).To find out how many puzzle pieces you have, how much time is remaining before you receive the puzzle piece, or how far along you are on the puzzle, click on the Puzzle icon.Once you obtain a puzzle piece, click on "Fit" on the Puzzle Event UI to place the puzzle piece on the board.The more puzzle pieces you obtain, the more prizes you get!When you complete [Event] Piecing Together the Puzzle!, you will receive the following rewards:
Season 3 Puzzle Master 2nd Title (Defense +7, Protection +7, Magic Defense +7, Magic Protection +7)Homestead Puzzle Picture Easel Season 3
