notes.title: Patch Notes - February 18th, 2021
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Winter Forest Wanderer Backpack: Thursday, February 4th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 4th, Before Maintenance
Valentine Shards Event: Thursday, February 11th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 25th, Before MaintenanceMilky Way Box: Thursday, February 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before MaintenanceDesperate Designer Event: Thursday, February 18th, After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before Maintenance
The following bug fixes have been made to the game:
Fixed a typo in the 2nd Support Box item description.Fixed a typo in the item requirement for crafting Magic Ink with the Stationary Crafting Skill. Fixed a typo where Glyph effects would say "Chain: [Fighter Skill]". It has been updated to say "Combo: [Fighter Skill]".Fixed a text issue with the announcement message for the Emain Macha Cooking Contest.Fixed a text issue with the Glyph Formulation training details.Fixed a text issue in the warning message for Glyph Design when a Magic Quill Pen is not in your inventory. Error message will now state "You don't have all the materials needed for Glyph Design. Glyph Design requires both Magic Parchment and a Magic Quill Pen."Fixed a typo at the end of the G25 Hypernova credits.Fixed an issue with the skill, Act 6: Crisis, that causes the player to be in a walking stance after desummoning a puppet.
The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.There is a typo in the "Price is Wright" title. It should state Magic Attack +20.There is a minor typo in the Taurus Balloon item description.New players cannot add friends to their friend's list.

notes.title: Desperate Designer Event
notes.content:
Oh no, Cindy has too many orders pouring in and she's desperate for help! Will any crafty Milletians step up to create dazzling Sewing Patterns? Cindy is willing to reward your help with super new items like the Professional's Mannequin or a Sewing Pattern - Robe of Nature's Beauty! Let your creativity flow as you assist this desperate designer. Check out the details below.

 Desperate Designer Event

Event Dates: Thursday, February 18th After Maintenance - Thursday, March 18th, Before Maintenance

Event Details
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea.Find Craft Designer Cindy in the Dunbarton Town Square.Register a main character with Cindy.You can only register one character per account.You will receive the following items after completing [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea:2,000 EXP2,000 GoldBeginner's Mannequin (Event)Log in to receive 100 Design Notes once per day.The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PST/PDT.All event quests and items will be removed when the event ends. These items will also also be completely removed from the Auction House when the event ends, regardless of Sold or Not Sold status, along with all the gold.
Quests

 Craft Designer Cindy's Sewing Pattern (Daily)
Complete the quest every day by using the Beginner's Mannequin received in [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea.The daily quest resets every day at 7:00 AM PST/PDT.To complete the quest, you must craft 10 Sewing Patterns.You can craft a Sewing Pattern using the Design Note.You can craft a Sewing Pattern anywhere. One Design Note will create one Sewing Pattern.The craft success rate by grade will differ depending on the type of mannequin used. There are three mannequins:Beginner's Mannequin (Event) (Received from [Guide] Designer Cindy's Desperate Plea)Journeyman's Mannequin (Event) (Craftable)Professional's Mannequin (Event) (Craftable)You can use the Handicraft Skill to craft the Journeyman's Mannequin (Event) and Professional's Mannequin (Event).Journeyman's Mannequin (Event) and Professional's Mannequin (Event) are tradable and can be purchased from other players.When you complete the daily quest, you will receive:20,000 EXP50 Design Notes
Help Cindy the Designer!
Complete the Craft Designer Cindy's Sewing Pattern quest 18 times to receive the following:200,000 EXP*NEW* Mannequin Selection BoxYou can select one of the following:Beginner's Mannequin

notes.title: Valentine Shards Event
notes.content:
Love is in the air and things are heating up in Erinn! Valentine's Day is the perfect day for moonlit strolls, dinner dates, and chocolate. Log in every day for some rewards and transform your day into something sweet! Check out the details below.

Valentine Shards Event

notes.title: G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright - Patch Notes - January 21, 2021
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/2765/200922_patchnotes_newsarticleheader_940x290.jpg
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Weapon and Pet Rental: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance
Winter 2020 Master Plan: Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before MaintenanceShy's Night Sky Shop 2020!: Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before MaintenanceAilionoa Haute Box: Thursday, January 7th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 28th, Before MaintenanceDragon Master Event: Thursday, January 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before MaintenanceMagical Fairy Tale: Thursday, January 21st, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before MaintenanceG25 Hypernova: Glyphwright Update: Permanent 
G25 Hypernova: Glyphwright Update
For an in-depth look into the new Glyphwrighting Talent, check out the Glyphwrighting Guide!To become a Glyphwright, you can either rebirth into the Glyphwrighting Talent, or buy the book, "Patterns of Power (1)" from Aeira in Dunbarton.If you create a new character and select Glyphwrighting as your first talent, you will gain a special title called, "the Aspiring Glyphwright".The title will disappear once you hit cumulative level 1,000.To start part 2 of the G25 Hypernova storyline, use the Familiar White Feather in your inventory that was given during part 1 of the G25 Hypernova storyline.
During the storyline, you will receive the new technique, Pragarah.When Pragarah is activated, the enemy's Magic Defense and Magic Protection are reduced.There are new titles that you can receive for completing the G25 Hypernova storyline.You will get the title, "the Star of the Dawn" when you complete G25 Hypernova.You will get one of the following titles depending on your story decisions throughout G25 Hypernova.VirtuousKindUnmoved
Homestead Map Update
When viewing the Homestead Map, you can now view your favorite Homesteads in list form by clicking on the Favorites List button.
Crystal Ball Update
The Crystal Ball in the Dunbarton Library has been updated!You can now view cutscenes from Chapter 6 (G19, G20, G21) and Chapter 7 (G22, G23, G24, G25).
The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.Fixed a typo in Llywelyn's special dialogue to address Altam as Commander.Fixed a typo in Avelin's dialogue in "A Wavering Gaze".Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "Another Path".Fixed an issue with the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) when it is equipped with a hat, the hat either is not visible or the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) loses textures.Fixed an issue where a button on Doll Bags was previously untranslated.Fixed an issue where the Crazy Rich Milletian Fur Scarf did not appear when worn with Macha Hair.Fixed a typo in Marleid's dialogue in "The Old Blood".Fixed a typo in Enya's dialogue in "White Wisps of Breath".Fixed a typo in "Slicing Through the Silence".Fixed an issue where you could not gift Score Scrolls to the Laighlinne partner.The Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon and the Special Floral Fairy Walk 2nd Title Coupon are now tradeable.
The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There are script errors when opening the cash shop in-game.While crafting Magic Ink with the Stationery Crafting skill, the item required says "[Color] Dye". It should say "[Color] Paint".Some Glyph effects say "Chain: [Fighter Skill]". It should say "Combo: [Fighter Skill]".

notes.title: Dragon Master Event
notes.content:
Now's your chance to wrangle the new Red Flame Fire Dragon! Brave the Uladh Dungeon and Shadow Missions to collect what Meiling needs to craft the dragon. Or, log in every day to make this majestic pet your own! You can also earn hot rewards like Nao's Festival Bag Coupon or the Aura of Vitality 2nd Title. Check out the details below!

Dragon Master Event

Event Dates: Thursday, January 21st After Maintenance - Thursday, February 18th, Before Maintenance

Dragon Master Event Details
Upon log in you will receive the quest [Guide] Dragon Clan Across the Sea.Talk to Meiling in Dunbarton Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account. The character must be above Level 30.Once completed, you will receive the following:10,000 EXPWalter Attendance Scroll
Crafting a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle
During the event, you can gather materials for Meiling to craft a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle.You can only craft one Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle during the event period.You can also obtain a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle as a reward from the Walter Attendance Scroll event.The event items (Horn of Thousand Year Dragon, Fire Dragon's Red Leather, Golden Yarn of Dawn, Incomplete Horn Bugle, and Walter Attendance Scroll) will be removed after the event ends, including any items in the auction house, mailbox, bank, or pet inventory.You must gather one Horn of Thousand Year Dragon, one Fire Dragon's Red Leather, and one Golden Yarn of Dawn for Meiling to attempt to craft the *NEW* Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1161/mabinogi-red-flame-fire-dragon-resting.pngYou have a chance to collect the Horn of Thousand Year Dragon by clearing Uladh Dungeon:
Alby IntermediateAlby AdvancedCiar IntermediateCiar AdvancedRabbie BasicRabbie AdvancedFiodh IntermediateFiodh AdvancedRundal BasicRundal AdvancedHard AlbyHard CiarHard RundalYou have a chance to collect Fire Dragon's Red Leather when you complete a Tara or Tailteann Shadow Mission:BasicIntermediateAdvancedHardEliteLordYou have a chance to collect Golden Yarn of Dawn when you fish at Tir Chonaill Fishing Area with Bait Tin.The harder the dungeon or mission difficulty, the better the chance to collect the material.When the crafting succeeds, you will receive an Incomplete Whistle. Stay logged in for 1 hour to convert it to a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle...and the Dragon might have something special for you!If you change channels or log out before the hour has finished, the timer will reset. You will need to stay logged in for the full hour to convert it to a Red Flame Fire Dragon Horn Bugle.When the crafting fails, you could keep all three materials or could lose one or more materials. You will also receive a consolation item.
Walter Attendance Scroll Event Details
Every day spend at least 36 minutes logged in to Mabinogi on your main character to receive a reward.To receive your reward, you must use the Attendance Scroll and click 'Receive Gift.'There is a maximum of 28 rewards to collect during the event period.The event resets daily at 7:00 AM PST.You can collect the following rewards:Day 1: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Coupon (Not tradable)
Redeem this voucher for Nao's Festival Bag. Its default size is 10 by 3, offering a total of 30 slots, and can hold a variety of items.When you apply a Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch to it, you can later expand its capacity to up to 10 by 13.The bag takes a 2 by 2 space in the Basic Inventory. You can only have one such bag.Nao's Festival Bag is a Personal Shop Bag.Day 2: Perfect Free Repair Kit (Expires: 15 days)Day 3: Guardian Soul Stone (Event) x10Day 4: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)A special royal pouch that can be applied to Nao's Festival Bag. Use it on Nao's Festival Bag to add 1 extra row at the bottom.Up to 10 royal pouches can be applied to one Nao's Festival BagDay 5: AP Potion (Event) (AP 30) (Expires: 15 days)Day 6: Rusty Hammer of Proficiency (Expires: 15 days)Day 7: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)Day 8: Direct Dye Ampoule (Expires: 15 days)Day 9: Golden Experience Fruit (300%) (Expires: 15 days)Day 10: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)Day 11: AP Potion (Event) (AP 30) (Expires: 15 days)Day 12: Baltane Elite Mission Pass Selection Box (Expires: 15 days)Day 13: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)Day 14: Enchant Protection Potion (Expires: 15 days)Day 15: Full Recovery Potion x5 (Expires: 15 days)Day 16: *NEW* Nao's Festival Bag Royal Pouch (Not tradable)Day 17: Unlimited Shadow Mission Pass (Expires: 15 days)Day 18: *NEW* Aura of Vitality 2nd Title Coupon (Luck +30)

Open it to receive one of the following: Toy Train of Memories (4 players), Toy Train of Memories (6 players), and Toy Train of Memories (8 players))

notes.content:
'Tis the season for giving and the Warm-Hearted Volunteer is looking for helpers! Travel around Erinn spreading good will and cheer (and the occasional carol) to earn sweet rewards such as the new Christmas Wreath Chair or Homestead Glowing Christmas Tree!
[hr][/hr]
Helping Hands in Erinn Event

Event Dates: Wednesday, December 23rd After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th Before Maintenance

Volunteering for the Holidays
During the event, you will receive the quest [Guide] Volunteering for the Holidays.Talk to the Warm-Hearted Volunteer in Dunbarton Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account.Once completed you will receive the following rewards:10,000 EXP3,000 Gold
Daily Quest
Each week during the event, there will be a different daily quest. See the schedule below for what quest will be available each week.The daily quest is only available for the main character.The daily quest will reset each day at 7:00 AM PST.If you have any items in the Temporary Inventory, you will not receive a new daily quest when it resets at 7:00 AM PST. Please empty the Temporary Inventory and then re-login to the game to receive a new daily quest.Each day, you will need the Carol Score Scroll to complete the daily quest. You can also purchase it from the Warm-Hearted Volunteer for 10,000 Gold.The Carol Score Scroll will be removed when the event ends.For the Week 2 quest, the snacks reset every day when the daily quest resets. You will receive new snacks each day.
Week 1: Wednesday, December 23rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 31, 6:59 AM PST
During Week 1 you will receive [Event] Christmas with a Lonely Neighbor.Travel to Emain Macha to donate gold to the beggar and play a carol.Tip: You can 'SHIFT + Click' on the Gold to drag and drop it for the Lonely NeighborOnce completed, you will receive the following rewards:100,000 EXP3,000 Gold*NEW* Gift Box for Devoted Milletians x3

Week 3: Thursday, January 7th, 7:00 AM PST - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance
During Week 3 you will receive [Event] Christmas with a Lonely Elder.Travel to Port Cobh to play a carol for Ascon.Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:100,000 EXP3,000 Gold*NEW* Gift Box for Devoted Milletians x3

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:

G25 Hypernova: Eclipse Update
Check out the G25 Hypernova: Eclipse post for more details!To start G25 Hypernova, click on 'Start' on the Chapter Info UI.
You must be cumulative level 3,000 in order to start G25.
The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:
The Chipmunk Bag has been renamed to the Squirrel Bag.Fixed an issue where the Rainbow Sprite pet was not changing colors.Fixed an issue in the G21 quest, "A Glimpse of the Future", that stated the incorrect objective.Modified the description of Nele's Music Renown and Spirit Unleashing from "Critical Rate Max Increase" to "Final Critical Rate Increase (Can exceed max)."Fixed an issue of Nele's Music Renown and Spirit Unleashing effects not applying when the Final Critical Rate is less than 30%.A minimum success rate of 0.1% has been added when using the Tame Wild Animal skill on a monster.The bank password input window will now close if the Auction House window is closed.Sealed items can no longer be reforged.Fixed an issue with the Catsidhe pet pushing targets back with the Gummy Attack skill.The Point Inventory window can no longer be opened while using a production skill.You can now set a shortcut key setting for Technique Set activation. [Options]->[Game]->[Control]->[Hotkey Settings]Fixed an issue where the Festia Clobbermeister matryoshka could be killed.You can no longer proceed through the Scathach Beach Purification mission when joining a squad, mini-game, or jam band.Added a "Failed to Create" notification window when trying to create a jam band or mini-game party during the Scathach Beach Purification mission.You can now obtain EXP, regardless of combat power, in a Baltane Mission.Fixed an issue where the age of a character was displayed as "0" in some RP missions.The following monsters/NPC fights have been fixed so that they cannot be knocked down. Additionally, the location lag has been improved.Tabhartas (Grandmaster mission)Cessair's Heart (Saga Season 1)Tarlach (Saga Season 1)Enslaved Ifrit (Saga Season 2)Fixed an issue where a Chain Blade hit in the G22 quest, "Wheel of Misfortune", would not be properly counted in the last phase.The dungeon walls inside the G24 quest, "Blessed Again", have been modified so that they do not block the player's view. Additionally, the maximum range of vision has been expanded.Fixed an issue where a character would freeze and would not be able to move after knocking on the door in the hallway during the G24 quest, "Deep Sea Clues".Fixed an issue where you are unable to click on the UI when the Stealth Potion UI overlaps another UI during the G24 quest, "Insufferable Presence".The issue of the cutscene in the G24 quest, "Stalemate", playing abnormally has been fixed.Fixed an issue where the Dark Thrust skill by the Incubus King was randomly not inflicting damage.Fixed an issue where the Divine Link effect was displaying in cutscenes.Fixed an issue where the Ctrl key was randomly detected as active when not actually pressedThe Character Selection screen speed has been improved.Fixed an issue where the Character Selection sound effect would overlap.Fixed an issue of characters/cards/pets being shown during the loading process when they are hidden by the filter.Fixed the issue of characters/cards/pets overlapping in one slot.Fixed the issue where connecting to the world would be slower when there were more characters/cards/pets shown in the Character Selection screen.Fixed the issue of being able to play the game abnormally when recognition delay was created on monsters by using Anchor Rush during some missions.Fixed an issue of not being able to use a pet without inventory (Beginner's Horse and Beginner's Eagle) as a sub-pet during Fynn Sync.
A change has been made so that the mouse cursor will move normally on the screen when the Blacksmithing window is covered by another windowFixed the issue of text in the Blacksmithing finish window displaying abnormally under certain UI themes.Fixed the issue of randomly not being able to receive the Field Raid contribution quest.Fixed untranslated text that appeared when trying to learn the Blaze skill from Berched.The browser size for the in-game cash shop has been increased.The dungeon difficulty text in the Dungeon Guide for Alby and Ciar has been changed from Basic to Normal]Changed the dungeon name in the Dungeon Guide from Sidhe Finnachaid of Sadness to Sidhe Finnachaid of Sorrow.
The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".When a hat is equipped with the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive), the hat is either not visible, or the Cat-Shaped Mask (Face Accessory Slot Exclusive) loses textures.There is a disconnection error that asks players to reset their secondary password.

notes.title: Hyper Bingo Event
notes.content:
Caravan Joe has returned after successfully infiltrating the Order of the Black Moon and wants to thank his savior for protecting him with the Hyper Bingo event! Complete the Bingo Board to earn rewards such as the new Eclipse 2nd Title, Etain Miniature, Mini Winter Outfits, and more!

Hyper Bingo Event

Event Dates: Thursday, December 17th, After Maintenance - Thursday, January 14th, Before Maintenance

How Caravan Joe Shows Gratitude
During the event, you will receive the quest [Guide] How Caravan Joe Shows Gratitude.Talk to G25 Event Helper Caravan Joe in Dunbarton's Town Square to register a main character.You can only register one character per account.Once completed you will receive the following rewards:12,001 EXP
The Bingo Sticker Packs will be removed when the event ends.
Bingo Board
After registering your main character, you gain access to the Hyper Bingo UI.Click on the Hyper Bingo icon to open the Hyper Bingo Board.    https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2212/mabinogi-bingo-board-icon.pngThe Hyper Bingo UI has a bingo board, the number of Bingo Sticker Packs and duplicate stickers available, and the current Daily and C7 Challenge progress. 
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2214/mabinogi-bingo-board-ui.png
The bingo board has 7 slots which correspond to the 7 trials of Hymerark. Obtain a sticker that matches each slot and complete the board.You gain rewards by obtaining Bingo Sticker Packs, completing bingo rows, and completing the entire board.Once you have completed the board, you will receive a new board and can start again!Bingo Sticker Packs, Duplicates, Daily Challenge progress, and C7 Challenges do not reset when you start a new board.
 Obtaining Stickers
Daily Challenge
The Daily Challenge resets every day at 7:00 AM PST.If you are logged in before 7:00 AM PST, you must change channels to reset the Daily Challenge.You can complete these challenges each day during the event:Log in to Erinn each day during the event to receive one Bingo Sticker Pack.Clear the Daily Shadow Mission Quest to receive one Bingo Sticker Pack.Clear the Advanced Uladh Dungeon to receive one Bingo Sticker Pack.For every 30 minutes you are logged in to Erinn, you will receive one Bingo Sticker Pack, up to a maximum of 5 Bingo Sticker Packs per day.
Time accumulated by minutes does not reset when you change channels or logout. For example, if you change channels or logout after 29 min 50 sec, you will need to stay logged in for 1 min to receive a Bingo Sticker Pack.Complete the quest [Event] Caravan Joe's Caravan Adventure to receive one Bingo Sticker Pack.You will receive a Venture Contract - [Caravan Repair] with the quest. This item expires in 12 hr and you can bulk delete any items that have expired.You can only use the Venture Contract if you have completed the [Guide] Thrilling Pet Expedition and have the Pet Expedition Board in your Homestead. You can find out more details about the Pet Exhibition Board in the Pet Adventurer Guide.
C7 Challenge
You will receive 7 Bingo Sticker Packs for clearing each of the following:G22 [Apocalypse]G23 [Tempest]G24 [Climax]G25 [Eclipse] Part 1You will receive the Bingo Sticker Packs for any generations that were cleared before the event began.C7 Challenges do not reset.
Opening Bingo Sticker Packs
Opening a Bingo Sticker Pack will create a random sticker.If the sticker is new, it will be placed on the bingo board.If the sticker is a duplicate of one already on the board, it will be added to the Duplicates count on the bingo board.Five duplicate stickers can be exchanged for a new sticker. Clicking the Exchange button allows you to obtain the sticker of your choice, which can be placed on any free spot on the board.Every time you open a Bingo Sticker Pack you will receive one *NEW* Doubhca Box.
Completing a Bingo
You complete a bingo when you have filled in 7 stickers in a row. Bingo can be achieved horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.Each time you complete a bingo you will receive one *NEW* *NEW* Eclipse Box.You will receive additional bonus Eclipse Boxes when completing multiple rows:Complete 3 Rows: 3 *NEW* Eclipse BoxesComplete 6 Rows: 3 *NEW* Eclipse BoxesComplete 9 Rows: 4 *NEW* Eclipse BoxesComplete 12 Rows: 6 *NEW* Eclipse BoxesWhen you finish the entire bingo board you will receive the following:6 *NEW* Eclipse Boxes1 *NEW* *NEW* Hypernova BoxAfter you have finished the entire board, you will be given a new bingo board to try again!You will receive additional rewards based on the number of bingo boards you have completed:1st Time Completion

notes.title: G25 Precursor Event
notes.content:
Caravan Joe needs your help! Rescue Caravan Joe every day to earn sweet rewards and experience to get you ready for G25. Check out the details below.

Table of Contents
Caravan Joe's FavorBlack Moon Stone FragmentsDaily QuestSkill Combo Card FragmentsBlack Combo CardBreaking the Seal
G25 Precursor Event
Event Dates: Thursday, December 3rd, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance
 
Caravan Joe's Favor
During the event, you will receive the quest, [Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor.Talk to the G25 Precursor Event Helper Caravan Joe in Dunbarton's Town Square.Register a main character with Caravan Joe.You can only register one character per account.Once completed, you will receive the following rewards:12,000 EXPRescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day)Black Moon Stone Fragment (21 days)Unlock the daily quest [Event] Caravan Joe in CrisisOnce the event ends, you can no longer grow the Black Moon Stone Fragment and will only be able to break the seal.
Important Notes Skill Combo Card Fragments and Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons will be removed when the event ends.These items will also also be completely removed from the Auction House when the event ends, regardless of Sold or Not Sold status, along with all the gold.The skill slots in the Black Combo Cards can only be changed with the Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons before breaking the seal and obtaining it permanently from the event.]Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons cannot be used to change the skill slots in the Black Combo Cards after obtaining it from the event.This is regardless of VIP status.Do not break the seal until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.Breaking the seal is NOT reversible. Even if you break the seal by mistake, you will be unable to reverse that decision.
Black Moon Stone Fragments

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2034/mabinogi-black-moon-stone-fragment.png
Press the Black Moon Stone Fragment image to open the event graphic. From here you can check the Black Moon Stone Fragment's growth status.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2036/mabinogi-g25-precursor-event-ui.png
2: Growth status of the fragment, up to 12 stages1.8 cm: 12 sizes of gems that you can obtain after breaking the seal100 pts: Growth points of the Combo Card that you can useNote: Obtaining Combo Card points and growing Black Moon Stone Fragments is not possible beyond 12 stages or after breaking the seal. However, you can still complete the daily quest.Filling the gauge 100% within a day will cause the fragment to grow by 1 stage.You can fill the gauge in the following ways:Stay logged in for 90 sec real-time to increase the gauge by 1%.Changing channels or logging out doesn't reset the gauge. However, if you change channels or log out before increasing the gauge by 1% (for example, only being logged in for 85 sec), you will need to stay logged in for the full 90 sec again.This resets daily at 7:00 AM PST. If you are online before 7:00 AM PST, it will reset without you needing to change channels.Your gauge increases 25% each time you complete Today's Special Mission.Check Today's Special Mission - Taillteann/Tara Mission to determine what you need to do.Completing both missions will increase the gauge by 50%.The gauge increases 50% upon completing the daily quest Caravan Joe in Crisis.As a bonus, each time you clear G22, G23, and G24 your fragment will grow by 1 stage.You will earn a stage for each generation completed before the event starts. If you have already completed all three generations, you will start at stage 4.If you clear G22 - G24 before the event begins, you will automatically reach stage 2 - 4 when the event starts:Clear G22: Stage 2 RewardsClear G23: Stage 3 RewardsClear G24: Stage 4 RewardsYou will receive the following rewards for each stage:Note: Item rewards are untradeable and expire in 14 days[table][tr][th]Stage[/th][th]Gem Size (cm)[/th][th]Combo Card Points (Accumulated)[/th][th]Item Reward by Growth Stage[/th][/tr][tr][td]1[/td][td]1.0[/td][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][/tr][tr][td]2[/td][td]1.8[/td][td]100[/td][td]AP Potion (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]3[/td][td]2.6[/td][td]200[/td][td]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/td][/tr][tr][td]4[/td][td]3.4[/td][td]300[/td][td]Skill Training Seal (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]5[/td][td]4.2[/td][td]400[/td][td]AP Potion (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]5.0[/td][td]500[/td][td]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]5.8[/td][td]600[/td][td]Skill Training Seal (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]6.6[/td][td]700[/td][td]AP Potion (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]7.4[/td][td]800[/td][td]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/td][/tr][tr][td]10[/td][td]8.2[/td][td]900[/td][td]Skill Training Seal (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]11[/td][td]9.0[/td][td]1,000[/td][td]AP Potion (30)[/td][/tr][tr][td]12[/td][td]10.0[/td][td]1,100[/td][td]Golden Experience Fruit (500%)[/td][/tr][/table]
Daily Quest: Caravan Joe in Crisis
The [Event] Caravan Joe in Crisis unlocks after completing [Guide] Caravan Joe's Favor.The daily quest resets every day at 7:00 AM PST. After you have completed the daily quest, you will receive one Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day) every day when you log in, starting the day after the first time you completed the quest.Use the Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day) to start the mission.You can enter the mission with a party of one to four people.If any member of the party is not registered as a main character for the event or has reached that day's limit of 10 missions, the party will not be able to start the mission.Before starting you can select the mission difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard).The difficulty level will determine your rewards, including how many Skill Combo Card Fragments you receive.Easy45,000 EXP1,000 Gold PouchReward Box (2 - 3 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 Random Potion, x1 Random Tailoring Material)Medium90,000 EXP15,000 Gold PouchReward Box (4 - 5 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 Random Potion, x1 Random Tailoring Material)Difficult190,000 EXP25,000 Gold PouchReward Box (6 - 7 Skill Combo Card Fragments, x1 Random Potion, x1 Random Tailoring Material)Once you have completed the quest, you will earn the following rewards:Fragment gauge fills up 50%x2 Rescue Caravan Joe Mission Pass (1 day)300,000 EXP
Skill Combo Card Fragments
You earn Skill Combo Card Fragments by participating in the Daily Quest.When you collect 10 Fragments for the same type of Skill Combo Card, you can exchange them for a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon.The Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon is used to change the selected skill in the Black Combo Card.There are 10 different types of Skill Black Combo Card Fragments and Exchange Coupons. All are tradeable.[Warrior] Skill Black Combo Card[Archer] Skill Black Combo Card[Mage] Skill Black Combo Card[Alchemist] Skill Black Combo Card[Merchant] Skill Black Combo Card[Fighter] Skill Black Combo Card[Puppeteer] Skill Black Combo Card[Gunslinger] Skill Black Combo Card[Ninja] Skill Black Combo Card[Chain Slasher] Skill Black Combo Card
Black Combo Card
Upon selecting a main character in Caravan Joe's Favor, three Combo Card slots will randomly open up.Important NotesThe skill slots in the Black Combo Cards can only be changed with the Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons before obtaining it permanently from the event.Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupons cannot be used to change the skill slots in the Black Combo Cards after obtaining it from the event. This is regardless of VIP status.Do not break the seal until you are 100% confident that the skills are finalized.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2035/mabinogi-black-combo-card.png
You can open up to a total of six Combo Card slots during the event.Collect Skill Combo Card Fragments by completing Caravan Joe in Crisis. Exchange 10 Skill Combo Card Fragments of the same type to receive a Skill Black Combo Card Exchange Coupon.You can use 40 points to use the Exchange Coupon to change a skill in the Black Combo notes.title: Dungeon Guide System - Patch Notes - November 12th, 2020
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Dungeon Guide System update!

The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Playful Puzzle Returns!: Thursday, September 24th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 24th, Before Maintenance	Attendance Check Event: Thursday, October 22nd, After Maintenance - Thursday, November 19th, Before Maintenance	Steam Engineer Toolbox: Thursday, October 29th, After Maintenance - Wednesday, November 25th, Before Maintenance	Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17th, Before Maintenance	Generation Boost Event: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before Maintenance	Weapon and Pet Rental: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, February 11th, Before Maintenance	Dark Divination Box: Thursday, November 12th, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 10th, Before MaintenanceDungeon Guide System: Permanent		

Dungeon Guide System:
The Dungeon Guide System update is now live! Easily see which dungeons you've cleared or find new dungeons to explore with the new Dungeon Guide UI. You can also earn a ton of rewards and buy items from a brand new shop. 		You can check out the full details of the Dungeon Guide System update in the guide!	You can access the Dungeon Guide UI by clicking on the Info tab, and selecting Dungeon Guide.	Each dungeon and mission listed on the Dungeon Guide UI will show information about that dungeon/mission. It will also show some of the main rewards of that dungeon/mission, as well as the guaranteed repeated dungeon clear rewards.	Clearing dungeons or missions multiple times will have guaranteed rewards. You can obtain these rewards in the Dungeon Guide UI.	Each dungeon or mission can only be repeated 10 times per account per real life day. The repeat timer resets at 12 AM server time.	The Dungeon Guide UI will also show recommended dungeons based on your physical or magical damage output.	Completing certain dungeons will yield you Support Boxes that will aid your character in getting stronger.	There is a new shop that you can access via Eavan in Dunbarton.	To purchase items in this shop, you will need Vouchers.	Vouchers can be obtained by registering a main character at Eavan and completing dungeons/missions.	You are able to change your registered character once per day after registering.	There are 4 different types of Vouchers that you can obtain in different dungeons and missions.		

Permanent Changes:

Dungeon Changes
The 8-Player Dungeon event will be turned on permanently with the Dungeon Guide update.You are now able to enter any of the following dungeons with 8 players on any difficulty:		Alby	Ciar	Rabbie	Math	Fiodh	Barri	Coill	Rundal	Peaca	

Chapter 7: Apocalypse Changes
The required level to start Chapter 7: Apocalypse has been reduced from level 5,000 to level 3,000.All enemy stats and skill ranks have been nerfed.

G22: Apocalypse Changes
The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Chance and Destiny":		In the last phase of the mission, the amount of time that you need to survive the wave of enemies is now displayed on screen.	The mission will not fail if the player is knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "Wheel of Misfortune":		During the last phase of the mission, the target submerges into the water, but does not move too far.	An issue where Dorcha Snatch was not counted as a hit to the target has been fixed.	When using certain Chain Blades skills that cannot hit the target, a message containing instructions will appear.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Holy Barrier":		Picking an incorrect answer will no longer cause the mission to fail.	The following changes have been made to the G22 quests, "In Search of Clues 1-7" and "Collect Clues 1-4":		The amount of glowing spots that you needs to find during "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been reduced.	The instruction text that guides you throughout "In Search of Clues 1" and "Collect Clues 1" has been improved.	Directional markings have been added to lead you to the destination in the quests "In Search of Clues 2" and "Collect Clues 2".	A location marker has been added to the NPC that needs to be found in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".	The mission guide dialogue has been improved in the quest "In Search of Clues 3".	The cooking difficulty for the quest "In Search of Clues 5" has been drastically reduced.	The following change has been made to the G22 quests, "Seven Eyelids", "Phantoms Among the Snow", "A Memory of Emain Macha", "Seeking the Last Symbols", and "A Missing Memory":		If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.	The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "The Broken Prison Gate":		You are now able to proceed with the quest, even if you do not have the skill, Life Drain.	The following change has been made to the G22 quest, "Seeking the Last Symbols":		The instruction text that appears during the quest has been improved.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Executive Discretion":		The amount of time you need to survive the wave of enemies will now be displayed on screen.	The following change has been made to the G22 mission, "Castling":		A message to better understand the mission progress has been added.	The following changes have been made to the G22 mission, "A False Promise":		The damaging field left by Salamanders and the damage from the Salamanders has been reduced.	The duration of the summoned Fire Pillars and the damaging fields that appear have been reduced.	The overall damage from the boss enemy has been reduced.	

G23: Tempest Changes
The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Winter Festival":		The hints provided for the Quiz Contest will be more direct.	You are now able to skip the sliding Picture Puzzle mini-game.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Preparing for the Plague":		The number of quest items needed to proceed with the quest has been reduced from 5 of each item, to 1 of each item.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered by the Winds":		If you lose the Topaz Arrow that Hagel gives you to enter the dungeon, you can request another one from him.	No matter which Topaz Arrow you use to enter the dungeon (either the one given before the update or the one given after the update), the quest item, a Fresh Water Bottle, will now be given 100% of the time.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Scattered Omens":		If you type in an incorrect answer, a more obvious hint will be given to you.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "Jarlath's Trail":		The required quest item can now be obtained 4 at a time.	The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%, regardless of the difficulty of the Shadow Mission.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Rain and Fire:"		Enemy stats in the quest mission have been nerfed.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Eye Spy":		You can now locate the target on the mini-map.	The following changes have been made to the G23 quest, "New Path in an Old Land":		The number of sketches that need to be checked has been lowered.	You can now locate all of the targets needed on the mini-map.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Nightmare's Embrace":		Enemy stats in the mission have been nerfed.	The chance of the enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.	You are now able to revive in the mission using Nao Stones.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "Generations":		The drop chance of the quest item is now set to 100%.	The following change has been made to the G23 quest, "On the Brink":		The warp device's recovery rate has been increased by 1.5x.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Who Rules the Sea":		Some skill damage from enemies has been nerfed.	The amount of summoned enemies that you need to defeat has been decreased.	The amount of summoned enemies appearing at the same time has been decreased.	The chance of an enemy using Thunder has been drastically decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G23 mission, "Failed Hypothesis":		While possessed by the enemy, the debuff effect has been decreased.	When the enemy is enraged, the attack damage increase rate has been nerfed.	The damage needed to cancel the enraged effect has been decreased.	

G24: Ascension Changes
The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Blue and White":		The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The skill damage of the enemy has been nerfed.	The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "The Secret in the Swamp":		The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Deep Sea Clues":		You no longer need to play the sliding puzzle mini-game.	The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Undertow":			The number of summoned enemies has been decreased.	The mission will no longer fail if you are knocked out. You are able to revive and continue the mission.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Gaze of the Blood Moon":		You are now able to clear Phase 2 of the mission when the enemy's HP drops below 50%.	The damaging field and the damage the enemy can deal have been decreased.	The duration of the Fire Pillar and the damaging field have been decreased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "A Lonely Obsession":		The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The close combat damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The number and range of the bombs dropped by the enemy has been decreased.	You will no longer get knocked out when hit by a bomb.	The number of summoned orbs has been decreased.	The time limit that you have to defeat the summoned orbs has been increased.	The following changes have been made to the G24 mission, "Lullaby of the Abyss": 		The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	The duration of the bleed effect from the enemy has been decreased.	The following change has been made to the G24 mission, "At the End of the Road":		Since the enemies have been nerfed, the RP character has also been nerfed.	The following changes have been made to the G24 quest, "Moonlight of Death":		The amount of HP the enemy has, based on the number of party members you bring into the mission, has been decreased.	The skill damage of the enemy has been decreased.	You will no longer get stunned or knocked out when attacked by the enemy.	

Technique Changes
The cooldown time of the Techniques, Iron Will, Relentless Assault, and Exploit Weakness, has been changed to 10 minutes.The cooldown time of the Technique, Time Shift, has been changed to 15 minutes.

Tory Ravine Changes
Poison Alligator, Doubcha Saturos, and Doubcha Floating Stone will no longer attack on sight.You will no longer be invincible when talking to a G24 NPC.
	

The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:
Fixed an issue where a disconnection error would ask players to reset their secondary password.Fixed an issue where cash items purchased with NX Credit required you to try and claim the items twice before it moves into your inventory.Fixed an issue with skill training EXP potions having the same name as EXP potions. Skill training EXP potions will name have "Skill" in the name.Fixed an issue with Shamala's Transformation Medal item tooltip displaying the incorrect name for Caravan Joe. The name has been changed to Halloween Caravan Joe.Fixed an issue with promotional crossover items appearing with random color when previewing in the Dressing Room.Fixed an issue where multiple items were previously not listable in the Auction House.

The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlorn Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Using the Golden Supplement can sometimes cause a pet to receive negative EXP on the pet's EXP bar.There are minor graphical issues when holding any of the 4 lantern weapons.There are minor graphical issues when wearing the Autumnal Outfits:If you are a female Giant, there is a slight clipping of the hands during the special outfit animation.If you are a female character, there is clipping of the wrist texture when wearing the Autumnal gloves.If you are a female character, the Autumnal outfit will clip at the bottom when holding a Cup o' Joe.If you are a male Human or Elf, sitting in a chair while wearing the Autumnal outfit will cause the chair to sink lower than with other outfits.If you are a male character, the Autumnal outfit animation will have a slight blinking issue near the bottom pockets.If you are a male character, there will be a slight cutoff of the hair texture when you wear a wig with the outfit.If a character is equipped with an umbrella item and uses the Jump action, the character's mouth with display as a smile until you change channels or log out.There is an issue where you cannot Friend Summon using Fynn Pets. It will show the error, "Unavailable because the owner has opened a Personal Shop".There is an issue where you are unable to enter the Forgotten Tomb because it will say you are already in a Shadow Mission.

notes.title: Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event
notes.content:
For a limited time, enjoy an increase in drop rates for some of Uladh's rarest items! Eight party dungeon teams are now a permanent addition to Mabinogi, so gather 7 friends and get ready to clear those dungeons. Check out the details below.


Event Dates: Thursday, November 12, After Maintenance - Thursday, December 17, Before Maintenance

Event Details
You can enter Uladh Dungeons with a maximum of 8 party members.	 Entering dungeons with 8-party teams is a permanent addition. You can continue to use 8-party teams after the Dungeon Drop Rate Increase Event ends.These dungeons include the following, on any difficulty:    Alby Dungeon  Ciar Dungeon  Math Dungeon  Rabbie Dungeon  Barri Dungeon  Coill Dungeon  Fiodh Dungeon  Rundal Dungeon  Peaca Dungeon  During the event, drop rates of dead end treasure chests from Uladh Dungeons are increased. This means that there will be an increased drop rate for items such as Destructive Robe sewing patterns, Succubus Fiend sewing patterns, and weapon crafting materials! notes.title: Join the Soul Streamers!
notes.content:
What is Soul Streamers?	
Soul Streamers is a partnership program for Mabinogi’s best and brightest content creators.
	
Members receive official support including monthly gacha rewards, giveaway opportunities, promotion on Mabinogi social channels, and more!
	
	Who Can Apply?	
Mabinogi content creators who meet our minimum criteria are eligible to apply.
	
	Minimum Applicant Criteria					Regularly creating Mabinogi-related content (once per month)			High-quality content that engages viewers and the Mabinogi community			
	Twitch					Minimum 15+ average viewers per stream			AND 360+ minutes (6+ hours) total streamed per month									These can be creative or gameplay focused streams							
	YouTube					1+ video per month with a minimum of 250+ views total 			Video content can be game related or combination with creative content related to Mabinogi			
	Other Platforms					Unique, creative content in image, video, stream, or other media format that engages followers and viewers (eg. Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, etc.)			At least 1,000 followers**			
**Consideration does not automatically guarantee membership. You will receive an email from us upon acceptance into the program.
	
Applications will be reviewed and measured against content quality and activity. Users with any Nexon Terms of Service violations on record will not be considered for the Soul Streamers program.
	
You, your channel, services and content must: not contain any of the following:
					Comply with and not violate, or promote the violation of, Nexon’s Terms of Service;			Comply with and not violate, or promote the violation of, Nexon America's Influencer Policy, which you agree to by becoming a Soul Streamers member.			Not promote or contain content that Nexon deems as illegal, racist, sexist, hateful, pornographic or otherwise offensive.

notes.title: Campfire Spirit - Patch Notes - September 10th
notes.content:
Check out all of the details of this month's Patch Notes, featuring the Campfire Spirit & Quality of Life update!
The following Events, Sales, and Promotions are running:
Modern School Uniform Box: Thursday, August 27th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 24th, Before MaintenanceConnous Beach Vacation Event: August 27th, After Maintenance - September 24th, Before MaintenanceSummer Master Plan: Thursday, July 9th, After Maintenance - Thursday, September 24th, Before MaintenanceStudy Event: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 8th, Before MaintenanceHistorian's Old Trunk Sale: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Thursday, October 8th, Before MaintenanceInventory Expansion Coupon and Inventory Expansion Coupon PLUS: Thursday, September 10th, After Maintenance - Permanent

New Updates:
The Campfire Spirit & Quality of Life update is now live! Gather round the campfire and invite your friends and favorite NPCs to kick back and relax with you. There are ample changes to make your life in Erinn even better!The Campfire Spirit is an update to the Campfire skill!Check out an in-depth overview of how the Campfire Spirit works on the guide!Earn increased EXP and items for burning items in the campfire.Occasionally obtain Burning Firewood and Campfire Invitations when performing normal burns.Before you set up the Campfire Spirit Campfire, use the Campfire Invitation to invite one Erinn resident to the campfire (note that if you set up a campfire without using the invitation, the invitation will be deleted).Use Burning Firewood to create a Campfire Spirit campfire to summon the Campfire Spirit.Earn additional rewards for burning items at a Campfire Spirit campfire and bonus EXP.Check out all of the awesome quality of life improvements in this update on its dedicated webpost!There are numerous improvements to the pet UI, Auction House, Shadow Missions, dressing room, general UI, and inventory!

The following bug fixes and changes have been made to the game:
Fixed the name of a duplicate Cute Heart Star Face Beauty Coupon (F) to Plump Heart Star Face Beauty Coupon (F).Some Shadow Mission Quest titles will no longer display and overlap the mission details in the Quest UI.Added "Pet Training" as a selectable Life Talent to receive a Skill Training EXP 2.0 bonus for the Catsidhe Pet.Fixed the Music Buff Duration of Fleur's Grass Tiara to match the description.Fixed the warning message that appears when buying limited allowable trade items or bidding/enlisting in the Auction House.Fixed overlapping text issue when using a Talent Reset Capsule and scrolling through the description.Fixed an issue where the hair colors from the Spring 2020 Hair Dye Selection Box did not display the color code correctly on Hairstyle Reversion Coupons.Fixed a typo for the Required Materials when making a Courageous Borage Perfume.Fixed a typo in the description of the "Unfading Flower".Changed Homestead item names to be Camping Bicycle, All-Terrain Bike and Trailer, and All-Terrain Bike Set.Fixed the issue where the Windmill Skill of the Gio, Lento, and Alto pets cannot be loaded.Changed the name for Long Wavy Hair Beauty Coupon (F) to Long Wavy Ponytail Hair Beauty Coupon (F).Fixed an issue with overlapping text in Blaanid's Memoir 3 Share Food 50 Times quest.

The following are known bugs:
The thread effects for the Puppetry and Gunslinger skills do not appear properly.The Large Ladle weapon will display as the same item color as the equipped item in the other hand.Cash items purchased with NX Credit will require you to try and claim the items twice before it moves into your inventory.Player character will hold the item Cup o' Joe incorrectly with a closed fist.Incorrect Onlooking Guard Spirit spawns in the third room of the Dynamic Lands dungeon.Slight effects issues with White-Crested Sage's Eyes, Sage's Eye, Forlon Eyes (Teary-Eyed), Awakened Eyes (Frenzied Red), and Eyes of Madness (Explosive Blue).Minor graphical issues with Soldier's Combat Raincoat.There is a known issue where characters can no longer "queue" gathering actions.The gold and ducats bar is misaligned in the main inventory.Pop-up UI message will have the header display as "OK" when listing or bidding in the Auction House.The Lucky Beast Doll Bag and Far Darrig Doll Bag's +10 Luck effects don't stack with each other.Some mail sent by Erinn Residents invited to a Spirit Campfire may have cutoff text.Some items in the Dressing Room will have random colors displayed when previewing them.The new Repurchase tab for NPC Shops appears in alphabetical order. This will be moved to the last tab for NPC Shops later.Manually inputting numbers above the maximum for Production queues will automatically change to the correct maximum amount after clicking "Start".The newly added expiration highlights for items in Pet and Partner inventories do not display correctly.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Quality of Life Details
Inventory Changes

Added the "Sort" function to sort items in your inventory bags. Each inventory bag can be sorted individually.
There is now tradeability information under the "Item Attributes" section for every item in your inventory.
You can now preview the appearance of Beauty Coupons in your inventory by right-clicking on the coupon and selecting "Preview". When hovering over a style in the Dressing Room, it will note if you have the coupon in possession.
You can now see the item's sale price if you were to sell it to an NPC under the "Item Attributes" section.
A star icon will now appear on any Doll Bag that is currently summoned.
When using the "Delete Expired Items" button in your inventory, the pop-up will now warn you of items that will be expiring soon. It will also highlight them in your inventory.
An option to tag Dye Ampoules and Gold has been added using the "Tag" function in inventory bags. Each inventory bag can be tagged individually.
You can ALT+left mouse click on an item in your inventory to move or sell it, depending on what other window is open.

You can move items to the following windows:

Pet Inventory Window
Bank
Trade window between players
NPC Shop


The search box field in your inventory will now say "Enter a search term" without having to click on it.
Several item max bundles/stack counts have been increased.

Pets

The Current and Cumulative levels of a pet can now be viewed in the Pet/Partner Window when you hover over a pet's name.
The Hotkey Settings button has been added to the Pet/Partner Info window.
You can now delete expired items in your pet's inventory by using the Expired Items function signified by the 'Hourglass' icon.

Auction House

Added the "Equip Restrictions" search filter when searching in the "Armor" category of the Auction House.

Additionally, the following searchable keywords have been added:

Human
Elf
Giant
Male
Female


When searching for specific options in the Auction House using the "Advanced Search Filter", the search filter is maintained even when refreshing the search.
When listing an item in the Auction House, it has been changed so that you can modify the price amount after highlighting any area with the mouse.
Added the "Yearly" market price range option when viewing an Item's Market Price Data in the Auction House.
The speed of searching for item names in the Auction House has been improved.
You can now list Pet Adoption Medals with stored pets on the Auction House.
The following categories have been added to the Misc section of the Auction House:

Beauty Coupon
Adoption Medal

The following advanced search filters have been added for Adoption Medals:

Price
Remaining number of adoptions
Pet race name
Pet cumulative level
Pet points
Pet type



You can now preview the following items in the Auction House:

Shamala's Transformation Medals
Beauty Coupon
Appearance Scrolls
Homestead Props
Outfit animations


Additionally, the issue of seeing abnormal animation when previewing a weapon with unique animation in the Auction House has been fixed.

The average price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal are now individually calculated according to the individual kind of Sewing Pattern, Blacksmith Manual, or Shamala's Transformation Medal item.

With the above change, the average selling price of Sewing Patterns, Blacksmith Manuals, and Shamala's Transformation Medal has been reset.


Shadow Missions

When receiving an Elite Shadow Mission, a menu will show a list of all Elite Pass items available for use in the inventory.

Items with an expiration timer will be listed first, depending on which pass expires first.
The number of passes owned won't matter.

Daily Shadow Missions now start at the same time when you first log in.

The day will reset at 7:00 AM server time.

Any daily Shadow Missions from the previous day are now automatically cancelled if you did not complete them before the reset.
The time requirement for when these Daily Shadow Missions can be completed has been removed.
A change has been made to prevent Daily Shadow Missions from being forfeited.
You cannot start the Daily Shadow Mission of that day if you have a previous quest that can be completed.

You must complete the quest and log in again or change channels to start the quest of that day.


Dressing Room

You can now preview items that are not collected in the Dressing Room. These items will be previewed in random colors each time you preview them.

Some wings are not currently available for preview, including some dyeable wings.

There is now a feature in the Dressing Room that shows if you currently have the needed Beauty Coupon in your inventory for Hair, Eyes, Face, and Mouth styles when hovering over a style.

UI Improvements

Favorite 1st and 2nd Titles can be added/removed by right-clicking the title in the Title menu. Favorites are signified by a star icon.
The "Keep Equipped Equipment" option is checked by default during rebirth. Additionally, any titles that were equipped before rebirthing are retained if you rebirth using this option.
When attempting to enter a Homestead shortly after combat, a pop-up window will now display the amount of time you must wait before entering.
The max auto-craft quantity for items created with the following Production skills have been increased to 100. Please note that special items that can only be crafted 1 at a time has not been increased.

Weaving
Handicraft
Refining
Potion Making
Carpentry
Hillwen Engineering
Magic Crafting
Fynn Crafting
Milling
Theatre Mission Pass Crafting

There is now a "Status List" menu to view all active status effects for the character.

This menu can be opened by clicking on "Details" in the Character Info menu.
The remaining duration for any status effect with a time limit can also be viewed in the Status List.

Improvements have been made to the recipe search function in the Production skill menu.

Party Board

The party board now displays the party's name..
A party created for the Mini-game Mafia can now be registered to the Party Board.
You can now sort the party list by clicking on the Party Name, Party Leader, Party Goal, Detailed Items, Restrictions, Members, or Features tab of the Party Board.
The Party Board tooltip will now display if a member of the party has a title with a Party EXP increase effect.

The tooltip will also display if the Grandmaster Cleric Unique Effect is activated.


Options Improvement

There is now an on/off option for game sounds to play even when the game screen is not active.

You can toggle this option by going to Options -> System -> Sound.

There is now a "Borderless Full Screen" mode.

You can set this mode by going to Options -> System -> Screen.

The "Full Screen" button has been removed from the System menu.

Pressing the Left Alt + Enter buttons in windowed mode will now switch to borderless full screen mode.


Bank

The Bank inventory window will now display above your inventory when you access the Bank.
Bank items can now be freely moved, similar to bags, as long as there is space available.

NPC Shops

You can now select the quantity of individual items in a NPC shop.
There is now a "Repurchase" tab in all NPC Shops. Items sold to a NPC shop can be repurchased for the price it was sold at.

Only up to 10 items, starting from the ones you sold recently, can be repurchased.
When you log out or move channels, the list of repurchasable items is reset.
You cannot repurchase items that have a Shop Sales Bonus or Exploration EXP.
You cannot repurchase items that are exempt from Bank fees.

Items with the enchants that give you extra gold when selling, cannot be repurchased.

Traveler's Guide

The Traveler's Guide search function has been improved with the following changes:

You can now search without needing to add a space.
You can now search by typing a single letter.


Friend's List

New options have been added to the Friend's list for notifications:

You can now set the use of Offline Groups for your friend's list via Friend's List -> Options.
You can now toggle guild member login notifications on/off via Friend's List -> Options.
You can now set an alert for unread notes when logging in via Friend's List -> Options.


Graphics

Characters will no longer appear semi-transparent while in Screenshot Mode.
Resolution settings are now based on the monitor in use.

4K and Ultrawide (21:9) resolution is now supported.
The "Widescreen support" option has been removed.


Other

In-game video clips now sync with your BGM volume option.
Screenshot filenames will now be saved with the year, month, day, hour, and minutes.

Hours are displayed in the 24-hour format.

notes.title: Memento Update
notes.content:
The bards encamped by Abb Neagh Lake have stumbled across something: music, an unfamiliar sound from an unfamiliar instrument, drifting over the water, stirring their curiosity. Help them meet a strange young girl in the surreal new adventure in the land of Erinn: Memento!


http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-00c9cee9-d5c1-4be8-862b-11a9af7b5017.jpg

New Storyline: Memento

The music drifts over the lake at night. Those that have gone to look have found no one behind the enchanting bells, ringing and ringing as midnight passes by. The bard Yvona, out of curiosity, or perhaps just a desire to have her rest go undisturbed, seeks out help to find out what is behind the strange sounds in the night sky...

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-b843a58c-0b8c-4842-a506-beec554be663.jpg

Characters with a cumulative level of 500 or higher will be given a quest to meet with Yvona on the banks of Abb Neagh Lake, to begin the Memento storyline. 

New Dungeons: Sidhe Finnachaid

The Memento Update brings us a new dungeon, Sidhe Finnachaid, sitting beneath the waters of Abb Neagh Lake. This dungeon has a special twist: Every time you enter the dungeon, your party leader will be able to select a version of the dungeon to battle in: Sorrow, Fear and Curiosity, each with a different Water Level, different foes to defeat and different rewards to claim.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-8de88326-c67b-48e3-a356-1e984f2f805f.jpg

Complete the Dungeon and you'll find a special bonus at the end. Sidhe Finnachaid may seem like just an ordinary dungeon (with an extraordinary disregard for the laws of physics), but it's the only place you'll find the brand new Echostones

Echostones

Echostonesare a brand new collection of power-boosting items that you'll only find in Sidhe Finnachaid. Equipped in the new Echostone section of the inventory, each stone will grant a boost to a primary stat or your Heath, Mana and SP pool, even beyond the 1500 point stat cap. But while you can Upgrade your Echostonesat the end of each Sidhe Finnachaid run, there's far more power to unlock here...

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J56-1ea1b9e4-3320-45e0-b715-8c72839182a2.jpg

At the end of Sidhe Finnachaid, you'll also be able to Awaken an Echostone by spending AP and Awakening materials collected throughout Sidhe Finnachaid. Awaken an Echostone to give it additional effects, including ones that can be found via Reforging and a special set of new abilities to grow your power even further. And if you don't like an existing Echostone's power, you can dismantle Echostones, granting Echostone Catalysts, Magic Powders and random items, including Elite Passes, gems, equipment and more.

New Skill: Dance of Death

Finish the quest, "So That You Are Not a Memory", in the Memento storyline to learn the brand new Dance of Death Skill! This skill allows you to move freely while busting a move, causing damage to enemies around you. If doing Ballet with floating hearts isn't your thing, then you can switch to different moods and themes, which you can obtain in the new Sidhe Finnachaid dungeon, by clicking the Manage Button next to the skill. The harder the difficulty, then there is a higher chance for the different Moods and Themes to drop.

Dance of Death is located under the Music Talent Tab.


Memento Events

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00J5H-df3c846d-0dbd-4b16-8744-9cee4b687288.jpg

Memento has arrived, and we're celebrating the update with a slate of bonuses and giveaways to make your experience in Sidhe Finnachaid even better! Earn double EXP this weekend, get through the storyline for a special new title, earn AP potions every day and claim special prizes for the next three weeks.

Check out the full details in the Memento Events post.

Additional Changes
Gold Rewards for the quest "Conflict! An Unexpected Battle" have been greatly reduced:
- Basic: 1,200 Gold (was 4,900 Gold)
- Int.: 1,680 Gold (was 6,860 Gold)
- Adv.: 2,400 Gold (was 9,800 Gold)
- Hard: 3,600 Gold (was 14,700 Gold)
- Elite: 4,800 Gold (was 19,600 Gold)

notes.title: G20 Update Notes
notes.content:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-732ad486-6719-4727-8175-f22c377f9a69.jpg

A new threat awakens and the Alban Knights need your help to safeguard Erinn from this unholy threat. G20 is here with the next part in the story of Mabinogi!

G20: The Gate of Sanctuary
It has been a time of troubles for the Alban Knights. The attacks by the Prophets have taxed their soldiers and shown that Erinn is not as safe as it once seemed... and now something new and terrible has seeped into Tir Chonaill. Human bodies, glowing with a golden energy before rising from the dead. Those that have completed G19's story can speak to Talvash in Tir Chonaill to get started with G20 and discover The Gate of Sanctuary!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-aff30329-dd0f-4901-b600-473cf3880696.jpg

Squires of Baltane

War has few constants, but two parts remain true: You need soldiers to fight in them, and they won't all return. No matter how well you fight, eventually new soldiers will need to be trained, and the Alban Knights have given you that honor.

For full details, click here!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00Isi-1bf1df26-4df0-4d7b-b63d-33fd5193a8bb.jpg

Divine Skill Changes

G19 saw the addition of the Divine Knights' central abilities, the Divine Skills. With G20, a brand new set of Divine Skills have been added, and a few of the previous set have been improved to grow even stronger.

For full details, click here!

New Items

A new story, new abilities and new students to train not enough? A gross of new items have also made their way to Mabinogi! Grab the following items in your quest to defend Erinn.

For full details, click here!

G20 Registration Rewards

Don't forget: If you Registered for G20, you have until May 11th, 2016 in order to claim your prizes! Simply login with your Level 50 or higher Character and claim all the goodies below!

For full details, click here!

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/fMA6V36.jpg

Lunar Fortune!
2015 is the Year of the Sheep, and this event is one way to see if your luck will be good or baaaaaad. A mysterious Fortune-teller has appeared in Dunbarton, passing out Fortune Boards to all those seeking some sheep thrills. Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK8-4940e438-fedd-4f8b-97a0-8ec94c775a8d.jpg

The Adorable Sheeptuplets Box
You've never seen sheep like these before. They walk on two legs, wear cute little outfits, lure over other sheep with their amazing personalities, and they don't even need their little wings to fly - they'll lift you off your feet as an epic Cumulosheepus! Adopt your very own Sheeptuplet, just in time for Lunar New Year!  Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00IK6-9dbe15f5-3805-482a-8121-e8a2360c501f.jpg

New Gingerbread Truck
It's a bird, it's a plane - no, it's much tastier than that! The sweet soaring Gingerbread Truck is more than just a mobile business, it's a lifelong companion with a sugary constitution. Go where you will and bring your buddies along for the ride, the land of milk and cookies is just beyond the horizon! Read More

http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/26/00G2Y-416dd02e-96fe-4459-aa0b-7b654c6b7c51.jpg
Homestead Candy Bonanza Returns
Your Homestead grows and changes with the seasons, and now is the perfect time to indulge in some seasonal Valentine's Day treats. Whether you're a botanist looking to grow a Candy Tree, a fisherman seeking some special goodies or an interior-decorating shopaholic, Candy Bonanza offers something for every homebody. Read More
